Description:
Job Summary
The High Court of Orissa, Cuttack is filling 31 posts of Junior Grade Typist / Data Entry Operator (Group-C) in its Establishment, in Level 4 of the Pay Matrix under ORSP Rules, 2017. Graduates in any discipline with PGDCA or equivalent and computer typing speed of 40 words per minute, aged above 21 and not exceeding 42 years, can apply as per Advertisement No. 07/2026.
Vacancy Details
Organisation: High Court of Orissa, Cuttack
Advertisement No.: 07/2026
Post Name: Junior Grade Typist / Data Entry Operator (Group-C)
Vacancies: 31 (including 10 for women)
Age Limit: Above 21 years and not exceeding 42 years
Application Fee: ; SC, ST and PwBD candidates exempted at their option
Job Location: Court's Establishment, High Court of Orissa, Cuttack
Application Mode: Online only
Of the total, 02 posts are for PwBDs and 01 post is for Ex-Servicemen. These posts are filled as per the relevant Acts, Rules, Orders or instructions of the State Government.
If eligible women candidates of a category are not available, the unfilled vacancies of that category will be filled by eligible male candidates of the same category.
Exchange of reservation between Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe will not be considered.
The number of vacancies is subject to change at the discretion of the Court.
Suitability for PwBD Candidates
Physical Requirement (SE, H, RW, MF): Functional Classification (OL, BL, HI)
SE - Work performed by seeing: OL - One leg affected (R and/or L)
H - Work performed by hearing/speaking: BL - Both legs affected but not arms
RW - Work performed by reading and writing: HI - Partially deaf
MF - Work performed by manipulating (with fingers)
Who Can Apply
Educational Qualification
A candidate must possess all of the following:
A Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognised University or such other qualification equivalent thereto;
Typewriting with a minimum speed of 40 words per minute in the Computer; and
PGDCA or such other qualification equivalent thereto from recognized Universities or AICTE recognized Institutions or any other Institutions recognized by the Government.
Age Limit
A candidate must be above 21 years and not exceeding 42 years of age. Name and date of birth are accepted only as entered in the High School Certificate / 10th Board Examination or equivalent certificate.
Age Relaxation
SC, ST, SEBC (Non-Creamy Layer) and Women: 5 years
PwBDs with permanent disability not less than 40% and not more than 50%: 10 years
PwBDs belonging to SC/ST/SEBC (Non-Creamy Layer): 15 years (10 years as PwBD + 5 years as SC/ST/SEBC)
Ex-Servicemen: As per relevant Acts, Rules, Orders or instructions of the State Government
A candidate who falls in more than one category gets only one age relaxation, the one most beneficial to him or her. Save as provided above, the age limit cannot be relaxed in any case.
Other Eligibility Conditions
The candidate must be a citizen of India, be of good character, and be of sound health and mind, good physique and free from any contagious or communicable disease, without bodily infirmity of more than 50%.
The candidate must not have more than one spouse living, if married.
The candidate must not have any past criminal antecedent or record, must not have been convicted by any Criminal Court for an offence involving moral turpitude, and must not have been debarred by any Government, Court or Public Service Commission or any other Commission from appearing in any Recruitment Test.
A candidate who changed name/surname after passing the High School Certificate Examination must furnish a copy of the notification in the Odisha Gazette; an application with a name discrepancy not supported by it shall be rejected.
Government servants can apply if they have the qualification and are within the age limit. They must inform their Heads of Offices in writing and produce a "No Objection Certificate" from them as and when directed.
Candidates should check the full eligibility conditions in the official notification before applying.
How to Apply for Orissa High Court Recruitment 2026
Applications are accepted only through online mode; forms sent by any other mode will be summarily rejected.

Description:
Dear Candidate,

We are looking for a dedicated and experienced Site Engineer to manage waterproofing, retrofit, repairs application projects across. The candidate will be responsible for site execution, billing, coordination with applicator manpower, and client interaction to ensure timely and quality project completion.

Please go through the Job Profile. Interested candidate are required to share their profile at shraddha.bhosle@jsw.in

Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Execution & Supervision
Supervise waterproofing application works at site.
Ensure work is executed as per technical specifications and quality standards.
Conduct site inspections and resolve technical issues.
Maintain daily progress reports.
2. Billing & Documentation
Prepare client RA bills and subcontractor/applicator bills.
Measure work quantities and maintain proper billing records.
Coordinate with accounts for timely submission and approvals.
Maintain material reconciliation statements.
3. Manpower Coordination
Coordinate with applicator teams and subcontractors.
Ensure availability of required manpower and materials.
Monitor productivity and discipline at site.
Provide technical guidance to applicators.
4. Client Coordination
Act as the primary point of contact at site.
Attend client meetings and provide project updates.
Handle site-related queries and ensure client satisfaction.
Coordinate for approvals, inspections, and certifications.
5. Planning & Material Management
Plan daily and weekly work schedules.
Ensure proper storage and usage of waterproofing materials.
Monitor material consumption and reduce wastage.
Preferred Candidate Profile:
Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering.
25 years of experience in waterproofing or construction site execution.
Good knowledge of waterproofing systems (PU coating, APP membrane, injection grouting, etc.).
Strong billing and measurement skills.
Basic knowledge of MS Excel and billing software.

SUMMARY
Job Description Junior Accountant

Location: Bhubaneswar, Odisha
Experience: 3+ Years
Qualification: B.Com / B.Com (Honours)
Salary: 20,000 25,000 per Month
Employment Type: Full - Time
Gender : Male

Job Summary
We are looking for a detail-oriented Junior Accountant to handle day-to-day accounting activities, financial records, and documentation while ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting.
Key Responsibilities
Maintain daily accounting records and financial transactions.
Handle accounts payable, receivable, and payment entries.
Prepare and maintain invoices, vouchers, and bills.
Assist with bank reconciliation and ledger management.
Maintain GST-related records and support tax documentation.
Assist in preparing financial reports and statements.
Ensure proper filing and maintenance of accounting documents.


Requirements
B.Com / B.Com (Honours) qualification.
Minimum 3 years of relevant accounting experience.
Knowledge of Tally, MS Excel, and basic accounting principles.
Familiarity with GST, invoicing, and bank reconciliation.
Good numerical, organizational, and documentation skills.

Expert knowledge of diesel engine diagnostics, repair, overhaul, rebuilding, and preventive maintenance.
Hands-on experience performing major engine overhauls (B, C, and D checks).
Strong experience with Cummins engine platforms such as KTAA19 G10, KTA50L, and QSK50 .
Advanced troubleshooting skills for mechanical, electrical, fuel, cooling, exhaust, control, and aftertreatment systems.
Experience supporting REPI, repower, new engine installation, commissioning, and railway workshop activities .
Strong knowledge of railway applications, including Power Cars, Tower Cars, HS SPART, Track Machines, and DEMU.
Proficiency in electronic diagnostic tools, service software, and technical documentation.
Ability to interpret engineering drawings, wiring diagrams, service manuals, and technical publications.
Strong analytical, diagnostic, and root cause analysis skills.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and customer relationship skills.
Ability to coordinate effectively with railway authorities, dealerships, workshop personnel, and cross-functional teams.
Leadership and mentoring skills with the ability to coach and develop junior technicians.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple field service activities and priorities.
Commitment to workplace safety, quality, continuous improvement, and customer satisfaction.
Experience
Significant experience in field service, engine overhaul, repair, diagnostics, and maintenance of diesel engines or heavy-duty equipment.
Expert-level experience with Cummins engine products, particularly KTAA19 G10, KTA50L, QSK50 , or equivalent heavy-duty diesel engines.
Proven experience performing major engine overhaul, rebuild, installation, commissioning, and repower activities.
Experience supporting railway, locomotive, industrial, power generation, or heavy equipment applications is strongly preferred.
Experience coordinating with railway authorities, depot personnel, dealerships, and internal engineering or service teams.
Customer-facing service experience with a demonstrated ability to resolve complex technical issues and build strong customer relationships.
Competencies:
Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Develops talent - Developing people to meet both their career goals and the organization s goals.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Manages conflict - Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Diagnostics Application - Translates customer complaints to develop troubleshooting plan; troubleshoots issue following guided work flows, procedures, specialized equipment such as mechanical and electronic service tools, and diagnoses computer software to isolate failed components to enable a successful repair; validates repair by duplicating complaint to ensure it has been resolved; documents results of troubleshooting in business systems to communicate what has been done for payment and historical tracking.

Electronic Service Tool Application - Identifies the suite of available hardware and software tools required for a service event; utilizes the appropriate electronic tool set to maintain the product or diagnose and troubleshoot an issue; interprets electronic tool results or recommendations to determine next steps for service resolution.

Engine Systems Interactions - Interprets and analyzes the interactions of internal and external electrical and mechanical systems (exhaust, heating, cooling, fuel systems, driveline, aftertreatment, controls, sensors, etc. ) by applying tools, service publications (Cummins, Original Equipment Manufacturer) and taking measurements to efficiently and correctly diagnose and repair.

Product Repair and Maintenance - Repairs and maintains mechanical/electrical products following guidelines, using required tools within standard repair time to ensure a quality repair; disassembles and assembles engines or power generators following guidelines, using required tools to ensure a clean and organized environment; inspects and replaces parts and components following re-use guidelines to minimize customers cost of ownership; performs progressive damage check following guidelines to restore to pre-failure condition.

Service Documentation - Creates and verifies customer, equipment and technical information; captures specific data using required service tools; follows procedures and documents required information in the service management system in order to have an accurate record of the work done.

Technical Escalation - Obtains product technical issue information and utilizes available resources including data management tools; elevates issues to a higher level of expertise, balancing timeliness of customer response with investigation efforts; captures all troubleshooting steps in the appropriate database in order to ensure seamless transitions and accurate response to ticket resolution in a timely manner.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

SUMMARY
WE’RE HIRING! Intern to Engineer Program
Job Title: Field Service Engineer Intern CCTV / ATM
Location:  jeypore
Industry: Electronic Security / ATM / Field Service
Employment Type: 9-Month Internship / Trainee Program
Stipend: 15,000 per month
Vacancies: 9 Apprentices
Job Overview:
We are hiring for a structured 9-month Intern-to-Engineer Program. Selected candidates will receive hands-on technical training from Senior Engineers in CCTV, electronic surveillance, ATM systems, installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting. Candidates who successfully clear the final assessment may be considered for full-time Engineer positions based on performance and approved business requirements.
Key Responsibilities
Assist Senior Engineers with CCTV, surveillance, and ATM installation and maintenance.
Learn troubleshooting, fault diagnosis, repair, and preventive maintenance.
Perform field service activities under supervision and gradually take ownership of assigned tasks.
Update service tickets, maintain reports, and follow SLA and documentation standards.
Follow safety protocols, site procedures, and customer service guidelines.
Coordinate with the technical team to resolve customer issues.


Requirements
Qualification:  Btech electronical/ ITI / Diploma / Graduate.
Experience: Freshers or candidates with up to 12 months of relevant experience.
Interest in electronics, CCTV, networking, ATM systems, or field service.
Willingness to travel and work at customer sites within the assigned territory.
Good communication, learning ability, and problem-solving skills.

Only male candidates can apply. 
Willingness to work in a field-based role.
Program Structure
Months 1 3: Technical training and shadowing with Senior Engineers.
Months 4 6: Guided fieldwork, supervised service calls, and performance assessment.
Months 7 9: Progressive independent deployment and final assessment.
Career Opportunity: Eligible candidates may be converted to full-time Engineer roles after completing the program and meeting company criteria.


Benefits
Monthly Stipend: 15,000.
Structured on-the-job technical training.
Hands-on exposure to CCTV, ATM, and electronic surveillance systems.
Opportunity for full-time Engineer conversion based on performance and business requirements.

Communication, implementation and compliance of all Corporate policies in the Centre.

Description:
Assists the Front Office Manager in administering front office functions and supervising staff on a daily basis.
Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk.
Position directs and works with managers and employees to carry out procedures ensuring an efficient check in and check out process.
Ensures guest and employee satisfaction and maximizes the ficial performance of the department.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Supporting Management of Front Desk Team
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Supervises and manages employees.
Managing all day-to-day operations.
Understanding employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Ensures employee recognition is taking place on all shifts.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees.
Monitoring and Supporting Progress Toward Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Collaborates with the Front Office Manager on ways to continually improve departmental service.
- Communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Office goals to produce desired results.
- Participates in the development and implementation of corrective action plans based on review of comment cards and guest satisfaction results.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Displays outstanding hospitality skills.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Interacts with customers on a regular basis to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
- Provides feedback to employees based on observation of service behaviors.
- Handles guest problems and complaints effectively.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
Managing Projects and Policies
- Implements the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
- Ensures compliance with all Front Office policies, standards and procedures.
- Monitors adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors and co-workers by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
- Functions in place of the Front Office Manager in his/her absence.
- Communicates critical information from pre- and post-convention meetings to the Front Office staff.
- Participates in department meetings.

Purpose of the Job:-

The purpose of the CI role is to ensure that the BHL sites are managed efficiently through proper maintenance of Equipments, management of stakeholders and OPEX control with the objective of driving higher uptime and Optimizing energy costs within company guidelines of Operations and Maintenance & Code of Conduct.







Prepare & monitor preventive maintenance (PM) Schedule; review the technician & vendor performance (Site visit, SLAs etc.).Periodically as per defined Parameters, ensure proper documentation of reports (Field service reports, log books etc.) accurately and Timely, supervise maintenance and working of Equipments like network monitoring systems, PIUs for Alarms to avoid major outage and drive better uptime and guide technicians in their work.
Conduct root cause analysis for breakdowns, analyses past PM data; review alarm status at the time of
Breakdown; guide technician on troubleshooting in order to identify causes of breakdown and ensure timely.
30% Compliance with PM Schedules, Site Audit compliance, Feedback, Higher Uptime, PIU working at Site, Accurate and timely Documentation No. of breakdowns at Site/Outages.



Conduct site visits to monitor site hygiene and safety, carry out periodic audits of log books, diesel filling
sheets and processes at site; supervise key management; monitor repair and maintenance in order to ensure that all assets are maintained in proper conditions and there is no discrepancy around rating of assets or any theft/misuse, No. of site visits, Repair & Maintenance cost.



Control energy OPEX by keeping DG on auto mode and utilizing battery back-up as planned, ensuring no overrated equipment is operated at site; monitor and analyses consumption patterns; identify discrepancies and negative trends; coordinate with technicians to take corrective actions to optimize diesel usage, monitor & document DG/battery/EB run hour and take corrective actions as required, control caretakers/landlords so that they do not interfere with operations & diesel-filling etc.
Liase with EB to ensure bills are generated and paid on time, resolve issues around line layout and bill
generation(especially meter reading), payment to avoid disconnection and any other EB related rectification and repair 20% Timely payment of EB bills No Disconnection/ penalties Diesel consumption



Engage with landlords to effectively deal with issues arising out of diesel theft, interference with equipment, usage and working, take timely feedback about rentals received etc. to pre-empt/minimize site outage due to landlord interference and protect company assets. Liase with community, local administration, police, EB officials etc
Create database of site history and issues to share experiences with team and proactively address
Potential problems. Follow up with internal stakeholders (legal/estate/Operations/ Infra/ Supply/ Purchase/Deployment/ Quality/ etc.) for tracking of equipment, work order, services etc. respond to & escalate unresolved issues to ensure timely closure of work orders and site support as required



Monitor details of equipments and their maintenance schedule, monitor vendor SLAs, cross verify FSRs filled by vendors with technician reports and site visit, coordinate with vendors in case of issues on site for timely service, give feedback to management for levy of penalties on default, resolve any escalated issues/ guide technicians on vendor management in order to ensure that all contractual obligations and SLA clauses are met by vendors and maintain asset lifespan.





B Tech/ Diploma in electrical/ Telecom/Mechanical /Automobile engineering with experience of 2-3 years in the Telecom sector (preferably).
Should possess good working knowledge of electrical equipments & past people management experience is preferred
Good knowledge of MS Office.
Equipment and Maintenance Knowledge Equipment Demonstrates in-depth knowledge of electrical equipment (PIU, SMPS, AC, Battery Bank, power plant, PCM, EB meter, panels etc.) and DG set.
Site Installation Demonstrates adequate knowledge of installation & commissioning procedures for equipment as well as cables, load connections, wires, required voltages etc. in order to ensure proper site setup and working.
Works in partnership with others, is flexible and willing to support others while achieving common goals.
Shows willingness to learn new methods by self-learning and learning by doing.
Identifies new ideas, solutions, in dealing with situations, suggesting new ways of doing things.
Execution Excellence- Strategic Agility Planning & Analysis.

Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Helps drive company values and philosophy and ensures all training and development activities are strategically linked to the organization s mission and vision. Works with property leadership team to identify and address employee and organizational development needs. The position is responsible for ensuring effective training is in place to enable the achievement of desired business results. Training programs focus on a variety of topics, including product knowledge, company philosophy, and customer service and leadership skills. Conducts needs assessments, designs and develops training programs and facilitates the delivery of both custom and corporate training programs. Measures the effectiveness of training to ensure a return on investment.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the human resources or related professional area; certified trainer.
OR
- 4-year bachelors degree in Human Resources, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; certified trainer; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Administering Employee Training Programs
- Promotes and informs employees about all training programs.
- Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Helps employees identify specific behaviors that will contribute to service excellence.
- Ensures employees receive on-going training to understand guest expectations.
- Uses effective training methods to ensure employees have a good understanding of guest satisfaction and can demonstrate guest satisfaction skills.
- Meets with training cadre on a regular basis to support training efforts.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals and/or managers.
Evaluating Training Programs Effectiveness
- Monitors enrollment and attendance at training classes.
- Meets regularly with participants to assess progress and address concerns.
- Partners with operational leaders to assess if employees demonstrate effective technical and leadership skills.
- Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.
- Measures transfer of learning from training courses to the operation.
- Ensures adult learning principles are incorporated into training programs.
Developing Training Program Plans and Budgets
- Ensures all training and development activities (department specific and general property training) are strategically linked to the organization s mission and vision.
- Identifies performance gaps and works with managers to develop and implement appropriate training to improve performance.
- Makes any necessary adjustments to training methodology and/or re-trains as appropriate.
- Aligns current training and development programs to effectively impact key business indicators.
- Establishes guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters.
- Develops specific training to improve service performance.
- Drives brand values and philosophy in all training and development activities.
- Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of departmental meetings with a focus on continuous improvement.
Managing Training Budgets
- Participates in the development of the Training budget as required.
- Manages budget in alignment with Human Resources and property financial goals.
- Manages department controllable expenses to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
- Utilizes P-card if appropriate to control and monitor departmental expenditures.

Description:
Responsible for preparing all event documentation and coordinates with Sales, property departments and customer to ensure consistent, high level service throughout pre-event, event and post-event phases of property events.
This position primarily handles events of average complexity.
Ensures their property events have a seamless turnover from sales to service back to sales.
Recognizes opportunities to maximize revenue opportunities by up-selling and offering enhancements to create outstanding events.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; experienced (1 - 2 years of experience) in the event management or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; at least 1 year experience in the event management or related professional area required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Event Logistics and Operations
- Ensures that events progress seamlessly by following established procedures, collaborating with other employees, and ensuring accuracy.
- Greets customer during the event phase and hands-off to the Event Operations team for the execution of details.
- Adheres to all standards, policies, and procedures.
- Ensures billing accuracy and conducts bill reviews with the clients prior to processing the final bill.
- Manages group room blocks and meeting space for average to large-sized assigned groups.
- Identifies operational challenges associated with his/her group and determines how to best work with the property staff and customer to solve these challenges and/or develop alternative solutions.
- Uses his/her judgment to integrate current trends in event management and event design.
- Acts as liaison between field salesperson and customer throughout the event process (pre-event, event, post-event).
- Participates in customer site inspections and assists with the sales process as necessary.
- Performs other duties as assigned to meet business needs.
- Solicits feedback from the property departments to identify areas for improvement to enhance the Event Planner s experience.
Ensuring and Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Delivers excellent customer service throughout the customer experience and encourages the same from other employees.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Coordinates and communicates event details both verbally and in writing to the customer and property operations.
- Makes presence known to customer at all times during this process.
- Oversees his/her customer experiences from file turnover through the post event phase until turnover back to sales.
- Follows up with customer post-event.
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Uses personal judgment and expertise to enhance the customer experience.
- Stays available to solve problems and/or suggest alternatives to previous arrangements.
- Works to continually improve customer service by integrating obtained feedback and personal judgment into action plans.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Ensures hourly employees understand expectations and parameters for event activities.
Leading Event Management Teams
- Conducts formal pre- and post-event meetings as required to review/communicate group needs and feedback.
- Leads formal pre-event and post-event meetings for average to large-sized assigned groups.
- Facilitates various meetings as he/she perceives necessary (Banquet Event Order meeting, block review, etc).
Supporting and Coordinating with the Sales and Marketing Function
- Assists in the sales process and revenue forecasting for customer groups.
- Up-sells products and services throughout the event process.
- Forecasts group sleeping rooms and event revenue (catering and audio visual) for his/her groups.
Conducting Human Resources Activities
- Reviews comment cards and guest satisfaction results with employees.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals and/or managers.
- Assists in the development and implementation of corrective action plans.
- Take initiative to use his/her experience to improve service performance according to his/her evaluation of the issue and resolution.
- Works with the property staff and customers to address operational challenges associated with his/her group.
- Performs other duties as assigned to meet business needs.

We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Designation: Assistant Manager Civil

Department: Civil / Project Execution
Industry: Infrastructure / EPC / Construction
Reporting To: Project Manager / Construction Manager
Job Location: Manipur, Noney Market

Job Purpose

To manage and supervise civil construction activities at project sites, ensuring timely execution, quality standards, safety compliance and optimum utilization of manpower, materials and machinery in accordance with project specifications and approved drawings.

Roles & Responsibilities

1. Project Execution & Site Management

Supervise day-to-day civil construction activities at project sites.

Ensure execution of work as per approved drawings, specifications and project schedules.

Coordinate activities related to railway tunnels, hydro tunnels, bridges and other infrastructure projects.

Monitor daily progress and ensure achievement of project milestones.

Identify site-related challenges and take corrective measures.

2. Planning & Coordination

Coordinate with Project Managers, Planning, Billing, Procurement, Stores and other departments.

Prepare daily, weekly and monthly work progress reports.

Ensure timely availability of manpower, materials and equipment.

Monitor project schedules and highlight delays or deviations.

3. Quality Control

Ensure civil works comply with approved quality standards and technical specifications.

Coordinate inspections and quality checks at different stages of construction.

Ensure proper implementation of quality control procedures.

Maintain site records, inspection reports and relevant documentation.

4. Manpower & Resource Management

Allocate and supervise manpower, contractors and subcontractors.

Monitor workforce productivity and site performance.

Ensure optimum utilization of construction materials, machinery and resources.

Maintain discipline and coordination among site teams.

5. Safety & Compliance

Ensure implementation of safety policies and site safety procedures.

Coordinate with the Safety Department to maintain a safe working environment.

Ensure compliance with statutory requirements and company policies.

Report unsafe practices, incidents and site hazards.

6. Documentation & Reporting

Maintain daily progress reports, site measurement records and work registers.

Coordinate with the Billing Department for quantity verification and RA bills.

Maintain records of material consumption and work completion.

Submit periodic project updates to senior management.

Educational Qualification

B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering or Diploma in Civil Engineering.

Relevant technical certifications will be an added advantage.

6- 8 years of relevant experience in civil construction / infrastructure / EPC projects.

Experience in railway tunnels, hydro tunnels, underground construction or heavy civil infrastructure projects will be preferred.

Experience in site execution, contractor management and project coordination is essential.

Required Skills & Competencies

Strong knowledge of civil construction methods and engineering drawings.

Project planning and execution skills.

Manpower and contractor management.

Knowledge of quality control and safety standards.

Problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

Strong communication and coordination skills.

Proficiency in MS Office and AutoCAD.

Ability to work independently at project locations.

Description:
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Attendant Operator to join our team at Sumitomo Chemical India Private Limited. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in chemical plant operations and be able to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

Roles and Responsibility


Operate and maintain chemical plant equipment for safe and efficient production.

Monitor and control chemical processes to meet quality and quantity standards.

Collaborate with other operators and maintenance staff to troubleshoot issues.

Implement safety procedures and protocols to prevent accidents and injuries.

Conduct regular inspections of equipment and facilities to identify areas for improvement.

Develop and implement process improvements to increase productivity and reduce costs.


Job Requirements


Strong knowledge of chemical plant operations and safety procedures.

Ability to work effectively in a team environment and communicate clearly with colleagues.

Familiarity with chemical plant software and instrumentation.

Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Ability to lift heavy objects and stand for long periods.

High school diploma or equivalent required; degree in a relevant field preferred.

About the Role
An ATM Field Service Engineer is responsible for the entire lifecycle of ATMs, from pre-installation and setup to ongoing maintenance and repair. This includes training clients on ATM usage, performing preventive maintenance to avoid problems, troubleshooting malfunctions, and completing repairs to get ATMs back up and running quickly. They also interact directly with customers to address any concerns and provide excellent customer service. The role requires a proactive approach, responding immediately to all complaints and scheduling preventive maintenance to minimize downtime. For complex issues, collaboration with the customer support team and R&D department is necessary. A valid 2-wheeler license and motorbike are essential for travel to various ATM locations.
About the Company
Vortex Engineering is a Chennai, India-based Technology company focused on building innovative products for the ATM/self-service market. The company has a family of ATM HW & SW products with around 10K installations and a portfolio of software products for the management of multivendor ATMs and other value-added applications. Our customers include leading banks in India and a growing set of new customers in growth countries in Asia, ME & Africa.
Vortex Engineering is revolutionizing self-service product space with unique firsts in the industry

Lowest carbon footprint with ultra-low power design, making it viable for solar-powered deployments
Most sustainable, and the only commercially successful ATM to run on an open-source Linux platform
Only Indian company (and one of a few globally) to have developed and patented dispenser technology
Developing next-generation secured Hardware & Software products using IoT, AI, ML & 5G

The company has a partnership with IIT-Madras for R&D on the latest cutting-edge technologies and offers exciting career opportunities for dynamic individuals with a passion to innovate, lead, take larger responsibilities and grow with the company.

Job Description QA/QC Engineer (Railway Tunnel Project)
Designation: QA/QC Engineer
Department: Quality Control
Project: Railway Tunnel / Railway Infrastructure
Experience: 5–10 Years (relevant tunnel experience preferred)
Qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering
Location: Project Site
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced QA/QC Engineer with railway tunnel construction experience to ensure that all civil construction activities comply with approved drawings, project specifications, quality standards, and applicable codes.
Key Responsibilities
Implement and maintain the project Quality Assurance and Quality Control (QA/QC) plan.
Inspect railway tunnel construction activities, including excavation, rock support, shotcrete, rock bolting, grouting, waterproofing, and concrete lining.
Monitor tunnel excavation and construction activities as per approved drawings and method statements.
Conduct inspections and coordinate material testing, laboratory tests, and field tests.
Verify the quality of concrete, reinforcement, cement, aggregates, and other construction materials.
Prepare and maintain Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), checklists, inspection requests, and quality records.
Coordinate with the client, consultant, and construction team for inspections and approvals.
Identify non-conformities (NCRs), recommend corrective actions, and ensure closure.
Ensure compliance with approved method statements, technical specifications, and relevant IS/IRC/railway standards.
Prepare quality reports, test reports, and documentation for audits.
Monitor subcontractor quality and ensure compliance with project requirements.
Support internal and external quality audits and ensure timely closure of observations.
Required Skills and Experience
Experience in railway tunnel construction projects is preferred.
Knowledge of tunnel excavation methods, including NATM, where applicable.
Knowledge of shotcrete, rock bolts, lattice girders, steel ribs, grouting, and tunnel lining.
Experience in QA/QC documentation, material testing, and site inspections.
Familiarity with drawings, specifications, method statements, and ITPs.
Good coordination and communication skills with clients and consultants.
Preferred Experience
Candidates with experience in railway tunnels, underground structures, highway tunnels, or other major infrastructure projects will be preferred.

Description:
The Asian International University is looking for Estate Manager to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.An Estate Manager, also known as a Property Manager or Estate Supervisor, is responsible for overseeing and managing various aspects of a property or estate, ensuring its efficient operation and maintenance. Estate Managers can work in residential, commercial, or institutional settings, and their duties may vary based on the size and nature of the estate they are managing.

Key Responsibilities:

Property Maintenance:

Supervise and coordinate maintenance and repair tasks.
Ensure the property is clean, well-maintained, and aesthetically pleasing.
Manage landscaping, gardening, and outdoor maintenance activities.
Regularly inspect the property to identify maintenance needs and address them promptly.
Financial Management:

Prepare and manage budgets for property operations and maintenance.
Monitor expenses, approve invoices, and reconcile financial records.
Negotiate contracts with vendors and service providers to ensure cost-effective services.
Security and Safety:

Implement and oversee security measures to safeguard the property and its occupants.
Coordinate with security personnel and install security systems as necessary.
Develop and enforce safety protocols and emergency procedures.
Tenant and Guest Relations:

Interact with tenants, guests, and residents in a professional and courteous manner.
Address tenant concerns, complaints, and requests promptly and effectively.
Conduct regular tenant meetings and ensure a high level of tenant satisfaction.
Staff Management:

Recruit, train, and supervise estate staff, such as maintenance workers, security personnel, and housekeeping staff.
Delegate tasks and responsibilities to staff members.
Conduct performance evaluations and provide feedback to employees.
Administrative Tasks:

Maintain accurate records of property-related activities, contracts, and expenses.
Prepare regular reports for property owners or management.
Handle administrative tasks such as scheduling, correspondence, and document management.
Compliance and Regulations:

Ensure the property complies with local, state, and federal regulations and codes.
Stay updated on relevant laws and regulations affecting property management.
Obtain necessary licenses and permits for the property's operation.
Project Management:

Oversee renovation, remodeling, and construction projects on the property.
Coordinate with contractors, architects, and designers to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Business, Property Management, Hospitality, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Previous experience in property management, estate management, or a related field is highly desirable.
Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Knowledge of property management software and basic financial principles.
Ability to multitask, prioritize tasks, and work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
Leadership skills and the ability to motivate and manage a team effectively.

Description:
AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Description:
About the company

Treebo Hospitality Ventures (THV) is a hotel group operating with a mission of "democratising
the joy of travel". We focus on the affordable segments of the market economy to
mid-market to cater to the next 100 million travellers who will experience the joy of travel
over the next 10 years. We offer these guests a high-quality experience at an affordable price
point, with a portfolio of 800+ hotels across 120+ cities.
We operate through multiple brands catering to different sub-segments:
Itsy (1000–1500)
Treebo and Treebo Premium (1500–3000)
Medalio, our newly launched affordable luxury brand (3000–6000 per night)

We are the most loved hotel chain in the affordable segment, with an average rating of 7.8/10
across independent review platforms — and we are just getting started

About the Role
As an Area General Manager, you will be responsible for executing the companys strategic vision of
democratizing the joy of travel. You will be responsible for a given area and the portfolio there in to ensure
highest levels of guest experience, product quality and business & profitability of the assets. While managing
the operations and enabling sales for your portfolio, you will also drive the expansion of our hotel portfolio
across your area and beyond through your network. This is a mission critical role that requires a perfect
balance of delivering operational excellence, relationship management, and a business development mindset.

Key Responsibilities
1) Operational Excellence Oversee day-to-day operations across multiple hotel properties in your area, ensuring adherence to
brand standards and service benchmarks
Drive compliance with Treebo's brand standards and SOPs, health and safety guidelines, and service
quality norms
Conduct audits, quality assurance checks, and drive corrective/preventive actions through hotel partners
to maintain Treebo standards
Act as the key liaison between the company and hotel partners, ensuring seamless coordination and
timely issue resolution
Monitor and enhance overall guest satisfaction by ensuring prompt and effective service recovery
mechanisms
2) Business Development & Growth
Identify, evaluate, and onboard new hotel properties to expand the company’s portfolio within the
assigned area
Negotiate terms of the agreement and ensure complete alignment with Treebo's operating procedures
before onboarding any hotel
Collaborate with the central business development team to oversee launch process of the signed
properties
3) Sales & MICE
Drive regional sales performance by collaborating with internal sales teams and property owners to
achieve revenue targets for your portfolio
Identify and push sales POCs to close MICE deals for your portfolio properties
Support pricing, promotions, and campaigns to drive business at the property level
Engage with local corporate clients, event organizers, and travel planners to push business to your
portfolio if needed
4) Team & Partner Management
Lead, mentor, and develop on-ground portfolio hotel teams to deliver exceptional guest experience in the
segment
Train hotel staff in brand values, SOPs, and customer service skills to ensure consistency
Build strong relationships with hotel owners and partners to foster collaboration and long-term association

What Are We Looking For
Strong communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
4–6 years of experience in hospitality management with demonstrated success in both operations and
business development.
Proven experience in property acquisition and/or sales in hospitality.
Knowledge and experience in the MICE segment is highly desirable.
Analytical mindset with problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.
Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned geography.
Entrepreneurial approach with a strong focus on execution and accountability

Job Title: US IT Recruiter (Multiple Openings) Fresher to Senior Level
Location: Salem, Tamil Nadu, Pondicherry
Experience: 0-10+ Years
Shift: Night Shift ( US Staffing)
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary:
We are looking for US IT Recruiters at different experience levels Freshers, Junior, Mid-Level, and Senior Recruiters — to join our recruitment team in Salem and Pondicherry.The role will be assigned based on the candidate's experience, skills, and knowledge of the US IT Staffing process.Freshers with good communication skills and a strong willingness to learn are welcome to apply. Experienced candidates should have hands-on experience in US IT Recruitment and candidate sourcing.Key Responsibilities
Source IT professionals using Dice, LinkedIn Recruiter, Monster, CareerBuilder, job boards, referrals, and other sourcing platforms.
Understand job descriptions and identify suitable candidates based on client requirements.
Search and identify candidates using Boolean search, keyword search, resume databases, and other sourcing techniques.
Review resumes and shortlist qualified candidates based on technical skills and experience.
Conduct initial candidate screening to assess skills, experience, communication, availability, location, work authorization, and interest.
Communicate job opportunities and requirements clearly to candidates.
Maintain regular communication and follow-up with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
Coordinate interviews and follow up on interview feedback.
Negotiate candidate salary/rate expectations within approved guidelines.
Collect required candidate information and documentation.
Submit qualified candidates to clients/account managers within the required timelines.
Maintain accurate candidate records, submissions, interview status, and recruitment activities in the ATS.
Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified IT professionals.
Meet daily, weekly, and monthly recruitment targets.
Maintain quality submissions and ensure timely completion of recruitment activities.
Experience-Level Expectations Fresher / Junior (0–2 Years):
Good communication skills and willingness to learn US IT Recruitment.
Learn and perform candidate sourcing, resume screening, candidate calling, and interview coordination.
Previous recruitment experience or internship is an advantage but not mandatory for freshers.
Mid-Level (2–7 Years):
Independently manage assigned US IT recruitment requirements.
Strong experience in sourcing, screening, candidate engagement, submissions, and interview coordination.
Ability to manage multiple requirements and consistently achieve recruitment targets.
Senior Level (7-10+ Years):
Handle complex, niche, and high-priority US IT requirements independently.
Strong expertise in advanced sourcing, candidate screening, rate negotiation, and candidate management.
Ability to mentor junior recruiters and contribute to team performance and recruitment strategies.
Required Skills
Good verbal and written communication skills.
Strong interpersonal and candidate engagement skills.
Good analytical and organizational skills.
Ability to work in a target-driven and fast-paced environment.
Basic understanding of IT technologies and technical terminology.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel, Word, and Outlook.
Willingness to work during US business hours / night shift.
Preferred Skills – Experienced Candidates
Hands-on experience in US IT Staffing / US IT Recruitment.
Experience with Dice, LinkedIn Recruiter, Monster, CareerBuilder, or similar sourcing platforms.
Knowledge of Boolean search and candidate sourcing techniques.
Understanding of W2, C2C, and 1099 hiring models.
Knowledge of US work authorization and visa categories such as H-1B, OPT, CPT, GC, and USC.
Experience with ATS platforms.
Knowledge of different IT skill sets and technical job requirements.
Experience working with VMS or client/vendor requirements is an advantage.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
MBA HR, B.E./B.Tech, B.Sc., BCA, or other relevant qualifications are preferred.
Freshers are welcome to apply.
Candidate Profile
We are looking for candidates who are:
Interested in building or advancing their career in US IT Staffing.
Good at communication and relationship building.
Willing to work in a night-shift environment aligned with US business hours.
Target-oriented and committed to achieving recruitment goals.
Willing to learn and continuously improve recruitment skills.
Candidates will be considered for the appropriate level based on their experience, skills, and demonstrated recruitment capabilities.

Description:
Role & Responsibilities 1. Manufacturing Line Quality Inspection
Conduct in-process quality inspections at all manufacturing stages to ensure products conform to approved drawings, specifications, and customer requirements.
Perform first-piece inspection, setup approval, patrol inspection, and periodic quality checks.
Verify Critical to Quality (CTQ) and Critical to Process (CTP) characteristics.
Ensure inspection activities are performed as per Control Plans, Work Instructions, and approved inspection standards.
Identify, report, and escalate quality abnormalities and process deviations.
Ensure only conforming products are released to the next process.
2. Process Quality Monitoring
Monitor manufacturing processes to ensure compliance with approved process parameters and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
Verify machine settings, fixtures, tools, gauges, and inspection equipment during production.
Monitor critical process parameters and ensure operators follow approved work instructions.
Verify process changeovers, model changes, and production setup approvals.
Ensure process controls, Poka-Yoke systems, and defect-prevention mechanisms are functioning effectively.
Conduct process verification following machine breakdowns, maintenance activities, parameter changes, or abnormal production conditions.
3. First-Piece Inspection & Setup Approval
Conduct first-piece inspection following production setup, model changes, tooling changes, or process adjustments.
Verify product dimensions, visual characteristics, electrical parameters, and functional requirements, as applicable.
Ensure production starts only after the required quality approval.
Maintain first-piece inspection records and ensure proper traceability.
Verify setup approval effectiveness and monitor initial production for abnormalities.
4. Defect Identification & Containment
Identify, segregate, and control non-conforming products.
Implement immediate containment actions for process defects and critical quality abnormalities.
Ensure defective and suspect materials are clearly identified and physically segregated.
Stop production or escalate to the concerned team in case of critical quality issues.
Ensure containment covers affected machines, production lines, shifts, batches, and products.
Verify rework and repair activities as per approved instructions.
Prevent rejected products from being mixed with accepted products.
5. Inspection & Testing
Perform visual, dimensional, electrical, functional, and other specified inspections.
Verify product characteristics against approved drawings, specifications, inspection standards, and sample criteria.
Conduct inspections using appropriate measuring instruments, gauges, and testing equipment.
Verify the calibration status and condition of inspection equipment before use.
Record inspection results accurately and maintain proper traceability.
Support destructive testing and validation activities, as required.
6. Quality Documentation & Traceability
Maintain inspection reports, patrol inspection records, first-piece approval records, defect records, and quality check sheets.
Ensure inspection results and process abnormalities are properly documented.
Maintain product traceability through lot number, batch number, date code, machine number, and shift details.
Ensure quality records are completed accurately and within specified timelines.
Support quality documentation updates following engineering or process changes.
7. Problem Solving & Corrective Actions
Support root cause analysis of manufacturing defects and quality abnormalities.
Participate in problem-solving activities using:
5 Why Analysis
Fishbone Diagram
Pareto Analysis
8D Problem Solving
Provide defect samples, inspection data, and process information to support investigations.
Verify corrective action implementation at the manufacturing line.
Monitor corrective action effectiveness and ensure recurrence prevention.
Escalate repeated defects and abnormal trends to Quality Engineers and Supervisors.
8. Product & Process Audits
Conduct layered process audits, product audits, and process compliance checks.
Verify adherence to:
Control Plans
Work Instructions
Standard Operating Procedures
Inspection Standards
Customer-Specific Requirements
IATF 16949 requirements
Verify operator compliance, process parameters, product identification, traceability, and defect-prevention controls.
Identify audit findings and ensure timely corrective action implementation.
9. Quality Data Monitoring
Collect and analyze manufacturing defect data.
Monitor rejection, rework, scrap, and defect trends.
Maintain daily defect reports and quality performance records.
Support Pareto analysis and defect-reduction activities.
Monitor process rejection trends and communicate abnormal performance.
Support PPM reduction and continuous improvement initiatives.
10. Cross-Functional Coordination
Coordinate with Production Supervisors, Operators, Quality Engineers, Manufacturing Engineering, Maintenance, Process Engineering, NPI/Engineering, Incoming Quality, and Warehouse/Logistics teams.
Communicate quality abnormalities promptly and ensure effective containment.
Support production teams in maintaining process discipline and quality standards.
Participate in daily quality meetings and continuous improvement activities.
India Nippon Electricals is seeking a motivated and skilled Engineer to join our dynamic team. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and testing electrical components and systems. The role requires collaboration with cross-functional teams to ensure product quality and reliability. The Engineer will analyze project requirements, create technical specifications, and oversee the implementation of engineering solutions. Additionally, the Engineer will participate in troubleshooting and maintenance of electrical systems, ensuring adherence to safety standards and compliance with industry regulations.

Job Description
We are hiring detail-oriented Process Executives for Finance & Accounting Operations to handle financial transaction processing and data entry activities. Freshers and experienced candidates are welcome to apply.
Candidates with prior experience in Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Invoice Processing, Payment Processing, Data Entry, or other Finance & Accounting processes are preferred but not mandatory.
The role primarily involves processing financial data, validating documents, updating information in internal systems, and ensuring accuracy while meeting defined productivity, quality, and SLA targets


Role & responsibilities

1. Transaction Processing & Data Entry
Process financial transactions and enter dataaccurately into the system.
Review and validate invoices, payment details, and supporting documents.
Perform data extraction, verification, and system updates.
Process financial documents based on standard operating procedures (SOPs).
Ensure accurate and timely completion of assigned transactions

2. Productivity & SLA
Meet daily and hourly productivity targets.
Complete assigned transactions within defined turnaround time (TAT) and SLA.
Handle high-volume transactions consistently.
Maintain required processing speed without compromising quality.

3.Quality & Accuracy
Maintain defined quality and accuracy standards.
Verify data completeness and identify incorrect or missing information.
Minimize data entry and transaction processing errors.
Follow process guidelines and client-specific instructions.
4. Process Compliance
Follow standard workflows, SOPs, and process guidelines.
Maintain proper transaction records and documentation.
Ensure compliance with internal policies and client requirements.

Required Experience / Quality
0-3 years of experience in Finance & Accounting Operations, BPO, KPO, or transaction processing.
Freshers with relevant educational qualifications are eligible.
Basic understanding of accounting and financial terminology is Mandatory.
Prior experience in invoice processing, payment processing, data entry, or financial transaction processing is an advantage.
Ability to work in a high-volume, target-driven environment


Required Skills
Typing speed of with good accuracy is Preferred Not Mandatory
Good English communication skills (reading,writing, and speaking).
Basic MS Excel and computer operating skills.
Strong attention to detail and data validation skills.
Good analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to meet productivity, quality, and SLA targets.
Good time management and multitasking skills.
Willingness to work night shifts, rotational offs, and a 6-day working week,

Education Requirement
B.Com / M.Com / BBA / MBA Finance.

Description:
Job Description:
The Purchase Manager will be responsible for end-to-end management of the Sheshyon shop. This includes establishing and maintaining supplier relationships, negotiating favorable deals, overseeing inventory, ensuring timely purchases and sales, handling invoices, tracking budgets, and managing records. The role requires an individual who is highly organized, skilled in negotiation, and capable of fostering efficient and cost-effective operations.

Key Responsibilities:

1.Supply Chain Management:
Establish and maintain relationships with suppliers to ensure a reliable flow of quality goods.
Identify new suppliers and vendors when necessary, expanding options to meet the shop's diverse needs.
2.Negotiations and Vendor Relations:
Negotiate terms, pricing, and conditions with suppliers to achieve cost-effective procurement.
Report on supplier performance to ensure adherence to quality and service standards.
3.Procurement and Inventory Control:
Make timely purchases based on the needs of HIAL, public customers, and budget guidelines.
Manage stock levels, reorder points, and work with suppliers to prevent stockouts.
4.Billing, Budgeting, and Accounting:
Prepare and manage invoices, maintain bill records, and ensure accurate accounting for all purchases and sales.
Track and report on budget allocations, and provide regular updates to management.
5.Customer Service and Sales:
Serve as the main point of contact for both internal HIAL departments and external customers. Ensure a high standard of customer satisfaction and timely responses to inquiries.
6.Returns, Charges, and Price Adjustments:
Assist in the return of goods to suppliers when necessary and handle related documentation. Review carriage charges, price increases, and communicate changes to relevant departments.

Qualifications:
Bachelor's/ Master's or MBA in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or related field.
Proven experience in purchasing, vendor management, and inventory control.
Strong negotiation and interpersonal skills.
Proficiency in accounting and budgeting.
Ability to multitask and work in a dynamic environment.

Job Description:
We are seeking a talented and creative Media Executive to join our team . The ideal candidate will have proven photography and videography skills, with a keen eye for capturing compelling visuals that tell a story. As a Media Executive, you will play a key role in documenting our projects, events, and initiatives through various forms of media, including photography, videography, and multimedia content creation. Responsibilities:
Capture high-quality photographs and videos that showcase the work and impact of HIAL's projects and initiatives.
Edit and enhance photos and videos using Adobe Creative Suite or similar software to ensure a polished and professional final product.
Collaborate with team members to develop creative concepts and visual storytelling strategies for various media projects.
Manage and maintain a library of multimedia assets, including photos, videos, and graphics.
Support social media and marketing efforts by providing engaging visual content for digital platforms.
Assist in the production of promotional materials, including brochures, presentations, and videos.
Travel with project teams to remote locations in Ladakh and other regions as needed to document fieldwork and events.

Bachelor's degree in photography, videography, media production, or related field preferred.

Strong attention to detail and ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues from diverse backgrounds.
Willingness to travel and work in challenging environments, including remote Himalayan regions, and be flexible with assignments and schedules.
Benefits:
Opportunity to work with a dynamic team dedicated to making a positive impact in the Himalayan region.
Experience the rich cultural heritage and breathtaking landscapes of Ladakh.
Professional development opportunities and training in media production and storytelling techniques.
If you are passionate about using your media skills to make a difference and are excited about the opportunity to work in the beautiful Himalayan region of Ladakh, we encourage you to apply for the Media Executive position at HIAL. Join us in our mission to create a more sustainable and resilient future for Himalayan communities.

Description:
Himalayan Institute of Alternatives, Ladakh (HIAL) is an upcoming Alternative Institute for Mountain Development which follows Contextual Learning and Experiential Pedagogy where students learn by doing and earn while they learn. It aims to develop Ladakh into a benchmark of sustainable living for the mountain world, where all children receive a meaningful education that prepares them for a life of dignity in harmony with nature. It believes in collaborative exercise between learners and facilitators. Instead of solving problems with the conventional 3Rs (Reading, writing, and arithmetic), the learners are encouraged to solve problems using the 3Hs: Bright Head, Kind Heart, and Skilled Hands. The institute is promoted by the renowned leaders in entrepreneurial education in India and attracts talent and grants from leading corporates and Government bodies in India.

Position Overview:
HIAL is looking for a dynamic and people-centered HR Manager who can lead and manage the institute's human resource functions in a proactive, empathetic and organized manner. The ideal candidate should be passionate about creating an inclusive, growth-oriented and values-driven work culture while aligning HR practices with the institute's mission.

Key Responsibilities:

1. HR Strategy & Policy Development:
Design, review and implement HR policies and procedures that reflect the institute's ethos and ensure legal compliance.
Support long-term HR planning, including workforce planning, succession planning and talent development.
2. Recruitment & Onboarding:
Lead the end-to-end recruitment process for faculty, administrative and support staff.
Develop effective strategies for talent acquisition, including campus outreach and collaborations.
Ensure smooth onboarding and orientation of new employees.
3. Performance Management & Capacity Building:
Design and implement fair and constructive performance appraisal systems.
Identify training needs and coordinate internal and external capacity-building initiatives.
Support managers in developing individual growth plans for their teams.
4. Employee Engagement & Culture:
Foster a healthy, inclusive and collaborative work environment rooted in mutual respect and collective purpose.
Plan and execute employee engagement activities, feedback mechanisms and team-building initiatives.
Serve as a bridge between staff and leadership, ensuring two-way communication.
5. HR Operations & Compliance:
Maintain accurate and confidential employee records including attendance, leave and service history.
Manage HR-related documentation, including contracts, policies and compliance with labor laws.
Oversee payroll coordination, benefits and timely employee reimbursements in collaboration with the Finance team.
6. Conflict Resolution & Welfare:
Address staff grievances with empathy and fairness, ensuring timely resolution.
Promote mental health and staff well-being initiatives.

Qualifications & Experience:

Bachelor's/Master's degree in Human Resource Management, Organizational Development, or related field.
Minimum 5 years of progressive HR experience; prior experience in an academic or social sector organization is preferred.
Strong understanding of HR laws, best practices and systems.
Excellent interpersonal, communication and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work in a multicultural, high-altitude and mission-driven environment.
Desirable Attributes:
Sensitivity to local culture and a passion for sustainable development in the Himalayan region.
Adaptability and willingness to live and work in a remote, cold desert setting.
Experience with HR tech platforms and digital tools.
Ability to handle both strategic HR planning and hands-on operational tasks.

Job Summary:
Job Summary

The Commis I Indian Kitchen is responsible for assisting in the preparation, cooking, and presentation of Indian cuisine while maintaining the highest standards of food quality, hygiene, and kitchen operations. The role requires sound knowledge of Indian cooking techniques, ingredients, and kitchen procedures, along with the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Prepare and cook Indian dishes according to established recipes and standards.
Assist senior chefs in mise en place and daily kitchen operations.
Ensure consistency in taste, presentation, and portion control.
Monitor the quality and freshness of ingredients before use.
Maintain cleanliness and organization of the assigned work station.
Follow all food safety, hygiene, and sanitation standards.
Ensure proper storage, labeling, and rotation of food items (FIFO).
Support in receiving and storing kitchen supplies and ingredients.
Minimize food wastage and contribute to cost-control initiatives.
Assist during buffet service, la carte operations, banquets, and special events.
Report equipment malfunctions, stock shortages, and quality concerns to supervisors.
Work collaboratively with other kitchen team members to ensure smooth operations.

Qualifications & Experience

Diploma or Degree in Hotel Management, Culinary Arts, or a related field preferred.
Minimum 2 4 years of experience in an Indian kitchen, preferably in a luxury hotel or fine-dining restaurant.
Knowledge of North Indian, Mughlai, Tandoor, and regional Indian cuisines is desirable.
Familiarity with food safety and hygiene standards.

Skills & Competencies

Strong understanding of Indian cooking methods, spices, and ingredients.
Ability to work under pressure and meet service timelines.
Attention to detail and commitment to quality.
Good organizational and time-management skills.
Team-oriented attitude with a willingness to learn.
Ability to maintain a clean and disciplined work environment.

What We Offer

Opportunity to work in a luxury hospitality environment.
Professional growth and learning opportunities.
Competitive compensation and benefits.
A collaborative and supportive workplace culture.

Description:
The Marketing Manager at the Himalayan Institute of Alternatives Ladakh will be responsible for developing and executing marketing strategies to promote responsible tourism-related events, projects and activities, as well as promoting various courses, conferences, and workshops offered by the institute. The role will encompass a range of marketing activities, including digital marketing, content creation, event promotion, and brand management.

Key Responsibilities:

Promote Responsible Tourism Events:
Develop and implement marketing plans to promote responsible tourism-related events and activities curated by HIAL.
Collaborate with local and international partners to create awareness and attract participants.
Utilize digital marketing channels, social media, and content marketing to reach the target audience.
Promote Institute Courses:
Create marketing campaigns to promote the various courses offered by the Himalayan Institute of Alternatives Ladakh.
Develop course-specific marketing materials, including brochures, flyers, and digital content.
Implement strategies to increase course enrollment and participation.
Promote Conferences and Workshops:
Plan and execute marketing initiatives to promote conferences, workshops, and seminars held at the institute.
Coordinate with speakers, sponsors, and participants to ensure successful event promotion.
Manage event registration and attendee communication.
Digital Marketing:
Implement digital marketing strategies, including SEO, SEM, email marketing, and social media campaigns.
Create and curate content that highlights the institute's mission and values.
Monitor website traffic, engagement, and conversion rates to optimize digital marketing efforts.
Resource Management:
Oversee resource allocation and cash flow management to maintain financial stability and ensure that the organization can meet its financial obligations and strategic goals.
Content Creation:
Develop compelling and informative content, including blog posts, videos, and infographics, to engage the target audience.
Ensure that content aligns with the institute's values and promotes sustainable practices.
Collaboration:
Collaborate with the institute's teams, including academic, administrative, and event planning, to align marketing efforts with organizational goals.
Foster relationships with local and regional stakeholders to enhance the institute's presence.
Budget Management:
Create and manage marketing budgets, optimizing resource allocation for maximum impact.
Monitor spending and provide regular reports

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field (Master's degree preferred).
Proven experience in marketing, preferably in the field of education, sustainable tourism, or related areas.
Strong knowledge of digital marketing techniques and tools.
Excellent communication and content creation skills.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a diverse team.
Passion for sustainable and responsible tourism practices.
Familiarity with Ladakh and the local community is a plus.
This Marketing Manager will play a crucial role in promoting the Himalayan Institute of Alternatives Ladakh's mission to promote responsible tourism and education in the region, while also fostering awareness and participation in its various courses, conferences, and workshops.
