Description:
The Himalayan Institute of Alternatives, Ladakh, is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Finance Head to lead our finance department. As the Finance Head, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the financial stability and success of our organization. You will be responsible for developing and maintaining financial forecasting models, supervising a team of accountants, and identifying cost-saving solutions. Additionally, you will collaborate with senior management to explore alternative funding options, manage resource allocation, and ensure compliance through audits.

Key Responsibilities:

Financial Forecasting:
Develop and maintain forecasting models for monthly, quarterly, and annual financial results to provide accurate and timely financial insights to the organization.
Team Leadership:
Provide strong leadership and supervision to a team of accountants, ensuring accuracy and efficiency in all financial transactions. Foster a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and professional development within the team.
Cost Optimization:
Identify opportunities for cost-saving solutions to optimize financial performance, enhancing the financial sustainability of the organization.
Funding Exploration:
Collaborate with senior management to explore alternate funding options for projects and initiatives, including grants, partnerships, and investment opportunities.
Resource Management:
Oversee resource allocation and cash flow management to maintain financial stability and ensure that the organization can meet its financial obligations and strategic goals.
Budget Approval:
Review and approve budgets, ensuring they align with the organizational goals and financial constraints. Monitor budget performance and recommend adjustments when necessary.
Vendor Payments and Payroll:
Ensure timely payments to vendors and the punctual release of employee salaries, maintaining strong vendor and employee relationships.
Financial Integrity and Compliance:
Conduct regular audits to maintain financial integrity and compliance with relevant laws and regulations. Develop and implement corrective measures as needed.

Qualifications:
Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field. MBA or a relevant advanced degree is preferred.
Proven experience in financial management, including forecasting, budgeting, and cost analysis.
Strong leadership and team management skills with a minimum of 5 years of supervisory experience.
Proficiency in financial modeling, accounting software, and Microsoft Office Suite.
Excellent analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Knowledge of funding opportunities in the nonprofit sector is a plus.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

To ensure that all loose grocery staples (rice, wheat, pulses, spices, sugar, flour, etc.) are
processed and packed in the factory to meet FSSAI and regulatory standards and company
quality standards before reaching customers.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Raw Material Quality Checks
• Inspect incoming loose staples for quality parameters (moisture, infestation, purity,
grain size, colour, odour, foreign matter).
• Verify supplier quality certificates and conduct sampling/testing.
2. In-Process Quality Control
• Monitor packing lines to ensure correct weight, sealing, labelling, batch coding, and
hygiene.
• Ensure FEFO/FIFO practices in usage of raw materials and packaging materials.
• Conduct line clearance checks before production runs.
3. Finished Goods Quality
• Inspect packed products for compliance with defined standards (net weight,
labelling, shelf life, seal integrity).
• Retain samples for shelf-life studies.
4. Food Safety & Compliance
• Ensure the factory follows FSSAI, HACCP, GMP, and hygiene norms.
• Monitor pest control, sanitation, and staff hygiene.
• Support internal/external quality audits.
5. Documentation & Reporting
• Maintain inspection logs, QC reports, and non-conformance records.
• Raise corrective/preventive actions (CAPA) with production & purchase teams.

Job Description: Associate / Senior Associate Used Commercial Vehicle
Finance (Ahmedabad, Baroda, Mumbai (all areas), Pune)
Job Summary
We are seeking a dynamic, result-oriented Field Sales Executive to drive growth in our
Used Commercial Vehicle (CV) Finance division. The ideal candidate will have a
minimum of 2 years of direct field experience in used CV financing, a strong local
network of brokers, dealers, and fleet operators, and a proven track record of meeting
monthly disbursement targets.
Key Responsibilities & KRAs
• Achieve Sales Targets: Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly disbursement
targets for Used Commercial Vehicles and any new CV products introduced by
the company.
• Lead Generation & Sourcing: Identify and develop new business opportunities
through direct field visits, cold calling, and local networking.
• Channel Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with used
vehicle dealers, brokers, mechanics, and local transport hubs.
• Customer Assessment: Conduct preliminary credit and financial screenings of
customers, evaluating their profile, repayment capacity, and asset condition.
• End-to-End Logistical Management: Oversee the loan process from document
collection and login to verification, valuation, and final disbursement.
• Portfolio Health & Collections: Assist the credit and collections team in
monitoring early delinquencies and ensuring timely recovery from acquired
portfolios.
Required Qualifications & Skills
• Experience: Minimum 2 to 5 years of core field experience specifically in Used
CV Finance (experience in Light, Medium, or Heavy Commercial Vehicles).
• Education: Graduate or Under-Graduate degree in any stream.
• Market Knowledge: Deep understanding of the local used commercial vehicle
market, asset valuation nuances, and competitor practices.
• Skills: Strong negotiation, interpersonal communication, and relationship-
building skills.
• Mobility: Must possess a valid driving license and a personal two-wheeler for
extensive field travel.

What We Offer
• Competitive fixed salary and a highly lucrative performance-based incentive
structure.
• Travel allowances.
• Fast-tracked career progression opportunities within a growing financial
institution.

Role & responsibilities


Job Title: Business Development Manager / Senior Manager Mid-Market (B2B Sales)

Company: G4S Secure Solutions India
Location: Multiple Locations / Pan-India Hubs
Experience: 2 – 8 Years
Role Type: Full-Time, Individual Contributor

About the Role
We are looking for high-energy, target-driven Business Development Managers to drive our Mid-Market corporate sales across Pan-India hubs. In this role, you will focus on acquiring new mid-sized corporate clients and expanding business within existing accounts.
You will manage mid-sized commercial deals (ranging from 20 Lakhs to 85 Lakhs+ / 25K–100K in annual contract value), allowing you to focus purely on high-impact corporate accounts while smaller transactional inquiries are handled by our operations team.

What’s in It for You? (Compensation & Growth)
Monthly Payouts: Fast-paced monthly performance tracking with monthly commission payouts.
Multi-Year Earning Potential: Earn trailing commissions in Years 2 and 3 for multi-year contracts you close, plus an Annual Target Bonus.
Clear Career Path: High performers hitting targets for 2 consecutive years qualify for fast-track promotion to Enterprise Sales roles.
Key Responsibilities
1. New Business Acquisition (50% of your time)
Identify and pitch to potential corporate clients across industrial corridors, manufacturing plants, logistics hubs, and commercial buildings through cold calling, field visits, and networking.
Follow up on and convert inbound leads from digital marketing, website inquiries, and branch referrals.
Prepare accurate pricing proposals/cost sheets using company tools and respond to commercial RFQs while maintaining healthy profit margins.
Close multi-year security service contracts within the mid-market segment.
2. Account Expansion & Retention (35% of your time)
Build strong relationships with existing mid-market clients to expand manpower deployments across new sites.
Cross-sell electronic security solutions (CCTV, access control, and intrusion detection packages) to existing customers.
Manage timely contract renewals (targeting 90%+ retention) and execute annual price revisions aligned with statutory minimum wage updates.

Partner with business leaders to understand goals and translate them into HR strategies.
Drive organizational design, workforce planning, and change management initiatives.
Act as a trusted advisor to leadership on people-related matters.
Talent Acquisition & Development
Collaborate with Talent Acquisition to attract top engineering talent.
Lead onboarding, career development, and succession planning programs.
Identify training needs and support leadership development initiatives.
Employee Engagement & Culture
Champion LTTSs values and culture through engagement programs.
Conduct regular pulse checks and implement feedback-driven improvements.
Promote diversity, equity, and inclusion across teams.
Performance & Rewards

Provide input on compensation strategies and recognition programs.
Analyze HR metrics to inform decisions and improve employee experience.

Ensure compliance with labor laws and LTTS policies.
Maintain confidentiality and integrity in handling sensitive matters.

Strong communication (oral and written) and interpersonal skills.
Excellent organizational and time management abilities.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Proficiency with HRIS and Microsoft Office Suite.
Knowledge of HR principles, practices, and employment laws.
Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.

Description:
Job description of this profile as follows:
Credit Manager will be responsible for evaluating, underwriting, and managing the credit risk associated with vehicle loans (including new/used CV loans, two-wheelers, 3-Wheelers, Electric vehicles). This role focuses on assessing creditworthiness, ensuring zero fraud, streamlining loan turn-around-time (TAT), maintaining a healthy portfolio quality, and achieving a sustainable balance between business growth and risk mitigation.

Core Responsibilities:
1. Credit Underwriting & Risk Assessment:
Evaluate loan applications for wheels products based on internal credit policies, financial statements, bank statements, Bureau records (e.g., CIBIL), and field verification reports.
Identify potential red flags, financial stress, or fraudulent documentation early in the underwriting lifecycle.
Assess the buyer's repayment capacity, cash flows (especially for self-employed individuals and commercial operators), and the valuation/LTV (Loan-to-Value) ratio of the vehicle being financed.

2. Portfolio Quality & Monitoring:
Track early mortality accounts and manage the non-performing asset (NPA) percentages within the assigned geography or product category.
Monitor monthly bounce rates, overdue accounts, and collection trends to proactively alter credit guidelines if specific segments show high risk.
Conduct periodic portfolio reviews and sample audits of disbursed cases to ensure absolute policy compliance.

3. TAT Management:
Ensuring quick Turn-Around-Time (TAT) from application login to final credit sanction without compromising risk standards.

Key Candidate Requirements:
Candidates should have 4-5 years' experience in credit underwriting of Wheels product.
Relevant experience in credit underwriting within an NBFC or bank.
Good understanding of bureau reports, income assessment, banking analysis, credit policies, and lending processes.
Ability to independently evaluate credit proposals and recommend appropriate credit decisions within delegated authority.
Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and sound credit judgment.

We are seeking a skilled Generative AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy enterprise-grade AI applications powered by Large Language Models (LLMs). Implement prompt engineering techniques to improve model performance and response quality.
Integrate vector databases for semantic search and knowledge retrieval.
Build scalable APIs and backend services using Python and FastAPI.
Fine-tune, evaluate, and monitor AI model performance.
Integrate AI solutions with enterprise applications, databases, and cloud services.
Implement AI guardrails, security controls, content filtering, and responsible AI practices.
Collaborate with product, data engineering, and cloud teams to deploy production-ready solutions.

Generative AI / Agentic Ai
Large Language Models (LLMs)
Prompt Engineering
RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation)

Location: Mumbai, Bangalore, Vadodara

About Livspace

Livspace is a leading technology-driven home interiors and renovation platform, providing end-to-end interior solutions for homeowners. We combine design, technology, project execution, and customer experience to deliver beautiful and functional homes.
Job Overview
We are looking for an experienced and creative Senior Interior Designer who can independently manage residential interior design projects from concept to final design closure.
The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in space planning, modular interiors, design concepts, client management, and design software, along with the ability to deliver high-quality designs within defined timelines.

Required Skills

Strong knowledge of residential interior design and space planning.
Excellent understanding of modular kitchens, wardrobes, living rooms, bedrooms, and complete home interiors.
Proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp, 3ds Max/3D visualization tools, and MS Office.
Strong knowledge of materials, finishes, hardware, lighting, and furniture.
Excellent presentation and client-handling skills.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to understand client needs and convert them into practical design solutions.
Strong attention to detail and design aesthetics.
Ability to manage multiple projects and work within deadlines.
Good understanding of design feasibility, execution requirements, and site constraints.
Experience & Qualification

3 to 6 years of relevant experience in residential interior design.
Bachelor's/Diploma degree in Interior Design, Architecture, or a related field.
Candidates with experience in home interiors, modular interiors, design studios, or interior design companies will be preferred.
Strong portfolio demonstrating residential interior design projects is preferred.
AboutCompany: Livspace is Asia's largest and fastest-growing home interiors and renovation platform. Leveraging its proprietary technology, the company delivers end-to-end home interior and renovation solutions, encompassing modular solutions, furniture, false ceilings, soft furnishings, dcor, civil works, and more. The company serves homeowners across diverse market segments in India and Singapore.

Description:
Position Title: Regional Sales Manager

Department: Sales and Distribution

Work Location: Regional office

Grade: M3/ M4

Travel Required: Yes(50%)

Reporting to:
Administrative: Regional Manager

Reported by: ASMs

Functional: Regional Manager Category Head

Educational Qualification: Graduate and MBA in Sales/ Marketing

Experience: 8 12 years

Any additional requirement:
Purpose of the Position (Job Summary)
The purpose of this position is to drive sales in the specific sub-region to meet AOP targets by implementing trade promotions, ensuring stock availability, distributor expansion, etc.

Key Roles and Responsibilities
Financial
Sales strategy: Design & execute sales strategies defined for each sub-category and state to ensure month-on-month achievement of sales target (value and volume). The RSM is responsible for overall sales in his assigned territory.
New product launches: Ensure revenue from sales of new products as per AOP target
Distributor expansion: Drive incremental revenue from distribution expansion
Customer Orientation
Distributor calls: Conduct calls as per the agreed plan with each distributor. Review call cycle, reporting (weekly) on calls made and stock ordered for the team
Distributor management: Build and maintain distributor relationships to grow regional sales
Marketing: Work closely with distributors to develop & execute annual plan for promotions, advertising campaigns and retailer meets; Coordinate with the Marketing team to ensure that distributors are fully aware of and support planned promotions
Merchandising: Provide merchandising assistance (i.e., through point of sale material, brochures, etc.) and advice to distributors in order to maximise sales
Distributor investments: Ensure distributors have appropriate investments to cater to market needs (stock levels, credit, salesmen, etc.)
Complaints management: Resolve product issues (such as recurring faults) at distributor level, arranging credits, replacement stock as required and providing feedback to Brand Managers for recurring issues; Ensure timely settlement of distributor issues like pending schemes/ discounts/ reversal of debit note, etc.
Product intelligence: Provide support to develop products as per region's demands
Exception approvals: Authorise and allocate transit damage rebates and credits effectively and within Company guidelines in order to maintain a positive relationship with distributors and maximise profitability. Report any exceptions to the Regional Manager
Market metrics: Track distributor order fulfilment of demand generated from Retailers by the field force
Competitor benchmarking: Benchmark market/ competitor best practices through ASMs & derive actionable recommendations from the same
Distributor appointment: Scouting and appointing new distributors as per defined norms
Distributor onboarding: Ensuring distributor gets all relevant post appointment support
Distributor exclusivity: Ensuring adherence of exclusivity to Relaxo by designated exclusive distributors
People Orientation
Market expansion: Motivate & lead ASMs & SOs to establish coverage, distribution and display objectives to meet Sales targets
Targets: Cascade targets for team & provide necessary support such as coaching, feedback, training & development to meet targets
Trainings: Provide inputs on training needs for the team to Regional Manager/ HR
Recruitment: Recruit and develop team members. Support HR in creation of a talent pipeline to ensure business continuity in case of attrition
Mentorship and supervision: Mentoring, coaching and supervising the work of ASMs
Internal Business Process
Sales planning: Overseeing creation of monthly/ weekly/ daily distributor-wise, sub category-wise sales plan for the month
Collections: Track & minimize average outstanding at end of each month as a % of month's sales
Balanced billing: Improve sales billing phasing to reduce month end skew
Channel partner engagement: Drive distributor/ retailer engagement and scale up efforts to increase number of participating distributors/ retailers
Market working plan adherence: Ensure adherence to market working plan for self & team. Report regularly to Regional Manager
Distributor quality tracking: Review quality of distribution by tracking the range of articles billed out of the identified focus articles and target fulfilment
Scheme success: Maximizing enrolment into trade schemes
Stock availability: Ensure improvement in article wise stock availability
Process sanctity: Ensure adherence to key sales processes
Distributor-retailer mapping: Prepare territory-wise distributor to retailer mapping records and ensuring adherence
Sales forecasting: Provide inputs to Regional Manager for accurate & timely sales forecasts
Reviews: Conduct and attend timely reviews as per sales governance model
Documentation from distributors: Collect no pending issue letter from distributors on quarterly basis

Execution excellence

Plumbing installation and maintenance
Pipe fitting and repair
Knowledge of pumps, valves, and water treatment systems
Troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
Basic understanding of safety practices in industrial environments

Preferred Candidate Profile
Experience in manufacturing or industrial environments.
Willingness to work in shifts if required.
Team player with a proactive approach toward maintenance activities.

Will assist in training of less experienced staff.

Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced environment while possessing strong organizational skills and a demonstrated ability to meet deadlines.
Strong written and verbal communication skills including good command of English language. In certain geographies where communication in local language is desired (e.g. Japan, China), excellent command of local language with reasonable proficiency in English preferred.
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with coworkers, managers and customers.

Description:
Interior Designer

Company: Parekh Architects

Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India

Employment Type: Full-time, On-site

Role Overview

Parekh Architects is seeking a talented and design-driven Interior Designer with strong creative sensibilities, technical expertise, and a refined understanding of materials, spatial composition, and detailing.
The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing and executing interior design projects from conceptualization through completion. The role requires a balance of creativity, technical proficiency, material knowledge, and project coordination, with an emphasis on delivering thoughtful and distinctive interior environments.

Key Responsibilities

Develop innovative interior design concepts, spatial layouts, and design narratives.
Lead interior design projects from conceptual development through on-site execution.
Prepare mood boards, material palettes, furniture layouts, design presentations, and detailed working drawings.
Develop bespoke furniture, fixtures, decorative elements, and interior architectural details.
Research and select materials, finishes, furnishings, lighting, fabrics, and accessories.
Coordinate with architects, consultants, vendors, contractors, and other project stakeholders.
Prepare and review technical drawings, specifications, and construction documentation.
Conduct site visits and oversee execution to ensure adherence to design intent and quality standards.
Manage project timelines, deliverables, and design coordination.
Guide and mentor junior designers and contribute to the firm's overall creative direction.
Stay informed of emerging design trends, materials, technologies, and industry innovations.

Qualifications and Experience

Degree in Interior Design, Interior Architecture, Architecture, or a related discipline.
Demonstrated experience across multiple stages of interior design and project execution.
Proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp, Adobe Creative Suite, and relevant 3D modeling and visualization software.
Strong understanding of interior construction, materials, finishes, furniture design, lighting, and technical detailing.
Experience in preparing comprehensive interior design and construction documentation.

Skills and Attributes

Strong conceptual thinking and creative design abilities.
Refined aesthetic judgment and attention to detail.
Excellent understanding of color, texture, proportion, lighting, and spatial composition.
Ability to translate creative concepts into technically feasible design solutions.
Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
Ability to independently manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
Strong organizational, coordination, and leadership capabilities.
A passion for design innovation, material exploration, and craftsmanship.

Application Requirements

Interested candidates should submit an updated CV and a comprehensive design portfolio demonstrating their creative abilities, technical proficiency, material sensibilities, and relevant professional experience.
AboutCompany:
Parekh Architects is a multidisciplinary architecture and interior design practice based in Ahmedabad, India, with a diverse portfolio spanning residential, commercial, hospitality, retail, and recreational environments.

The practice is driven by a philosophy of design exploration, material innovation, and contextual sensitivity, bringing together creative vision and technical expertise to create distinctive and meaningful built environments. Its approach emphasizes spatial experiences, architectural expression, craftsmanship, and the interplay between materiality, light, form, and function.

Through a collaborative and research-driven design process, Parekh Architects approaches each project as an opportunity to challenge conventions and develop thoughtful, contextually responsive solutions. From conceptualization through execution, the practice maintains a strong commitment to design integrity, precision, and quality, creating spaces that are both experientially engaging and enduring in their relevance.

The firm's work has received recognition from architectural and design platforms, reflecting its commitment to innovation and excellence in architecture and interior design.

Description:
As a Field Service Rep, you are responsible for coordinating with customers in field issues, warranty complaints and resolutions. You will carry out and support site commissioning, service and repair jobs at customer sites. This position will be based at Vadodara QRC.
Responsibilities:
Perform in-house and on-site repairs and service activities
Assess problems and take actions to resolve promptly.
Work side-by-side with our customers personnel as required.
Oversee the full cycle of repair: disassembly, cleaning, inspection, repair, and assembly.
Ensure that equipment is installed successfully and on schedule.
Check equipment prior to start-up and assess start-up performance.
Monitor the maintenance and performance of Flowserve equipment.
Train customers in the proper procedures for operating and maintaining Flowserve products.
Collaborate effectively with the supporting organizations of Flowserve, including the customer service, and sales engineering.
Maintain and submit organized, accurate records, including daily reports, jobs quoted, jobs performed, and time and materials charged.
Knowledgeable about the industrial applications and operations of pumps, turbines, compressors, seals, actuators, or any rotary equipment.
Other duties as assigned.
Requirements:
Electrical-Instrumentation / Mechanical degree with 0-2 years of relevant experience
Experience with installing, maintaining mechatronic equipment
Experience with repairing pump equipment, installing cables/instruments
Proven ability to correctly read and interpret blueprints, engineering drawings, and schematics
Must be a self-starter with good follow-through, capable of working independently with little supervision
Proficiency in Outlook, Word, and Excel
Able to travel throughout India
Able to work overtime as required to minimize impact on customers
Physical activity is required, including frequent lifting up to 50 pounds / 25kg, ascending/descending ladders and staircases, and climbing and reaching in, under, and around large equipment, often outside year-round.
Preferred Experience / Skills:
- Strong verbal and written communication skills
-Instrumentation & Electrical failure analysis background is a plus
- Proficient in Microsoft Office, including Word
- Able to work well with a team
- Experience serving customers in FMCG/Pharma and other general industries
- Willingness to travel as needed to customer sites.

Job Requirements
This position is a mechanical integrity technical position for fixed equipment in support of petrochemical facility
This position provides technical support to the client with a focus on managing the risk based inspection program, troubleshooting, asset improvement, and technology selection
Provide strong technical leadership in Inspection/Corrosion Management for Oil & Gas upstream/downstream assets
Provide technical solution in upstream/downstream Asset Integrity
Has ability to create innovative solutions /automations/ methodologies to build a differentiation for Quest Global
Integrity assessment/assurance activities like FFS, Corrosion Evaluations and Remaining Life Studies
Drive and manage Integrity Engineers to execute the workflows with Quality at scale

Drive core team members to recruit skilled resources or train internal resources to achieve the targets
Act as a bridge between customer, sales organization and global technical teams
Lead Develop, nurture and manage global customer relationships and drive strategic partnering initiatives to address unique business situations and complex technology needs
Review technical scoping, estimation, fitment and feasibility studies, mapping customer expectations and solution design, prepared by Program Managers and Project Leader
Degradation evaluations related to pressure equipment, heat exchangers, piping circuits, fired equipment, flares, above ground storage tanks, and/or pressure relief devices.
Monitoring and surveillance of integrity parameters to ensure reliable operations.
Troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and integrity recommendation stewardship.
Bad actor identification and analysis to reduce equipment downtime.
Data analytics, digital tools/ technologies and operationalize upgraded work practices through digital transformation.
Overall integrity effectiveness and management which includes, criticality assessments, consequence/ complexity rating of fixed equipment, development of fit-for-purpose risk based strategies, setting optimum task intervals including considerations to local regulations/ statutory requirements, timely review of inspection findings, and ever-greening of strategies.

- Risk Based Inspection methodologies 
- Fixed equipment inspection tasks/ procedures 
- Inspection Optimization
- Piping Circutization/TML development 
- API Damage Mechanisms of Refinery/Chemicals 
- In-service inspection of all types of fixed equipment 
- Knowledge of materials and standards 
- Knowledge of corrosion & welding
- Knowledge of NDTs
-Thickness inspection management and analysis
- Corrosion management and analysis
- Inspection plan development/ optimization.
- Knowledge of software (APM Meridium/Pestra/Credo, etc.) 
- Ability to lead teams 
- Excellent communication 
Should have working knowledge of oil and gas plant operations 
Should have exposure to Operating condition Safety, SHE risks, spill/ safety incident and equipment failure opportunities 
Should have Knowledge of various roles and responsibilities of engineers working in the oil and gas field/site 
Should have knowledge of corrective and preventative maintenance strategy 
Should have knowledge of International standards in design, quality, and procedures for approved equipment
Working knowledge in key sections of ASME Sec Div. 1/2, ASME Sec V, ASME Sec IX, ASME Sec Il, ASME B31.3/ B31.1/ B31.4/ B31.8, ASME PCC-2
Field in-service inspection and repair of pressure equipment, heat exchangers, piping systems, pressure relief devices and above ground storage tanks in operating unit
Good to have skills:
Certification and in-depth working knowledge in API 580, API 510, API 570, API 571 , API 653, NACE Senior Corrosion Technologist, BSI ISO/ ENI AS Standards, AWS/ CSWIP/ ASNT NDT Techniques
Experience with Meridium/Credo/Pestra and SAP

Job Title: Team Leader - HNI Dealing - Branch Broking

Company Name: Bajaj Broking

Job Description
As a Team Leader - Branch Broking, you will be responsible for driving individual business performance as well as leading the branch dealing team to achieve overall business objectives. The role involves managing your own HNI client portfolio, generating revenue through client acquisition and trading activities, and simultaneously guiding the team to achieve their respective targets.

You will be accountable for individual revenue generation, team productivity, client acquisition, retention, and overall business growth while ensuring superior client servicing, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities
Lead, motivate, and manage the team to achieve overall business and revenue targets.
Drive team-level revenue generation, client acquisition, activation, and retention.
Monitor individual team members' performance and ensure achievement of assigned targets.
Support team members in acquiring new clients, increasing client engagement, and improving revenue productivity.
Oversee trading activities across equity, derivatives, Nifty, and stock options.
Ensure timely sharing of stock, sector, and market updates with clients.
Handle key HNI relationships and resolve escalated client queries.
Conduct regular performance reviews, provide coaching, and develop team capabilities.
Coordinate with research and internal teams to provide relevant investment insights and strategies.
Ensure accurate trade execution, documentation, and adherence to regulatory and internal compliance requirements.
Track individual and team performance through regular business reviews and reporting.
Identify opportunities to improve revenue, operational efficiency, and overall client experience.
Coordinate with Branch and Regional leadership to achieve business objectives.
Achieve assigned individual revenue targets through HNI client acquisition, relationship management, and trading activities.

Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; an MBA will be an added advantage.
Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in dealing, sales, or business development within the financial services industry, preferably with exposure to HNI clients.
Prior experience in team handling or a supervisory role will be preferred.
Strong knowledge of financial markets, equity, derivatives, and investment products.
Strong leadership, communication, relationship management, and people-management skills.
NISM Series VIII Certification is mandatory.

Description:
Position : Associate Director / Director

Department: Tax Restructuring/Succession Planning Team
Designation: Associate Director / Director (10+ years)
Experience: 10+ years post-qualification
Qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA)
Location: Vadodara (Preferred) | Ahmedabad | Mumbai
Role Overview
We are looking for experienced Chartered Accountants to join its Succession Planning Team. The role involves independently leading succession and estate planning assignments for business families and HNIs, covering the complete process from understanding family objectives to structuring, drafting and implementation.
The candidate should have the ability to understand business strategy, ownership structures and long-term family objectives and design appropriate succession structures beyond conventional tax and legal considerations.

Key Responsibilities
1. Succession & Estate Planning
Lead succession and estate planning assignments for operating businesses, promoter shareholdings, immovable properties, investments, artwork and other family wealth.
Analyse family ownership structures, family dynamics, commercial objectives and long-term goals.
Design succession structures involving private trusts, Wills, family arrangements, family charters, gifts, partition arrangements, holding structures and family governance mechanisms.
Advise on ownership succession, management succession, business continuity and next-generation involvement.
2. Transaction & Corporate Structuring
Consider M&A, business restructuring, business sales and other corporate events while designing succession structures.
Handle succession planning for pre-IPO and IPO-bound businesses, considering DRHP disclosures, promoter contributions, lock-in and holding-period requirements.
Advise on listed company succession matters involving SEBI regulations, promoter and promoter-group requirements, disclosures, transfer restrictions and regulatory approvals.
3. Tax, Legal & Regulatory Advisory
Analyse Indian tax, stamp duty, Companies Act, FEMA, SEBI and succession-law implications.
Handle assignments involving NRIs, non-resident trustees or beneficiaries, foreign trusts, overseas foundations and foreign assets.
Assess overseas taxation, succession laws and inheritance or estate-tax implications, coordinating with specialist teams wherever required.
4. Documentation & Implementation
Draft, review and finalise trust deeds, Wills, family arrangements, shareholder agreements, family charters, partition deeds and other legal documents.
Prepare structure notes, technical opinions and presentations explaining available alternatives, risks and recommended structures.
Lead client and family discussions and translate commercial and family objectives into practical legal and tax structures.
Coordinate with internal specialists and external legal, tax, regulatory and valuation advisers for implementation.
5. Team Management
Supervise junior team members.
Review research, documentation, drafting and technical work.
Ensure quality and timely execution of succession planning assignments.

Description:
Job Summary
We are looking for an energetic Business Development Executive to grow AllHomes specifier network in Mumbai - across the AllHome Bharat Platform and its partner brands (ColourCoats, FIAMARC, The Window Factory, Metalia, Shapes, Ledlum, and The House of W). Reporting to the Regional Sales Head - West, you will open doors with architects, interior designers, contractors, and developers, get our brands specified at the design stage, and convert those relationships into project orders across categories. Candidates from any architectural or interior products background are welcome - what matters is that you know how to sell to the design fraternity.

Key Responsibilities
Market Mapping & Lead Generation
Map architects, interior designers, PMCs, contractors, and developers across Mumbai and MMR; build a live project database
Generate qualified leads through daily field visits, referrals, site scouting, and industry networks
Track upcoming residential, hospitality, retail, and office projects in the territory
Specification & Relationship Building
Make studio and site visits to introduce the AllHome portfolio and secure specification at the design stage
Arrange product demos, samples, mock-ups, and experience-centre walkthroughs for design teams
Cross-sell across brands - take more than one AllHome category into the same project, coordinating with the respective brand teams
Sales Support & Order Closure
Support the regional team on proposals, BOQs, and quotations, and follow up from enquiry through tendering to closure
Own conversion of small and mid-ticket opportunities end-to-end; support high-value mandates with the regional team
Coordinate with dealers, supply chain, and accounts on dispatches, deliveries, and post-order support
Process, CRM & Reporting
Maintain daily call reports, funnel stages, and quotation trackers on the CRM with clean data hygiene
Share weekly territory reports - pipeline value, win rates, and competitor activity across categories

Key Requirements
10+ years of B2B sales or business development experience in architectural or interior design products - lighting, hardware & fittings, tiles & surfaces, bathware, modular furniture, flooring, paints, windows, or faades
Demonstrated success in selling to or influencing architects, interior designers, and contractors; an existing Mumbai design and construction network is a strong plus
Working understanding of specification-led selling, BOQs, quotations, and tender basics
Confident communication and presentation skills - able to pitch to design principals and senior consultants
Self-driven, organized, and comfortable with CRM tools and daily field travel across MMR

Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in any discipline; Architecture, Interior Design, Engineering, or an MBA in Marketing preferred
Exposure to building materials, home improvement, or premium interior product categories is an added advantage
AboutCompany:
About Us
AllHome is a house-of-brands platform for architectural and interior design products, founded by the founding team of PharmEasy and backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. We design, manufacture, source, and supply across seven brands Ledlum (architectural lighting & fans), Shapes (hardware & furniture fittings, est. 1992), Colour Coats (wood coatings & paints), House of W (luxury bathware), The Window Factory (high-end windows), Metalia India (metal faades), and Fiamarc (interior & construction products).

Description:
Key Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain Alteryx workflows for data preparation, transformation, and integration.
Develop and support ETL/data workflows to ingest, cleanse, validate, and enrich data from multiple sources.
Translate business requirements into technical workflow designs and reusable components/macros.
Implement data quality checks, reconciliation logic, and exception handling to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Optimize workflow performance by improving logic, reducing run time, and managing resource usage effectively.
Document workflow logic, data mappings, and operational steps to support maintainability and handovers.
Collaborate with analysts, data engineers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues and deliver enhancements.
Support production runs, monitor scheduled workflows, and resolve failures within defined timelines.

Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelors degree (or equivalent) in Engineering/Technology/Computer Applications/Science (e.g., BTech, BE, BSc, MCA, MTech, MSc).
2-5years of experience working with Alteryx to build and maintain data preparation or automation workflows.
Strong hands-on experience in ETL and data workflow development, including transformation and validation steps.
Solid understanding of data concepts such as joins, aggregations, filtering, data types, and schema handling.
Ability to analyze requirements, debug workflow issues, and deliver reliable outputs with attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.
Understanding of analytics lifecycle practices such as versioning, documentation standards, and reusable workflow design.
Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders, present findings, and recommend improvements to data processes.
Good to have skills:
SQL, Data Warehousing, Data Quality Frameworks, Power BI, Python

Fast-tracked career progression opportunities within a growing financial institution.

Description:
CBRE is seeking a high-performing senior professional to join our Office Leasing practice as Landlord Representation.

In this role, you will lead business development, strategic landlord advisory, and deal execution for major institutional investors, developers, and asset owners. You will be responsible for securing multi-asset leasing mandates across key markets, formulating asset positioning strategies, driving revenue targets, and delivering end-to-end commercial real estate transactions.

Key Responsibilities

Mandate Origination & Business Development: Drive pipeline growth by identifying, pitching, and securing high-value Landlord Representation mandates; expand existing accounts through strategic relationship management.
Strategic Advisory & Commercial Structuring: Formulate asset-specific leasing strategies, pricing models, rent escalation structures, lock-in terms, tenant incentives, and positioning frameworks based on competitor benchmarking and occupier demand.
Portfolio & Governance Management: Oversee multi-asset, multi-city portfolios; establish structured client governance including weekly reporting, leasing dashboards, milestone tracking, and escalation frameworks.
Marketing & Positioning Execution: Conceptualize and drive go-to-market strategies, broker engagement protocols, collateral development, and targeted campaigns in collaboration with branding and design agencies.
Transaction Execution & Deal Closure: Lead high-value lease negotiations, prospect engagement, heads of terms drafting, and transaction closures while advising landlords on risk mitigation.
Stakeholder & Ecosystem Engagement: Build and maintain high-level relationships with institutional landlords, developers, corporate occupiers, investors, and third-party channel partners/agents.
Cross-Functional Integration: Collaborate with CBRE Research, Capital Markets, Project Management, and Occupier Services to deliver integrated solutions and cross-sell business lines.
Team Leadership & Performance: Mentor junior and mid-level team members, manage channel partner ecosystems, and ensure alignment with regional revenue and occupancy targets.

Candidate Profile

Experience: 712+ years of relevant commercial real estate experience, with a proven track record in Landlord Representation, agency leasing, and developer account management.
Occupier Relationship: Experience in engaging with regional and international occupiers, institutional landlords, developers, and corporate real estate (CRE) heads.
Portfolio Capabilities: Proven capability to manage multi-asset, portfolio-wide leasing mandates across geographic markets.
Commercial & Financial Acumen: Deep knowledge of commercial office lease structures, financial modeling, market dynamics, and yield optimization strategies.
Leadership & Influence: Strong negotiation, pitch presentation, and client advisory skills with an ownership mindset and the ability to operate effectively at senior executive levels.

Job Opening: Project Controls Analyst
We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Project Controls Analyst to support integrated project planning, governance, cost control, resource management, and performance reporting. Integrated Project Controls & Governance

Key Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain Alteryx workflows for data preparation, transformation, and integration.
Develop and support ETL/data workflows to ingest, cleanse, validate, and enrich data from multiple sources.
Translate business requirements into technical workflow designs and reusable components/macros.
Implement data quality checks, reconciliation logic, and exception handling to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Optimize workflow performance by improving logic, reducing run time, and managing resource usage effectively.
Document workflow logic, data mappings, and operational steps to support maintainability and handovers.
Collaborate with analysts, data engineers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues and deliver enhancements.
Support production runs, monitor scheduled workflows, and resolve failures within defined timelines.

Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelors degree (or equivalent) in Engineering/Technology/Computer Applications/Science (e.g., BTech, BE, BSc, MCA, MTech, MSc).
2-5years of experience working with Alteryx to build and maintain data preparation or automation workflows.
Strong hands-on experience in ETL and data workflow development, including transformation and validation steps.
Solid understanding of data concepts such as joins, aggregations, filtering, data types, and schema handling.
Ability to analyze requirements, debug workflow issues, and deliver reliable outputs with attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.
Understanding of analytics lifecycle practices such as versioning, documentation standards, and reusable workflow design.
Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders, present findings, and recommend improvements to data processes.
Good to have skills:
SQL, Data Warehousing, Data Quality Frameworks, Power BI, Python

Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value
(GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities
Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions formonth-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (
reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.
AboutCompany: Swiggy is an Indian online food ordering and delivery company. Founded in 2014, Swiggy is headquartered in Bangalore and operates in more than 580 Indian cities, as of July 2023.[4] Besides food delivery, the platform also provides quick commerce services under the name Swiggy Instamart, and same-day package deliveries with Swiggy Genie.

Title :- Unit Sales Manager - Health Agency
#HealthVertical - Agency channel
#Benefits : Fixed CTC + Monthly Incentive + conveyance allowance

Description:
Ways of Working - Office / Field: Employees are expected to work from the office on all days out of their respective base locations.
Role Summary - The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month. The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned.


Responsibilities
Account Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as diner denied payout and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.
Data Interpretation Business Performance Management: Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partners investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.
Interaction with Stakeholders: Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).
Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , Ads revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition


Qualifications

Desired Skills
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity Initiative: Demonstrate creativity originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Areas of responsibility include Restaurants/Bars and Room Service, if applicable.
Assists in the daily supervision restaurant operations and assists with menu planning, maintains sanitation standards and assists servers and hosts on the floor during peak meal periods.
Strives to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction.
Determines training needed to accomplish goals, then implements plan.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. OR
2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Assisting in Management of Restaurant Team
Handles employee questions and concerns.
Monitors employees to ensure performance expectations are met.

Communicates to Chef and Restaurant Manager any issues regarding food quality and service levels.
Ensures compliance with all restaurant policies, standards and procedures.
Monitors alcohol beverage service in compliance with local laws.
Manages to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
Performs all duties of restaurant employees and related departments as necessary.
Opens and closes restaurant shifts.

Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
Encourages employees to provide excellent customer service within guidelines.
Handles guest problems and complaints, seeking assistance from supervisor as necessary.
Strives to improve service performance.
Sets a positive example for guest relations.
Assists in the review of comment cards and guest satisfaction results with employees.
Meets and greets guests.
Conducting Human Resource Activities
Supervises on-going training initiatives.
Uses all available on the job training tools for employees.
Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.
Coaches and counsels employees regarding performance on an on-going basis.
Additional Responsibilities
Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
Assists servers and hosts on the floor during meal periods and high demand times.
Recognizes good quality products and presentations.
Supervises daily shift operations in absence of Restaurant Manager.

Description:
Company Name: Axis Max Life Insurance
Job Title: Manager - Training

The Manager - Training will be responsible for developing, implementing, and managing training programs aimed at enhancing the skills and knowledge of employees within the organization. This role involves conducting training needs assessments, designing training materials, and delivering engaging training sessions. The Manager will work closely with various departments to ensure alignment of training programs with company objectives and employee performance metrics. Additionally, the role requires tracking and reporting on training effectiveness and participating in continuous improvement initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Conduct training needs assessments to identify gaps in employee skills and knowledge.
2. Design and develop training programs and materials tailored to various employee groups.
3. Deliver engaging and effective training sessions using various instructional techniques.
4. Collaborate with department heads to ensure training aligns with business goals.
5. Evaluate training effectiveness through surveys, assessments, and performance metrics.
6. Provide coaching and support to employees to reinforce learning outcomes.
7. Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in training and development.
8. Manage training budgets and resources efficiently.

Skills and Tools Required:
1. Strong communication and presentation skills.
2. Ability to design and develop training materials and programs.
3. Knowledge of adult learning principles and training methodologies.
4. Proficiency in using Learning Management Systems (LMS) and training software.
5. Analytical skills to assess training effectiveness and make data-driven decisions.
6. Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively with diverse teams.
7. Project management skills to oversee training initiatives and meet deadlines.
8. Familiarity with performance management systems and tools.
9. Innovative thinking to create engaging and effective training solutions.

Preferred Qualifications:
1. Bachelor s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.
2. Proven experience in training and development within the insurance or financial services industry.
3. Certification in training or instructional design is a plus.

Operate and maintain chemical plant equipment, including reactors, distillation columns, and centrifuges.

Implement safety procedures and protocols to prevent accidents and injuries.

Conduct regular inspections of equipment and facilities to identify potential hazards or defects.

Develop and implement process improvements to increase efficiency and reduce costs.

Diploma or degree in Chemical Engineering or related field.

Minimum 2 years of experience as an operator in a chemical plant setting.

Strong knowledge of chemical plant operations, including safety procedures and protocols.

Ability to work effectively in a team environment and communicate clearly with colleagues.

Familiarity with chemical plant software and instrumentation is desirable.

Must pass a pre-employment physical and drug-alcohol screening.

Designation:- Senior Engineer
Process & Production department.

Roles & Resposibilities
1. Grinding Operation & Process Control
Operate and monitor VRPM and Cement Mill circuits through CCR and field coordination.
Ensure stable mill operation with optimum parameters (feed rate, separator efficiency, circulation load).
Maintain desired fineness, residue, and cement quality.
Optimize mill output while maintaining energy efficiency.
Monitor mill ventilation, grinding pressure, and material flow.

2. Production Planning & Execution
Execute daily cement grinding plans as per dispatch and market requirements.
Ensure maximum utilization of VRPM and Cement Mill capacity.
Coordinate with maintenance for planned shutdowns and breakdown handling.
Minimize mill stoppages and improve availability.

3. Quality Control Coordination
Coordinate with QC team to maintain cement quality parameters (fineness, residue, setting time, strength).
Adjust process parameters based on lab feedback.
Ensure proper proportioning of gypsum and additives (fly ash/slag).

4. Process Optimization & Cost Reduction
Optimize grinding efficiency and reduce power consumption (kWh/ton).
Improve VRPM performance for better pre-grinding efficiency.
Reduce recirculation load and improve separator efficiency.
Identify and implement cost-saving initiatives in grinding section.

5. Equipment Monitoring & Maintenance Coordination
Monitor critical equipment like rollers, table liners, separators, fans, and bag filters.
Ensure timely inspections and preventive maintenance.
Coordinate with maintenance team for quick resolution of breakdowns.
Track equipment performance and reliability.

6. Team Handling & Supervision
Supervise shift engineers, operators, and technicians.
Ensure proper shift management and manpower utilization.
Provide training on grinding process and safety practices.
Maintain discipline and team efficiency.

7. Safety & Compliance
Ensure adherence to safety practices in grinding section.
Monitor dust control systems (bag filters, ESPs).
Conduct safety audits and toolbox talks.
Ensure compliance with environmental norms.

8. MIS & Reporting
Prepare daily/weekly/monthly grinding performance reports.
Monitor KPIs like mill output, power consumption, and downtime.
Maintain logs for stoppages, breakdowns, and process deviations.
Report performance trends and improvement actions to management.

9. Coordination & Communication
Coordinate with Dispatch, Packing Plant, QC, and Maintenance teams.
Ensure smooth clinker supply and cement dispatch planning.
Participate in review meetings and present section performance.

Description:
ABOUT THE HANS FOUNDATION
The Hans Foundation (THF), established in 2009, is a Public Charitable Trust that works towards creating an equitable society to enhance quality of life for all through the empowerment of marginalized and underprivileged communities in India. The Hans Foundation works for the Health and Wellbeing of remote and under-served groups, with an additional focus on children, persons with disabilities and women. THF also works for holistic Education and Livelihood development of our communities. Our Two-Fold Strategy involves identifying and working within Aspirational Districts and high poverty index in the North, North-East and East regions within specific states, as well as catering to lower-income and migratory populations in cities, through urban programs.
Over its 15 years of existence, THF has reached more than 35 million beneficiaries through its programs. THF works with communities through direct implementation of projects on the ground in addition to providing local management and monitoring support to not-for-profit organisations in India funded through THF USA and RIST.
PROJECT OVERVIEW: HANS HEALTH WELLNESS CENTRE
The Hans Health Wellness Centre, Meghalaya, is a transformative initiative aimed at addressing the fundamental healthcare needs of rural and hard-to-reach populations. Recognizing the limitations of government resources, The Hans Foundation (THF) has committed to bridging the gap by taking over 50 sub-centres in the first phase. This project is designed to make a substantial impact on health parameters, particularly in reducing maternal mortality rates. Through a meticulous gap assessment, THF will provide the necessary equipment and facilities, deploy skilled human resources, and ensure comprehensive training to meet the project s demands. The initiative is not just a short-term intervention but a long-term commitment, with regular operations and monitoring to ensure sustained improvement. THF envisions this project as a model for community healthcare at the grassroots level, aspiring to set a benchmark that other states might seek to replicate, ultimately expanding its reach across the region in a phased manner.
GENERAL
Location of Job: Thiepkseh SC- West Khasi Hills (Meghalaya)
Type of Employment: Contractual for a period of one year, renewable basis of performance and project requirements
No. of Position: 1
Reporting to: Project Coordinator

1. JOB PURPOSE
Nurse (ANM/GNM) will be responsible for providing preventive, promotive and curative health care services through VHSND in the assigned villages. S/he will accompany the team and will be responsible for providing counselling services to the community and other field level communication, counseling and health education support to the program. S/he will ensure participation of the community. S/he will maintain records of patient registrations and provide health education using IEC materials.
2. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
Visit along with the team in VHSND Programs.
Ensure support and work in coordination with local community workers such as Anganwadi workers, ASHA workers for effective service delivery.
Provide preventive, promotive and curative health care services.
Conduct individual and group sessions on reproductive health, mother and child health and nutrition, communicable and non-communicable diseases, and adolescent health.
Support in the management of Sub Center especially, record keeping, management of the patient flow and medicine distribution.
Coordinate to refer the patients to nearest health facility for secondary level treatment and follow up.
Responsible for supervision of village health workers and their capacity building.
Maintain relevant reports and documents.
3. Other Indicative Requirements
Educational Qualifications : Bachelor s degree in nursing /GNM training or a related field with good knowledge in public health or hospitals
Functional / Technical Skills and Relevant Experience Other requirements (Behavioural, Language, Certifications etc.)
Experience of working in field/clinic for 1-3 years.
The candidate should be well versed with English, Hindi and local dialect.
Community mobilization and communication skills

Description:
Job Summary
The Civil Engineer will be responsible for planning, technical assessment, execution monitoring and quality supervision of construction, renovation, repair and infrastructure-development works undertaken by the Organisation. The role will ensure that civil works are completed in accordance with approved designs, specifications, budgets, timelines, safety requirements and organisational procurement and financial procedures. The position will also provide technical documentation and measurement-based verification to support transparent project implementation and payment processing.
Meghalaya


Responsibilities

A. Site Assessment and Technical Planning
Conduct site visits and assess existing infrastructure, site conditions and project requirements.
Prepare technical feasibility reports, layouts, drawings and specifications, as required.
Prepare detailed cost estimates, quantity calculations and Bills of Quantities (BOQs).
Identify material, labour, equipment and resource requirements and highlight technical risks.


B. Project Execution and Site Supervision
Supervise construction, renovation, repair and maintenance works at assigned locations.
Monitor contractors and vendors to ensure work is carried out as per approved drawings, BOQs, specifications and work orders.
Track site progress against approved timelines and budgets and submit periodic updates.
Identify delays, deviations and additional-work requirements and obtain written approval before execution of variations.
Coordinate with project teams, contractors, architects and other technical personnel.


C. Quality Control and Compliance
Inspect construction materials and workmanship at different stages of execution.
Ensure quality of materials and work conforms to approved specifications and applicable engineering standards.
Identify defects and recommend corrective measures within agreed timelines.
Monitor compliance with applicable building regulations, site-safety requirements and relevant standards.


D. Measurement and Contractor Bill Verification
Verify physical measurements and quantities of work completed at site.
Prepare or check Measurement Books (MBs) and item-wise measurement sheets.
Verify running and final contractor bills against actual work completed, approved BOQ and agreed rates.
Provide technical certification of work completed for payment processing, subject to organisational approval.
Document quantity variations, deductions and additional items with supporting justification.


E. Budgeting and Cost Monitoring
Prepare project-wise cost estimates and provide technical inputs for budget preparation.
Monitor expenditure and identify potential cost overruns or savings.
Review technical proposals for additional work and recommend cost-effective alternatives.
Ensure that work is not undertaken beyond the approved scope without prior written authorisation.


F. Procurement and Vendor Coordination
Prepare technical specifications and BOQs for procurement of civil works and materials.
Review vendor quotations for technical compliance and support preparation of technical comparisons.
Participate in technical evaluation of contractors and vendors, as required.
Coordinate with Procurement and Finance teams to ensure complete supporting documentation.


G. Safety, Documentation and Reporting
Monitor site-safety arrangements and report unsafe conditions or incidents promptly.
Maintain site inspection reports, progress records, approved drawings, BOQs and measurement records.
Maintain stage-wise and before-and-after photographs of civil works.
Prepare completion reports and technical completion certificates after verification of work.
Provide technical clarifications and records required for management reviews, audits or donor reporting.


Qualifications and Experience
Graduate degree or diploma in Civil Engineering from a recognised institution.
Relevant experience in construction, renovation, infrastructure development or civil-work supervision.
Experience in preparing BOQs, cost estimates, technical drawings and measurement books.
Working knowledge of construction materials, quality standards, site supervision and contractor bill verification.
Experience in NGO, development-sector or institutional projects will be an advantage.


Skills and Competencies
Strong technical knowledge of civil construction and renovation works.
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, BOQs and technical specifications.
Good measurement, estimation, costing and analytical skills.
Strong coordination, communication and vendor-management skills.
Ability to prepare clear site reports and maintain accurate documentation.
Proficiency in MS Office; knowledge of AutoCAD and relevant estimation tools will be an advantage.
Ability and willingness to travel to project sites, as required.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Performance Area: Timely completion; Expected Result: Civil works completed within approved timelines.
Performance Area: Budget adherence; Expected Result: Actual cost monitored against approved estimate and budget.
Performance Area: Quality; Expected Result: Compliance with approved specifications and timely closure of defects.
Performance Area: Measurement accuracy; Expected Result: Accurate and complete MBs and quantity verification.
Performance Area: Bill verification; Expected Result: Contractor bills technically checked against actual work and approved rates.
Performance Area: Documentation; Expected Result: Timely submission of site reports, photographs and completion records.
Performance Area: Safety and compliance; Expected Result: Prompt reporting and resolution/escalation of site-safety and compliance issues.


Working Relationships
The Civil Engineer will work closely with Project/Programme teams, Administration, Procurement, Finance, contractors, vendors and other stakeholders to ensure effective planning, execution, monitoring and documentation of civil works.


Authority and Accountability
The Civil Engineer is responsible for technical assessment, site supervision, measurement and technical recommendations. The Engineer shall not independently approve budgets, vendor selection, scope variations or payments unless specifically authorised in writing. All procurement, financial and administrative approvals shall follow the Organisations delegated-authority matrix and policies.
