Description:
Role & responsibilities

1. Job Purpose
To ensure efficient operation, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and breakdown maintenance of mechanical equipment in the cement plant, with specific responsibility for crushers and associated material-handling equipment to minimize downtime and ensure smooth plant operations.
2. Key Roles and Responsibilities
A. Crusher Operation and Maintenance
Perform preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance of crushers, including jaw crushers, hammer crushers, impact crushers, and other crushing equipment, as applicable to the plant.
Monitor crusher performance, vibration, temperature, noise, lubrication, and equipment condition to identify potential faults.
Inspect and maintain crusher components, including hammers, blow bars, liners, jaw plates, bearings, shafts, rotors, and drive assemblies.
Identify and troubleshoot mechanical issues related to crushing equipment and ensure timely rectification of breakdowns.
Monitor wear parts and coordinate their replacement to maintain crushing efficiency and equipment availability.
Assist in maintenance and troubleshooting of crusher feed systems, belt conveyors, vibrating screens, feeders, and associated material-handling systems.
Ensure proper alignment, clearance, lubrication, and assembly of crusher components after maintenance activities.
B. Mechanical Maintenance
Execute scheduled preventive maintenance and equipment inspections as per the maintenance plan.
Maintain and troubleshoot mechanical equipment such as conveyors, gearboxes, motors, pumps, fans, bearings, couplings, and hydraulic systems.
Assist in equipment erection, installation, alignment, dismantling, and commissioning activities.
Identify recurring mechanical failures and support root cause analysis to prevent repeated breakdowns.
Ensure the availability of critical spares and maintain records of maintenance activities, breakdowns, and equipment history.
C. Safety and Compliance
Follow plant safety procedures, Permit-to-Work (PTW), Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), and applicable PPE requirements.
Ensure safe execution of maintenance activities, particularly during crusher inspection, cleaning, and repair.
Identify unsafe conditions and report equipment abnormalities, hazards, and near misses.
Maintain good housekeeping and ensure compliance with plant safety standards.
D. Coordination and Reporting
Coordinate with production, electrical, instrumentation, and other maintenance teams for planned maintenance and breakdown resolution.
Maintain daily maintenance reports, inspection checklists, and breakdown records.
Support efforts to improve equipment reliability, reduce downtime, and optimize maintenance costs.
2.. Educational Qualification
Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering.
Relevant technical qualifications in mechanical maintenance may be considered based on experience and company requirements.
3. Required Technical Skills
Practical knowledge of crusher maintenance, wear parts, bearings, shafts, lubrication, and drive mechanisms.
Understanding of preventive maintenance, breakdown maintenance, and basic troubleshooting techniques.
Knowledge of conveyors, feeders, gearboxes, couplings, and material-handling equipment.
Ability to read mechanical drawings, equipment manuals, and maintenance checklists.
Basic knowledge of maintenance planning, spare parts management, and root cause analysis.
Working knowledge of MS Excel and maintenance reporting systems.

4. Preferred Candidate Profile
Candidates with hands-on experience in crusher maintenance within a cement manufacturing plant, particularly limestone/raw material crushing, are preferred. The candidate should possess sound mechanical troubleshooting skills and the ability to support preventive and breakdown maintenance activities independently under the guidance of the senior maintenance team.

Description:
You will be the main point of contact for a small group of 3 to 5 client accounts. You run their client calls, plan and track their monthly work with our specialist teams, check the work before it reaches the client, and make sure every client gets what we promised, on time. You dont do the execution yourself. Our SEO, social media, ads, design, video and tech specialists do. You make sure it happens, and that its right.


What this Role Is
youve handled client accounts at a digital marketing agency, you understand marketing well enough to brief and check the work, and youre very organised.


What this Role Is Not
your background is IT project management, sales only, or SaaS customer support without marketing.


Responsibilities
Own your clients. Be the main contact for your 3 to 5 accounts. Lead the weekly and monthly client calls, and bring in a specialist when something technical needs explaining.
Plan the month. Take each clients agreed monthly plan and turn it into dated tasks, one task per line, on your client dashboard.
Track every day. Know whats happening on every task, spot delays early, and follow up with the team before a date slips.
Check before it goes out. Make sure every deliverable matches what the client asked for and what was agreed, after our team leads have approved the craft.
Report. Send each client a weekly update and a monthly report that explains results clearly.
Handle changes properly. Know the difference between a revision and new work. Log extra requests and get them priced, rather than quietly absorbing them.
Chase client inputs. Get the approvals, access and content you need from the client, early and in writing.
Keep and grow your accounts. Look after renewals, and spot where a client would benefit from more of our services.
Know your numbers. Understand the revenue and cost of your client group, and help keep it healthy.


Requirements
3 to 6 years of experience, with at least 2 years in client servicing or account management at a digital marketing agency
Has handled at least 3 clients at the same time
Understands social media, ads, SEO and content, and design and video well enough to brief and check the work
Very organised: trackers, dashboards or project tools like Asana, ClickUp, Trello or Google Sheets
Calm and clear in difficult client conversations
Excellent written and spoken English


Nice to Have
International clients (UK, US, UAE)
Both B2B and B2C clients
Understands marketing numbers: leads, cost per lead, traffic, engagement
Experience preparing client reports and presentations


Not Needed
Hands-on execution skills. Our specialist teams do the work.


KPIs
Your clients get what we promised, on time
Little work sent back by clients
Your clients renew and grow with us
Problems caught by you before the client notices
Clear, on-time weekly updates and monthly reports


Perks
Own a small, focused group of accounts: no juggling 15 clients
Specialist teams behind you, so you can focus on the client
A clear path to Client Servicing Lead

Description:
At Saturday Art Class (SArC), we believe that every child deserves the tools to imagine, express, and grow. Saturday Art Class is a non-profit organization that provides visual arts and social-emotional learning (SEL) education to children from low-income communities in India. By creating safe spaces for students to express themselves, we help them build essential skills to thrive during their formative years.
Join us as we continue to make creativity a right, not a privilege, for every child, everywhere.
Role Overview
The Manager will play a critical role in anchoring the organization\'s work in Meghalaya by serving as a key bridge between the Mumbai-based team and state government stakeholders. The role will ensure seamless coordination across partnerships, training initiatives, curriculum contextualisation, and on-ground implementation. Working closely with government officials, school systems, and internal teams, the Manager will enable effective communication, alignment, and execution, ensuring that program design is responsive to the local context while staying aligned with organizational goals.
Roles and Responsibilities
Government Liaisoning and Partnerships
Act as a key point of coordination with government stakeholders, including DERT, the Directorate of School Education, and the MPower team
Support communication, scheduling, and follow-ups for meetings, reviews, and program updates
Build and maintain strong working relationships with state and district-level stakeholders to ensure alignment and continuity
Prepare briefs, reports, and communication materials for government engagements
Proactively engage with government stakeholders to understand priorities, evolving needs, and policy directions, and translate these into program actions
Ensure timely sharing of updates, data, and reports with government officials to build trust and transparency.
Support the preparation and facilitation of review meetings, presentations, and field visits with government stakeholders.
Track key decisions, approvals, and action points from government interactions, ensuring timely follow-through.
Identify opportunities to deepen the partnership, including scale-up, integration into existing systems, and long-term collaboration.
Training Coordination and Support
Plan and coordinate teacher training programs in collaboration with internal teams and government partners
Manage logistics, communication, and on-ground facilitation support for training sessions.
Track participation, engagement, and feedback from educators to inform ongoing improvements.
Support documentation of training processes and outcomes.
Curriculum Contextualisation
Act as a key bridge between government stakeholders and the internal curriculum team to co-develop a contextually relevant and effective well-being curriculum
Work closely with the curriculum team to adapt and contextualise the visual arts curriculum for Meghalaya
Incorporate local culture, practices, and classroom realities into curriculum design
Facilitate continuous feedback loops between government stakeholders, educators, and the curriculum team
Support pilot implementation of curriculum in schools and gather insights for iteration
Ensure alignment of curriculum with state priorities and education frameworks
Monitoring, Evaluation, and On-Ground Observations
Conduct regular school visits to observe classroom implementation and training impact
Collect qualitative and quantitative data to support monitoring and evaluation efforts
Document classroom practices, student engagement, and educator facilitation
Regularly review program dashboards and extract relevant insights to share with government officials and internal teams
Present key data points and trends to support decision-making, program improvements, and stakeholder updates
Share insights and feedback with internal teams to strengthen program design and delivery.
Program Coordination and Execution
Ensure alignment across partnerships, training, curriculum, and M&E workstreams, proactively identifying and resolving gaps.
Track progress of key program activities, timelines, and deliverables, ensuring accountability across teams.
Support and drive internal coordination between teams to enable smooth and timely on-ground execution.
Flag risks, delays, and dependencies early, and work with relevant stakeholders to problem-solve and course-correct.
Maintain structured trackers and systems for program management, ensuring visibility and transparency across teams.
Contribute to periodic reports, case studies, and program updates for both internal review and external stakeholders.
Support planning and execution of review meetings with government and internal teams, ensuring clear documentation and follow-through on action points.
Qualifications & Experience
5-6 years of experience in program management, operations, communications, consulting, or similar roles
Experience working closely with senior leadership and/or government stakeholders, with the ability to manage both strategic and operational responsibilities
Prior experience in the education or social sector is preferred, especially within government or school-based programs
Experience working in or with government systems, NGOs, or multi-stakeholder environments, particularly in Northeast India, is an added advantage
Demonstrated experience in professional writing, stakeholder communication, and supporting training or capacity-building initiatives, along with the ability to manage field operations and program tracking, documentation, and basic M&E processes.
Strong proficiency with Google Workspace, project management platforms, and communication tools
Based in Shillong, Meghalaya, with a willingness to travel across districts in Meghalaya as required
Working knowledge of Khasi and/or Garo is strongly preferred
Skills and Mindset
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with government stakeholders and represent the organization clearly
High ownership, reliability, and follow-through; able to independently drive workstreams and ensure closure
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, especially in managing multiple priorities and stakeholders
Ability to operate in dynamic, on-ground contexts

Job Summary

You have done hands-on SEO and outbound for clients, and you are ready to lead a team.

Plan the strategy. Build SEO, content, LinkedIn and cold email plans for each client, with clear targets you can stand behind.

Requirements
4 to 7 years in B2B and B2C marketing, at an agency, a consultancy or an in-house team
Hands-on SEO and content experience
Hands-on cold email or LinkedIn outbound experience
Has managed or guided at least 1 or 2 people (team members or freelancers)
Comfortable talking to clients, including when the news is not good
Clear written English


Nice to Have
Experience with tools like Ahrefs or Semrush, Search Console, Apollo, Instantly, Smartlead or Lemlist
Worked with international clients (UK, US, UAE)
Worked on website builds or redesigns
Uses AI tools well, and checks their output properly


KPIs
Client work delivered on time and to a high standard
More traffic, leads and meetings for clients, against the targets you set
Fast replies to every lead from outbound campaigns
A team that gets better under you
Clear, on-time progress reports


Working Hours
Monday to Friday, 11 AM to 6 PM, at our Mohali or Shillong office. Some Saturdays may be working days.

A. About the Role:
We are looking for an experienced Manager/ Senior Analyst Management Consulting (Commercial) to support the execution of a consultancy assignment with Meghalaya Energy Corporation Limited (MeECL) and its subsidiaries viz. Meghalaya Power Generation Corporation Limited, Meghalaya Power Transmission Corporation Limited and Meghalaya Power Distribution Corporation Limited. The role involves supporting the Meghalaya Power Distribution Corporation Limited in supporting in day to day commercial activities such as monitoring the billing, collections, identification of energy and revenue leakages etc.

B. Detailed expectations from the role:
The Manager shall be responsible for providing strategic and operational consulting support on Commercial function. Key responsibilities include:

Business Process Re-engineering
Review the existing process of reporting of key commercial parameters of the Distribution utility.
Prepare a Standard Operating Procedure for reporting of the key parameters along with responsibility matrix.
Engage with all the Stakeholders and get the feedback from them on the proposed SOP including middle and lower management.
Assist in the implementation of the Standard Operating Procedure within timeframes as approved by the Management.
Provide on recommendations on digital interventions along with the probable solutions along with the cost benefit analysis.
Formulate standardized daily, weekly and monthly reporting formats on key parameters with diagnostic analysis along with probable interventions to capture adverse deviations.

Billing and Collection
Monitoring the effective of billing and facilitating in ensuring 100 % billing.
Formulating Process of Billing Quality check. like- Under billed consumers, Overbilled, never billed.
Preparing of Billing, Collection & customer data Management Information reports from the billing Master data.
Billing & Collection Analysis of consumers of various categories.
Suggesting Changes & improvement of Billing system to minimize errors and system gaps.
Work in close coordination with the Unified Billing System provider.
Analyze the data of Smart Metered Consumers in terms of key parameters and prepare a report on the deviations along with the corrective actions. The report is to be circulated to all lower, middle and top management and vigilance team for corrective actions.
Suggesting the utilities on best practices in the industry for billing and collection checks.
Coordinate with Distribution Franchisee operator for submission of monthly MIS as per the contract document.

Management Review
Prepare presentation at sub-division level for the review meeting by management highlighting the key parameters along with the diagnostic analysis and suggestions for improvement.
Coordinate with the sub-divisions level officers for the Action Taken Report after each review meeting.

C. Required skill set:
Strong technical and commercial knowledge about the power distribution business.
Strong analytical, documentation, and report-writing skills.
Experience in handling smart meter data
Working knowledge of key regulatory interventions effecting the commercial parameters of DISCOM.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities.
Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and MS Office applications.
Experience working with State DISCOMs, Government Utilities, or Power Sector Consulting organizations will be preferred.

D. Education and Experience:
BE/ B. Tech/ MBA/ M. Tech (Candidates with B. Tech and MBA may be preferred but not mandatory).
Knowledge of advanced MS Excel and Microsoft Power point is highly preferred.
Atleast 5 Years experience in Commercial Matters of DISCOM or consultancy company.

E. Location:
Shillong, Meghalaya.
The role will involve regular interaction with utility officials and may require field visits within Meghalaya based on project requirements.

F. Remuneration Structure:
We offer a motivation-based and competitive reward package aligned with international consulting industry benchmarks.

Mercados Energy Markets India Pvt. Ltd. (Mercados) is a specialist consultancy firm, exclusively focused on business solutions in the energy and environment domain. We strive to promote efficient and sustainable energy markets; design effective regulations and assist energy businesses to succeed. Our approach integrates innovative, state-of-the-art techniques with practical, tailor-made solutions to solve current energy sector challenges. We have permanent offices in New Delhi (head office), Gurugram, Mumbai, Ahmedabad and Lucknow and various Project offices across India.

While the Management Consulting Vertical provides leading edge Advisory solutions to generation companies with over 42 GWs of conventional and renewable energy-based capacities, distribution companies with over 54 million consumers and large industrial consumers: the Enterprise SaaS Vertical aims at offering tailor-made digital solutions, power portfolio management, generation planning and algorithmic trading solutions – “jouleOS” - to Utilities in India.

Summary
The Area Sales Manager is a key strategic leader within the solar energy industry, responsible for driving revenue growth and expanding market presence across a defined geographic region. This role focuses on building and managing a high-performing B2B sales team, cultivating relationships with commercial and industrial clients, and executing targeted sales strategies to achieve aggressive quarterly and annual targets. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in B2B sales within the renewable energy sector, with a proven ability to navigate complex procurement processes, negotiate long-term contracts, and deliver scalable solar solutions. As a critical link between the organization and its enterprise clients, the Area Sales Manager plays a pivotal role in advancing sustainable energy adoption, contributing to corporate sustainability goals, and strengthening the companys position as a leader in the solar industry.

Responsibilities
Develop and execute regional sales strategies aligned with company growth objectives and market opportunities in the solar energy sector.
Lead, mentor, and manage a team of B2B sales representatives, ensuring performance excellence through coaching, goal setting, and regular feedback.
Identify, qualify, and pursue new commercial and industrial B2B prospects, focusing on solar PV system installations for businesses, manufacturing facilities, and institutional clients.
Build and maintain strategic relationships with key decision-makers at enterprise accounts, including facility managers, sustainability officers, and procurement teams.
Collaborate with technical and project development teams to deliver customized solar solutions that meet client energy needs and financial objectives.
Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and customer behavior to refine sales approaches and improve win rates.
Prepare and present detailed proposals, financial models, and ROI analyses to support client decision-making.
Track and report on sales pipeline, forecast accuracy, and KPIs using CRM platforms to ensure transparency and data-driven planning.
Ensure compliance with industry regulations, safety standards, and company policies throughout the sales and project handoff process.

Requirements
Requirements:
Bachelors degree in Business, Engineering, Renewable Energy, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
Proven experience (5+ years) in B2B sales, with a strong track record of exceeding sales targets in the renewable energy, clean tech, or construction industry.
In-depth knowledge of solar energy systems, including photovoltaic (PV) technology, financing models (PPA, lease, cash purchase), and incentive programs (e.g., ITC, state rebates).
Demonstrated ability to manage complex sales cycles involving multi-stakeholder decision-making and long-term contracts.
Proficiency in CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and Microsoft Office Suite for reporting, forecasting, and client presentations.
Strong negotiation, presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence at the executive level.
Valid drivers license and willingness to travel extensively within the assigned region.
Experience in team leadership and performance management, including hiring, training, and performance evaluation.
Familiarity with sustainability metrics and ESG reporting is a plus.

Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance

Description:
Job Summary
Programme Lead - Community Libraries
Location: Shillong, Meghalaya, India
Contract: Fixed term consulting contract
Based on previous CTC and experience
Project Background
Sauramandala Foundation is an NGO founded in 2018 with a vision to bring about systemic change in the lives of remote communities through empathetic, collaborative, and contextual solutions that are co-created with the communities themselves.
About the Project (CM Youth Center):
The Government of Meghalaya, in partnership with Sauramandala Foundation, has established 22 rural community centres for youth, called the Chief Ministers Youth Centers (CMYC) with an aim to build resilience, agency and problem-solving skills in the community. The key programmes in the CMYCs are - Self Designed Learning, Entrepreneurship Development, Sports Coaching, Arts and Theatre and a Community Library Programme. The learning is open to all ages to have more involvement from the community. The CMYCs are set to expand from 22 centers to cover all 55 blocks of Meghalaya over a 2 year period.
Objective of the Engagement
To design and operationalize well-resourced, welcoming libraries in CMYCs that:
Build a culture of reading by working closely with children, young adults and youth in the community.
Serve as learning hubs supporting adolescent well-being and development.
Scope of Work
Curation
Build vibrant, culturally rooted, multilingual collections for children, young adults and youth.
Curate collections across themes of well-being, mental health, coming of age, gender, environment, sci-fi, indigenous knowledge and local culture and so on.
Ensure enough reading materials for beginner to confident and advanced readers.
Programme Design
Support the design of libraries and child and youth-friendly spaces.
Design a joyful community library programme that makes reading social, engaging and meaningful.
Create spaces for dialogue and self expression - reading circles, book discussions, open mics, writing labs, movie screenings and debrief reflections.
Integrate life skills and SEL into the library programme to build empathy, self-confidence, critical thinking etc.
Design for the library activities to travel to nearby villages around the Youth Center and to engage with existing Youth Clubs.
Building Community Ownership
Position the CMYC and the libraries as a community asset by engaging the community especially the adults to build a connection with the space.
Organise reading festivals, youth showcases, and community celebrations.
Create systems to encourage youth to play an active role in shaping the libraries - youth volunteers, library leaders and so on.
Strengthening libraries as safe, welcoming, learning hubs
Develop a simple monitoring framework for smooth operations.
Train first-time libraries with tools and techniques on youth engagement, creating safe spaces, facilitating shared reading experiences in the libraries.
Bring in low-cost digital tools and offline e-resources where possible.
Document learnings and adolescent and youth stories from the libraries.
Expected area of expertise
Master's Degree in Education/Library & Information Science or related field (preferred, not mandatory).
8-9 years of experience in setting up community libraries, training librarians and educators to build a culture of reading.
Any certifications on library science or engagements with organisations working in the field is preferred.
Strong knowledge of curation for different age groups from children to young adults and youth.
Ability to design and facilitate training workshops for first-time librarians.
Adaptability to an agile, cross-functional, collaborative working environment.

ABOUT THE HANS FOUNDATION
The Hans Foundation (THF), established in 2009, is a Public Charitable Trust that works towards creating an equitable society to enhance quality of life for all through the empowerment of marginalized and underprivileged communities in India. The Hans Foundation works for the Health and Wellbeing of remote and under-served groups, with an additional focus on children, persons with disabilities and women. THF also works for holistic Education and Livelihood development of our communities. Our Two-Fold Strategy involves identifying and working within Aspirational Districts and high poverty index in the North, North-East and East regions within specific states, as well as catering to lower-income and migratory populations in cities, through urban programs.
Over its 15 years of existence, THF has reached more than 35 million beneficiaries through its programs. THF works with communities through direct implementation of projects on the ground in addition to providing local management and monitoring support to not-for-profit organisations in India funded through THF USA and RIST.
PROJECT OVERVIEW: HANS HEALTH & WELLNESS CENTRE
The Hans Health & Wellness Centre, Meghalaya, is a transformative initiative aimed at addressing the fundamental healthcare needs of rural and hard-to-reach populations. Recognizing the limitations of government resources, The Hans Foundation (THF) has committed to bridging the gap by taking over 50 sub-centres in the first phase. This project is designed to make a substantial impact on health parameters, particularly in reducing maternal mortality rates. Through a meticulous gap assessment, THF will provide the necessary equipment and facilities, deploy skilled human resources, and ensure comprehensive training to meet the project s demands. The initiative is not just a short-term intervention but a long-term commitment, with regular operations and monitoring to ensure sustained improvement. THF envisions this project as a model for community healthcare at the grassroots level, aspiring to set a benchmark that other states might seek to replicate, ultimately expanding its reach across the region in a phased manner.

1. JOB PURPOSE
Nurse (ANM/GNM) will be responsible for providing preventive, promotive and curative health care services through VHSND in the assigned villages. S/he will accompany the team and will be responsible for providing counselling services to the community and other field level communication, counseling and health education support to the program. S/he will ensure participation of the community. S/he will maintain records of patient registrations and provide health education using IEC materials.
2. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
Visit along with the team in VHSND Programs.
Ensure support and work in coordination with local community workers such as Anganwadi workers, ASHA workers for effective service delivery.
Provide preventive, promotive and curative health care services.
Conduct individual and group sessions on reproductive health, mother and child health and nutrition, communicable and non-communicable diseases, and adolescent health.
Support in the management of Sub Center especially, record keeping, management of the patient flow and medicine distribution.
Coordinate to refer the patients to nearest health facility for secondary level treatment and follow up.
Responsible for supervision of village health workers and their capacity building.
Maintain relevant reports and documents.
3. Other Indicative Requirements
Educational Qualifications : Bachelor s degree in nursing /ANM/GNM training or a related field with good knowledge in public health or hospitals

Position: Community Program & Skill Development Officer
Department: Hospital Administration / Community Outreach
Reporting To: Medical Superintendent
Location: Tura, Meghalaya
Gender: Male or Female (Both can apply)
Position Summary
The Community Program & Skill Development Officer will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and implementing community outreach programs, health awareness campaigns, and skill development initiatives in villages and surrounding areas of Tura, Meghalaya. The role requires building strong relationships with local communities, government agencies, NGOs, schools, and village leaders to improve public health awareness and healthcare accessibility.
Key Responsibilities
Community Outreach & Awareness
Plan and conduct health awareness programs in villages, schools, community centres, and local institutions.
Organize health camps, screening programs, and preventive healthcare awareness drives.
Educate communities on topics such as maternal and child health, nutrition, sanitation, hygiene, communicable and non-communicable diseases.
Develop strategies to increase community participation in hospital-led health initiatives.
Design and implement skill development and capacity-building programs for community members.
Conduct training programs for community volunteers, healthcare workers, and self-help groups.
Identify local skill gaps and create relevant development initiatives.
Coordinate with government departments and development agencies for training support.
Build and maintain relationships with village heads, local authorities, NGOs, schools, and community-based organizations.
Liaise with government departments and healthcare agencies for collaborative programs.
Represent the hospital in community meetings and public events.
Develop IEC (Information, Education, and Communication) materials for awareness campaigns.
Promote hospital services and healthcare initiatives within target communities.
Utilize local languages and culturally appropriate communication methods to maximize outreach impact.
Required Qualifications
Graduate degree in Social Work, Community Development, Public Health, Sociology, Rural Development, Healthcare Management, or related field.
Postgraduate qualification will be an added advantage.
Experience
Minimum 3-5 years of experience in community development, healthcare outreach, CSR projects, rural development, skill development, or social sector initiatives.
Experience working with rural communities in Meghalaya or the Northeast region is preferred.
Skills & Competencies
Strong communication and public speaking abilities.
Ability to conduct community mobilization and awareness programs.
Good networking and stakeholder management skills.
Strong organizational and reporting capabilities.
Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Ability to travel extensively to villages and remote locations around Tura and Meghalaya.
Knowledge of local languages and cultural practices will be an advantage.
Preferred Attributes
Passion for community service and public health improvement.
Leadership skills and ability to work independently.
Problem-solving and initiative-taking mindset.
Strong interpersonal and team-building abilities.
Those interested can share their cv to hrgen@acarehospitals.com

Description:
BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT / TEAM LEAD - PHARMA SALES
Department: Sales Business Development
Industry: Pharmaceutical / Pharma OTC / Generics
Experience: 2-5 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Role Objective
The candidate will be responsible for driving sales and brand promotion through local market visits, retail/store engagement, dealer and distributor management, and market development. The role requires a candidate with practical knowledge of the pharmaceutical/OTC/generic products market and experience in handling channel sales.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and grow sales across assigned local markets and territories.
Visit medical stores, pharmacies, retail outlets, and other relevant local stores for product promotion and sales development.
Build and maintain strong relationships with dealers, distributors, stockists, and retailers.
Identify new dealers/distributors and expand the distribution network.
Promote assigned pharmaceutical, OTC, or generic products within the retail and distribution channel.
Generate orders and achieve monthly/quarterly sales targets.
Monitor product availability, stock movement, and market demand.
Coordinate with distributors and retailers to ensure regular product supply.
Conduct regular market visits to understand competitor activities, pricing, product availability, and customer requirements.
Support brand promotion activities and execute local-market sales initiatives.
Follow up on outstanding orders and coordinate for timely delivery.
Collect market feedback and communicate customer/product requirements to the management.
Prepare regular sales, market visit, and distributor activity reports.
For a Team Lead position, guide team members, monitor field activities, and support achievement of territory-level targets.
Required Experience
2-5 years of relevant sales/business development experience in the pharmaceutical sector.
Candidates must have experience in Pharma / Pharma OTC / Generic products.
Candidates with experience as Medical Representatives (MRs) may be considered only if their experience includes retail, distributor, dealer, stockist, or channel sales.
Experience in dealer/distributor handling and market development is mandatory.
Experience in local store/pharmacy visits and product promotion will be preferred.
Educational Qualification
Graduate in any discipline.
Candidates with B.Pharm / D.Pharm / B.Sc. / B.Com / BBA / equivalent qualifications may be preferred, depending on relevant sales experience.
Key Skills
Pharma Sales Business Development
Dealer Distributor Management
Retail/Local Market Visits
Brand Product Promotion
Channel Sales Market Development
Sales Target Achievement
Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate should be a field-oriented sales professional with strong knowledge of the pharmaceutical/OTC/generic market, good communication and negotiation skills, and practical experience managing dealers, distributors, stockists, pharmacies, and retail outlets.
Budget: Maximum 30,000 net per month, depending on experience and suitability.

Description:
Financial management tools should demonstrate the same care and craft as consumer software, designed with contemporary, human-centred practices. Join our Design team supporting Wholesale Lending Services to help reimagine lending journeys and design servicing applications, with a particular focus on applying agentic AI and automation to improve user experiences and streamline servicing workflows.
Job Summary
As a Senior UX Design Associate within the Design team supporting Wholesale Lending Services, based in Bangalore, you will engage in the full design process, from research and insights through ideation, prototyping, testing and delivery of final designs. You will partner with Product, Technology and Operations, as well as Experience Design teams across other operations businesses, to shape lending journeys and servicing application experiences. Working closely with business stakeholders and users, you will apply user-centred design practices to address complex problems. You will bring strengths in interaction design and a desire to continually broaden and improve your skills.
Job Responsibilities
Design and redesign lending journeys and servicing applications across Wholesale Lending Services.
Partner with UX Researchers and Lead Designers to participate in upfront user research, understand user needs and behaviours, and conduct usability testing to evaluate design solutions.
Collaborate with Product, Technology and Operations, as well as Experience Design teams across other operations businesses, advocating for the user s perspective.
Use ideation and prototyping to explore different options, including innovative, practical solutions.
Define product interactions through user flows and wireframes.
Develop detailed designs using our Design System to bring solutions to life.
Present your work and articulate design decisions to Product team leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
Required Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills
A bachelor s degree in a relevant design discipline, such as Interaction Design, Human-Computer Interaction or User Experience Design; certification from a credible bootcamp or similar accelerated learning programme; or equivalent work experience.
A minimum of three years of relevant work experience.
Ability to plan and structure your own work, delivering quality outcomes within expected timeframes.
Demonstrated experience applying user-centred design approaches.
Experience collaborating within design teams, including designers, UX researchers and content designers, and cross-functionally with Product Managers and software engineers.
Strong interaction design skills, paired with proficiency in visual/UI design or information architecture, and developing skills in adjacent areas such as user research, UX writing and prototyping.
Ability to demonstrate how an understanding of technical constraints and opportunities has informed your design solutions.
Intermediate communication and presentation skills, including the ability to articulate the rationale behind design decisions within the team.
Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills
Prior experience designing applications within complex business domains.
Developing understanding of accessibility guidelines and inclusive design practices.
Experience shipping digital products or developing a launch-ready prototype.
Understanding of the basic technical context of your designs, including familiarity with HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
Foundational understanding of business needs and how design supports them.
Developing experience using AI-powered analytics, workflow automation, or intelligent process tools to drive efficiency gains, reduce manual effort, or improve accuracy in operational processes

Description:
Sector Specialists are subject matter experts in sectors such as Healthcare, Financial Services, Consumer Goods & Services, Retail, etc. The role involves building Industry Landscape, Sector Definition, identifying interesting Business Models, and Competitor Analysis. This research is used by numerous Venture Funds and Corporates to make their investment decisions.

Key Responsibilities
Industry Definition
Conduct in-depth research to identify Markets in the Industry.
Eg: Consumer Goods Industry would include Markets like Consumer Electronics, Fashion, FMCG, etc.
Market Definition
Build an in-depth understanding of companies operating in the market.
Identify sectors that would be interesting for VC / PE clients for investment.
Eg: Consumer Electronics Market would include sectors like Mobiles, Computers, Home Appliances, etc.
Market Taxonomy
Classify the companies in groups and build a detailed taxonomy of the market.
Eg: Zomato and FreshMenu would be classified in different groups for the FoodTech segment.
Track companies and events in the sector to continuously improve the taxonomy.
Build a landscape view of the Market showcasing the most important sub-markets.
Identify Top Business Models
Study Business Models used by companies and evaluate their long term sustainability.
Provide ratings for business models based on the market size.
Competitor Analysis
Study the top companies in each market and identify competitors.
Develop an in-depth understanding of the Tracxn platform and features.
Conduct Daily Review meetings with the Manager. Actively seek feedback on the approach, quality, and throughput of all work done. Implement suggestions.

Requirement:
Organized and focused on delivering tasks within defined deadlines
Strive for Excellence. Perform at the highest levels of accuracy and efficiency
Strong commitment to improving things every day
Seek Continuous Feedback
Strong Team Player
High Sense of Ownership

What can you expect at Tracxn?
Meritocracy Driven, Candid Culture. No Politics
Like-minded Intellectually Curious Colleagues
High-Paced Learning. Continuous Mentorship to help Achieve Peak Potential

Founders:
Neha Singh (ex-Sequoia, BCG | MBA - Stanford GSB)
Abhishek Goyal (ex-Accel Partners, Amazon | BTech - IIT Kanpur)

About Tracxn:
Tracxn (www.tracxn.com) is a Bangalore-based product company providing a research and deal sourcing platform for Venture Capital, Private Equity, CorpDev and professionals working around the startup ecosystem.
We are a team of 600+ working professionals serving customers across the globe. Our clients include Funds like Andreessen Horowitz, Sequoia Capital, Accel Partners, NEA, and Large Corporates such as ING, Societe Generale, LG, and Royal Bank of Canada.

Summary

Fundamental proficiency in computer operations.
Capacity to maintain productivity within a rapid-paced operational environment.

Description:
Job Summary
The opportunity: Consultant-AMI-Business Consulting Risk-CNS - Risk - Process & Controls - Mumbai
AMI
The Advanced Manufacturing, Mobility & Infrastructure (AMI) Industry Market contains the following industries: Aerospace and Defence, Chemicals, Infrastructure, Industrial Products, Automotive, and Transportation that includes Mobility-as-a-Service. We help our clients to address the rapidly changing needs of our business world on not only how goods and services are bought and sold, but also on how they are designed and created. AMI builds and shares resources across sectors facing common challenges and aims to drive more effective cross-sector collaboration while enabling greater resource-pooling and developing more cohesive market responses. AMI also presents an opportunity to connect regional sector communities with a more robust, global priority sector infrastructure.
CNS - Risk - Process & Controls
EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organizations ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are :
Enterprise Risk - helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls
Technology Risk - helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses.
Financial Services Risk - helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management.
Your key responsibilities
Technical Excellence
Internal audit experience for 0-2 years
To qualify for the role you must have
Qualification
Chartered Accountant
Experience
0-2 years
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Description:
Join JPMorganChase as a Fund Services Associate I and become an integral part of our dynamic team. This role offers a unique opportunity to enhance your career by working closely with operations, financial controllers, and external partners. Youll be at the forefront of ensuring smooth fund servicing operations while contributing to process improvements. Embrace the chance to grow your skills in a supportive environment that values innovation and collaboration.

As a Fund Servicing Associate I within JPMorganChase, you will play a pivotal role in enhancing our operational services related to fund accounting and administration. Your work will have a meaningful impact within our department, as you apply your broad knowledge of fund servicing principles and practices to perform diverse activities requiring analysis and judgement. With your advanced emotional intelligence, you will build trusting relationships with peers, managers, and stakeholders, fostering a collaborative environment. Your continuous improvement mindset will drive you to propose and implement improvements to our current working methods, contributing to the efficiency and resilience of our operating platform.

Job responsibilities
Manage teams within the Global/Regional IBOR function and act as the client-facing escalation point.
Participate in, represent, and help implement the ongoing IMOS global strategy.
Own and/or oversee daily operational activities essential to the construction and delivery of IBOR client reporting.
Identify opportunities to improve service levels and operational efficiency for both J.P. Morgan and the client.
Maintain robust SOPs / procedures / guidelines aligned to corporate risk and control standards; ensure SOPs are updated as processes change.
Provide subject matter expertise to support efficiency initiatives and continuous improvement projects.
Partner cross-functionally with Technology, Service, Product, and Operations to manage end-to-end IBOR service delivery.
Oversee/own (as needed) reconciliations and transaction lifecycle management.
Support planning and execution for onboarding new tasks/funds, including UAT testing.
Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills
Demonstrated experience managing teams across process, risk, and control within Investment Operations, including managing change.
Strong client-facing capability and communication style; comfortable engaging with key clients.
Extensive product knowledge across OTC, Exchange Traded Derivatives (ETDs), Fixed Income, Equities, and other financial instruments.
Experience across Investment Operations including Trades, Cash, and Reconciliations.
Experience in reconciliations and transaction lifecycle management.
Experience in workflow and vendor management supporting end-client reporting.
Highly organized with ability to prioritize, meet tight deadlines, and meet client expectations.
Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills
Middle Office experience within Investment Operations (preferred but not required, per the JD wording).
Exposure to LLM Suite / AI tools and applying them to day-to-day BAU to improve efficiency and controls.
Developing experience using AI-powered analytics, workflow automation, or intelligent process tools to drive efficiency gains, reduce manual effort, or improve accuracy in operational processes

Job Summary
The opportunity: Consultant-National-TAX-TAX - Other - Other Services - Mumbai
National comprises of sector agnostic teams working across industries for a well rounded experience.
TAX - Other - Other Services: Our globally coordinated tax professionals offer connected services across all tax disciplines to help the clients thrive in an era of rapid change. We combine our exceptional knowledge and experience with the people and technology platforms to equip clients in making better business decisions by bringing insights to the forefront. We help companies understand the tax policies and tax laws of governments around the world to plan and comply accordingly. Our teams leverage transformative technologies to deliver strategy and execution, from tax and regulatory obligations to operations and workforce management, to reduce risk and drive sustainable value.

Research and analyze complex, novel, and interesting tax technical issues for advising clients/ client teams
Assist by providing accurate, timely and reliable drafts for research papers, guidance notes, opinions, and memos on tax technical issues

Assist partners in preparing presentations for external/internal direct tax conferences

Chartered Accountant
Experience
Income-tax

People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner, having strong analytical skills and affinity towards reading and interpreting law. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.
Preferred experience
Participation in income tax seminars, conferences, lecture meetings organised by professional bodies like ICAI, BCAS or CTC
Delivered presentations, trainings or written articles on income tax subjects

email communication with client.

• Effective problem solving skills as well as ability to proactively identifying process improvements which reduce operational costs and maintain quality.

Department: Treasury
Reporting To: Manager - Treasury
Job Location: Mumbai
Education Qualification Required: B Com/M Com
Number of Years of Experience Required: 2-4Yrs
Summary:
The Treasury Analyst is responsible for the day-to-day management of treasury operations, ensuring efficient cash flow, accurate financial reporting, and compliance with internal controls and regulations.
Key Responsibilities:
Daily:
Cash Management:
Prepare and share daily cash position reports with OpCo and regional teams.
Report cluster and cash balances to GL and Treasury Manager.
Manage fund flow and cash flow, including loan disbursements, payments, rollovers, and follow-ups.
Share bank debits with the Payments team and credits with the Collection team.
Share bank statements (collections) with relevant teams.
Accounting and Reporting:
Account for and approve treasury-related entries and share with the GL team for posting.
Prepare Bank Reconciliation Statements (BRSs).
Follow up with Collection and Payment teams to resolve open items in BRS.
Arrange entries for Conversion of EEFC balances to INR as needed.
Transaction Processing:
Prepare fund transfer letters, dial online transactions, and prepare checks for manual transfers.
Provide inward remittance purpose to banks for accurate credit allocation.
Weekly:
Prepare and share weekly cash flow forecasts.
Submit weekly cash reports to WPP Group Treasury.
Monthly:
Prepare and review intercompany cash pooling workings, entries, and payments, ensuring compliance with SOX controls.
Prepare Balance Sheet schedules (intercompany, expense, and income).
Generate stale cheque schedules.
Obtain balance confirmations and user access reports from banks.
Quarterly:
Obtain bank mandates from banks.
Yearly:
Ensure smooth dividend payout.
Manage timely renewal of LEI code.
As and When Required:
Handle documentation and setup for new account openings, bank mandate updates, net banking document execution, and signatory maintenance.
Maintain Board Resolutions as per OpCo or WPP SSC Treasury instructions.
Respond to audit queries (SOX, Statutory, Income Tax, Internal).
Perform other treasury activities as required.
Mandatory Responsibilities:
Comply with all Treasury Controls (SOX Controls) and CAS Controls.

You're extraordinary: We are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.
What we'll give you:
Passionate, inspired people we champion a culture of people that do extraordinary work
Scale and opportunity we offer the opportunity to create, influence and deliver projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.
Challenging and stimulating work – unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers.

About Axis Max Life Insurance
Axis Max Life Insurance Limited, formerly known as Max Life Insurance Company Ltd., is a Joint Venture between Max Financial Services Limited (“MFSL”) and Axis Bank Limited. Axis Max Life Insurance offers comprehensive protection and long-term savings life insurance solutions through its multi-channel distribution, including agency and third-party distribution partners. It has built its operations over two decades through a need-based sales process, a customer-centric approach to engagement and service delivery and trained human capital. As per the annual audited financials for FY2023-24, Axis Max Life Insurance has achieved a gross written premium of INR 29,529 Cr. For more information, please visit the company website at www.maxlifeinsurance.com.
AboutCompany:
Axis Max Life Insurance, one of the leading non-bank promoted private life insurers, is a joint venture between Axis Max Services Ltd. and Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Co. Ltd. Axis Max Services Ltd. is part of the Axis Max Group, which is a leading Indian multi-business corporation, while Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance is a member of the MS&AD Insurance Group, which is amongst the leading insurers in the world.

Axis Max Life Insurance offers comprehensive long term savings, protection and retirement solutions through its high quality agency distribution and multi-channel distribution partners. A financially stable company with a strong track record over the last 20 years, Axis Max Life offers superior investment expertise. Axis Max Life has the vision 'To be the most admired life insurance company by securing the financial future of our customers'. Description:
Personal Assistant to Senior Oncologist & Founder
About the role
Work directly with Dr. Salil Patkar, Medical Oncologist and Co-founder of ICTC (Indian Cancer Treatment Centre), Mumbai's largest day-care chemotherapy network. You will be his right hand, handling his inbox, calendar, hospital coordination and day-to-day support. This is a hands-on, varied role for someone who enjoys being trusted with responsibility.
Key Responsibilities
- Manage email: draft and send replies on instruction, follow up, and flag what is urgent
- Manage the calendar: OPD, meetings, travel and external calls
- Coordinate with hospital staff, patients' families, vendors and partner institutions
- Prepare documents, presentations, notes and simple reports
- Track tasks and deadlines, and make sure nothing falls through
- Run errands and handle ad-hoc tasks as instructed
- Look after day-to-day office and personal needs, including tea/coffee, meals and keeping the cabin organised
- Maintain strict confidentiality of patient, business and personal information
Requirements
- Graduate in any discipline
- Fluent written and spoken English (mandatory); Hindi and Marathi are a plus
- Comfortable with email, Google Workspace / MS Office and smartphones; familiarity with AI tools is a plus
- Organised, proactive and calm under pressure
- Willing to do whatever the day needs, from formal emails to hands-on help
- Discreet, reliable and trustworthy
- Hospital or healthcare experience preferred, but not mandatory
What we offer
- Salary: Rs. 30,000 - 45,000 per month, depending on experience
- Close exposure to healthcare leadership and the business side of a growing hospital network
- Full-time, in-office role in Mumbai

Are you a motivated individual with a passion for real estate sales? Join our team at
Nobroker as an Inside Sales Executive and help revolutionize the way people buy and
sell properties !!!
Location

About Us
NoBroker.com, founded in 2014 by Amit, Akhil, and Saurabh, is Indias first Proptech
unicorn. Its a brokerage-free platform that directly connects property owners with tenants
and buyers, eliminating the need for middlemen. With over 1 crore customers and 5 lakh
new users each month, its reshaping the real estate market. The platform handles 55,000
transactions monthly, saving INR 1200 crore in brokerage fees each year. Headquartered
in Bengaluru, NoBroker operates in key cities like Mumbai, Delhi, Pune, Chennai, and
Hyderabad. Recently, it raised USD 210 million, bringing its valuation to over USD 1
billion.
Specific Responsibilities:
Prospect Identification: Identify and engage potential business opportunities.
Sales and Relationships: Build strong client relationships and effectively
communicate product value.
Problem Solving: Address client challenges with tailored solutions.
Lead Management: Handle outbound calls and follow-ups to nurture leads and
drive conversions.
Service Excellence: Maintain high service standards to ensure client satisfaction.
Revenue Generation: Focus on closing sales and meeting revenue goals.



Perks & Value Proposition:
Health insurance: Rs 1 lakh per year, fully paid by the company.
Free lunch and snacks: Provided to all employees.
Promotions: Employees are promoted every 6 months, with outstanding
performers eligible for promotions every quarter.
Rewards: Monthly recognition and rewards for top performers.
Career growth: Employees can become Assistant Managers in as little as 2
years.
Team-building activities: Regular team parties and an Annual Day outing for
all employees.
Educational & Skill-Set Qualifiers:
Education: Graduation or HSC qualified.
Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication, good interpersonal skills,
numerical and analytical ability, and strong decision-making skills.
Languages: English and Hindi mandatory; Kannada, Tamil, or Marathi preferred.
Technical skills: Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word).
Work schedule: Flexible for a day shift (9 hours between 8 AM - 10 PM), and
comfortable working 6 days a week, with a weekday off.
Why Nobroker?
At Nobroker, we believe in empowering our employees to reach their full potential. Join a
dynamic team of professionals who are passionate about changing the real estate landscape.
Take the next step in your career and apply today !!!

Description:
Job Description
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month
What Were Looking For
Experience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in FMCG food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales Qualifications
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in FMCG food/beverage, or hotel industry)

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You will be responsible for ensuring that the health club is clean, welcoming, and well-maintained for guests. You will greet and assist guests with information about the facilities, handle check-ins, and ensure the smooth flow of guests through the fitness and wellness areas. You will ensure that the health club is equipped with fresh towels, properly maintained equipment, and all amenities are in working order. As a Health Club Associate, you re not just fulfilling the daily health club operations - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Previous experience in customer service, preferably in fitness or hospitality
Basic knowledge of fitness equipment and safety protocols
Excellent communication skills and a guest-focused attitude
Proficiency in English; additional languages are a plus
Ability to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays
Team-oriented with a proactive and professional approach
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Guest Service Excellence: Provide a warm welcome, assist with inquiries, and ensure guest satisfaction across all health club touchpoints.
Operational Support: Maintain cleanliness and organization of fitness areas, locker rooms, and wellness spaces; replenish amenities and supplies.
Reception & Administration: Manage guest check-ins, bookings for classes and services, and respond to inquiries at the reception desk.
Team Support: Assist the Health Club Manager in supervising operations and stepping into staff roles as needed to maintain service continuity.
Training & Supervision: Help train and schedule team members across fitness, spa, and guest service roles.
Compliance & Safety: Ensure adherence to health, safety, sanitation, and alcohol awareness regulations; report equipment issues or safety concerns.
Business Support: Assist with marketing, merchandising, programming, inventory, and tracking performance to drive engagement and efficiency.

Description:
Consultant, Business Process Controls Advisory, Audit and Assurance
At Deloitte, we do not offer you just a job, but a career in the highly sought-after risk Management field. We are one of the business leaders in the risk market. We work with a vision to make the world more prosperous, trustworthy, and safe. Deloittes clients, primarily based outside of India, are large, complex organizations that constantly evolve and innovate to build better products and services. In the process, they encounter various risks and the work we do to help them address these risks is increasingly important to their success—and to the strength of the economy and public security.
By joining us, you will get to work with diverse teams of professionals who design, manage, and implement risk-centric solutions across a variety of domains. In the process, you will gain exposure to the risk-centric challenges faced in today’s world by organizations across a range of industry sectors and become subject matter experts in those areas.
Work you'll do
As a Consultant on the Internal Audit team, you will be responsible for:
* Plan and execute internal audit assurance activities, including Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX), Statement on Standards for Attestation Engagements No. 18 (SSAE 18), and EQARs; conduct client walkthroughs, controls testing, stakeholder communication, and follow-up.
* Assess financial, operational, compliance, strategic, business-cycle, and information technology risks; identify control deficiencies; evaluate risk implications; and recommend control improvements.
* Develop audit approaches, scopes, programs, and procedures; perform selected audit tests; and apply internal audit standards, professional skepticism, and the code of ethics through engagement completion.
* Prepare internal control documentation, including narratives, process and data flows, workpapers, audit findings, reporting, and action plans; present outcomes to clients and stakeholders.
* Use technology-enabled tools and methods to analyze data, support reviews of business-cycle, general computer, and enterprise resource planning controls, and deliver risk-centric solutions.
Location: Hyderabad/Bangalore
Shift Timings: 12 PM to 9 PM / 1 PM to 10 PM
Qualifications
Required:
* Up to 4 years of experience conducting Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance reviews, internal audits, Statement on Standards for Attestation Engagements No. 18 (SSAE 18) reviews, or internal controls testing.
* Experience performing risk assessments and audits of financial, operational, and information technology processes.
* Experience supporting investment management or asset management operations audits.
* Experience testing business-cycle, general computer, and enterprise resource planning (ERP) controls using Oracle or SAP.
* Experience preparing audit documentation, including narratives, process and data flows, workpapers, findings, and action plans.
* Experience applying the Committee of Sponsoring Organizations of the Treadway Commission (COSO) Internal Control—Integrated Framework, U.S. generally accepted accounting principles (US GAAP), and guidance issued by the Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA), Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (PCAOB), and American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA).
* Chartered Accountant, MBA in Finance, or certification as a Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), or Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA).
Preferred:
* Experience in Asset wealth management or investment management.
* Experience at a Big Four professional services firm

Role: Devops and Cloud L3 & Architect
Exp: 7yrs to 18yrs
Location Flex: Pune/Bangalore/Hyderabad/Chennai
Shift: Rotational
Mode of Working: Hybrid

Mandatory Skill to Apply: Devops + Multi Cloud( Any 2- AWS/Azure/GCP) + CI/CD or Jenkins + Git + IAC (Terraform or Automation or Ansible)

Core / Must-Have Skills:-

Strong CI/CD experience with Jenkins, GitHub Actions and/or Azure DevOps
Strong hands-on Terraform
Docker & Kubernetes
At least one managed Kubernetes platform: EKS / AKS / GKE
Helm and/or Argo CD
Python and/or Shell/Bash scripting
Practical experience with AWS, Azure or GCP
DevSecOps pipeline integration
Monitoring/observability experience
Git and modern branching/deployment strategies
Strong troubleshooting skills across application delivery and cloud environments

Detailed JD:

The Multi-Cloud DevOps, DevSecOps & Platform Engineer will design, build, automate and support modern software delivery and cloud platform solutions across AWS, Microsoft Azure and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
The role requires strong hands-on expertise in CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), DevSecOps, Docker, Kubernetes, GitOps, cloud platforms, observability and automation. The engineer will collaborate with application, cloud, security and operations teams to build secure, scalable and reusable deployment solutions while improving release reliability and engineering efficiency.
Candidates should have strong expertise in at least one major cloud platform (AWS/Azure/GCP). Exposure to additional cloud platforms and multi-cloud environments is preferred.
1. CI/CD & DevOps Engineering
Design, develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps and/or Jenkins.
Implement Git-based workflows, reusable pipeline templates, artifact management, environment promotion, approvals and rollback mechanisms.
Implement GitOps deployment practices using Argo CD and Helm for Kubernetes workloads.
Integrate automated testing, code-quality checks and security controls into CI/CD pipelines.
Troubleshoot pipeline and deployment failures and improve build and release efficiency.
Build reusable pipeline components and automation to support consistent software delivery.
2. Infrastructure as Code & Automation
Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform across AWS, Azure and/or GCP.
Build reusable Terraform modules and manage remote state, versions, variables and environment configurations.
Implement IaC validation, testing and configuration/drift-management practices.
Use Ansible for configuration management and infrastructure automation where required.
Develop Python and Shell/Bash automation for infrastructure provisioning, API integration and Day-2 operational activities.
Automate repeatable infrastructure and platform activities to reduce manual intervention.
3. DevSecOps & Security Automation
Integrate security controls into CI/CD pipelines, including SAST, DAST, SCA, IaC scanning, container/image scanning and secrets detection.
Implement secure artifact, container image and dependency-management practices.
Integrate secrets-management and key-management solutions with pipelines and application deployments.
Apply appropriate access controls and least-privilege principles for pipeline and runtime identities.
Work with cybersecurity teams to identify and remediate vulnerabilities.
Support automated security and compliance validation within the software delivery lifecycle.
4. Multi-Cloud & PaaS Engineering
Implement DevOps and deployment solutions across AWS, Azure and/or GCP.
Work with relevant PaaS and serverless services such as Azure App Service, Azure Functions, AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Run and Cloud Functions.
Support application teams with standardized approaches for build, deployment, configuration, secrets, networking and monitoring.
Leverage cloud-native services while maintaining reusable and consistent DevOps practices.
Support hybrid and multi-cloud deployment requirements where applicable.
5. Containers, Kubernetes & GitOps
Build, deploy and manage containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
Work with managed Kubernetes platforms such as Amazon EKS, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and/or Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE).
Implement Kubernetes application packaging and deployments using Helm and Argo CD.
Configure deployments, autoscaling, ingress, secrets, configuration and application upgrade strategies.
Integrate container/image scanning and Kubernetes security controls into CI/CD processes.
Troubleshoot application deployment, container and Kubernetes platform issues across environments.
6. Observability & SRE Practices
Implement monitoring and observability across applications, infrastructure and Kubernetes using Datadog, Dynatrace and/or cloud-native monitoring tools.
Configure and manage metrics, logs, traces, dashboards and alerts.
Support SLI/SLO-based monitoring, incident management and operational runbooks.
Automate common operational, monitoring and remediation activities.
Analyze telemetry to improve application reliability, deployment stability and platform performance.
Participate in incident troubleshooting and root-cause analysis (RCA) and contribute to continuous reliability improvements.

Description:
Position- Senior Data Engineer
Exp- 5-10 years
Required Skills
Migration project experience (critical)
Mandatory: Python, SQL, BigQuery/snowflake
Important: DBT model (easy), Data modelling, Architect/Data Governance/Security, Snowflake, Spark
Location- Gurgaon, Noida, Pune, Bangalore

WHAT YOULL DO:
Design data pipelines utilizing ETL tools, event driven software, and other streaming software.
Design data architecture that is simple and maintainable while enabling Data Analysts, Data Scientists, and stakeholders to efficiently work with data.
Partner with both data scientists and engineers to bring our amazing concepts to reality. This requires learning to speak the language of statisticians as well as software engineers.
Ensure reliability and quality in data pipelines and enforce data governance, security and protection of our customer information while balancing tech debt.
Partner with product and engineering teams to design data models for downstream consumers.
Evaluate and champion new engineering tools that help us move faster and scale our team

You have 5+ years of data engineer experience coding in Python and using SQL.
Experience working with at least one major Datawarehouse in BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks
Bachelor's degree in technology or data science or a related filed, work experience can be substituted for education
You are comfortable with data engineering tools such as Airflow, dbt, AirByte/ Fivetran, Atlassian suite, GitHub, Terraform as well as Kubernetes.
You understand standard ETL patterns, modern data warehousing ideas such as data mesh or data vaulting, and data quality practices regarding test driven design and data observability.
You have experience partnering with data analysts, data scientists, and engineering stakeholders.
You have a background in data engineering, computer science, software development or another engineering field
You can communicate with a team and articulate ideas to both team members and non-technical stakeholders
You have a drive to learn and master new technologies and techniques
Bachelor's degree or relevant experience can substitute for formal education
Technologies You Will Use
Python/ Airflow for data pipeline and automation.
Airbyte for ETL purpose
dbt for data transformation
Snowflake/ BigQuery as Data Warehouse

Service Assurance

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science, or related field with experience in Telecom OSS projects and business analysis.
