You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and delivering digital marketing programs to kickstart the sale of our products and drive the rapid expansion and growth in the market. You will identify new and exciting opportunities and establish brand awareness. If you are the person who can execute the ambitious goals at one-third resources than the normal, we would like to meet you. To succeed in this role, you must have a growth mindset and be a creative, self-starter, top-notch communicator, and passionate marketer.
Responsibilities
Comprehend categories, products, customers and business goals
Know the persona of customers and understand their needs
Research products and competitors to identify opportunities
Establish a digital marketing strategy across various engagement channels both online and offline and develop a marketing calendar
Identify syndication schedules for editorial calendars for blogs, content, and social media posts
Develop effective paid search strategies to gain market share
Plan, design, launch and optimize various PPC campaigns
Perform keyword research and audience targeting in support with management
Work with web developers and designers to manage integrations and tooling for PPC, social media, etc.
Monitor advertisement budgets and oversee search platform accounts
Track KPIs, analyze web traffic metrics, and provide recommendations and useful reports for management
Maintain partnerships with PPC ad platforms and vendors
Identify click frauds and eliminate it
Ensure the highest possible ROI on ad-spend
Perform ongoing keyword discovery, expansion, and optimization
Research and implement search engine optimization recommendations
Research and analyze competitor advertising links
Develop and implement link building strategy
Recommend changes to website architecture, content, linking, and other factors to improve SEO positions for target keywords
Build a social media strategy through the audience identification, competitive research, benchmarking and messaging including platform strategy
Setup, Review, and Optimize company pages on social media platforms
Establish metrics and goals on customer engagement and intimacy on social media to boost website traffic and gain revenue
Engage with the customer on behalf of the brand and perform soft-sell while managing and improving brand reputation
Collaborate with other stakeholders such as content developer (copywriter), graphics and media designer, and management for consistent brand messaging and best customer experience
Qualifications
Proven SEM experience with PPC campaign management across multiple web and social channels
In-depth experience with website analytics tools such as Google Analytics
Solid understanding of performance marketing, conversion, and online customer acquisition
Expertise in keyword research, data analysis and reporting
Knowledge of ranking factors and search engine algorithms
Up-to-date with the latest trends and best practices in SEO and SEM
Strong business acumen and expert communicator
Experience with A/B and multivariate experiments
Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, XML, JavaScript, and web development and industry-leading commerce tools
Education Certifications
Bachelors/Masters in Marketing, Quantitative, Media or a related field
Google Adwords Certification
Google Analytics and other SEO training are welcome

If you are the person who can design and develop web / mobile platforms securely at an unbelievable pace, we would like to meet you.
To succeed in this role, you must have a growth mindset and be a self-starter, top-notch communicator and passionate hands-on programmer.
Responsibilities
Optimize existing Magento 2 installation
Provide regular and emergency support for break-fixes
Troubleshoot integration and performance issues
Design interfaces, themes, templates while following best practices and maintain world-class coding styles and standard
Anticipate the performance requirements and communicate with management on remediation plans to CTO/CIO
Develop new Magento modules and functionalities
Manage and upgrade Magento add-ons and conduct code reviews/scans
Establish DevOps pipelines, Release/Change management procedures, etc.
Develop testing scenarios including unit testing, integration testing and automate those
Work with UI/UX and graphic designers to implement front-end changes
Work with content writer to implement new contents
Implement additional components such as Elastic Search, Varnish, Redis, CDN, RabbitMQ, etc.
Manage SSL certificates, software accounts, keys, etc.
Rearchitect environment and provide vertical and horizontal scaling as demand grows
Fine-tune batch jobs (Crons) or Consumers
Migrate databases and data
Develop integrations for files, images, etc.
Manage stack components and upgrade them (Ubuntu, PHP, Percona, Nginx, Composer, Firewall, Redis, etc.)
Create plans for developing mobile experience, mobile apps or PWA front end environment
Maintain confidentiality about IP, methods, processes and data
Participate in conferences, webinars and provide presentations while socializing and partnering with startups
Install security patches and monitor web traffic
brand and perform soft-sell while managing and improving brand reputation
Collaborate with other stakeholders such as content developer (copywriter), graphics and media designer, and management for consistent brand messaging and best customer experience
Qualifications
Strong experience with Magento 2 development and debugging
Strong experience with high-performance technologies such as Nginx, Varnish, Redis, ElasticSearch
JavaScript and AJAX experience for Front-end
Extensive HTML5, LESS and CSS knowledge
Understanding of modern UI/UX trends
Experience or knowledge of React.js, Vue.js and Node.js
Experience with AWS components such as VPC, IAM, EC2, ECS, Lambda, S3, CloudFront, WAF Cloud Formation
Linux or Ubuntu server operations working and know-hows
Experience in working with MySQL databases like MariaDB and Percona
Basic understanding of networking and ports
Experience with Google Tag Manager, SEO, Google Analytics, PPC, Facebook Pixels. A/B Testing
Strong attention to details about design styles to improve look and feel
Very good PHP knowledge and understating of various frameworks
Ability to work in a professional capacity and team environment is must
Ability to manage projects and work in strict deadlines
Education Certifications
Bachelors/Masters in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field
Magento 2 Certification is required
Cloud Computing Certification (AWS/GCP/Azure) is a plus

Job Description
HCM BI Publisher (BIP)/ OTBI Senior Analyst (5-10 Years of experience)
As an BIP Sr. Associate, you will work with technical and projects teams to deliver cutting edge reporting solutions on Oracle cloud platforms for some of our Fortune 1000 clients. You will have the opportunity to contribute to work that may involve building new Oracle cloud solutions; migrating applications to co-exist in the hybrid cloud (On-Premise and Cloud); deploying a global cloud application across multiple countries. Our teams have a diverse range of skills and we are always looking for new ways to innovate and help our clients succeed. Primary focus on developing custom solutions using BIP/ OTBI reports
Key Responsibilities
Gather and analyze reporting requirements from HR and business stakeholders
Design and develop reports and dashboards using OTBI and BI Publisher (BIP)
Build custom data models using SQL, and create RTF, Excel templates
Create and configure OTBI analyses, subject area queries, and dashboards
Develop reports for HCM areas such as Core HR, Absence, Payroll, Talent, Compensation, and Benefits
Optimize report performance and troubleshoot data and logic issues
Support unit testing, SIT, UAT, and production issues
Prepare technical specifications, test cases, and user documentation
Technical Skills
Strong hands-on experience in BI Publisher (BIP): data models, templates, bursting, and scheduling
Strong hands-on experience in OTBI: subject areas, analyses, and dashboards
Good knowledge of Oracle Fusion HCM data model and tables
Strong SQL and PL/SQL skills
Experience with HCM Extracts
Understanding of Fusion security, roles, and data access
Good communication and documentation skills
Good to have
Knowledge of Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI) or Oracle Analytics
Knowledge on OCI, REST/SOAP APIs and APEX/ VBCS application would be added advantage
Exposure to multiple end-to-end Fusion HCM implementations
Oracle HCM Cloud certification
Consulting Requirements
5-10 years of relevant consulting, industry or technology experience
Proven knowledge of Oracle Cloud platform and tools
Excellent team player
Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills
Strong communicator
Willingness to travel up in case of project requirement
Strong knowledge of software implementation best practices
Ability to adapt quickly to an existing, complex environment and learn new concepts and software
Self-motivated, independent, detail oriented, responsible team player and exhibit exceptional relationship management skills
Passionate about building high-quality systems with software implementation
Professionalism and integrity
Strong interpersonal and written communication skills
Ability to work in fast paced environment

Job description
Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC) -FDI Manager (10-16Years of Experience)
As an OAC Senior Developer, you will work with technical and project teams to design and deliver enterprise-grade data integration solutions for some of our Fortune 1000 clients. You will have the opportunity to contribute to work that may involve building new ELT/ETL pipelines; migrating on-premise integration workloads to the cloud; modernizing legacy Data Warehouse feeds; and integrating Oracle Data Integrator with GoldenGate, OCI Data Integration, and other Oracle data platform services. Our teams have a diverse range of skills, and we are always looking for new ways to innovate and help our clients succeed. The primary focus of this role is to design, develop, and support enterprise data integration solutions using Oracle Data Integrator (ODI), Oracle GoldenGate, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Data Integration/Data
Role & responsibilities
As OAC developer you will have multiple responsibilities depending on the project type. One type of project may involve migrating existing reporting applications to Oracle cloud infrastructure.Another might involve building new reporting solutions directly within Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC) .The key responsibilities may involve some or all the areas listed below:
Role & responsibilities
10-16 years of hands-on experience with Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC) , including KM development and topology configuration.
Experience with Oracle Data Integrator 11g/12c/ODI Marketplace Edition.
Exposure to Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC) or Fusion Data
Strong SQL and PL/SQL skills, with experience on one or more relational databases on Oracle.
Solid understanding of ELT/ETL architecture, data warehousing concepts, and dimensional modeling.
Experience with Oracle GoldenGate for real-time replication and Change Data Capture (CDC).
Exposure to OCI Data Integration / Data Transforms and cloud-native, serverless integration patterns.
Experience migrating on-premise ETL workloads to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.
Working knowledge of Oracle Autonomous Database and Oracle Exadata Cloud Service as integration targets.
Exposure to Big Data connectivity (Hadoop, Hive, Spark, Kafka) within ODI or GoldenGate for Big Data.
Experience with job scheduling, load plans, and ODI agent (Standalone/JEE/Colocated) administration.
Preferred
Experience with Oracle GoldenGate 21c/23ai.
Exposure to Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC) or Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI) as downstream consumers of ODI pipelines.
Experience in Oracle BI Apps (OBIA).
Exposure to one or more of the following: Python, R, or UNIX shell scripting.
Expertise in analyzing and troubleshooting large-scale, high-volume data integration jobs.
Systematic problem-solving approach.
Ability to debug and optimize code and automate routine tasks.
Exposure to ODI SDK and Groovy scripting for automation.Role & responsibilities

As an Azure Databricks + AI Manager you will lead data engineering work that brings together cloud data platforms, analytics, and AI-enabled solutions within our Data & Analytics practice. As a Manager you will guide teams through planning, delivery, and review of client work, using sound judgment, mentoring junior colleagues, and helping drive clear priorities across multiple workstreams. In this role at PwC, you will contribute to data modernization efforts, work through complex data platform challenges, and help shape scalable solutions across Azure Databricks and AI use cases.
As a Manager you will coach team members, oversee deliverables, and support client service accounts while maintaining a practical focus on timelines, quality, and stakeholder communication. In this role at PwC, you will collaborate across Cloud Engineering, Data & Analytics and Data, Analytics & AI to translate technical needs into actionable work, identify opportunities for process improvement, and bring structure to delivery in a fast-moving environment.
Responsibilities
- Leading Azure Databricks data engineering workstreams for cloud-based analytics and AI initiatives
- Managing project plans, priorities, and deliverables across multiple client engagements and internal teams
- Designing and implementing data pipelines, data transformations, and data quality checks within Azure Databricks
- Developing data architecture, data models, and lakehouse solutions that support scalable analytics use cases
- Applying Azure Data Factory, Apache Airflow, and related orchestration tools to automate batch and streaming workflows
- Optimizing performance across data pipelines, query processing, and warehouse structures to improve processing efficiency
- Reviewing technical deliverables for accuracy, data integrity, and alignment with client requirements
- Coaching team members on data engineering methods, cloud tooling, and delivery approaches
- Identifying opportunities to apply AI fluency, digital tooling, and modern data modernization methods to client challenges
- Validating security, privacy, and data governance considerations across engineering solutions
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 9+ years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Management Information Systems, Computer and Information Science, Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Mathematical Statistics
- Demonstrating Azure Databricks implementation across enterprise data platforms
- Utilizing Data Engineering, Data Integration, and Data Quality skills in delivery
- Managing client workstreams within Data Modernisation initiatives
- Coaching teams through analytics, AI, and cloud transformation efforts
- Applying agile delivery, analytical thinking, and strategic questioning
- Adapting to ambiguity while leading data modernization decisions

Job Description
As a Manager - Organizational Change Management, you will lead complex transformation engagements, helping organizations navigate business, workforce, and technology changes. Within our Management Consulting practice, you will guide senior client stakeholders in shaping change strategies, leading cross-functional teams, and driving the adoption of transformation initiatives. This role involves optimizing organizational structures and processes to enhance efficiency and align with strategic goals for long-term success.
As a Manager, you will leverage your leadership skills to mentor junior staff, manage client accounts, and deliver strategic planning. You are accountable for project success, maintaining standards, and inspiring your team to deliver quality outcomes. Your role will involve identifying opportunities that contribute to the firm's success, embracing technology and innovation, and articulating our purpose and values with integrity and authenticity.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will focus on developing innovative change solutions, contributing to practice growth, and building trusted advisor relationships with senior client stakeholders. You will also engage in business development activities, support proposal development, and foster a collaborative and inclusive team environment.
Responsibilities
- Leading complex transformation engagements across business, workforce, and technology change initiatives
- Developing and implementing integrated change management strategies to align with business objectives
- Providing strategic direction on change impact assessments, stakeholder analysis, and organizational readiness
- Advising executive sponsors and business leaders on change risks and stakeholder engagement approaches
- Designing and delivering learning solutions to drive adoption and build workforce capability
- Managing project scope, timelines, budgets, and risks to deliver quality client outcomes
- Applying data-driven insights and workforce analytics to enhance decision-making and change outcomes
- Building trusted advisor relationships with senior client stakeholders and providing strategic guidance
- Leading executive workshops and steering committee meetings to influence key decisions
- Collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver integrated transformation solutions
- Mentoring and coaching consulting teams to foster a collaborative and innovative environment
- Supporting business development activities, including opportunity identification and proposal development
- Contributing to the evolution of change management offerings through innovative methodologies and solutions
- Staying current with emerging trends in organizational change and workforce transformation
- Driving the creation of thought leadership and internal knowledge assets to strengthen market positioning
What Sets You Apart
- Relevant certifications in Change Management, Project Management, Human Capital/Workforce Transformation, Organizational Change Management (e.g., Prosci), or Instructional Design and Learning Solutions are highly desirable and will be considered an added advantage
- Experience in Consulting (preferably experience in Human Capital, Change & Communication Management, Learning Solutions, HR Transformation, or related fields).
- Demonstrating strategic and creative thinking with a client-centric approach
- Excelling in storytelling and executive communication skills
- Leading consulting engagements and mentoring junior team members
- Supporting proposal development and business development initiatives
- Possessing certifications in Change Management, Project Management, or Human Capital/Workforce Transformation
- Utilizing analytical thinking and business process analysis for change management
- Embracing change and fostering cultural evolution within organizations

At Deloitte, you will build a career in risk and controls advisory while helping organizations navigate evolving business, regulatory, and technology risks. Experience evaluating business process controls and information technology general controls

Job Description

The Opportunity
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Servicessolving real client challenges through connected collaboration. Well help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a differenceevery day.
As a Senior Associate in Treasury Management System Implementation within our Finance practice, you will play a pivotal role in delivering finance solutions that enhance operational efficiency and client satisfaction. You will be at the forefront of client engagements, utilizing your skills to analyze complex financial operations and develop tailored solutions that meet the unique needs of each client.
As a Senior Associate, you will leverage your professional skills to build meaningful client relationships and navigate complex situations. You will be responsible for mentoring junior team members, guiding them through the intricacies of financial operations, and fostering a collaborative environment that encourages growth and innovation. Your ability to anticipate client needs and deliver quality solutions will be crucial in maintaining professional standards and driving success within the team.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will have the opportunity to work within our Finance practice, focusing on finance operations and digital core modernization. Your contributions will be instrumental in shaping the future of financial consulting, providing you with a platform to grow your personal brand and deepen your technical skills.
Responsibilities
- Implementing treasury management systems to optimize financial operations
- Analyzing financial statements and preparing comprehensive reports for stakeholders
- Developing financial strategies and forecasting models to support business objectives
- Conducting financial statement reviews and confirming compliance with internal controls
- Utilizing financial accounting practices to maintain accurate financial records
- Collaborating with clients to address financial management challenges and provide solutions
- Applying analytical thinking to enhance financial reporting and decision-making processes
- Planning, budgeting, and forecasting to align with organizational financial goals
- Reviewing financial statements to identify areas for improvement and efficiency
- Supporting client engagements by providing insights into financial operations and strategies

Rewards - Senior Associate
Job description
4-8 years Reward consultant,Job Architecture with Human Capital Consultant, team you will help clients address workforce and organizational challenges through innovative solutions. As an Associate you will support client delivery across key Organization & Talent priorities while developing your analytical and communication skills. This position provides an exciting opportunity to engage with diverse stakeholders and contribute to impactful transformation initiatives.Human capital Consultant, Human Resources Management,Job Architecture, Organizational Behavior Studies, Organizational Management, Sociology, Psychology

Role & responsibilities
Assist clients in addressing organizational and workforce challenges
Hands on experience Job Architecture,and rewards
Engage with diverse stakeholders to gather insights and feedback
Develop analytical skills to inform decision-making processes
Contribute to the design of creative solutions for clients
Collaborate with team members to enhance communication strategies
Participate in impactful transformation initiatives
Uphold professional standards and industry practices in consulting

Those in organisational design at PwC, you will focus on optimising the structure and processes for businesses to enhance efficiency and effectiveness. You will help clients align their organisational structure with their strategic goals for long-term success.
Driven by curiosity, you are a reliable, contributing member of a team. In our fast-paced environment, you are expected to adapt to working with a variety of clients and team members, each presenting varying challenges and scope. Every experience is an opportunity to learn and grow. You are expected to take ownership and consistently deliver quality work that drives value for our clients and success as a team. As you navigate through the Firm, you build a brand for yourself, opening doors to more opportunities.
Examples of the skills, knowledge, and experiences you need to lead and deliver value at this level include but are not limited to:
Apply a learning mindset and take ownership for your own development.
Appreciate diverse perspectives, needs, and feelings of others.
Adopt habits to sustain high performance and develop your potential.
Actively listen, ask questions to check understanding, and clearly express ideas.
Seek, reflect, act on, and give feedback.
Gather information from a range of sources to analyse facts and discern patterns.
Commit to understanding how the business works and building commercial awareness.
Learn and apply professional and technical standards (e.g. refer to specific PwC tax and audit guidance), uphold the Firm's code of conduct and independence requirements.

Key Responsibilities:
As a Learning Design & Development practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients navigate their transformation challenges by designing and building the learning solutions that carry those transformations, owning the work from curriculum architecture through to release-ready assets. You will provide tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities, optimize HR functions, and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growth
As such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to):
Engagement Delivery
Delivering learning solutions for technology driven or culture-based client transformation journey, by including (but not limiting to) the below skill sets:
Learning Strategies:
Instructional Design (ID) or Learning Experience Design (LXD) with a strong command of adult learning principles and instructional strategies, and working fluency in recognized frameworks - ADDIE and/or SAM, Blooms taxonomy for objective setting, and Kirkpatrick for evaluation.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of business operations and ERP and HCM solutions like Workday, Oracle, SAP, etc.
Learning Activities:
Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to deliver Training Needs Analysis, Curriculum design, role-based learning plans and blended training solutions.
Ability to use a variety of collaboration tools available to the client to run workshops and presentations.
Ability to develop engaging scenarios, activities, and assessments for blended learning solutions.
Hands-on proficiency with industry-standard authoring and multimedia tools - Articulate Storyline and Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond, or equivalent - to build visually engaging learning assets.
Publish and troubleshoot content on an LMS or LXP, including SCORM/xAPI packaging and versioning, and build to accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 / Section 508).
Work directly with clients to support engagement delivery spanning across phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation of training.
Learning Effectiveness:
Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs against Kirkpatrick Levels 13 using a range of methods - reaction surveys, knowledge checks, and on-the-job performance measures.
Continuously improve learning programs based on feedback, industry best practices, and emerging trends.
General Requirements:
Excellent storyboarding skills, and able to produce release-ready facilitator guides, participant materials and ILT/vILT decks to a publishable standard.
Communicate complex information effectively through engaging written and verbal formats tailored to the client's needs and audiences.
Ensure regular communication and alignment on project updates with the engagement team
Ability to work through ambiguity, flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
Ability to work flexibly across time zones as per project requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and efficient project execution.
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in learning and development.
Contribute learning scope, effort estimates and instructional methodology input to pursuits and proposals as a subject-matter expert.
Provide guidance and support to team members to reinforce learning from engagements.
Believe in the value created by diverse teams and adapt to different working styles.
Continue to develop internal relationships and your PwC brand.

Summary:
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Network Engineer with 10+ years of experience in enterprise network operations, routing & switching, and Cisco ACI environments. The candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, troubleshooting, and optimizing large-scale enterprise and datacenter networks. The role requires strong technical expertise in LAN/WAN technologies, Cisco Nexus platforms, Cisco ACI fabric, and network troubleshooting within complex enterprise environments.

Roles & Responsibilities
Design, implement, and support enterprise Routing & Switching infrastructure.
Manage and troubleshoot Cisco ACI fabric including tenants, VRFs, bridge domains, EPGs, contracts, and policies.
Configure and support Cisco Catalyst, Nexus, and ISR/ASR platforms.
Perform advanced troubleshooting for LAN, WAN, WLAN, and datacenter network issues.
Handle routing protocols such as OSPF, BGP, EIGRP, and static routing.
Configure and troubleshoot Layer 2 technologies including VLANs, STP, EtherChannel, HSRP/VRRP, VXLAN, and trunking.
Monitor network performance, availability, and capacity utilization.
Participate in major incident management and provide RCA for critical outages.
Implement network changes following enterprise change management processes.
Work closely with security, server, cloud, and application teams for end-to-end connectivity solutions.
Support datacenter migration, network transformation, and automation initiatives.
Maintain network documentation, diagrams, SOPs, and operational runbooks.
Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior engineers and operations teams.

Professional & Technical Skills:
Strong proficiency in core routing and switching (OSPF, BGP, EIGRP, HSRP/VRRP, Switching, ACLs, NAT, DHCP, QoS)
Hands-on experience with Cisco ACI deployment and support.
Experience in enterprise NOC or production support environment.
Strong troubleshooting and incident management skills.
Experience handling P1/P2 incidents and RCA preparation.
Experience in automation and scripting (Python, Ansible, or similar).
Experience with AI-aided network observability and management tools.
Understanding of Agentic AI frameworks for network operations.
Ability to troubleshoot complex network incidents and infrastructure issues.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications and Certifications
Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or related field.
Cisco certifications preferred:
oCCNP Enterprise
oCCNP Data Center
oCCIE Enterprise Infrastructure (preferred)

Additional Information:
The candidate should have minimum 8-10 years of experience in large enterprise network implementation and 3-4 years of experience in Network implementation.
Knowledge of cloud networking (GCP/AWS/Azure).
Experience in large enterprise or global network environments.
A 15-year full-time education is required.
This position is based at our Hyderabad/Bangalore office.

Description:
Project Role : Custom Software Engineer

Project Role Description : Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs.

Must have skills :Automotive ECU Software

Good to have skills:NA
Minimum 7.5 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification:15 years full time education

Summary:
Lead systems engineering for production-oriented tire intelligence solutions delivered to global OEM and Tier-1 customers. Translate customer and product needs into complete, traceable system requirements and architectures coordinate embedded software, algorithms, sensors, gateways, cloud interfaces, functional safety, cybersecurity, integration, and validation from concept through vehicle launch and field support.

Roles & Responsibilities:


Own end-to-end systems engineering for OEM tire intelligence applications, including system context, use cases, operating scenarios, interfaces, performance targets, diagnostics, assumptions, and acceptance criteria.
Elicit, analyze, and negotiate OEM requirements perform gap and impact analysis establish bidirectional traceability across customer, system, software, hardware, algorithm, safety, cybersecurity, and test work products.
Develop and maintain system architecture and interface definitions across tire-mounted sensors, vehicle networks, ECUs/TCUs, receivers/gateways, embedded algorithms, cloud services, and customer applications.
Convert tire intelligence functions such as tire health, pressure/load estimation, leak detection, road or friction insights, and aquaplaning-related features into implementable and verifiable system specifications.
Lead technical reviews with OEMs, Tier-1s, suppliers, and global engineering teams drive decisions, interface alignment, risk closure, and resolution of system-level issues.
Plan and support integration and verification through model-, software-, processor-, hardware-in-the-loop, bench, vehicle, and fleet testing ensure requirements-based coverage and evidence.
Apply Automotive SPICE and systems V-model practices, including change control, baselining, configuration management, design reviews, defect management, and release readiness.
Integrate functional safety and cybersecurity needs in coordination with specialists, supporting ISO 26262 and ISO/SAE 21434 work products, safety/security analyses, technical concepts, and customer evidence.
Support production launch and lifecycle activities, including calibration/interface changes, root-cause analysis, field issue resolution, technical documentation, and lessons learned for reusable platforms.
Mentor engineers and strengthen India-based systems capability through structured reviews, knowledge transfer, and consistent global engineering practices.
SUCCESS PROFILE :Systems thinker who combines technical depth, disciplined execution, customer orientation, and pragmatic decision-making in a global matrix environment.

Professional & Technical Skills:
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Systems, Electrical, Electronics, Computer, Automotive, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline.
7-10 years of automotive/embedded product-development experience, including 4+ years in systems or requirements engineering for OEM or Tier-1 programs.
Hands-on experience with requirements engineering, architecture, interface management, integration, verification, and customer technical reviews.
Working knowledge of Automotive SPICE, ISO 26262, ISO/SAE 21434, and production software/hardware release processes.
Proficiency with Polarion, DOORS, or equivalent familiarity with SysML/UML modeling and tools such as Enterprise Architect or Cameo.
Knowledge of CAN/CAN FD, J1939, UDS/OBD-II, Ethernet, BLE/RF, sensor interfaces, telematics, and embedded/cloud connectivity.
Ability to interpret MATLAB/Simulink models and analyze data using MATLAB or Python experience with Vector and/or dSPACE environments is preferred.
Strong technical writing, analytical problem-solving, and communication skills able to collaborate across India, Europe, Asia, and North America.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE
Tire/vehicle dynamics, TPMS or tire-mounted sensing, signal processing, estimation algorithms, gateways/TCUs, or connected-vehicle platforms.
OEM production programs from concept and RFQ through SOP, including HIL/vehicle validation, calibration, and issue management.
AUTOSAR, embedded C/C++, model-based development, cloud/IoT architectures, CI/CD, and test automation.

Additional Information:

- The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Automotive ECU Software.
- This position is based at Bangalore /Hyderabad facility
- A 15 years full time education is required.

Description:
Position: PLM Support Engineer
Experience: 3 to 8 Years
Location: Bangalore / Pune / Chennai / Hyderabad (or as applicable)
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled PLM Support Engineer with 3 to 8 years of experience in supporting and maintaining Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) applications. The ideal candidate will be responsible for providing L2/L3 production support for PLM platforms such as PLM Support ,Teamcenter, Aras Innovator, and SmarTeam, ensuring stable operations, timely incident resolution, and continuous process improvement. The role involves troubleshooting workflows, CAD integrations, BOM management, release processes, and collaborating with global cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality support.
Key Responsibilities
Production Support & Incident Management
Provide L2/L3 production support for PLM applications including Teamcenter, Aras Innovator, and SmarTeam across production and non-production environments.
Act as the primary point of contact for business users for PLM operational, application, and workflow-related issues.
Manage incidents, service requests, problem tickets, and change requests within agreed SLA timelines.
Perform impact analysis and prioritize tickets based on business criticality.
PLM Functional Support
Support Engineering Change Management (ECM/ECR/ECO) processes and workflows.
Manage and troubleshoot complex BOM (Bill of Material) structures and product data issues.
Support product release processes, document lifecycle management, and workflow execution activities.
Assist users with process adherence, workflow execution, and system functionality.
CAD & Integration Support
Provide support for CAD integrations with Siemens NX, CATIA, and related engineering applications.
Troubleshoot CAD data loading, synchronization issues, and integration failures.
Investigate dataset validation failures, translator issues, and CAD file management problems.
Workflow & System Administration Support
Troubleshoot workflow integration issues, dispatcher failures, workflow processing delays, and PDF generation errors.
Support vault server management, job server monitoring, and scheduled background jobs.
Monitor workflow execution and system performance to ensure application availability and stability.
Analyze system bottlenecks impacting user performance and workflow processing.
Root Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement
Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring production incidents.
Implement corrective and preventive actions to reduce ticket volumes and improve system reliability.
Identify opportunities for automation and process improvements within PLM support operations.
Maintain knowledge articles, support documentation, and troubleshooting guides.
Reporting & Stakeholder Management
Generate and publish support metrics, incident reports, ticket trend analysis, and SLA compliance reports.
Provide regular status updates to management and key stakeholders.
Coordinate with development, infrastructure, database, and global support teams for issue resolution and deployments.
Participate in release validation, patch deployment, and post-deployment support activities.
Required Technical Skills
PLM Technologies
Strong experience in at least one or more PLM applications:
Teamcenter
Aras Innovator
SmarTeam
Functional Knowledge
Engineering Change Management (ECR/ECO/ECN)
Product Structure Management
BOM Management
Workflow Management
Release Management
Document Management
CAD Integration
Siemens NX
CATIA
CAD Data Management
Technical Skills
SQL Queries and Database Fundamentals
PLM Data Model Understanding
Workflow Configuration and Troubleshooting
Dispatcher Monitoring
PDF Generation Processes
Job Server and Vault Management
Application Log Analysis
Support Tools
ServiceNow / Jira / Remedy
Incident & Change Management Tools
Monitoring and Reporting Tools
Desired Qualifications

Job Title: Data Warehouse Testing Engineer
Experience: 8-15 Years
Location: Bangalore / Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled Data Warehouse Testing Engineer to validate and ensure the quality, accuracy, and integrity of data across Data Warehouse, ETL, and Reporting systems. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in SQL, Data Warehousing concepts, ETL testing, and source-to-target data validation.
Key Responsibilities
Analyze business requirements, data models, and source-to-target mapping documents.
Develop test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for Data Warehouse projects.
Validate data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Perform data reconciliation and source-to-target validation.
Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across systems.
Execute functional, integration, regression, and system testing.
Validate reports, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions.
Perform backend testing using complex SQL queries.
Identify, document, and track defects using defect management tools.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, ETL Developers, Business Analysts, and stakeholders.
Prepare test execution reports and quality metrics.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Data Warehouse Testing and ETL Testing.
Advanced SQL skills including joins, subqueries, aggregations, and stored procedures.
Strong understanding of Data Warehousing Concepts:
Fact and Dimension Tables
Star Schema
Snowflake Schema
Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)
OLAP Concepts
Experience with ETL tools such as Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, or Ab Initio.
Expertise in source-to-target data validation and data reconciliation.
Experience with defect tracking tools such as JIRA.
Knowledge of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and Agile methodologies.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Cloud Data Warehouses:
Snowflake
Amazon Redshift
Azure Synapse
Google BigQuery
Knowledge of Big Data technologies such as Hadoop, Hive, and Spark.
Experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Cognos.
Basic automation knowledge using Python or SQL scripting.
Experience with Data Lake and Data Migration Testing.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
ISTQB or relevant Data Testing certifications are preferred.
Key Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail.
Ability to understand complex data flows and business rules.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.

Greetings from Axtria! (Axtria is a global provider of cloud software and data analytics to the Life Sciences & Healthcare industry).

About The Role
We are looking for a Data Governance Consultant to drive core data governance engagements for our clients. This role combines hands-on governance program design with client-facing consulting and pre-sales responsibilities, working closely with business and IT stakeholders to stand up sustainable governance operating models.
Key Responsibilities
Data Governance Program Delivery
Define and own the data governance charter, including scope, guiding principles, roles & responsibilities, and success metrics
Partner with business and IT teams to design and implement escalation matrices for data issues, policy exceptions, and change requests
Establish and facilitate the Data Governance Council, including cadence, decision rights, and reporting structures
Formulate, document, and maintain SOPs covering data quality, stewardship, issue resolution, and data ownership processes
Define data ownership and stewardship models (data owners, stewards, custodians) across business domains
Design and roll out data policies, standards, and metrics/KPIs to track governance maturity and adoption
Tools & Technical Fluency
Demonstrate working proficiency in leading data governance/catalog platforms such as Collibra, Atlan, and Alation
Support tool evaluation, configuration recommendations, and policy/workflow design within these platforms
Collaborate with data engineering and analytics teams to align governance policies with underlying data platforms
Client Engagement & Business Development
Lead or support client discovery sessions, workshops, and governance maturity assessments
Own or contribute to RFP/RFI responses, including solutioning, effort estimation, and proposal narrative
Build client-facing deliverables (decks, SOPs, charters, maturity frameworks) and present to senior stakeholders
Act as a trusted advisor to client governance leads, balancing pragmatic delivery with long-term governance maturity
Stakeholder & Project Management
Drive cross-functional alignment between business, IT, compliance, and data teams
Manage timelines, risks, and dependencies for governance workstreams within larger data management programs
Mentor junior consultants and contribute to CoE assets and reusable governance frameworks
Required Qualifications
12+ years of experience in data governance or related consulting roles
Proven experience defining data governance charters, councils, and operating models in a real client/enterprise setting
Hands-on exposure to at least one major data governance/catalog tool (Collibra, Atlan, or Alation); familiarity with multiple is a plus
Experience responding to RFPs/RFIs and supporting pre-sales or proposal development
Strong understanding of data governance frameworks (e.g., DAMA-DMBOK) and concepts such as data lineage, data quality, and stewardship
Excellent stakeholder management and facilitation skills, with experience engaging both business and IT audiences
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience building executive-ready presentations
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in life sciences/pharma or other regulated data environments
Prior consulting/CoE experience with both offshore and onshore delivery models
Relevant certifications (DAMA CDMP, Collibra/Alation/Atlan certifications)
Why Axtria: -
Axtria (www.Axtria.com) is truly a New-Age Software Product Unicorn, a first of its kind in providing the cloud software and data analytics to the Life Sciences industry globally. We help Life Sciences companies transform the product commercialization journey to drive sales growth and improve healthcare outcomes for patients. We are acutely aware that our work impacts millions of patients and lead passionately to improve their lives.
Since our founding in 2010, technology innovation has been our winning differentiation, and we continue to leapfrog competition with platforms that deploy Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. Our cloud-based platforms - Axtria DataMAX, Axtria InsightsMAX™, Axtria SALESIQ™, Axtria CUSTOMERIQ™ and Axtria MarketingIQ- enable customers to efficiently manage data, leverage data science to deliver insights for sales and marketing planning and manage end-to-end commercial operations. With customers in over 20 countries, Axtria is one of the biggest global commercial solutions providers in the Life Sciences industry. We continue to win industry recognition for growth and are featured in some of the most aspirational lists - INC 5000, Deloitte FAST 500, NJBiz FAST 50, SmartCEO Future 50, Red Herring 100, and several other growth and technology awards.
Axtria is looking for exceptional talent to join our rapidly growing global team
People are our biggest perk! Our transparent and collaborative culture offers a chance to work with some of the brightest minds in the industry
Our data analytics and software platforms support data science, commercial operations, and cloud information management. We enable commercial excellence through our cloud-based sales planning and operations platform
We are leaders in managing data using the latest cloud information management and big data technologies
Axtria Institute, our in-house university, offers the best training in the industry and an opportunity to learn in a structured environment. A customized career progression plan       ensures every associate is setup for success and able to do meaningful work in a fun environment. We want our legacy to be the leaders we produce for the industry
3500+ employees worldwide – growing rapidly & strengthening our product engineering team. We would almost double our India headcount in the coming year

Location: Bangalore / Pune / Mumbai / Gandhinagar
Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled and passionate SAP ABAP Workflow Consultant to join our growing SAP practice. Work with functional consultants and stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical workflow solutions.
Ensure adherence to SAP development standards, best practices, and quality processes throughout the project lifecycle.

Required Skills

Strong hands-on experience in SAP ABAP Workflow Development.
Expertise in SAP Business Workflow configuration and development.
Experience with BOR (Business Object Repository) and ABAP OO Workflow.
Good knowledge of Workflow Administration, Event Management, Agent Determination, and Rule Resolution.
Strong ABAP development skills including Reports, Enhancements, BAdIs, User Exits, Function Modules, and Object-Oriented ABAP.
Experience in workflow debugging, monitoring, and troubleshooting.

Capgemini is seeking highly skilled SAP Central Finance (CFIN) Consultants to join our growing SAP Finance Transformation practice. Initial Load & Replication

Application Interface Framework (AIF)

Enable process standardization and harmonization across global business units.
Support business stakeholders in defining future-state finance operating models.
Financial Reporting & Support
Support financial reporting, analytics, and consolidation requirements.
Develop and enhance reporting solutions using SAP Fiori, Embedded Analytics, SAC, and BW.
Support month-end and year-end closing activities.
Provide post-go-live support and resolve issues related to:
Data Replication
Financial Postings
AIF Monitoring
Mapping Errors
Reconciliation Discrepancies
Financial Reporting

Experience with:
SLT Replication
AIF Framework
MDG Integration
Data Migration & Reconciliation
Financial Master Data Management
SAP Fiori Applications
Understanding of SAP integration methodologies and architecture.

Strong knowledge of:

Accounts Payable (AP)
Accounts Receivable (AR)
Asset Accounting (AA)
Cost Center Accounting
Profit Center Accounting
Internal Orders
Bank Accounting
Financial Closing & Reporting

Experience working on global SAP S/4HANA transformation programs.

Description:
We are currently hiring for Sales Specialist for our Apple Retail Stores in India.


Do you love how it feels to encourage others? As a Part-Time Specialist, you help create the energy and excitement around Apple products, providing the right solutions and getting products into customers hands. You understand that the Apple Store is dedicated to delivering a customer experience thats unlike any other. It starts with you discovering customers needs. And with the support of your store team members, you match those needs with the right products. Every day is an opportunity for you to turn another Apple Store visitor into a loyal Apple customer.


Role & responsibilities

Deliver excellent service to Apple customers by seeking to understand their needs, identifying ownership opportunities, presenting products and services, and educating customers on relevant ways to buy products.
Understand and proactively stay up to date on Apples products, services, purchase options and Product Zone sales processes.
Support your peers throughout the store as needed by sharing knowledge about Apples products, services and purchase options, and assist in offering ownership opportunities. Maintain accuracy and follow guidance.
Perform other tasks as needed, including but not limited to providing customer service and support in other areas of the store.
Contribute to an inclusive environment by respecting each others differences and having the curiosity to learn.
Demonstrate Apples values of inclusion and diversity in daily activities.



Preferred candidate profile

Demonstrate knowledge of Apple products and services.
Personalise solutions based on customer needs, and effectively communicate them.
Work in a fast-paced environment, often supporting multiple customers at the same time.
Work in a team environment, demonstrating shared responsibility and accountability with other team members.
Be curious and open to learning from others and helping each other grow.
Learn about and deepen your understanding of Apple products and services, and third-party products, to enhance the customer experience.
Be trusted with sensitive or confidential information, keeping with Apples core values.
You should have availability to work a schedule based on business needs that may include nights, weekends and public holidays in the retail store, and reliably attend work as scheduled, in line with local laws and subject to any approved accommodations.

This is a Part-Time opportunity, requiring you to work 4 Days in a week for 5 hours each day i.e 20 hours in a week.

Bangalore , Delhi, Noida

Description:
Role: Area Sales Manager
Experience - Field Sales Experience is mandatory
About the Company:
NoBroker is the world's largest no-brokerage property platform, offering end-to-end services in real estate. As India's first Prop-Tech unicorn with a billion-dollar valuation, we provide a seamless experience to future homeowners. We operate in six major cities: Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, NCR, and Chennai. About the Role: As an Area Sales Manager (ASM), you will play a crucial role in bridging demand and supply in the real estate market. You will guide, consult, and support potential homebuyers throughout their purchase journey, helping them find the right property while maximizing sales for NoBroker.
Key Responsibilities:
Engage potential customers via phone, virtual meetings, and on-site visits to explain available properties and convert them into buyers.
Attend qualified leads through virtual or in-person meetings, present tailored property options, and encourage on-site visits.
Negotiate deals between clients, ensuring a win-win agreement.
Build and maintain client relationships, ensuring satisfaction and generating referral business.
Cross-sell additional NoBroker services to offer a complete home-buying experience.
Nurture leads to build a strong sales pipeline and meet daily, weekly, and monthly targets.

Job Description:
About the Role
We are looking for Implementation Analysts Products to support the implementation and deployment of a SaaS-based Consent Management solution for Enterprise and Small & Medium-sized Business (SMB) clients.

The role involves working closely with clients, business stakeholders, product teams and technical teams to drive implementation activities from requirements gathering through go-live and hypercare.
The deployment location will be Mumbai, Delhi NCR or Bangalore, depending on the client's office locations. Each deployment is expected to last approximately 68 months, and candidates may subsequently be deployed on other client projects.
Prior experience in Consent Management, DPDP or Cybersecurity is not mandatory, as product-specific training will be provided.
This is an early-career implementation role suitable for candidates with 1- 3 years of relevant experience.

Roles & Responsibilities
Support end-to-end implementation and deployment of a SaaS/product solution at client locations.
Translate business requirements into configuration and implementation activities.
Support product demonstrations, customer onboarding and configuration activities.
Identify risks proactively, mitigate them and escalate as deemed appropriate.
Coordinate integration discussions involving APIs, data flows, interfaces and technical dependencies.
Manage SMB demo and implementation deals for the Consent Management solution, with a primary focus and special emphasis on supporting Free Plan users.
Guide SMB customers through self-service setup, configuration and troubleshooting to ensure quick go-live and faster Time to Value.
Gather feedback on product experience throughout the customer lifecycle through targeted surveys.
Gather customer feedback and support continuous improvement of the implementation experience.
Travel to and work from client locations for extended deployment periods, as required.
Mandatory Skills & Eligibility Criteria
1- 3 years of experience in technology products, SaaS or Cloud products, implementation or technology consulting.
Prior exposure to customer onboarding, product demonstrations, technical support or pre-sales is preferred.
Understanding of APIs and basic general technical architecture and components is a must.
Good to have development experience in REST APIs, JavaScript and JSON/XML data structures.
Understanding of Kubernetes, Docker and deployment workflows is preferred.
Understanding of infrastructure components such as databases, queues, API gateways and firewalls is preferred.
Willingness to learn on-premise deployment concepts and assist senior team members on enterprise accounts.
Understanding of BFSI (Banking, Financial Services and Insurance) would be preferred.
Fluency in English is mandatory; fluency in Hindi is preferable.
Ability and willingness to travel to client locations for extended deployment periods.
Willingness to undergo product-specific self-paced training and certification before deployment.
Candidates must be currently based in Mumbai, Delhi NCR or Bangalore.

Employment & Engagement Conditions
The position is offered as a fixed-term contractual employment opportunity for a period of 12 months.
The contract is non-extendable and non-renewable.
Candidates selected by the client will be required to complete product-specific training and certification before deployment.
The training will be self-paced, supported by daily one-hour Q&A sessions, and will conclude with an assessment requiring a minimum score of 75%.
The pre-deployment product training period is unpaid. No salary, stipend or other payment will be provided by BDO or the client during this training period.
Upon completion of the initial deployment or assignment, employees may be considered for deployment on another project of the same client, subject to business requirements and applicable contractual terms.

Job Role:
Responsible for managing day-to-day workplace operations, space management, visit coordination, and technology platform support across the Bangalore Innovation Hub. The role requires a strong on-site presence, proactive operational management, and coordination with internal stakeholders, Accenture Leadership, ecosystem partners, vendors, and client visitors to ensure a seamless and professional workplace experience.
Business Operations:
Maintain a mandatory five-day-a-week on-site presence to ensure effective workplace operations.
Conduct daily morning floor walks to ensure the office premises, meeting rooms, and common areas are fully operational and presentable for client and leadership visits.
Develop a thorough understanding of the overall hub layout, infrastructure, and seating arrangements to facilitate effective space allocation and operational activities.
Ensure the workplace consistently meets expected standards for leadership, client, and partner visit experiences.
Provide operational support during Accenture Leadership, ecosystem, and vendor partner visits as required.
Space Management & Visit Coordination:
Manage end-to-end space and meeting room reservations for internal stakeholders, leadership, and client visits, ensuring timely and accurate bookings aligned with business requirements.
Proactively handle all reservation requests, including urgent, ad hoc, and last-minute requirements, ensuring no requests are overlooked.
Recommend suitable alternative spaces to Visit POCs whenever their preferred spaces are unavailable or unsuitable.
Ensure Visit POCs accurately capture and update visitor details in the VMS portal.
Maintain and regularly update the space allocation tracker, capturing all relevant visit and reservation details.
Ensure meeting room information sheets are consistently updated to provide accurate and comprehensive visibility for Leadership visits to BDC11.
Provide day-to-day operational support for HSM-related activities.
Monitor production issues and coordinate with relevant support teams for timely resolution.
Proactively identify operational disruptions and ensure appropriate follow-up to minimize business impact.
Conduct regular testing of Welcome Screen portals across Bangalore and Hyderabad locations.
Validate portal functionality, content accuracy, and overall user experience.
Ensure the Welcome Screen portals remain functional and provide a consistent, professional experience for visitors and leadership.


Qualification
Key Expectations:
Strong ownership and accountability for day-to-day workplace operations.
Proactive approach to space management and visit coordination.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, including urgent and last-minute requests.
Attention to detail in maintaining trackers, reservation records, and visitor information.
Commitment to delivering a consistent, professional, and seamless workplace experience across locations.

Job description: SAP BW4/HANA L3 Support and Enhancement.
A BW/4HANA L3 Support Engineer requires advanced technical support for SAP BW/4HANA systems, resolving complex issues escalated from lower support levels. This role requires deep knowledge of SAP BW/4HANA architecture, data modelling and troubleshooting techniques. Key responsibilities include analysing and resolving critical incidents, performing root cause analysis, and collaborating with development teams for long-term solutions.
Key Responsibilities:
Troubleshooting and Resolution: Investigate and resolve complex technical issues related to SAP BW/4HANA, often involving performance bottlenecks, data inconsistencies, or system errors.
Root Cause Analysis: Conduct thorough root cause analysis to identify the underlying causes of issues and implement preventative measures.
Collaboration: Work closely with L1 and L2 support teams, development teams, and other IT teams to resolve issues and improve system stability.
System Monitoring: Monitor the health and performance of SAP BW/4HANA systems, proactively identifying and addressing potential problems.
Knowledge Management: Document solutions, troubleshooting procedures, and best practices to build a knowledge base for future reference.
Mentorship: Provide guidance and mentorship to junior support engineers.
Incident Management: Manage critical incidents (P1 and P2 tickets) and ensure timely resolution.
System Enhancement: Contribute to the development and implementation of solutions to improve system performance and stability.
Required Skills & Experience:
Deep knowledge of SAP BW/4HANA: Including data modelling, data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Advanced troubleshooting skills: Ability to analyse complex issues, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions.
Strong communication and collaboration skills: Ability to effectively communicate with various stakeholders, including business users and technical teams.
Experience with SAP BW/4HANA administration: Including system configuration, performance tuning, and security.
Experience with ABAP development: For data extraction and transformation.
Knowledge of HANA platforms: (e.g., Native HANA modelling, AMDP) is often preferred.
Experience with incident management and ticketing systems: 3-5 years of experience is required.

Since June 2021, frog is part of Capgemini Invent. frog partners with customer-centric enterprises to drive sustainable growth, by building and orchestrating experiences at scale, while harnessing the power of data and technology. We're inventing the future of customer experiences by delivering market-defining business models, products, services, brand engagements and communications.
Joining frog means you'll be joining the "pond," a global network of studios, each with a thriving in-person and vibrant virtual culture. frogs are curious, collaborative, and courageous, united by our passion for improving the human experience across our areas of expertise, while each bringing our unique and diverse skills and experiences to the table. We draw on our global reach and local knowledge to solve complex problems and create innovative, sustainable solutions that touch hearts and move markets. frogs prize humour, positivity, and community just as highly as performance and outcomes. Our culture is open, flexible, inclusive, and engaging. Working at frog means being empowered to meet the moment, and Make Your Mark on every project, in your studio, your community - and the world at large.
Your Role
The ideal candidate will combine expertise in social listening, consumer and market intelligence, and AI-driven analytics to generate actionable insights from online conversations and digital data. The candidate should understand how AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) can transform social listening workflows, enabling faster, more scalable, and insight-led delivery. Strong analytical thinking, stakeholder management, and communication skills are essential, along with the ability to translate complex data into strategic business recommendations.
The candidate will be expected (but not limited) to:
Lead social listening and digital intelligence engagements, translating business objectives into research frameworks, listening strategies, and actionable insights.
Leverage AI, LLMs, and automation to streamline social data collection, analysis, sentiment assessment, topic clustering, trend identification, and insight generation.
Explore and implement AI-first approaches to improve the speed, accuracy, scalability, and quality of social listening and consumer intelligence deliverables.
Work with AI platforms, social listening tools, APIs, and data connectors to integrate information from social media, online news, forums, reviews, and other digital sources.

Your Profile
7 - 10 years of proven experience in social listening, consumer insights, digital intelligence, market research, analytics, or a related field, with demonstrated expertise in AI-led solutions.
Strong understanding of social listening methodologies, digital data sources, sentiment analysis, taxonomy development, trend analysis, and competitive intelligence.
Hands-on experience using AI tools and LLMs to automate or enhance research, analytics, insight generation, or reporting workflows.
Familiarity with social listening platforms such as Meltwater, Brandwatch, Talkwalker, Sprinklr, or equivalent tools.
Experience in prompt engineering, workflow automation, and evaluating the quality and reliability of AI-generated outputs.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to connect qualitative and quantitative findings to business outcomes.

What you will love about working here
We recognize the significance of flexible work arrangements to provide support. Be it remote work, or flexible work hours, you will get an environment to maintain healthy work life balance.
At the heart of our mission is your career growth. Our array of career growth programs and diverse professions are crafted to support you in exploring a world of opportunities.
Equip yourself with valuable certifications in the latest technologies such as Generative AI.

Job description: SAP BW4/HANA L3 Support and Enhancement.
A BW/4HANA L3 Support Engineer requires advanced technical support for SAP BW/4HANA systems, resolving complex issues escalated from lower support levels. This role requires deep knowledge of SAP BW/4HANA architecture, data modelling and troubleshooting techniques. Key responsibilities include analysing and resolving critical incidents, performing root cause analysis, and collaborating with development teams for long-term solutions.
Key Responsibilities:
Troubleshooting and Resolution: Investigate and resolve complex technical issues related to SAP BW/4HANA, often involving performance bottlenecks, data inconsistencies, or system errors.
Root Cause Analysis: Conduct thorough root cause analysis to identify the underlying causes of issues and implement preventative measures.
Collaboration: Work closely with L1 and L2 support teams, development teams, and other IT teams to resolve issues and improve system stability.
System Monitoring: Monitor the health and performance of SAP BW/4HANA systems, proactively identifying and addressing potential problems.
Knowledge Management: Document solutions, troubleshooting procedures, and best practices to build a knowledge base for future reference.
Mentorship: Provide guidance and mentorship to junior support engineers.
Incident Management: Manage critical incidents (P1 and P2 tickets) and ensure timely resolution.
System Enhancement: Contribute to the development and implementation of solutions to improve system performance and stability.
Required Skills & Experience:
Deep knowledge of SAP BW/4HANA: Including data modelling, data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Advanced troubleshooting skills: Ability to analyse complex issues, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions.
Strong communication and collaboration skills: Ability to effectively communicate with various stakeholders, including business users and technical teams.
Experience with SAP BW/4HANA administration: Including system configuration, performance tuning, and security.
Experience with ABAP development: For data extraction and transformation.
Knowledge of HANA platforms: (e.g., Native HANA modelling, AMDP) is often preferred.
Experience with incident management and ticketing systems: 3-5 years of experience is required.

Description:
Hiring: B2B Sales & Business Development Higher Education
Locations: Bangalore | Chennai | Pune | Mumbai | Delhi
Experience: 5-15+ Years
Industry: Education | EdTech | Higher Education
Work Mode: Field-Based / Hybrid, as per role

Role Overview
We are looking for dynamic B2B Sales and Business Development professionals to drive institutional partnerships, acquire new university accounts and expand existing business across assigned territories.
The opportunity is open for both Account Manager and Zonal Manager positions. Candidates will be responsible for revenue generation, institutional relationship management, new business development and strategic account growth.
Key Responsibilities
1. Business Development & New Client Acquisition
Identify and acquire new business opportunities across universities, colleges and business schools.
Develop strong institutional sales pipelines through campus visits, networking, referrals and leadership meetings.
Manage the complete B2B sales cycle, including prospecting, presentations, proposals, negotiations and deal closures.
Achieve assigned regional revenue targets.
2. Institutional & Strategic Relationship Management
Build and maintain relationships with senior decision-makers, including Chancellors, Vice-Chancellors, Trustees, Directors, Deans, HODs and Placement Heads.
Develop long-term partnerships with universities and higher education institutions.
Identify opportunities for cross-selling, upselling and business expansion.
3. Account Management & Revenue Growth
Manage existing institutional accounts and ensure partnership renewals.
Develop account growth plans and improve the value of existing partnerships.
Coordinate with Customer Success and internal teams for partner onboarding, product demos, training and ongoing engagement.
Monitor client satisfaction and resolve account-related concerns.
4. Regional Business & Team Management (Senior Role)
Drive regional business strategy and revenue growth.
Lead and mentor regional sales teams / Key Account Managers.
Monitor sales performance, pipeline health, revenue forecasts and business reviews.
Build strategic relationships with key institutional stakeholders and drive large partnership opportunities.
Desired Candidate Profile
5 to 10+ years of experience in B2B Sales, Institutional Sales, Enterprise Sales or Key Account Management.
Strong preference for candidates from Higher Education, EdTech, Executive Education, Professional Education or Learning Solutions.
Proven experience in selling solutions to universities, colleges, business schools or educational institutions.
Strong understanding of institutional sales cycles and partnership development.
Experience in achieving revenue targets, acquiring new clients and managing key accounts.
Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship management skills.
Willingness to travel regularly for campus meetings and institutional visits.
MBA / PGDM preferred.
Position Levels
Account Manager B2B Higher Education
5+ years of relevant experience.
Focus on individual revenue targets, new institutional acquisition, account management and partnership growth.
Zonal Manager B2B Higher Education
10+ years of relevant experience.
Strong regional business development and team leadership experience.
Responsible for zonal revenue, strategic partnerships, market expansion and team performance.

Role Title:SAP Fiori/UI5 Developer

Location: Hybrid

Role Overview:The SAP Fiori/UI5 Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining SAP Fiori applications and SAP UI5 components to deliver intuitive, user-friendly interfaces for SAP systems. Key Responsibilities:
Application Development:
Design and develop SAP Fiori applications using SAP UI5 framework, HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript.
Implement responsive and adaptive UI designs aligned with SAP Fiori guidelines.
Integration:
Integrate Fiori/UI5 apps with SAP backend systems using OData services and Gateway.
Testing & Debugging:
Perform unit testing, troubleshoot issues, and ensure high-quality deliverables.
Collaboration:
Work with UX designers to enhance usability and user experience.
Coordinate with SAP functional consultants and ABAP developers for end-to-end solutions.
Maintenance & Upgrades:
Upgrade existing Fiori/UI5 applications and ensure compatibility with new SAP releases.
Documentation:
Prepare technical specifications, design documents, and user guides.
Innovation:
Stay updated with SAP Fiori/UI5 best practices and emerging technologies.
Technical Skills:
Strong knowledge of SAP UI5, Fiori design principles, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3.
Experience with SAP Gateway and OData services.
Familiarity with MVC architecture and SAP Web IDE or Business Application Studio.
Additional Skills:
Understanding of SAP architecture and integration patterns.
Knowledge of Git, RESTful APIs, and Agile methodologies.
Experience:
35 years of SAP Fiori/UI5 development experience for intermediate roles.
5–8 years for senior roles, including full-cycle implementations.
Education:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
Exposure to SAP BTP, CAPM, and cloud deployment.

Attractive Fixed Salary Package.

Job Title: Senior Data Scientist/ Data Scientist
Job Location: Bangalore, Pune, Mumbai, Gurgaon, Chennai, Hyderabad, Noida and Coimbatore
Job Description:
Lead a small group of DS developers in collaborate/streamline data science work with product, BA, MLOps. Cover tasks in DS model development/redevelopment and support the deployment into multiple markets for production purpose.
Leading the collaboration with MLOps to understand the need for industrialization, ensure smooth transition from DS development to industrialization by providing sufficient DS support.
Code development/redevelopment planning, provide direct support to DS developers in the execution.
Leading model tunning.
Ensure proper code standard are enforced, complete documentation is created and strong code management through version control. Leading regular code review together with the data scientist project lead.
Leading the testing/evaluation planning with the data scientist project lead. Establishing model evaluation and validation framework in the context of deployment. Creating standard test report structure.
Ensure production grade code is developed and maintained for quick roll-out purpose. High level of transparency and replicability is achieved.
Leading the planning of RCA for any issue identified.
Creating the monitoring plan for production.
Support the activities in the UAT with the end users.
Working as the contingency resource for development to ensure timely delivery.
Ensure a common code base is created for efficient roll-out in new market with highly modular architecture, well designed data abstraction, high configurability and high level of parameterization.
Technical Skills:
Brings 6+ years of deep data science experience.
Strong knowledge of machine learning and statistical modeling techniques in a in a clouds-based environment such as GCP, Azure, Amazon, Databricks
Experience with programming languages such as Python, R, Spark
Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software design principles, highly sensitive to algorithm complexity.
Experience with GCP platforms and services such as Big Query, Cloud ML Engine, and Cloud Storage
Experience in configuring and setting up the version control on Code, Data, and Machine Learning Models using GitHub.
Strong experience in development planning.
Good knowledge in coding standard, building re-useable services.
Experience in end-to-end data science project delivery
Non-Technical Skills:
Solution Designing
Critical Thinking
Ecommerce Domain Understanding (Good to Have)
EDUCATION:
B.E/B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science or related technical degree OR Equivalent.
