Description:
About the Role
Lords Mobility is looking for highly motivated and result-oriented sales professionals to drive business expansion in assigned territories across India.
The candidate will be responsible for developing dealer networks, appointing new channel partners, driving sales, establishing NBFC and finance partner tie-ups, and achieving business targets.
We are looking for business-oriented professionals with strong knowledge of the automobile/EV market, particularly the 3-wheeler segment, who can independently develop and grow their assigned territory.

Key Responsibilities
1. Territory Management & Business Development
Take complete ownership of assigned territory and achieve sales targets.
Identify potential markets and opportunities for business expansion.
Develop and execute territory-wise sales and expansion strategies.
Build Lords Mobility's market presence.
2. Dealer Network Development
Identify, appoint and onboard new dealers and distributors.
Develop a strong and active dealer network.
Maintain relationships with existing dealers and drive business growth.
Ensure dealer activation and consistent sales performance.
3. Sales & Revenue Generation
Achieve monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.
Drive primary and secondary sales through dealer networks.
Monitor dealer-wise sales performance and improve conversions.
Develop new business opportunities and increase market penetration.
4. NBFC & Finance Partner Tie-ups
Identify and onboard NBFCs, banks and financial institutions.
Establish finance partnerships to support vehicle sales.
Develop relationships with finance partners and ensure smooth financing support for dealers and customers.
5. Market Research & Reporting
Monitor competitor activities, pricing and market trends.
Identify new dealer locations and business opportunities.
Prepare sales forecasts, territory plans and dealer development reports.
Conduct regular market visits and provide business updates to management.

Candidate Requirements
Bachelor's degree preferred.
Minimum 3 years of experience in Automobile or Electric Vehicle sales.
Candidates with experience in 3-wheeler sales (Electric or Conventional) will be strongly preferred.
Experience in dealer appointment, dealer onboarding and channel sales.
Experience in achieving sales targets and developing new markets.
Knowledge of NBFC tie-ups, vehicle financing and finance partner onboarding.
Strong negotiation, communication and relationship management skills.
Ability to independently manage the assigned territory.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory.
AboutCompany:
Lords Mark Tech Next Pvt. Ltd., operating under the brand name Lords Mobility, is an emerging electric vehicle manufacturer committed to transforming India's mobility landscape through innovative, reliable and sustainable transportation solutions.
Established in February 2020 and headquartered in Thane, Maharashtra, the company is engaged in manufacturing a wide range of electric vehicles, including electric two-wheelers, passenger and cargo three-wheelers, e-rickshaws, electric loaders and specialized electric vehicles for commercial applications.
With manufacturing facilities in Manesar, Haryana, and Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, Lords Mobility is expanding its presence across India through a growing dealer network and strategic business partnerships.
The company aims to deliver affordable, efficient and sustainable mobility solutions while creating business opportunities for dealers, channel partners and customers across the country.
CompanyAddress: Head Office: Cosmos Mary Park, 401, Kolbad Cross lane, Thane (W), Maharashtra.

Responsibilities
Service Operations Technical Leadership: Plan, allocate and supervise daily PM schedules, breakdown call, route rationalization/route loading to ensure timely and high-quality service delivery.
Monitor response time, shutdown duration, call-back trends and implement corrective actions to improve reliability and cost efficiency.
Guide technicians in troubleshooting and repair activities, providing on-site technical support for complex faults.
Conduct AES and Safety Tests, PM Audits, ensure proper documentation of all the audits and safety tests, equipment inspections and other statutory requirements.
Reporting of Incidents and Near Missed in line with the company s process.
Organize service inspections of new installation units prior to handover to customers and ensure that incomplete jobs are not handed over.
Business Development - AMC, Repair Modernization Support Service Sales Team to drive revenue growth through proactive selling of AMCs, Spares, Repair and Modernization packages to new and existing customers.
Identify upgrade and modernization opportunities during AES and service visits, prepare inputs for proposals, book the SRM orders and ensure timely closure.
Improve service quality to ensure timely AMC renewal follow-up, collection of pending dues and promotion of OEM spares and value-added services to enhance customer loyalty.
Customer Relationship Management: Act as the single point of contact for key customers in the territory, handling escalations, service reviews and communication on equipment performance.
Conduct regular review meetings, non-price visits and performance presentations to strengthen long-term partnerships and understand future customer needs.
Coordinate internally to ensure commitments on response time, uptime and quality are met, and that customer complaints are resolved promptly and effectively.
People Management, Training and Vendor Development: Organize, mentor and develop the service team, including technicians, through regular coaching, performance reviews and skill-gap analysis.
Plan and conduct technical, safety and behavioural training for field staff, ensuring adherence to safe work practices and service standards.
Process, Inventory Compliance: Implement and sustain company service processes, documentation standards and digital tools for call logging, work order closure, billing and collection.
Oversee spare parts planning, ordering, inventory control and consumption analysis to support uptime targets and cost optimization.
Prepare and present MIS reports and periodic reviews to the Head Office team covering service KPIs, revenue performance, safety, quality and improvement plans.


Qualifications
Diploma in Electrical Engineering is mandatory.
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering preferred.


Experience
Minimum 15 years of experience in the elevator industry for Diploma Engineers or 10 Years for Graduate Engineers with strong exposure to service, repairs and modernization.
Thorough knowledge of elevator systems, troubleshooting, testing and commissioning across multiple control and drive technologies.
Proven track record of leading service teams and delivering results in a demanding field environment.

Job Details
Job Title: Loan Officer-Micro Banking
Grade: DM-I
Department: Micro Banking
Location: Branch
Type of Position: Full-time
Reports To: CRM
Reporting Into: NA
Job Summary
Drive acquisition of new unsecured loan customers from open market
Identify quality leads from unsecured loans liabilities customers through assessments by analyzing credit histories and performing financial analysis, ensuring compliance with internal and external regulations
Monitor and manage installment payments and collections of assigned customers
Strengthen existing customer relationships through targeted cross-selling Ujjivan's products customer profile needs
Size of the Role
Financial size: 5-7 Cr. loan portfolio
Non-financial size: NA
Key Duties and Responsibilities of the Role Business/ Financials
Develop and execute strategies to acquire new unsecured loan customers
Collaborate with the liabilities team to cross-sell unsecured loans
Follow up on leads provided by team various channels within defined TAT
Achieve monthly loan disbursement targets through acquisition of new customers and conversion of existing customers
Coordinate with Products Marketing department to carry out marketing drives at his/her assigned and catchment areas for unsecured loans
Prospect new customers, maintain database of the leads, meet convert select prospects and manage the relationship thereafter
Attend center meetings to generate leads for Unsecured loans and actively driving conversion of existing borrowing customers into SBL customer
Cross sell other products of Ujjivan and pass quality leads to respective officers/staff
Share customer insights/product related feedback with the Branch Head and Area Manager Microfinance
Provide inputs pertaining to revision of product and credit policies to the respective teams on the basis of geography specific considerations
Customer
Interact with customers in a courteous and professional manner; provide prompt, efficient and accurate services and establish professional relationship with them, with a long-term perspective
Conduct the appraisal process of potential customers in a courteous manner without compromising quality
Guarantee confidential treatment of all the information gathered from customers
Internal Process
Carry out the pre and post-loan activities related to Unsecured loans, perform simple financial analysis, present the loan applications to the sanctioning authority by adhering to the set TAT prioritize repayment of loans to maintain best portfolio quality

Position : Territory Executive

Job Location : Jaipur, Ahmedabad, Pune (PCMC Area), Nagpur, Indore, Bangalore, Mumbai, Guwahati, Ludhiana

Products Segment - Vascular, Aneasthesia, Neonates, Vascular, Hemodynamics , Critical Care,
Role Overview:
The Territory Executive will be responsible for driving sales growth within the assigned territory by identifying new business opportunities, developing strong customer relationships, and promoting the company's product portfolio.

Key Responsibilities -
Identify, prospect, and acquire new customers, including hospitals, nursing homes, healthcare institutions, and distributors.
Promote and demonstrate company products to healthcare professionals and key decision-makers.
Generate product demand through regular field visits and customer engagement activities.
Achieve assigned sales targets and contribute to territory revenue growth.
Build and maintain strong professional relationships with doctors, surgeons, nursing staff, purchase managers, biomedical teams, OT technicians, and other key stakeholders.
Provide product-related training, demonstrations, and support to customers.
Ensure consistent follow-up with existing customers to strengthen business
Ensure timely secondary sales generation and coordinate with internal teams for efficient order processing and product delivery.
Monitor inventory availability and support demand forecasting activities.
Follow up on outstanding payments and ensure timely collections in line with company policies.
Maintain accurate sales records and submit periodic sales and market reports as required.

Preferred candidate profile -
Minimum 4 years experience in sales of Medical Devices / Pharma industry.
Experience working with specialists such as Anesthesiologists, Pediatricians, Neonatologists, Oncologists, and Surgeons will be preferred.
Strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and relationship management skills.

Description:
Role: Business Development / Expansion Role OYO (Field Profile)

What is this role about?
This role is about *expanding OYOs hotel network in new and upcoming markets

You will identify hotels, meet property owners, explain OYO’s vision, and help them partner with OYO. From the first discussion to the hotel going live, you will manage the full journey.

This is a field-based role and requires regular travel.

What will you do in this role?

* Find hotels and properties that can partner with OYO
* Generate leads through market visits, brokers, and referrals
* Visit properties and meet hotel owners face to face
* Explain how partnering with OYO can grow their business
* Negotiate commercials and close property signings
* Build a joint business plan with property owners for long-term profitability
* Coordinate with internal teams to launch the property on OYO
* Review agreements and service levels with property owners
* Resolve issues between property owners and internal OYO teams

How is your performance measured?

* Number of sellable rooms signed every month
* Number of rooms made live and available for booking
* Gross margin generated from signed properties

Education:
* Graduation mandatory
* MBA preferred

*Experience & Skills:*
* 1–5 years of relevant experience
* Strong negotiation and deal-closing skills
* Comfortable reading and understanding legal agreements
* Analytical and data-driven mindset
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment
* Basic working knowledge of ERP or mobile apps
* Good Excel skills and professional email writing

Stakeholders you will work with:

Internal:
* Business Development Head
* Hub Head
* Central Team
* Operations Team
* Transformation Team
* Legal Team

External:
* Property Owners
* Real Estate Brokers

In simple words:

Your role is to find hotels, sign them, launch them on OYO, and ensure the partnership is profitable.
AboutCompany: OYO is a global platform that aims to empower entrepreneurs and small businesses with hotels and homes by providing full-stack technology products and services that aims to increase revenue and ease operations; bringing easy-to-book, affordable, and trusted accommodation to customers around the world. OYO offers 40+ integrated products and solutions to patrons who operate over 157K hotel and home storefronts in more than 35 countries including India, Europe, and SEA. OYO operates a unique business model that helps its patrons transform fragmented, unbranded and underutilized hospitality assets into branded, digitally-enabled storefronts with higher revenue generation potential and provides its customers with access to a broad range of high-quality storefronts at compelling price points

Strong experience in revenue management, business development and sales operations.
Excellent leadership, team management, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
Strong analytical, planning and execution capabilities.

Position: TSM
Function: Retail Sales

Purpose of Role:
The Sales Officer Retail Sales will be responsible for expanding the dealer network, driving sales growth, strengthening market penetration, and ensuring product availability across the assigned territory. The role involves managing dealer relationships, implementing sales strategies, executing promotional activities, and monitoring market and competitor performance to achieve business objectives.

Reporting to:
This role reports to the Area Sales Manager.

Key accountabilities:
Identifying and appointing dealer for deeper market penetration and reach in depth market share.
Analyze and compare sales plans with the last year base and implement appropriate sales activities to achieve targeted sales.
Overseeing the sale activities of products thereby achieving increased sales growth/ maximized volume and value growth in depth.
Assisting the dealers in achieving the targets and providing them with training
Ensuring the seeding of new product in right Channel.
Ensuring the SKU range availability at key outlets
Conceptualizing and implementing sales promotional programs for brand building
Ensuring profitability of dealers, in alignment with organization's policies and interest
Making a territory monitoring report every month including competitor's activities.
Conducting the retail audit to assess market potential, estimation of sale of competitors with a view to adopt suitable strategies for sale.
Solving all the issue of dealer for making smooth business relation.

Behavioral Competencies:
Highly energetic, motivated, confident candidates with good communication and selling skills.
Should have the ability to get the 'feel' of the market and to convert products into business.
Must be a go-getter with high drive and initiative.
Should be a local candidate.

Educational Qualification:
UG : B. Tech/B.E. - Any Specialization, B.Sc - Any Specialization, B.Com - Commerce

Experience:
Candidate should be a Graduate and a Post Graduate Degree / Diploma in Marketing Management with an experience of 3-6 years in Channel Sales preferably from Paints or Building material industry.

AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Description:
AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Description:
AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Job Summary
Function Summary: The agency channel refers to a distribution method where insurance products are sold through agents. These agents act as intermediaries between the insurance company and customers, facilitating the sale of policies, providing customer support, and offering advisory services. This initiative is expected to improve customer experience, especially in markets where customers prefer human interaction. It also supports customers in a) resolving policy service needs; b) renewal collection to resolve policy holder's service needs; cross-sale opportunity.


Responsibilities
Agent Recruitment - Develop various sources of agent hiring; build a team of agent pipeline.
Agent Recruitment - Conduct activity to enhance existing agent footfall to generate fresh referrals for new agent hiring.
Agent Recruitment - Conduct Career Seminar of prospects.
Agent Recruitment - Follow agent hiring mechanism and other hiring norms.
Agent Development - Ensure product knowledge by AMLI ways of training; Field demonstration (FODs).
Agent Development - Development of agent prospecting habits, calling habits and work habits.
Agent Development - Work with agent on planning and reviewing of activities and goals.
Agent Development - Identify the training needs of the agent and work with Trainers to improve the same.
Meet Business Targets - Achievement of monthly, quarterly yearly business plans.
Meet Business Targets - Improve agent productivity persistency by regular PRP/IID/GID etc.
Meet Business Targets - Ensure company's product mix sales ratio and adhere to the business norms.
Meet Business Targets - Maintain agent pro activity as per business plan.
Customer Centricity - Be AMLI brand ambassador, a customer champion.
Customer Centricity - Follow AMLI sales practice to develop deep customer loyalty.
Customer Centricity - Hold periodical customer meet to understand customer pulse need.
Customer Centricity - Ensure customer queries are responded to satisfactorily as per AMLI standard.
Measures of Success - Achievement of business plan GPA.
Measures of Success - Recruitment / Development Activation of agent as per plan.
Measures of Success - Number MTD Active; Persistency as per grid; Number of EC/MDRT agent.


Qualifications
Sales Background
Minimum 2 Years Experience, At least 6 Months in last Job
Age Criteria: 24 Years to 35 Years
Should be employed in BFSI/Structured Company
Not more than 2 Job Changes in one year
Should be in City for at least 1 Year

Job Description: Client Servicing Intern Retention

Company: Delhivery
Duration: 6 Months (Full-Time Opportunity)
Location: Bangalore
Work Mode: Hybrid (3 Days WFO)
Qualification: Any Graduate
Role Overview
We are looking for a customer-focused individual to manage existing client relationships and drive client retention. The role will focus exclusively on retaining existing clients, with no client acquisition responsibilities.
Key Responsibilities
Manage relationships with existing clients.
Focus on client retention and customer satisfaction.
Address client queries and ensure timely resolution.
Coordinate with internal teams to resolve client concerns.
Conduct regular follow-ups to maintain strong client relationships.

Eligibility Criteria
Any Graduate.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Proficiency in the required language is mandatory.
Good client-handling and problem-solving skills.
Prior experience in client servicing or customer retention will be preferred.

Additional Details:
Bangalore, Hyderabad & Kerala -based candidates preferred; relocation candidates may also be considered.
6-month engagement with a full-time opportunity.
AboutCompany: Delhivery is India's leading e-commerce fulfillment company, where we use technology to drive supply chain solutions. Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced VTEX Commerce Architect with 13-15 years of overall technology experience and proven expertise in architecting enterprise-scale digital commerce solutions using VTEX. The candidate will own end-to-end solution architecture across VTEX Commerce Platform, VTEX IO, Store Framework, FastStore, headless storefronts, GraphQL APIs, integrations, security, performance, scalability, and operational readiness.
The ideal candidate should combine hands-on VTEX platform knowledge with strong architectural thinking. The role requires translating complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions, evaluating native VTEX capabilities versus custom extensions, leading architecture governance, and guiding distributed engineering teams through design and delivery.
Roles and Responsibilities
Own and drive the end-to-end architecture of enterprise digital commerce solutions built on the VTEX Commerce Platform.
Define solution architecture covering catalog, pricing, promotions, search, cart, checkout, payments, orders, logistics, inventory, marketplace, sellers, and VTEX Master Data.
Design modern storefront solutions using VTEX Store Framework, VTEX IO, FastStore, React, Next.js, and GraphQL.

Evaluate business requirements and determine when to use native VTEX capabilities, VTEX IO applications, custom services, middleware, or third-party products.
Define GraphQL and REST API contracts, schema design, API aggregation, versioning, caching, rate limiting, security, and error-handling standards.
Design integrations between VTEX and ERP, PIM/MDM, OMS, WMS, CRM, payment gateways, tax services, identity providers, search platforms, and marketplaces.

Lead architecture reviews, design workshops, technical risk assessments, production issue reviews, root-cause analysis, and long-term remediation planning.
Create and maintain HLDs, LLDs, C4 diagrams, sequence diagrams, integration specifications, API specifications, data-flow diagrams, and Architecture Decision Records.
Guide engineering teams during implementation and ensure adherence to architecture principles, coding standards, security controls, and operational requirements.

Mentor technical leads, senior developers, and architects, while promoting engineering excellence and continuous learning.

Professional and Technical Skills
Deep architectural and implementation knowledge of VTEX Commerce Platform, VTEX IO, Store Framework, FastStore, and VTEX APIs.
Strong understanding of VTEX commerce domains including catalog, pricing, promotions, search, cart, checkout, orders, logistics, inventory, marketplace, sellers, and Master Data.
Proven experience designing headless and composable commerce solutions using API-first and MACH-aligned principles.
Strong expertise in GraphQL, including schema design, queries, mutations, fragments, resolvers, federation/aggregation considerations, caching, and performance optimization.
Strong understanding of React, Next.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, SSR, SSG/ISR, frontend state management, web accessibility, SEO, and storefront performance.
Experience defining BFF patterns and clear boundaries between storefront, VTEX, middleware, and backend services.
Deep knowledge of microservices, domain-driven design concepts, event-driven architecture, distributed systems, API management, and enterprise integration patterns.
Strong knowledge of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, SSO, secrets management, secure API design, OWASP practices, and PCI considerations.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, including containers, Kubernetes, CDN, observability, autoscaling, and resilient deployment patterns.
Experience with CI/CD, DevSecOps, automated quality gates, environment strategy, release governance, and infrastructure-as-code practices.
Understanding of observability using structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, dashboards, and alerting tools.
Ability to assess architecture trade-offs, document technical decisions, and communicate recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Proven experience leading architecture governance and technical delivery across multiple workstreams and distributed teams.
Strong architectural thinking, structured problem solving, and the ability to work effectively with ambiguous requirements.
Ability to make, explain, and defend technical decisions using evidence, constraints, risks, and trade-offs.
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for business and client stakeholders.
Confidence in leading architecture discussions, discovery sessions, design workshops, and technical governance forums.
Strong stakeholder management and collaboration across product, engineering, security, infrastructure, and third-party teams.
Proactive ownership of risks, dependencies, assumptions, and technical gaps, with clear mitigation and escalation.
Ability to mentor senior engineers and technical leads while providing constructive design and code-review guidance.
Comfort working with geographically distributed teams and balancing strategic architecture with delivery priorities.
Strong accountability, decision-making maturity, negotiation skills, and a continuous improvement mindset.

Job Title - Solution Architect - AI - Manager - ACS SONG
Management Level:Level 7 -Manager
Location:Kochi, Coimbatore, Trivandrum, Bangalore

Good to have skills:Model Context Protocol (MCP)/ Agent2Agent (A2A)
Experience:10 - 15 years of experience is required

Educational Qualification:B.Tech/BE/M.Tech/MCA
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect - AI with 10+ years of overall technology experience, including at least 3 years of hands-on experience designing and architecting AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, or Agentic AI solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in enterprise solution architecture and experience designing scalable, secure, resilient, and production-ready AI solutions on at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
The role will be responsible for defining end-to-end AI solution architectures covering application, data, AI/ML, integration, security, infrastructure, and operational components. The architect will work closely with business stakeholders, enterprise architects, data teams, AI engineers, software engineers, security teams, and cloud platform teams to translate business requirements into practical and scalable technology solutions.
The candidate should have strong knowledge of modern AI architecture patterns including Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI, AI agents, vector databases, knowledge retrieval, API/tool integration, model orchestration, observability, security, and responsible AI. Experience in taking AI solutions from initial discovery and proof-of-concept through production deployment and operationalization is essential.


Roles and Responsibilities
Design end-to-end AI and Generative AI solution architectures that address business requirements while meeting enterprise standards for scalability, security, performance, reliability, and maintainability.
Define appropriate architecture patterns for Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG, Machine Learning, intelligent automation, conversational AI, and AI-enabled enterprise applications.
Provide architectural leadership across the complete solution lifecycle, from discovery, feasibility assessment, architecture definition, prototyping, implementation, production deployment, and post-production operations.
Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to evaluate AI use cases, identify suitable technologies, assess technical feasibility, and define implementation roadmaps.
Lead the architecture and solution design of enterprise AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Agentic AI solutions across cloud and hybrid environments.
Translate business requirements, functional requirements, and non-functional requirements into scalable and secure solution architecture designs, architecture diagrams, integration patterns, and technical specifications.
Design AI solutions using services and technologies available on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, including managed AI/ML, data, integration, compute, security, and observability services.
Define architectures for LLM-based applications, including prompt orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector search, embeddings, model routing, grounding, knowledge bases, AI agents, tool/function calling, and multi-agent architectures.
Design enterprise integration patterns connecting AI solutions with APIs, databases, data platforms, SaaS applications, enterprise applications, event-driven systems, and external services.
Evaluate and recommend appropriate foundation models, LLMs, embedding models, AI platforms, vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and supporting technologies based on business, technical, security, cost, and performance requirements.
Define architecture approaches for AI security, identity and access management, data privacy, guardrails, content filtering, responsible AI, model governance, and regulatory compliance.
Establish architectural standards for AI observability, monitoring, tracing, logging, evaluation, performance management, reliability, and operational support.
Work closely with AI engineers, data scientists, data engineers, application developers, DevOps/MLOps teams, cloud engineers, and security teams to guide implementation and ensure alignment with the target architecture.
Lead architecture reviews, technical design workshops, proof-of-concepts, technology assessments, and design governance activities while communicating complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and business stakeholders.
Ability to conduct AI use-case discovery, technical feasibility assessments, architecture assessments, technology evaluations, and solution option analysis.
Ability to create and communicate high-level architecture, detailed solution architecture, sequence diagrams, data flows, integration diagrams, deployment architectures, and architecture decision records.
Ability to design appropriate AI guardrails addressing areas such as hallucination, prompt injection, data leakage, harmful content, unauthorized tool execution, and inappropriate model responses.
Ability to define reference architectures, reusable architecture patterns, technical standards, and architecture governance frameworks for AI solutions.


Qualification
Professional and Technical Skills
10+ years of overall experience in software engineering, application architecture, cloud architecture, data architecture, solution architecture, or related technology roles.
Minimum 3 years of experience designing or implementing AI-based solutions, including Generative AI, Machine Learning, Intelligent Automation, Conversational AI, or Agentic AI.
Demonstrated experience working as a Solution Architect, Technical Architect, Cloud Architect, AI Architect, or equivalent senior architecture role.
Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale, production-grade solutions involving multiple applications, platforms, integrations, and data sources.
Hands-on architecture experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, document retrieval, and enterprise knowledge bases.
Strong hands-on architecture experience with at least one major cloud platform:
AWS - for example Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker,
Microsoft Azure - for example Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search,
Google Cloud Platform (GCP) - for example Vertex AI, Gemini, BigQuery
Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture patterns, including microservices, APIs, serverless architectures, containers, event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, and distributed systems.
Strong understanding of REST APIs, API gateways, authentication and authorization, OAuth/OIDC, networking, secrets management, encryption, and enterprise security architecture.
Strong understanding of enterprise data architectures including data lakes, data warehouses, lakehouses, relational databases, NoSQL databases, vector databases, and streaming platforms.
Strong understanding of enterprise security architecture including Identity and Access Management, Role-Based Access Control, network security, encryption, key management, secrets management, and secure API design.
Strong ability to evaluate architectural trade-offs across cost, performance, scalability, security, maintainability, complexity, and time to market.
Experience integrating AI applications with enterprise data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, Amazon Redshift, Microsoft Fabric, or equivalent technologies.
Experience designing integrations between AI solutions and enterprise systems using APIs, messaging platforms, event buses, queues, workflow engines, and integration platforms.
Experience designing highly available, scalable, fault-tolerant, secure, and cost-effective enterprise solutions.
Experience taking technology solutions through multiple lifecycle stages including discovery, architecture, proof-of-concept, implementation, deployment, and production support.
Experience with prompt engineering, context management, grounding techniques, model selection, model evaluation, hallucination mitigation, and AI guardrails.
Experience defining deployment strategies for AI applications across development, testing, staging, and production environments.
Experience working with enterprise security, risk, compliance, and governance teams to ensure AI solutions meet organizational and regulatory requirements.
Experience estimating solution complexity, cloud infrastructure requirements, implementation effort, technical dependencies, and architecture risks.
Understanding of common AI orchestration and development frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, DSPy, or equivalent technologies.
Understanding of AI production monitoring including model/application performance, latency, token consumption, cost, prompt and response tracing, model failures, retrieval quality, and system availability.
Understanding of Agentic AI concepts, including AI agents, planning and reasoning workflows, tool/function calling, agent orchestration, workflow automation, and multi-agent systems.
Understanding of CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, DevOps, MLOps, LLMOps, containerization, Kubernetes, and automated deployment practices.
Understanding of data ingestion, ETL/ELT, data pipelines, data quality, metadata management, data governance, and data security concepts.
Knowledge of Responsible AI principles, AI governance, model risk management, data privacy, prompt security, content moderation, explainability, and human-in-the-loop controls.
Knowledge of emerging AI interoperability patterns and protocols such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication is desirable. Any experience with UCP is also a plus.
Familiarity with observability platforms and technologies such as OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Google Cloud Operations, Datadog, Grafana, or equivalent tools.
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage effectively with business leaders, product owners, enterprise architects, engineering teams, security teams, and senior management.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex AI and architecture concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate multiple technical approaches and clearly articulate architectural trade-offs.
Ability to provide technical leadership and architectural guidance to cross-functional engineering teams without necessarily being responsible for direct people management.
Strong consulting mindset with the ability to understand business problems, challenge assumptions, identify technical risks, and recommend pragmatic solutions.
Ability to work across multiple projects and technology domains while maintaining consistency with enterprise architecture principles and standards.

Additional Information
Relevant cloud architecture certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Certified:Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect, or equivalent certifications.
AI/ML or Generative AI certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Google, Databricks, NVIDIA, or other recognized technology providers are advantageous.
Experience working in large enterprise environments, consulting organizations, or complex multi-cloud transformation programs.
Experience defining or contributing to organizational AI architecture standards, Generative AI platforms, AI Centers of Excellence, or enterprise AI governance frameworks would be advantageous.

Role & responsibilities
JOB DESCRIPTION
RTL Architect
Experience

15+ years

Location

Hyderabad, bangalore,chennai,kochi,pune
Domain

ASIC / SoC Turnkey Silicon

Employment

Full-time

The Role
Define micro-architecture and lead RTL design and SoC/subsystem integration for complex silicon, owning PPA and design quality through tape-out.

What You Will Do
Define micro-architecture, block partitioning and interface specifications from system requirements.
Own PPA trade-offs and RTL quality: lint, CDC/RDC, synthesis and constraints (SDC, UPF).
Lead subsystem and SoC integration, and drive design and code reviews.
Partner with DV, DFT and PD to close verification, testability, timing and power.
Mentor and technically guide RTL teams; act as the escalation point for design issues.
Support emulation, FPGA prototyping, silicon bring-up and root-cause analysis.

What You Bring
15+ years in RTL design and integration, with multiple tape-outs in a lead or architect role.
Expert Verilog / SystemVerilog and strong micro-architecture skills.
Deep experience with AMBA (AXI/AHB/APB), NoC and high-speed interfaces such as PCIe, DDR/LPDDR, Ethernet, USB.
Solid grasp of low-power design (UPF), clocking, CDC/RDC and timing-driven RTL.
Proficiency with front-end tools: lint, CDC, synthesis, STA; scripting in Python, Perl or Tcl.
Clear technical communication with customers and cross-functional teams.

Good to Have
ARM or RISC-V subsystem integration
Die-to-die / UCIe and chiplet architectures
Post-silicon debug experience

Description:
Key Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain Alteryx workflows for data preparation, transformation, and integration.
Develop and support ETL/data workflows to ingest, cleanse, validate, and enrich data from multiple sources.
Translate business requirements into technical workflow designs and reusable components/macros.
Implement data quality checks, reconciliation logic, and exception handling to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Optimize workflow performance by improving logic, reducing run time, and managing resource usage effectively.
Document workflow logic, data mappings, and operational steps to support maintainability and handovers.
Collaborate with analysts, data engineers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues and deliver enhancements.
Support production runs, monitor scheduled workflows, and resolve failures within defined timelines.

Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelors degree (or equivalent) in Engineering/Technology/Computer Applications/Science (e.g., BTech, BE, BSc, MCA, MTech, MSc).
2-5years of experience working with Alteryx to build and maintain data preparation or automation workflows.
Strong hands-on experience in ETL and data workflow development, including transformation and validation steps.
Solid understanding of data concepts such as joins, aggregations, filtering, data types, and schema handling.
Ability to analyze requirements, debug workflow issues, and deliver reliable outputs with attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.
Understanding of analytics lifecycle practices such as versioning, documentation standards, and reusable workflow design.
Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders, present findings, and recommend improvements to data processes.
Good to have skills:
SQL, Data Warehousing, Data Quality Frameworks, Power BI, Python

Description:
Purpose of the Role
The role is responsible for increasing the penetration of Tata Genuine Parts in authorised workshops by driving the availability of parts throughout the assigned territory. It involve working closely with distributer to ensure the availability and consumption of parts by executing sales and demand fulfilment strategy leading to increase sales and market share. It also involves ensuring parts availability of NPI models.

Job Responsibility
1. Sales Planning and Execution:
Drive effective stock planning by monitoring stock levels, supply constraints and demand levels and also ensure that fast moving parts are replenished through auto ordering system
Ensure the availability of parts for newly launched vehicles
Drive adherence to sales process guidelines set by the organization
Drive primary part sales and ensure targets are achieved within respective territory and drive secondary sales through consumption demand
Ensure demand fulfilment by coordinate with workshop, distributers and internal team to ensure that product is available when required:
Drive sales targets in the respective territory by execute various demand generating activities like schemes, holding mechanic meets, Customer meets
Coordinate and ensure the proper movement and supply of parts with PHQ
Improve turnaround time TAT by ensuring the availably of parts availability and improve the following scores: DSI, CSI, TSI, NPS, CEI
Ensure the timely handling of channel partners and customer complaints including resolving payment issues, claims settlements and product availability
Actively explore growth opportunities to increase market share and expanded the network to meet business objectives
Develop a deep understanding of the market and competition in assigned area and use insights on competition pricing and distribution strategies to help improve organizations own strategies and tactics
2. Financial Management:
Monitor and ensure channel partners financial health by helping secure availability of financial options, conducting stock analysis and receivable management
Monitor over dues of dealers and distributers in assigned area and take actions when required
3. Relationship Management:
Work collaboratively with channel partners to understand their issues and be an integral part in providing solutions at various levels
Collaborate and maintain channel partner communication and share best practices
4. People Management:
Maintain up to date product knowledge and actively provide training and educate to the retailers, mechanics, fleet operators and channel partners regarding product and the usage of genuine spare parts.
Instilling the importance of resolving customer complaints received by distributors and guiding them on best practices for handling tricky situations in a timely manner. Also training them on importance of stock keeping, timely ordering of parts, DPM, TPM, new products and new initiative

Stakeholder Profiles & Nature of Interactions
Internal
Warehouse
Servicing of Orders, providing e-permits.
Central Logistics team
Tracking shipments
Tech Cell
Tech Cell
External
Distributors
For order planning, Payments, review on regular basis
Dealers
For order planning, Payments, review on regular basis
TASS
For order planning, Payments, review on regular basis
Key account Customer
Create the awareness about TGP benefit and resolve the parts availability issue
Transporter
For claims and timely delivery of consignments

Desired Candidate Profile
Education B E (Mechanical / Automobile Engg) : Optional MBA from renowned B school
Relevant Experience: 3-4 years
Experience in Automobile Industry
Experience in B2B or Channel Sales or Auto Component Sales
Knowledge of English , Hindi & Regional Language is a Must
Technical Knowledge of Spare Parts
Knowledge SAP, CRM
Knowledge of Channel Management and Supply Management

Skills & Competencies
Analytical Skills
Technical Skills
Communication Skills
Interpersonal Skills
Relationship Building skills
Negotiation Skills
Selling Skills
Time Management Skills
Problem Solving Skills
Service Orientation
Business Acumen

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Senior Manager - Delivery to lead large and complex engagements across Commerce and Sales. This role will be responsible for driving delivery excellence, financial performance, client satisfaction and operational efficiency across engagements. The role will work closely with client stakeholders, account leadership, sales, solution and delivery teams to manage delivery commitments, revenue, profitability, risks and resource requirements. The Senior Manager will also contribute to business growth through RFPs, solutioning, renewals, account expansion and new opportunities. The ideal candidate will bring strong delivery leadership combined with a good understanding of the Commerce and Sales landscape, including digital commerce, B2B/B2C commerce, sales platforms, pricing/CPQ and associated transformation programs.
Role and Responsibilities
Lead end-to-end delivery of large and complex Commerce and Sales engagements, ensuring alignment with agreed scope, timelines, quality, financial targets and business objectives.
Drive delivery governance and operational performance across engagements, ensuring effective management of risks, issues, dependencies and client commitments.
Own and monitor financial performance, including revenue, budgets, forecasts, costs, margins and profitability.
Track revenue commitments and collaborate with account and delivery teams to achieve financial and business targets.
Build and maintain strong client relationships, acting as a senior point of contact for delivery reviews, escalations and key operational matters.
Ensure adherence to agreed KPIs, SLAs, quality standards and contractual commitments.
Participate in RFPs, RFIs and proposal development, working with sales, solution and delivery teams on delivery approach, effort estimation, resource plans, commercials and timelines.
Support business growth by identifying opportunities for renewals, scope expansion, additional services and new engagements.
Work closely with account, sales and solution teams to assess delivery feasibility, risks and dependencies associated with proposed solutions and commitments.
Own resource and capacity planning across engagements, including demand forecasting, staffing, utilization, skill requirements and resource allocation.
Work with capability and workforce teams to address resource gaps and ensure timely availability of skills required to meet delivery commitments.
Drive cost optimization, productivity and operational efficiency through process improvement, standardization, automation and effective delivery models.
Proactively identify and manage delivery risks and escalations and drive timely resolution in collaboration with relevant stakeholders.
Ensure adherence to organizational governance, compliance, security and delivery standards.
Provide regular delivery, financial, risk and operational updates to client stakeholders, account leadership and senior management.
Provide leadership and direction to delivery teams, fostering a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement


Qualification
Professional and Technical Skills
Extensive experience managing large and complex technology delivery engagements, preferably within Commerce, Sales or related digital transformation programs.
Strong experience in end-to-end delivery management covering scope, schedule, quality, risk, financial and resource management.
Demonstrated experience in revenue management, budgeting, forecasting, cost management, margins and profitability.
Experience in RFPs, RFIs, proposals, effort estimation, commercial discussions and solutioning activities.
Strong client relationship and stakeholder management experience, including senior-level delivery reviews and management of critical escalations.
Experience in resource planning, capacity management, utilization and management of large, distributed teams.
Experience identifying and supporting account growth, renewals and expansion opportunities.
Strong understanding of delivery governance, KPIs, SLAs, contractual commitments and continuous improvement practices.
Good understanding of the Commerce and Sales technology landscape, including digital commerce, B2B/B2C commerce, order management, sales platforms, pricing and CPQ.
Exposure to enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, SAP Commerce, commercetools, Adobe Commerce, Shopify, Conga, PROS, Pricefx or similar platforms would be advantageous. Deep hands-on technical expertise is not required.
Experience managing large, geographically distributed and cross-functional teams.
Strong leadership, decision-making, negotiation, commercial acumen and problem-solving skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication, executive presentation and stakeholder management skills.
Certifications such as PMP, Agile/Scrum, SAFe or equivalent are an advantage
Additional Information
Demonstrated experience managing large or multiple concurrent Commerce and Sales engagements.
Experience working directly with senior client stakeholders and account leadership.
Experience in consulting, technology services or large-scale digital transformation environments is preferred

At Accenture Song, delivering top-notch solutions means ensuring development outcomes align with expectations. We are looking for a detail-oriented Senior Manual Tester to ensure the quality and reliability of our applications. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in manual and API testing, defect management, and end-to-end functional validation, along with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment.

Support UAT (User Acceptance Testing) and assist stakeholders with test execution.
Collaborate with developers and product owners to understand requirements and identify potential issues.

The ideal candidate will combine strong technical expertise with proven leadership capabilities to lead high-performing engineering teams delivering scalable, customer-centric digital experiences.
The role combines client-facing solution leadership, technical and architectural oversight, delivery leadership, and people development. The individual will be expected to shape frontend solutions from pre-sales through delivery, lead senior engineering teams, influence client technology decisions, and continuously evolve our frontend capabilities in line with market trends. Experience in Digital Commerce and Composable Commerce architecture is highly preferred.
We are seeking a senior Frontend Engineering and Solution Leader who can own the frontend technology agenda across complex digital and commerce engagements.
Roles and Responsibilities
Own the frontend solution and technology strategy for complex client engagements, from discovery and architecture through implementation and evolution.
Provide technical oversight during solution design, development, testing, and production support activities.
Act as a Senior Frontend technology advisor to clients, translating business and experience requirements into scalable frontend solutions.
Lead frontend solutioning across digital commerce, composable and headless architectures, and web and mobile experiences.
Own and guide key architectural decisions across frontend frameworks, micro-frontends, design systems, performance, security, accessibility, SEO, and integration patterns.
Build strong relationships with client technology leadership and establish credibility as a trusted technology advisor.
Provide technical direction and governance across multiple frontend teams and workstreams.
Lead frontend solutioning for RFPs, RFIs, proposals, and client pursuits, defining the technology approach, architecture, delivery model, and estimates.
Identify opportunities to expand frontend engineering, composable commerce, and digital experience capabilities within existing and new client engagements.
Provide end-to-end technical leadership and governance for large and complex frontend initiatives.
Guide solution design, architecture, development, testing, deployment, and production support while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture and engineering standards.
Lead and develop a strong community of frontend architects, leads, and engineers across the practice.
Build capability across modern frontend technologies, headless architectures, design systems, and composable digital experiences.
Drive hiring, succession planning, career development, and the identification of emerging technical leaders.
Establish reusable engineering patterns, reference architectures, accelerators, and best practices.
Provide technical mentorship and direction beyond individual project teams, helping to establish a consistent frontend engineering approach across the practice.
Create a strong engineering culture focused on technical excellence, innovation, reuse, and continuous learning.


Qualification
Professional and Technical Skills:
15+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years in Frontend Management or Technical Leadership roles.
Experience delivering Digital Commerce, eCommerce, or Composable Commerce solutions is strongly preferred.
Expertise in NextJS, ReactJS, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, and modern frontend development practices.
Experience with micro-frontend architecture and frontend design systems.
Strong understanding of frontend performance optimization, accessibility standards (WCAG), SEO, and responsive design.
Experience designing scalable, enterprise-grade web applications.
Strong knowledge of RESTful APIs, GraphQL, and frontend-backend integration patterns.
Familiarity with headless CMS, composable commerce platforms, and API-driven architectures.
Demonstrated success in leading, mentoring, and growing engineering teams.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and decision-making skills.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational capabilities.

Description:
Job Summary
We are looking for an SAP CPI Manager to join the EY GDS - SAP TechOps Team. As part of our EY GDS - TechOps team, you will be responsible for the development, maintenance and optimization of our SAP CPI solutions in alignment with our business objectives in a multi-region environment. You will collaborate closely with cross functional teams to address issues, implement enhancements, and optimize applications to deliver seamless global operations support to global clients. You will lead the design, development, and implementation of integration solutions within the SAP BTP Integration Suite. You will bridge business requirements with technical specifications, connecting SAP S/4HANA, cloud apps (SuccessFactors/Ariba), and third-party systems. Key responsibilities include designing iFlows, securing APIs, troubleshooting, and mentoring developers. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth as you get to work with high quality team to support clients ensuring the stability of global 500 companies through best-in-class solutions, automation and innovation.
Your Key Responsibilities
Provide day to day Application Management support for SAP Applications across IT Service Management including service requests, incident management, enhancement requests as Level 2 Application Management Specialist
Provide level 2 support for SAP CPI/PIPO development activities including customizations, enhancements, and bug fixes across multiple SAP environments troubleshooting and resolving issues related to customer CPI developments and SAP System Performance
Collaborate with functional consultants to gather requirements for incidents, enhancements and problems and translate them into technical solutions
Perform Debugging and Testing to ensure the quality of CPI/PI/PO developments
Support system integration testing, user acceptance testing and production deployment of CPI/PI/PO objects
Document technical specifications, code changes and implementation details for knowledge sharing and future reference
Keep abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies and SAP best practices to contribute to continuous improvement initiatives
Participate in on-call rotation and provide off hours support as needed to ensure the availability and reliability of critical SAP systems
Available to work on shift hours depending on the requirement of the client
Skills and qualifications
Bachelor's degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences.
Minimum of 7 years working experience in SAP CPI/PI/PO development with a focus on level 2 support
Team Leadership & Management: Lead, mentor, and manage a team of developers, fostering collaboration and high performance.
Proven experience in designing complex integrations, cloud applications, and security architectures.
Sound experience in Design and implement complex, end-to-end integration scenarios using SAP BTP Integration Suite (CPI, API Management, Event Mesh).
Solution Delivery: Drive end-to-end delivery of SAP projects, from requirement gathering to implementation, focusing on scalable and maintainable architectures.
3 to 5 years of SAP PI/PO/CPI experience participation as a lead person responsible for integration design and implementation in at least two full-cycle SAP projects or roll-outs
Strong skills in SAP PI/PO/CPI Design, Configuration, and Administration
Good hands-on knowledge of Java, XSLT Mapping, Java mapping, Groovy
Good Understanding of Business processes and Create and maintain end-to-end functional designs for interfaces
Suggest improvements to current operational procedures within integration environment good knowledge of integration technologies and specific SAP Integration architecture
Strong Knowledge of using IDOC, RFC, JDBC, File, ABAP Proxy, SOAP, HTTP, REST, SFTP, SuccessFactors, sFTP
Knowledge of SAP BPM/BRM Design, Build, Monitoring and troubleshooting
Strong Knowledge of SAP Cloud Platform services like CPI-DS, SDI, Open Connectors, Persistence

As a Territory Sales Officer, you will be responsible for the overall development and business performance of the territory assigned to you. Your key responsibilities will include:
Achieving the monthly sales targets assigned by the Sales Manager and taking timely corrective action wherever a shortfall is anticipated.
Developing new customers, including hardware/paint shops and paver block units, while continuously working to revive dormant and at-risk customers.

Sales-oriented and target-driven.
Good communication and negotiation skills.

Strong follow-up and execution skills.
Basic knowledge of MS Office / CRM / ERP systems preferred.

Job Summary
You-ll capture user requirements and translate them into business and digitally enabled solutions across a range of industries.


Roles and Responsibilities
Analyzing as-is and design to-be processes to define business, solution and system requirements.
Organizing and facilitating workshops with clients to elicit and understand their requirements.
Interacting with various (client) stakeholders to, gain a deep understanding of their needs and represent that knowledge to the rest of the team, while using analysis techniques like story mapping, process modelling and data- and document analysis.
Managing the requirements life cycle
Facilitating effective communication between the team and acting as a point of contact for clarifications on product backlog items
Iteration planning, backlog refinement, creating user stories and story acceptance criteria is also part of your scope.
Stakeholder management and being an interface between your team, the customer and the project manager.

Collaborating with key external and internal project stakeholders who have a direct impact on their role and deliverables (e.g., decision-makers, Subject Matter Experts)
Ensuring that requirements and designs at an implementation level are aligned to one another, and managing the changes to related requirements
Retaining requirement accuracy and consistency throughout and beyond the change during the entire requirements life cycle, and supporting the reuse of requirements in other solutions

Qualification
Professional and Technical Skill
Experience in producing implementation-ready product backlog items based on the elicited requirements
Experience in understanding initial product backlog/ inception documentation to be able to form a complete picture of project scope
Skilled in engaging with clients, vendors, and internal teams to align expectations and deliverables.
Excellent verbal and written communication for reporting, presentations, and team coordination.
Ability to mentor, motivate, and manage cross-functional teams across geographies.
Proficiency in JIRA, MS Project, or similar platforms.
Understanding of development, testing, deployment, and maintenance phases.
Knowledge of automation pipelines, version control, and deployment strategies.
Relevant application knowledge of any commerce platforms like SAP Hybris, commerce tools or similar could complete your profile.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced and motivated Salesforce B2B Commerce Lead - Specialist with 5-8 years of experience in designing, developing, and delivering scalable eCommerce solutions on Salesforce B2B Commerce Cloud. The ideal candidate has strong knowledge of Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Salesforce platform capabilities, with proven experience in both backend and frontend development. You will lead technical delivery, mentor team members, and ensure adherence to best practices while collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive successful multi-market rollouts.


Roles and Responsibilities
Own the technical direction and ensure delivery of high-quality, scalable, and maintainable Salesforce B2B Commerce solutions.
Lead and mentor developers, providing guidance through code reviews, technical planning, and solution design.
Design, develop, debug, unit test, and document complex Salesforce applications and integrations.
Develop and customize Lightning Web Components (LWC) and Communities for B2B Commerce Cloud.
Implement Apex Classes, Triggers (before/after insert, update, delete), and Scheduler Classes for automation.
Create and manage Flows (Schedule-triggered, AutoLaunched, Record-triggered) and modify standard checkout flows.
Make architectural and design decisions ensuring scalability, maintainability, and compliance with Salesforce standards.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align technical implementation with business requirements.
Proactively identify technical risks and propose improvements across the codebase and processes.
Ensure proper validation checks, error handling, and user experience enhancements (e.g., Toast Notifications).
Act as a key troubleshooter in complex/escalated incidents and provide innovative solutions.
Manage multi-market rollouts including multi-currency and multi-language implementations.
Ensure adherence to CI/CD pipelines, code quality standards, and Salesforce best practices.

Qualification
Professional and Technical Skills
Strong expertise in Salesforce B2B Commerce Cloud (LWR template, checkout flows, staged rollouts).
Hands-on experience in Apex programming (Classes, Triggers, Scheduler, Batch jobs).
Proficiency in Lightning Web Components (LWC) including lifecycle hooks (connectedCallback, renderedCallback), directives (for:each, iterator, if:true), and decorators (@track, @wire, @api).
Experience with frontend customization:styling LWC with custom CSS, applying validation checks, and building reusable components.
Knowledge of Salesforce Communities and integration with external APIs.
Strong understanding of SOQL, data loading activities (Data Loader, Workbench), and permission set assignments.
Experience with GitHub, Bitbucket, and code management tools.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and code quality tools (SonarQube).
Exposure to multi-threaded integrations, caching mechanisms, and API-driven commerce flows.
Strong problem-solving, analytical, and logical skills with attention to detail.
Ability to work under pressure and deliver within deadlines.

Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Assistant Manager - Employee Relations
Function Description:
Employee Relations function is a Centre of Excellence function within the Talent organisation of EY Global Delivery Services (GDS). Employee Relations CoE works in close partnership with Strategic Talent Consultant function, GDS Ethics Office as well as GDS General Counsel s Office and is primarily responsible for managing complex/sensitive ER incidents. The function continuously monitors the ER risk profile of the Firm and develop/deploy strategies to manage the same. ER CoE is also responsible to project manage Talent special projects and is the custodian of all Talent Policies.
Job description:
Conduct workplace investigations into sensitive Employee Relations matters. This involves facilitating and documenting Investigation interviews, analysing evidence and drafting investigation findings reports.
Partner with Senior ER professionals in providing guidance to Talent Consultants and Business Leaders in managing wide range of Employee Relation issues, including Code of conduct breaches, Performance lapses, Discrimination allegations, Workplace harassment allegations, Integrity issues etc., and ensure resolution of the same with minimal risk exposure to the Firm and its professionals.
Maintain ER Incident data base, identify trends and thereby assist Talent leadership in developing appropriate strategies and initiatives to proactively mitigate ER risk exposures.
Actively participate in special projects undertaken by EY GDS Employee Relations Centre of Excellence
To qualify for the role, you must have:
Education : Master s Degree in Human Resource Management or Business Administration with HR specialisation or Bachelor in Legislative Law (LLB)
Experience : 6 - 10 years of experience of Human Resources, with at least 4 years experience in Employment Law, preferably in Big Fours or Leading IT services/Consulting Firms.
Should have strong knowledge of Indian employment law and regulations, especially related to conduct of disciplinary procedures, work-place investigations, employment litigation procedures etc.
Should possess exceptional written skills, specifically legal writing, as well as oral communication skills.
Should have the capability to apply discretion and make sound judgement, even in highly stressful and emotional scenarios.
Should have the ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information
Should be able to navigate through complex, difficult, and ambiguous situations.
What we offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across eight locations - Argentina, Hungary, India, Mexico, Philippines, Poland, Spain and Sri Lanka - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
EY | Building a better working world
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique.

We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.
