Description:
Manager, Credit Strategy & Solutioning
Location: Gurgaon / Bangalore / Mumbai
Experience: 5+ years
Job Summary
We are looking for an analytically sharp, driven individual to join our Credit team and take on some of the highest-impact problems in our embedded finance business. This role sits at the intersection of credit, strategy, and product - requiring someone who can take open-ended, ambiguous problems, research them from the ground up, and turn them into well-structured, scalable credit solutions. You will work closely with key ecosystem partners to design and grow embedded credit products, and collaborate deeply with business, policy, and product teams to implement these solutions. This is a high-visibility, hands-on role with direct senior leadership exposure, and the work you do will directly shape the trajectory of our most important growth vertical.
Key Responsibilities
Work closely with existing partners to diagnose what is limiting scale, and design the right credit solution - combining partner ecosystem analysis, customer behavior insights, and market research to identify the right product fit and growth levers.
Build templated, scalable credit solutions for specific industry verticals (e-commerce, FMCG, ERP, travel, and others) - defining the right product structure and strategic positioning that can be replicated across partners in each segment.
Drive end-to-end solutioning for new partner launches in close collaboration with business and policy teams, from problem definition and research through to execution.
Work with the payments team to co-design integrated credit and payments journeys for partners.
Query, explore, and analyze portfolio and partner data to extract meaningful insights - know where to go deep and where to do 80:20, and translate findings into clear decisions and actions.
Drive strategic decision-making across our portfolio with key business partners - LSPs & bureaus.
Manage relationships with external vendors, data providers, and business partners (LSPs); evaluate new data partners for incremental value in credit strategies.
Present structured findings and recommendations to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
Qualifications
5+ years of relevant experience in credit risk, analytics, strategy, or a generalist problem-solving role (such as a founder's office) at a fintech, bank, consulting firm, or any organization with significant exposure to lending.
Proven track record of high-impact work - strong analytical thinking, first-principles problem solving, and a sharp instinct for where value lies in a problem.
Demonstrated ability to work on open-ended, ambiguous problems and bring structure and clarity to them.
Skills
Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills; experience working cross-functionally across business, product, and risk teams.
Expert-level proficiency in Excel and at least one data querying language (SQL or Python).
Working knowledge of credit products, underwriting, bureau data, and risk models.
Ability to communicate complex analyses clearly to diverse audiences, including senior leadership.
Graduate degree in business, engineering, statistics, economics, or other analytical field from a Tier 1 institute.

Description:
AWS Full Stack Developer Manager (Job Description)
About the Role
We are seeking an experienced AWS Full Stack Developer to lead full-stack application development on AWS, driving architecture decisions, CI/CD automation, and team delivery across frontend and backend workloads.
The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in full-stack application development on AWS, with proven ability to lead development teams, drive architectural decisions across frontend (React/Angular with Amplify) and backend (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB/RDS) layers, and establish CI/CD standards.
Key Responsibilities
Lead full-stack application development using React/Angular (with Amplify and Next.js/Nuxt), Java/Python/Node.js, and AWS serverless services.
Architect end-to-end solutions including frontend (CloudFront CDN distribution), backend (Lambda, Lambda MicroVMs, Lambda Managed Instances), API (API Gateway, AppSync for GraphQL), and database layers (DynamoDB, RDS/Aurora, ElastiCache).
Design scalable REST and GraphQL API architectures using API Gateway and AppSync with advanced patterns (caching, WebSocket, request/response transformations).
Lead database design and optimization for DynamoDB (single-table design, GSI/LSI) and RDS/Aurora workloads.
Establish CI/CD pipeline standards using CodePipeline, CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, and Amplify Hosting with managed CI/CD.
Implement AWS security best practices including Cognito, IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, WAF, and Shield.
Develop IaC using Terraform, CloudFormation, or AWS CDK.
Lead and mentor development teams on modern frameworks, TypeScript full-stack patterns, and AWS best practices.
Collaborate with DevOps, Security, QA, and business teams for delivery excellence.
Use CloudWatch, X-Ray, CloudTrail, and CloudWatch Logs Insights for observability and performance optimization.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
10+ years of experience in software engineering.
5+ years of hands-on AWS experience.
Deep proficiency in frontend frameworks (React, Angular, Next.js) and backend technologies (Java, Python, Node.js/TypeScript).
Extensive experience designing REST and GraphQL APIs with API Gateway, AppSync, and serverless patterns.
Hands-on experience with AWS services including Lambda (Functions, MicroVMs), S3, RDS/Aurora, DynamoDB, API Gateway, CloudFront, Cognito, IAM.
Proven experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines at scale using CodePipeline, CodeBuild, and Amplify.
Strong proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK).
Familiarity with containerization and orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes, ECS/EKS, Fargate).
Strong understanding of application security (Cognito, IAM, KMS, WAF) and cloud governance.
Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
Knowledge of Agile Methodology and Practices.
Prior experience with microservices architecture and event-driven design.
Nice to Have
AWS Professional or Associate certifications.
Experience with AI tools in development lifecycles (GitHub CoPilot, Cursor, Amazon Q Developer) and brought in efficiencies.
DevOps experience (CI/CD pipelines using CodePipeline, GitHub Actions, Jenkins).
Experience with AWS migration tools (DMS, SCT, Migration Hub, AWS Transform).
Experience with GraphQL at scale using AppSync.Role & responsibilities

Key Responsibilities
1. Databricks Enterprise Strategy
Define and own the enterprise-wide Databricks platform strategy, roadmap, and adoption model in line with business goals.
Set up a Databricks Center of Excellence (CoE), including best practices, reusable frameworks, and engineering standards.
Assess new Databricks capabilities (Unity Catalog, Delta Live Tables, Serverless, Photon, Mosaic AI, Databricks SQL) and lead their adoption.
Drive platform cost optimization (FinOps), workspace strategy, and capacity planning.
Act as the primary technical liaison with Databricks and cloud vendor partners.
2. Advanced DABs (Databricks Asset Bundles) Framework
Design and implement an enterprise-grade CI/CD framework using Databricks Asset Bundles for consistent, repeatable deployments.
Standardize Infrastructure-as-Code and Configuration-as-Code practices across environments (Dev, QA, UAT, Prod).
Integrate DABs with DevOps tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, and Terraform.
Build reusable bundle templates, deployment patterns, and automated testing and validation pipelines.
Ensure version control, environment promotion, and release governance across all Databricks workloads.
3. Governance Implementation
Lead the design and rollout of data governance using Unity Catalog, covering access controls, data lineage, auditing, and data discovery.
Implement data security, privacy, and compliance controls (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2, CCPA, as applicable).
Define data quality frameworks, metadata management standards, and data ownership and stewardship models.
Work with InfoSec, Risk, and Compliance teams to enforce policies such as row/column-level security, data masking, and fine-grained permissions.
Set up monitoring, observability, and audit mechanisms across the data platform.

Architect and evolve the enterprise Data Lakehouse using Delta Lake and the Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold).
Design scalable data models that support analytics, BI, ML/AI, and real-time use cases.
Lead migrations from legacy data warehouses, Hadoop, and on-prem platforms to the Databricks Lakehouse.
Ensure performance tuning, storage optimization (Z-Ordering, Liquid Clustering, partitioning), and high availability.
Enable data sharing through Delta Sharing and support data mesh and data product approaches where relevant.

Design secure, scalable, and resilient cloud-native data architectures on AWS and/or Azure.
Oversee the integration of Databricks with cloud services, such as:

AWS: S3, Glue, Kinesis, Lambda, IAM, Redshift, Lake Formation
Define networking, identity, and security architecture, including VNet/VPC injection, Private Link, and SSO/SCIM.
Drive disaster recovery, business continuity, and multi-region strategies.

Establish reusable ingestion, transformation, and orchestration frameworks (Databricks Workflows, Airflow, ADF).
Ensure pipelines meet SLAs, scalability, reliability, and data quality requirements.
Promote engineering excellence through code reviews, testing standards, modular design, and documentation.
Enable real-time and near-real-time data processing for critical business use cases.

Prioritize initiatives based on business value, ROI, and strategic alignment.

Report progress, KPIs, and outcomes to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
Run delivery governance using Agile, SAFe, or hybrid methodologies.
People Leadership
Lead, mentor, and grow a team of data engineers, architects, and tech leads, including onshore and offshore teams.
Build a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.
Drive hiring, performance management, and career development for the team.

Role / Job Title- Manager - Oracle Fusion HCM Payroll Functional Consultant
Experience - 8 - 14 years

Key Skills -Oracle Fusion HCM Payroll, US Payroll, Payroll Configuration, Elements, Calculation Cards, Balances, Fast Formulas, Payroll Flows, Retro Processing and Costing
Location - Bangalore/Hyderabad/ Pune /Gurugram

Role & responsibilities

8 - 14 years of experience in Oracle HCM applications, with strong hands-on expertise in Oracle Fusion HCM Payroll.
Must have worked on at least two end-to-end Oracle Fusion Payroll implementations, with strong Oracle US Payroll experience; Canada Payroll experience is a plus.
In-depth hands-on configuration across Legislative Data Groups, payroll definitions and calendars, Payroll Statutory Units / Tax Reporting Units, elements, input values, element eligibility, calculation cards, balances, payment methods and payroll costing.
Strong knowledge of QuickPay, payroll flows, retroactive processing, proration, balance adjustments, costing and payment processing.
Hands-on expertise in Payroll Fast Formulas and troubleshooting complex payroll calculation and configuration issues.
Strong understanding of US payroll processing, including federal, state and local taxation, quarter-end / year-end activities and legislative updates.
Experience with HDL / payroll data conversion, payroll extracts and reporting, with the ability to collaborate with technical teams on integrations and extensions.
Ability to perform fit-gap analysis, translate business requirements into scalable configuration, and lead unit testing, UAT / regression testing, quarterly release readiness and production issue resolution.
Strong client-facing communication and delivery leadership, including risk / escalation management, team guidance and working knowledge of Core HR and related HCM touchpoints.
As a Manager, you will serve as the functional lead and client-facing subject matter expert for Oracle Fusion HCM Payroll, combining deep payroll configuration expertise with delivery leadership across implementation, enhancement and production support engagements.
Lead the Oracle HCM Payroll functional workstream across solution design, configuration, testing, cutover, hypercare and ongoing support.
Lead client requirement and design discussions, translate payroll policies into Oracle configuration, and provide clear recommendations on solution options and impacts.
Own complex payroll functional issues from analysis through resolution, driving root-cause analysis and sustainable fixes.
Review payroll configurations, functional designs and deliverables for quality, accuracy, controls and adherence to agreed standards.
Manage incidents, service requests, changes and problem records in line with SLAs / KPIs, including prioritization, risks, escalations and stakeholder communication.

Description:
Imagine yourself going to work with one thing on your mind: to provide the best customer experience to your clients. As you look at your tasks for the day, you should be able to drive the performance of teammates in order for them to continuously hit their goals. You must be able to coach and manage the teammates under your supervision and act as a bridge between your teammates and the other departments.
Being a Team Leader, you will manage the day-to-day planning and operations of your team. This includes making sure that each of your Teammates delivers on their Service Level Agreement (SLA) and achieve their Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). As Team Leader, you are in charge of managing the team and making sure everyone adheres to their schedules. You must be organized and be able to handle responsibility. A critical part of the role is to be able to train and help in the development of your team, by conducting team huddles, coaching sessions, and recognizing weaknesses - so you can offer solutions to help them improve and grow. Through that, your team will be able to deliver a superior customer experience - which is the main thrust of your department.
You must be adept at creating reports of your teams performance and documenting feedback from your client. You must be able to effectively manage issues that might arise (including HR related ones); not to mention, being creative in terms of thinking of solutions; and acting as the liaison between management and your team.
So, do you have what it takes to be a Team Leader?
Requirements:
So, what are we looking for?
We need someone who has the skills to call themselves a Leader. Someone with at least one (1) year of relevant Team Leader experience managing at least 10 + teammates while working in a customer support role within an outsourcing or similar company. We need someone with excellent verbal and written communication skills along with above-average technical know-how.
If you have previous experience working on the phone, email and live chat customer support roles, then that’s a plus in your favor. If you’re familiar with E-Commerce, ZenDesk, or any other CRM tools; flexible and willing to work different shifts - then we definitely want to talk to you.
If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

Description:
KDN India_Consultant/Assistant Manager_Financial Modelling
As a member of KDN, youll be a part of the KPMG family working alongside some of our profession’s most skilled practitioners on rewarding programs and initiatives that are changing the way business operates, delivering value to our clients, and driving positive change in the communities we serve.
You’ll be enabling KDN accelerate new ways of working, using cutting-edge technology and working together with our member firms located in nearly 150 countries to help us achieve our ambition to be the most trusted and trustworthy professional services firm. And through your work, you’ll build a global network and unlock opportunities that you may not have thought possible with access to great support, vast resources, and an inclusive, supportive environment to help you reach your full potential.

Role & responsibilities

Support the specification / design of models and analysis tools.
Develop models (incl. integrated P&L, Cash flow and Balance sheet models) from scratch.
Amend models developed by KPMG staff or by third parties.
Carry out financial analysis of the outputs of models.
Ensure the consistency in client models and create / maintain project documentation and data books.
Carry out testing of models as per KPMG quality control procedures.
Review models and feedback findings to clients using KPMG proprietary software.
Review and comment on revised models received from clients to verify whether review comments have been acted upon.
Document the operation of models and the findings from our work.
Document issues in a business model for inclusion in review reports and liaise with the project manager to fully explain the points raised.
Design and execute commercial analysis e.g. market sizing, market driver analysis, competitive benchmarking etc.
Develop business cases and business plans underpinned by robust financial analysis in support of strategic initiatives.

Preferred candidate profile
3-6 years working experience of Financial Analysis, Business Modelling or Financial Modelling;
A good working knowledge of accounting, financial statements, and financial analysis;
Strong analytical and problem solving skills;
Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel;
A commercial outlook and a good understanding of the general business and economic environment;
Excellent communication and presentation skills
Ability to build effective networks internally and externally

Job Description
The Finance Solution team works closely with client and project teams in the US to help CFOs and their finance organizations identify, design and implement programs that transform their finance functions to meet todays demanding requirements while continuing to provide valuable insights to the business.
A career within the Finance Solutions team, will provide the opportunity to work alongside CEOs, CFOs and Controllers to optimize their Record to Report process. We work closely with clients to diagnose current-state finance operations, identify improvement opportunities, design future-state processes, and implement digital and process solutions to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and control in financial reporting.

Role & responsibilities
4-9 years Experience R2R Finance Strategy, Process Transformation,Blackline end to end Implementation.
1. Finance Strategy, Process Transformation & Optimization Workiva Implementation,Blackline Implementation.

Assist the finance function to define the finance vision, outline clear-set of value proposition, define sustainable cost reduction model, prepare a roadmap for finance transformation strategy, define and develop a finance target operating model.
Lead assessments and diagnostics of clients Controllership function / R2R processes, identifying pain points, inefficiencies, and control gaps.
Design future-state processes aligned with leading practices and automation opportunities.
Drive simplification, standardization, and centralization initiatives across global finance functions.
Performance / KPI Management - define an effective set of performance measures and KPIs which will focus the business on the delivery of strategy and business plans
2. Technology Enablement & Digital Finance
Lead implementation and optimization of Last mile tools (BlackLine, Trintech, Floqast, ReconNet, Workiva, Alteryx, Power BI).
Collaborate with technology teams to define system requirements, support testing, and ensure smooth deployment.
Leverage analytics, RPA, and AI-based solutions to drive continuous improvement.
3. Financial Close & Reporting Excellence
Improve close cycle timelines, accuracy of financial statements, and reconciliation efficiency.
Implement best-in-class closing calendars, governance models, and reporting frameworks.
4. Stakeholder Management & Communication
Act as a trusted advisor to client CFOs, Controllers, and Shared Services leaders.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams (FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Procurement) to ensure end-to-end process alignment.
Prepare and deliver high-quality deliverables, presentations, and reports for leadership reviews.
5. People Development & Knowledge Sharing
Contribute to firm-wide knowledge creation, methodologies, and accelerators for finance transformation projects.
Mentor junior team members and support their development through on-the-job training and feedback.
Preferred candidate profile
An ideal candidate for the Finance Solutions practice of PwC Advisory Acceleration Center should be proficient in one or more of the below:
Advising global organizations on improving efficiency and effectiveness in Record to Report processes
Have a strong business acumen, with an ability to understand how business processes and decisions impact people and organization
Ability to conduct walkthroughs, workshops and meetings involving various business stakeholders
Strong understanding of Record to Report processes (GL, Intercompany, Fixed Assets, Reconciliations, Financial Close, Inventory Accounting and Reporting).
Exposure to automation and reporting tools like BlackLine, Trintech, Floqast, ReconNet, Workiva.
Working knowledge of any digital tools and accelerators such as Alteryx, PowerBI, Tableau, Power Automate, Power Apps etc. would be an added advantage

Job Title: Java Solution Architect
Experience: 12-15 Years
Location: Pune / Mumbai / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Chennai / Gurgaon
Employment Type: Full-Time

About the Role
Capgemini is looking for an experienced Java Solution Architect to lead the design and implementation of scalable, secure, cloud-native enterprise applications. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in Java technologies, Microservices, Cloud Platforms, Enterprise Architecture, and Digital Transformation initiatives. The role requires strong technical leadership, stakeholder management, solution design expertise, and the ability to drive technology modernization programs.

Define end-to-end architecture for enterprise-grade applications and digital transformation initiatives.
Design scalable, resilient, and secure solutions using Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, and Cloud technologies.
Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, enterprise architects, and engineering teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Lead architecture reviews, technical governance, and design workshops.
Establish architecture standards, best practices, and development guidelines.
Develop cloud-native architectures leveraging AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud platforms.
Drive API-first, event-driven, and domain-driven design approaches.
Evaluate and recommend emerging technologies, frameworks, and platforms.
Ensure solution compliance with security, performance, scalability, and reliability requirements.
Guide engineering teams during implementation and resolve complex technical challenges.
Mentor technical leads and development teams across multiple projects.
Support pre-sales activities, solution estimations, RFP responses, and technical proposals.

Support large-scale transformation and modernization programs.

Job Description
Overview
The Technical Manager role at AtkinsRalis GDC Transportation focuses on delivering advanced BIM and CAD designs for major global rail and bridge infrastructure projects. Based in Bangalore or Gurgaon, the position involves creating and leading and managing 3D models, producing detailed 2D drawings, coordinating multidisciplinary BIM workflows, and ensuring compliance with AtkinsRalis standards and international BIM practices. The role requires strong modelling expertise, understanding of BIM standards, experience with tools like MicroStation, OpenBuildings, ProjectWise/ACC, and the ability to collaborate within large engineering teams. It offers excellent growth opportunities within a world-leading infrastructure consultancy.
Your Role
Should be able to develop CAD/BIM 3D Models / 2D Drawings to the standards codes.
Should be able to produce medium to complex 3D modelling for bridges Rail structures.
Competent in producing GA and RC detailing drawings for bridges and Rail structures.
Work with the Information Manager and project teams to assist in the development and implementation of BIM strategies, BIM Execution Plans, workflows and processes on projects in accordance with AtkinsRalis Corporate Standards, Client requirements and industry best practice.
Should be able to produce 3D models and extract information directly from models to create 2D drawings, schedules, setting out, quantities and other deliverables.
Should be able to develop models and technical content including clash detection and compliance with BEP.Should be able to follow OCRA process in EDMS workflow.
Should have strong written verbal communication in English.
Experience of working in Common Data Environment (CDE) like ProjectWise / ACCApply AtkinsRalis Quality, Safety Environmental (QSE) standards and Business Management System (BMS)
About You
Requirements
Must have Civil Engineering background with preferable Rail domain experience.
Experience of Bridge Detailing, reinforcement detailing, structural steel detailing and schedules.
Hands-on experience of industry standard Rail BIM Platforms such as OpenBuildings Designer, MicroStation Connect (3D).
Proven experience of a range of CAD and BIM industry standards including an understanding of UK BIM Level 2 requirements.
Understanding of BIM Standards such as BS1192 and PAS1192 Part 2 is also desirable.
I-Twin or Bentley Cloud Services with capabilities to federate individual discipline BIM Models.
Setup, maintain and run clash rules and clash tests across federated BIM Models.
Working experience in Revit Structures including 3D RC detailing would be an added advantageQualifications and attributes.
Excellent time management skills.15 to 20 years of relevant experienceExperience of using written and spoken English within a business environment.
A Diploma/Degree holder in Civil Engineering with sufficient and relevant experience.Flexible and engaging with resilience, drive and self-motivation.
Ability to collaborate successfully within a project and team environment but also to work independently and in a client environment.
Constantly striving towards continuous improvement and innovation.Ability to exercise initiative and take ownership of project issues.
Ability to adapt to different cultures and working environments to build rapport with customers.
Highly IT literate, excellent command of standard office software, knowledge of IT infrastructure and hardware.
Working knowledge of British / American Standards

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Grwoth Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Role & responsibilities
Substation & Grid Management: Direct the O&M of the site's outdoor switchyard, power transformers, Vacuum Circuit Breakers (VCBs), and lightning arrestors. Coordinate with local electricity distribution companies to manage load scheduling, power quality, and unexpected line faults.
Heavy-Duty Rotating Equipment: Manage preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance for HT Motors (11kV) and LT Motors driving vertical turbine and centrifugal raw/clear water pumps. Oversee associated drive systems including large-scale Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs), soft starters, etc. Coordinate equipment repair or replacement such that all approved limits are maintained as per set norms. Oversees maintenance of pumps, motors, various kinds of valves and water meters. Knowledge of the methods, materials, tools, and equipment used in the operation, maintenance, inspection, repair, and installation of water treatment plants.
Intake Well Engineering: Ensure vertical shaft electricals, and moisture-resistant switchgear exposed to river-side high humidity
Switchgear & Power Quality Optimization: Supervise HT/LT panels, Main Distribution Boards, and Motor Control Centers (MCCs). Actively monitor Automatic Power Factor Correction (APFC) panels and harmonic filters to maintain power factor near unity, mitigating utility penalties. Energy Bill monitoring & certification.
Backup Power & Control Networks: Maintain absolute readiness of heavy-capacity Diesel Generators (DG sets) and industrial Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPS) feeding automated PLC/SCADA control networks. Knowledge in HMI and SCADA.
Safety & Statutory Compliance: Deploy Tata Steel UISL Safety Standard in Office & work site by preparing SWP, trainings related to SWP to own and contractors employees. Strictly implement Positive isolation systems, permit-to-work protocols, and high-voltage safety norms. Ensuring compliance to CEA Regulations with respect to O&M and Safety. Liaise with the Central/State Electricity Authority (CEA) for annual structural clearance and licensing renewals.
Preferred candidate profile

Plans, organizes, assigns, directs, and reviews the work of employees engaged in the operation and maintenance of various facilities related to municipal water supply including River Water Withdrawal & treatment system.
Develops and implements techniques and methods of process control which increase plant efficiency. Preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual reports. Ensuring the work of others contracted to work on plant. Ensuring emergency and unscheduled work to assure appropriate follow through.
Ensuring Customer engagement initiatives (Complaint Management, Customer visits, etc.). To lead a team of Engineers, Operators, Technicians / Asst. Technicians etc. To ensure implementation of goals and targets for the department/section in line with the ABP.
Person will be responsible to coordinate with both internal & external customers and to meet the demand time to time. Responsible for trouble shooting and analyzing of problems during course of job execution and site management.
Must possess working knowledge on Computers (MS Office). Knowledge of QMS and TQM principles to establish quality standards & control measures and ensure total quality management of the project.

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Patrol all areas of the property; secure rooms; assist guests with room access. Conduct emergency response drills, daily physical hazard/safety inspections, investigations, interviews, and key control audit. Monitor Closed Circuit Televisions and alarm systems. Authorize, monitor, and document access to secured areas. Assist guests/employees during emergency situations. Respond to accidents, contact EMS or administer first aid/CPR as required. Gather information and complete reports. Maintain confidentiality of reports/documents, release information to authorized individuals. Defuse disturbances in accordance with company policies and procedures. Resolve safety hazard situations. Handle all interruptions and complaints. Escort unwelcome persons from the property. Ensure compliance with alcoholic beverage control laws. Call for assistance using proper code responses. Provide proper paperwork to employees.
Assist management in training, motivating and coaching employees; serve as a role model and first point of contact of the Guarantee of Fair Treatment/Open Door Policy process. Follow all company policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests service needs; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. In addition, some states may have additional licensing/registration requirements to be considered for this position. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines (e.g., to identify defects). Enter and locate work-related information using computers and/or point of sale systems. Move at a speed required to respond to work situations (e.g., run, walk, jog). Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and objects weighing in excess of 75 pounds with assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 2 years of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: At least 1 year of supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow thebusiness and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value
(GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities

Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team ( reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).
Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition


Desired Skills

Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

SUMMARY
Summary
We are seeking dynamic, results-oriented Sales & Application Engineers to join our team, offering an exciting career path for Diploma and Engineering graduates. This pivotal role combines technical expertise with business development to drive revenue growth and foster strong client partnerships. The successful candidate will be responsible for achieving territory-specific sales targets, identifying new market opportunities, and delivering tailored technical solutions that meet customer needs while maintaining a deep understanding of market trends and competitor activities.

Responsibilities
Achieve assigned sales targets specific to the designated territory.
Identify and cultivate new business relationships with customers, OEMs, and industrial accounts.
Generate business opportunities through strategic market visits and proactive lead generation.
Conduct regular on-site customer visits and facilitate detailed technical discussions.
Promote product offerings and provide appropriate technical solutions to client challenges.
Manage the sales cycle from generating enquiries to following up on quotations and converting opportunities into confirmed orders.
Maintain robust customer relationships to encourage repeat business and long-term loyalty.
Monitor market trends, track competitor activities, and identify emerging business opportunities.
Accurately maintain CRM records and sales reports to ensure data integrity.



Requirements
A Diploma or Engineering degree in a relevant technical field.
Strong passion for technical sales, business development, and customer relationship management.
Proven ability to build and maintain effective relationships with diverse clients.
Excellent communication and presentation skills for technical and commercial discussions.
Capability to analyze market trends and competitor actions to drive strategic growth.
Proficiency with CRM tools and sales documentation management.
Willingness to travel and work across assigned locations, including Sambalpur, Cuttack, Kolkata, Jamshedpur, and Bhilai.
Educational Qualification
B.E./B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering or a related discipline.

Experience
Freshers are welcome.
1 3 years of relevant experience in field sales, industrial sales, technical sales or business development preferred.


Benefits
Salary Structure
Freshers:
15,000 20,000 per month.
Experienced Candidates (1 3 Years):
25,000 40,000 per month, depending on current salary and relevant experience.

Travel Allowance:
Fixed travel allowance of 8,000 per month for local travel within an approximate 40 km radius.
Travel beyond this radius may be reimbursed subject to Reporting Manager approval.
For senior-level employees, customer visit expenses will be reviewed internally on a case-by-case basis.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
1. CSR Strategy & Program Design
Lead the formulation of CSR strategies with a primary focus on public health and community well-being.
Drive evidence-based planning through field assessments using PRA, FGDs, baseline surveys, and stakeholder consultations.
Develop Detailed Project Reports (DPRs) for health and rural development initiatives.
Collaborate with senior leadership to align CSR strategy with organizational priorities and SDGs.
Provide actionable recommendations to enhance impact, scalability, and sustainability.
2. Public Health Program Development & Implementation
Conceptualize and implement public health interventions (e.g., nutrition, maternal & child health, communicable diseases, sanitation, health system strengthening).
Ensure end-to-end project lifecycle managementplanning, execution, monitoring, and closure.
Set and track project KPIs, ensuring timely delivery and high-quality outcomes.
Integrate convergence with government health programs (NHM, ICDS, etc.) where applicable.
3. Administrative & Operational Leadership
Oversee program administration, including budgeting, vendor management, compliance, and documentation.
Ensure adherence to CSR regulations, audit requirements, and internal governance standards.
Manage implementation partners (NGOs/agencies) and ensure performance accountability.
Manage direct reporting team and strengthen internal processes for efficient program execution and reporting.
4. CSR Communication & Reporting
Develop structured communication strategies for CSR and employee volunteering initiatives.
Prepare high-quality internal and external reports, impact assessments, and case studies.
Support leadership communication through presentations, dashboards, and annual CSR disclosures.
5. Stakeholder Engagement & Partnerships
Build and manage partnerships with government bodies, Tata Group entities, NGOs, CSR implementing agencies, and community institutions.
Act as a key interface with district/state administration, PRI institutions, and development partners.
Facilitate CSR audits, reviews, and third-party evaluations.
6. Digitization, MIS & Data-Driven Monitoring
Drive adoption of digital tools and MIS platforms for real-time project monitoring and reporting.
Design dashboards for data visualization, decision-making, and impact tracking.
Ensure data integrity, transparency, and usage compliance across stakeholders.
Apply scientific and TQM methodologies to improve program efficiency and outcomes

Preferred candidate profile
5to11 years of experience in CSR / development sector
Strong experience in public health program design and implementation
Prior experience with NGOs, CSR implementing agencies, or government health programs preferred
Demonstrated exposure to program administration and team/partner management

Account & Partner Relationship Management

Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.

Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Job Description (JD)
Consultant / Assistant Manager Internal Audit
Location: Mumbai, Kolkata, Hyderabad, Chennai & Bangalore
Function: Governance, Risk and Compliance Services (GRCS) Department: Risk Consulting
Role Overview
Consultant / Assistant Manager Internal Audit will be responsible for managing and executing internal audit, risk consulting and process improvement engagements across multiple industries. The role involves leading project teams, managing client relationships, ensuring quality deliverables, supporting business development activities and contributing to the growth of the GRCS practice
Key Responsibilities
A. Internal Audit & Risk Advisory
Lead risk-based internal audits, process audits and risk consulting engagements.
Conduct Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) and risk assessments.
Evaluate business processes, identify operational risks and assess internal controls.
Perform SOX 404, Internal Financial Controls (IFC) and regulatory compliance reviews.
Identify control gaps and recommend process improvements and risk mitigation measures.
Execute control self-assessments, revenue assurance and continuous monitoring activities.
B. Project Management & Execution
Manage multiple internal audit and risk consulting projects simultaneously.
Lead project teams and oversee project planning, execution and delivery.
Ensure project quality, profitability and adherence to timelines and budgets.
Report project progress and key risks to the Director / Partner.
Act as the primary client contact throughout project execution.
C. Client & Stakeholder Management
Manage client relationships and understand business requirements.
Conduct stakeholder discussions and management presentations.
Communicate audit findings, control gaps and recommendations.
Support clients in implementing corrective actions and process improvements.
D. Team Management & Leadership
Supervise, coach and mentor junior team members.
Review team deliverables and ensure quality standards.
Conduct training and support team capability development.
Manage team performance and promote effective collaboration.
E. Business Development & Practice Growth
Identify business opportunities and contribute to lead generation and deal closure.
Support proposals, pre-sales activities and RFP responses.
Identify cross-selling opportunities across KPMG service lines.
Contribute to revenue growth and client relationship development.
F. Thought Leadership
Contribute to developing new solutions and service offerings.
Participate in knowledge management and practice development initiatives.
Stay updated on industry trends, regulatory developments and emerging risks.
3. Key Service Offerings
Risk-Based Internal Audit
Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) and Risk Assessment
Business Process Consulting
SOX 404 and Internal Financial Controls (IFC)
Regulatory and Contractual Compliance
Corporate Governance Advisory
Revenue Assurance and Control Self-Assessment
Continuous Auditing / Monitoring
Accounting Manuals Development
Capital Projects Audits
Project-Focused Control Assessment
Setting Up Internal Audit Functions
4. Educational Qualifications
- MBA / Chartered Accountant (CA)
Preferred Certifications:
CIA Certified Internal Auditor
CISA Certified Information Systems Auditor
CPA Certified Public Accountant
CMA Certified Management Accountant
ACCA Association of Chartered Certified Accountants

Job Description HR Operations Executive
Company: Vishang Services Pvt Ltd
Job Title: HR Operations Executive
Department: Human Resources
Location: Bangalore
Experience: 2 to 5 Years
About the Company
Vishang Services Pvt Ltd is a leading staffing and workforce management company providing recruitment, payroll, compliance, and manpower solutions across industries including Engineering, Construction, Manufacturing, Infrastructure, and corporate sectors.
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented HR Operations Executive to manage daily HR operational activities, employee lifecycle management, attendance tracking, payroll coordination, HR documentation, and employee support functions. The candidate should possess strong organizational skills and knowledge of HR operations processes.

Key Responsibilities
Handle end-to-end employee onboarding and joining formalities
Maintain employee records, personal files, and HR documentation
Manage attendance, leave management, and payroll input coordination
Coordinate employee background verification and document collection
Support statutory compliance documentation and audit requirements
Process employee confirmation, transfers, promotions, and exit formalities
Generate HR MIS reports and maintain employee database accuracy
Update employee details in HRMS/ERP systems
Address employee queries related to attendance, payroll, and HR policies
Coordinate with recruitment and operations teams for manpower onboarding
Assist in employee engagement and internal HR communication activities
Ensure smooth implementation of HR operational processes and policies
To create dashboard and reports.

Required Skills
Strong knowledge of HR operations and employee lifecycle management
Experience in attendance management and payroll coordination
Good communication and interpersonal skills
Proficiency in MS Excel, HRMS, and MIS reporting
Strong documentation and organizational skills
Ability to handle multiple tasks and meet deadlines

Qualification
B. Com, MBA/PGDM in HR or Any Graduate with relevant HR Operations experience
AboutCompany: Vishang Services Pvt. Ltd. is one of India's leading workforce management and manpower solutions providers, specializing in Blue-Collar, Grey-Collar and White-Collar staffing across infrastructure, construction, EPC, manufacturing and industrial sectors. With a strong pan-India presence and 10,000+ manpower deployments, we provide end-to-end recruitment, bulk manpower mobilization, staffing, payroll, Managed Services and workforce management solutions. Our extensive sourcing network and dedicated teams enable us to deliver reliable, scalable and cost-effective workforce solutions to leading organizations across India.

Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. EDC Retail  is one of Paytm‘s business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.

3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset

About Swiggy: 
Swiggy is Indias leading on-demand delivery platform with a tech-first approach to logistics and a solution-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500+ cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation. Built on the back of robust ML technology and fuelled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India. From starting out as a hyperlocal food delivery service in 2014, to becoming India’s leading on-demand convenience platform today, our capabilities result not only in lightning-fast delivery for customers, but also in a productive and fulfilling experience for our employees.
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city.
You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants - learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement.
This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success.
You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
-Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
-Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
-Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy’s products as solutions, not features
-Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
-Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
-Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
-Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
-Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
-80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month
What We're Looking For
Experience & Background:
-0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
-Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
-Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
-Comfort with data, especially Excel—you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
-Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Job Summary
The role will be responsible to drive sales and customer acquisition for home loan and mortgage products, and contribute to the organizations revenue growth through direct sourcing and strategic networking. Excellent interpersonal skills
Customer handling and relationship-building abilities - Result-oriented and self-motivated
Strong negotiation and influencing skills
Qualifications
Minimum: Graduate in any discipline (Bachelors degree required)
Having a two-wheeler will be an added advantage

;

Correct the operational errors and get 100% cases repayment in Non-PDC mode. 19. Collect fresh data from open marketing activities for tele calling and self sourcing.20. Follow leads so generated from data received from telemarketing team 21. Complete documentation, file agreements, formats and other formalities for disbursement of cases 22. Clear queries from credit, Ops, Legal, Valuation etc. 23. Timely submit daily MIS and sourcing data to reporting authority

Description:
Job Purpose
The role will be responsible to drive sales and customer acquisition for home loan and mortgage products, and contribute to the organizations revenue growth through direct sourcing and strategic networking. This role involves generating leads, managing customer relationships, conducting field visits, and ensuring end-to-end loan processing with a focus on delivering a seamless customer experience.
Key Responsibilities:
Go on field visits to meet customers and explain loan products
Work to achieve sales targets and help grow the companys business
Build good relationships with customers by meeting them regularly and following up for more business
Meet new customers and ask happy customers to refer others who may need a home loan - Coordinate with credit team for smooth processing and disbursal of loans
Maintain credit quality
Onboard new channel partners
Find and add new housing projects (APFs) and agents to bring in more loan applications.
Required Qualifications and Skills
1-5 years of experience in Home Loan or Mortgage Sales within the BFSI/NBFC sector
Prior experience in direct customer acquisition and channel sales preferred; Freshers with strong sales aptitude may also be considered
Strong local market knowledge and established network in the region
Excellent interpersonal skills
Customer handling and relationship-building abilities - Result-oriented and self-motivated
Strong negotiation and influencing skills
Educational Qualifications:
Minimum: Graduate in any discipline (Bachelors degree required)
Having a two-wheeler will be an added advantage

Description:
About the role
We are looking for a Senior Manager to lead strategic engagements with government and ecosystem stakeholders across education, skilling, vocational education and others. The role will involve working closely with senior government officials to understand priorities, identify system-level opportunities, design and drive high-impact interventions, and translate evidence into actionable policy and program decisions.

The ideal candidate will bring a strong understanding of government systems, excellent stakeholder management skills, strategic problem-solving capabilities, and a strong bias for execution. They should be comfortable operating at the intersection of government, technology, data and social impact, and be able to move seamlessly between strategic discussions with senior bureaucrats and ground-level implementation.

Key Responsibilities
1. Government engagement & strategic partnerships
Build and manage trusted relationships with senior government officials across education, skilling, and other adjacent domains.
Engage with senior bureaucrats and department leadership to understand priorities, decision cycles, institutional constraints and emerging opportunities.
Represent the organisation in strategic discussions with state and central government departments, Sector Skill Councils, industry bodies, employers and other ecosystem stakeholders.
Act as a strategic thought partner to government stakeholders, bringing evidence, insights and practical recommendations to support policy and program decisions.
Identify opportunities to align organisational interventions with government priorities, schemes, budgets and existing institutional structures.
2. Strategy, policy & program design
Lead the design and execution of large-scale education and skilling programs in partnership with government, private sector and philanthropy.
Analyse government policies, schemes, budgets and implementation frameworks to identify opportunities for convergence, optimisation and system-level innovation.
Develop strategies and program models that address challenges across education, skilling, employability, placement and workforce outcomes.
Drive evidence-backed policy advocacy and support government stakeholders in translating insights into actionable reforms.
Work with leadership to develop proposals, partnership models and new program opportunities across states, central government and thematic areas.
3. Data, research & evidence
Translate large and complex datasets into actionable insights for government decision-makers and organisational leadership.
Develop analytical frameworks, policy briefs, dashboards, visual reports and presentations that enable real-time decision-making.
Lead research and ecosystem assessments to understand implementation bottlenecks, user needs and opportunities for reform.
Build evidence bases around outcomes such as learning, skilling, employability, placement, wages and workforce participation.
Use data and field evidence to identify course corrections and strengthen program design and implementation.
4. Program execution & impact
Own delivery of complex, multi-stakeholder programs from strategy and design through implementation and scale-up.
Work closely with internal teams across product, technology, analytics, training and program delivery to ensure timely and integrated execution.
Monitor program milestones, risks, dependencies and impact indicators, proactively identifying and resolving bottlenecks.
Lead impact articulation through clear measurement, reporting and documentation frameworks.
Ensure that learnings from implementation are systematically captured and translated into improvements in program strategy and delivery.
5. Field engagement & implementation intelligence
Conduct regular field visits to understand implementation realities, frontline needs and stakeholder experiences.
Engage with teachers, trainers, students, administrators, employers and other actors to gather ground-level intelligence.
Bring field insights into policy discussions, program design and strategic decision-making.
Identify gaps between policy intent and implementation and develop practical recommendations to address them.
6. Communication & thought leadership
Develop compelling narratives, presentations and communication materials that connect field evidence, policy priorities and program outcomes.
Communicate complex insights clearly to senior government and internal leadership.
Publish articles, reports and thought pieces that showcase organisational learning and insights from the education and skilling ecosystem.
Represent the organisation in relevant forums, conferences and ecosystem discussions.
7. Growth & ecosystem development
Identify and shape new opportunities across state government departments and relevant thematic areas.
Build relationships with ecosystem organisations to broaden policy recommendations and enable adoption.
Work with leadership to identify potential partnerships, funding opportunities and pathways for scaling successful models.
Qualifications & Experience
8+ years of relevant professional experience in management consulting, public policy, government advisory, program management, education, skilling or other relevant domains.
MBA, Master s in Public Policy, Development Studies, Education or a related field preferred.
Demonstrated experience working with government stakeholders, with government engagement experience being essential.
Prior experience managing relationships with senior bureaucrats, ideally at the level of Principal Secretary/Secretary/Director and above in State Government.
Experience in designing or implementing large-scale, multi-stakeholder programs in partnership with government.
Strong understanding of government schemes, policies, institutional structures, decision-making processes and budgetary mechanisms.
Experience leveraging technology, digital platforms, data products or Digital Public Infrastructure for social impact is highly desirable.
Demonstrated experience in using data and evidence to influence policy or program decisions.
Experience leading teams and managing complex programs with multiple stakeholders.
What we are looking for
Strategic thinker with a strong execution bias - able to move from a high-level problem statement to concrete action.
High ownership and initiative - comfortable taking responsibility for ambiguous problems and charting a path forward.
Strong government orientation - able to build credibility and trusted relationships with senior public-sector stakeholders.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills - able to synthesise diverse information into clear recommendations.
Strong communication skills - able to communicate effectively with senior bureaucrats, frontline stakeholders and internal teams.
Collaborative leader who can work across multidisciplinary teams and bring diverse stakeholders together.
Data-driven and impact-oriented, with a demonstrated commitment to improving education, skilling and employment outcomes.
Comfortable working in fast-paced, ambiguous and evolving environments, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Why this role
This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of government, technology, data and social impact, and to contribute to reforms that can influence education and skilling outcomes at scale. The role offers significant ownership in shaping government partnerships, translating evidence into policy and program decisions, and taking high-impact interventions from strategy to implementation to scale.

Location: Itanagar,Pune,Chennai,Dehradun,Mumbai

Primary Duties and Key Responsibilities:
i. Implementation, monitoring, co-ordination and supervision of civil construction/renovation/redevelopment works of building related infrastructural system and other related jobs in office buildings and residential colonies of Bank.
ii. Identification of civil/interior repair/ maintenance works required in the office buildings/residential colonies and preparation of concept, detailed estimates, preparation of tenders/quotation document, preparation of financial estimate/BOQ as per Bank's approved/market rates for these works to receive necessary approval.
iii. Ground level monitoring and supervision of repair and maintenance work of office buildings. NABARD has its office buildings in all state capitals of the country, either owned or rented.
iv. Ground level monitoring and supervision of repair and maintenance works ongoing in staff quarters to ensure the quality standards and timely completion of works. They will have responsibility to undertake regular maintenance, repair and renovation of staff quarters located in various cities of the country, as per Bank's guidelines.
v. Repair and maintenance of Visiting Officers flats (VoFs), Single Room Accommodations (SRAs) located at various premises all over the country, as per Banks guidelines.
vi. Supervision and monitoring of Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) works such as housekeeping, electrical, plumbing, carpentry, pest control, gardening, VOF management, deadstock maintenance etc.
vii. Taking measurements of completed works related to construction/ renovation/redevelopment/repair/maintenance and ensuring the proper completion of works.
viii. Certification of bills as per onsite measurement and recommendations for payment by competent authority.
ix. Conducting visual structural audit and implementation of recommendations of detailed audit done by expert, in NABARD official and residential buildings.
x. Regular liaison with engineers and officers of state or municipal bodies for local level approvals regarding maintenance, repair, renovation or property related matters.
xi. Verification of dead stock articles provided in office and colonies to ensure that these are in good working condition. To recommend for repair, replacement etc. in case of non-functional items.xii. Ensuring quality, timely completion and compliance in all the works.
Educational Qualification:
Bachelors degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized Institute or University with minimum60% marks
Required Experience:
Minimum 03 years experience of working in residential/ office buildings/ commercial buildings projects (maintenance/construction)
Other skills and competencies:
Good knowledge of MS office, Google tools, including advanced Excel features for day-to-day operations. Experience in Zoho projects or any other project management software shall be preferred. Knowledge of relevant Engineering Software will be preferred.Excellent written & oral communication and presentation skills in English and local languageThe ability to coordinate and prepare technical and financial proposals in response to EOIs and bids will be preferred.
Age: Maximum Age as on date of application: 35 Years
Contract Period
The Junior Technical Supervisors (PBCS) would be hired on contract for a period of 11 months with further periodic extensions based on the performance and NABARD discretion.
Termination
NABCONS may terminate the contract at any time without prior notice and without providing any reason thereof. However, in normal course, NABCONS may terminate the engagement by giving one (01) month notice in advance within the contract period.

Candidates are requested to apply only ON-ONLINE through NABCONS website (www.nabcons.com). No other mode of submission of application will be accepted.

Last date for submission of online applications: 19 November 2026 (Midnight)

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced and responsible Store Executive to manage day-to-day store operations at our project sites across India. The candidate should have experience in inventory management, material handling, stock maintenance and documentation.

Key Responsibilities

Manage daily site store operations and maintain proper inventory records.
Receive, inspect and verify incoming materials against purchase orders and delivery challans.
Issue materials to site engineers and other departments based on approved material requisitions.
Maintain stock registers, inward and outward records, and material issue reports.
Monitor stock levels and coordinate with the purchase team for material replenishment.
Conduct periodic physical stock verification and reconcile discrepancies.
Ensure proper storage, identification and safety of materials.
Maintain records of tools, equipment, consumables and construction materials.
Prepare daily, weekly and monthly stock reports.
Coordinate with project managers, site engineers, vendors and the accounts department.
Ensure proper documentation of material receipts, transfers and returns.

Required Skills

2 to 3 years of experience in site store management, preferably in construction / infrastructure projects.
Knowledge of inventory management and stock maintenance.
Basic knowledge of MS Excel and computer operations.
Experience in maintaining GRN, MRN, material inward/outward registers and stock reports.
Good coordination and communication skills.
Ability to independently manage site store operations.

Candidate Requirements

Candidates must be willing to work at project locations across Pan India.
Must be flexible to relocate or travel based on project requirements.
Immediate joiners will be preferred.
Candidates with construction or infrastructure project experience will be given preference.

Interested candidates can apply with their updated resume on below mail id.

The Demi Chef de Partie reports directly to the Chef de Partie and is supported by the Sous Chef.

Description:
About us:Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.
About the team: QR & Soundbox is one of Paytm‘s business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.
About the role: The person should be capable of increasing the sale of QR & Soundbox through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.   
Expectations/ Requirements :1. Grow Distribution and Market share in the assigned area of operations.2. Visibility Accountability through Extensive QR & Sound box deployment and sale of the product.3. Identify and Recruit the sales team to align and drive business in the market. 4. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application new learned ideas and concepts. 5. Plan the market size, span and geographies for FSE. 6. Should be able to devise the best methods for communication of plans/targets to the team so as to minimize the expectations vs delivery gap. 7. Monitor the Quality parameters as suggested by the management. 8. Validate and conduct the audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team. 9. Ensure the team members are in the market where sales & usage are done regularly 10. Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area.
Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role  1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team3. Must Be a Graduate4. Growth Mindset
Why join us : We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.

Qualification:- Graduate/Post Graduate.
Compensation:-If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!
