Description:
About the Role
We are looking for an enthusiastic and target-oriented Admission Counselor to guide working professionals in choosing the right upGrad programs based on their career goals and professional experience.

Key Responsibilities
Connect with working professionals through calls and other communication channels to understand their career and learning requirements.
Counsel prospective learners about upGrads programs, courses, eligibility, and career benefits.
Follow up with leads and convert prospective learners into enrolled students.
Achieve assigned monthly admission and revenue targets.
Maintain regular follow-ups and build strong relationships with prospective learners.
Handle queries and objections related to programs, fees, eligibility, and career outcomes.
Maintain accurate lead and conversion records in the CRM.
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure a smooth admission and enrollment process.

Requirements
0-3 years of experience in Inside Sales, EdTech Sales, Admission Counseling, Telesales, or Business Development.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong convincing, negotiation, and objection-handling abilities.
Comfortable working with sales targets and performance metrics.
Ability to understand customer needs and recommend suitable learning programs.
Good follow-up and relationship-management skills.
Candidates from EdTech, Education, BFSI, Telecom, or other sales-driven industries are preferred.
Willingness to work from the Pune office.
AboutCompany:
About upGrad:
upGrad is an online education platform building the careers of tomorrow by offering the most industry-relevant programs in an immersive learning experience. Our mission is to create a new digital-first learning experience to deliver tangible career impact to individuals at scale. upGrad currently offers programs in Data Science, Machine Learning, Product Management, Digital Marketing, and Entrepreneurship, etc. upGrad is looking for people passionate about management and education to help design learning programs for working professionals to stay sharp and stay relevant and help build the careers of tomorrow.

Support the maintenance of the fixed asset register.

Help with capitalization, depreciation, and disposals.

Intercompany Transactions:

Provide supporting documentation for disclosures.

Audit Support:

Liaise with internal and external auditors.

Provide requested schedules, reconciliations, and documentation.

Compliance Reporting:

Support in preparing statutory reports and regulatory filings.

Ensure timely submission of required reports to authorities.

Variance Analysis:

Help in performing variance analysis between actuals, budgets, and forecasts.

Assist in preparing commentary and explanation for deviations.

Data Compilation & Quality Checks:

Extract financial data from ERP systems for reporting.

Perform data integrity checks before finalizing reports.

The position is for an Apprenticeship - PB Operations based out of Mumbai and reporting to the Head, Controls - Operations (NPC).

Other Operations related activities which may be assigned from time to time.

Good knowledge of Excel, Word, and Power point presentation.
Excellent communication skills.

Bachelor Degree from an accredited college or university

Training and development to help you excel in your career
Coaching and support from experts in your team
A culture of continuous learning to aid progression

Description:
SUMMARY
Job Description
Title : Field Sales Executive
Location: Bangalore
Job Type: Contract (For more than 1 year)
Industry : Paint - Chemical
Summary :
This field sales role is pivotal in driving business growth by building strong relationships with key stakeholders such as painters, contractors, builders, architects, and engineers. The ideal candidate will be responsible for consistently achieving and surpassing sales targets through proactive customer engagement, daily site visits, and active presence at assigned retail locations. By organizing regular shop meetings, maintaining accurate sales records, and leveraging a strong understanding of the market, the sales representative will play a critical role in expanding market reach and enhancing brand visibility. The position requires a self-driven, results-oriented professional with a proven ability to thrive in a dynamic, customer-focused environment.
Responsibilities :
Consistently meet and exceed assigned sales targets.
Develop and nurture long-term relationships with painters, contractors, builders, architects, engineers, and other key customers.
Conduct a minimum of two site visits per day to identify and pursue new business opportunities.
Spend at least two hours daily at the assigned store to engage customers and support sales activities.
Organize and lead weekly shop meetings with applicators to drive product adoption and team alignment.
Submit accurate and timely daily sales reports via the online portal.

Other pointers regarding this job:
Location : Bangalore (Work from Office only)
Age Criteria: 18years old to 30years old are eligible
Gender : Only males can apply
Eligibility: Freshers and candidates with 1+ year experience in field sales, channel sales, banking, or insurance sales can apply.
Qualification: Graduate or Post Graduate (any year pass - out).
Work Details: Day shift role with third-party payroll (2coms).


Requirements

Valid two-wheeler is mandatory for field operations.
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
Self - motivated, disciplined, and driven by performance targets.
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; graduation preferred.
6 months to 12 months of experience in channel sales (e.g., AP/Akzo, Laminates, Plywood, Electricals, Lubricants).
Fresh graduates or professionals from insurance or banking sectors with sales aptitude are also encouraged to apply.




Benefits
Net Take Home: 18K-22K (Negotiable)
MWA 5000/ -
Lucrative performance-driven incentives.
Absorption after 1 year on a performance basis.
Travel allowance up to 5000 per month based on profile.

Description:
Change the world. Love your job.
Texas Instruments Incorporated (TI) is a global semiconductor design and manufacturing company that develops analog ICs and embedded processors. By employing the world s brightest minds, TI creates innovations that shape the future of technology. TI is helping about 100,000 customers transform the future, today. We re committed to building a better future - from the responsible manufacturing of our semiconductors, to caring for our employees, to giving back inside our communities and developing great minds. Put your talent to work with us - change the world, love your job!
Are you looking for a career at one of the leading semiconductor companies in the world Texas Instruments (TI) is looking for a Digital Design Verification Engineer to join the team of enthusiastic engineers who develops highly complex mixed signal devices for audio applications with industry leading performance.
These audio products are truly mixed-signal devices with highly integrated digital circuits such as a DSP core for digital filters and audio signal processing blocks, hardware processing blocks, analog controllers, various serial interfaces (Audio serial interfaces, I2C, SPI) and other digital blocks like clock-generation, registers map, Interrupts etc.
This is a great opportunity to be part of an established team that s continuing to look for growth opportunities, working with worldwide leading customers and developing cutting edge solutions in the areas of consumer electronics, industrial and automotive markets.
Position : Digital Design Verification Engineer
Domain : Consumer Audio Amplifiers and Haptics
Location : Bangalore
What can you expect to learn in this role/Opportunity
To work with the best experts in the industry.
To develop capability to work effectively in a technically challenging fast-paced and rapidly changing environment.
To innovate on core technology in verification methodologies influence decisions that have wide business impact across many products teams.
To work on cutting edge industry leading products.
To learn overall product development Process and directly influence the features, differentiation quality of the product.
To learn and develop business insights, drive open discussions with business technology leaders and drive decisions impacting product technology execution.
To build strong, influential relationships with domain experts.
To develop good communication, interpersonal skills while interacting with worldwide cross functional experts.
To learn identifying risks across domains and adapt to support changing priorities.
To present analysis and conclusions to internal customers and business leaders in a comprehensive and effective manner.
To work closely with cross-domain experts other engineers and interns.
Primary Responsibilities:
Responsible to develop detailed coverage driven Verification plan working closing with System and Application team and design team.
Owning part of digital verification of the sub-system and full-chip by working closely with other verification team members, leads including outside services.
Develop/Enhance SV/UVM based testbenches and tests and simulations at all phases (RTL, GLS),
Understanding spec and coming up with testplan. Writing TB components, testcases, checkers, assertions, enhancing with randomization and coverage-feedbacks.
RTL and GLS regression and follow-up with tracking of the various activities. Run coverage and meet the defined coverage(coverage functional) goals.
Good interaction with Digital Design team, Firmware developers, Analog Designers, and rest of the team.
Excellent teamwork, adapting to situations and ability to guide, help DV members Communication of DV status, issues, and concerns.
Innovate drive new and improved design verification methodologies where needed, work with the EDA team to upgrade tools and flows.
Interacting with Test/Silicon Validation/Application Engineering team to ensure successful use of products and support customer applications debug/analysis.
Identify and write all types of coverage measures for stimulus and corner-cases.
Debug tests with design engineers to deliver functionally correct design blocks.
Close coverage measures to identify verification holes and to show progress towards tape-out.
Basic Qualifications: Bachelors/Masters Degree in EE/ECE
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor s degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering.
3 years of Digital design verification experience.
Basic Requirement:
Strong digital design fundamentals basic Electrical engineering
Experience with Verilog, System Verilog languages with UVM methodology.
Experience on randomization and coverage driven digital verification.
Experience in working with VIPs, creating TB components, agents, monitors, scoreboards and other ways to automate verification.
Hand on experience in RTL and Gate level simulations of complex ASIC at block and top level
Expert in using simulation tools (preferably Cadence, Xcelium/Ncsim).
Basic scripting knowledge using shell/python/perl.
Excellent debugging and problem-solving skill.
Excellent in Coverage driven verification with code coverage, functional coverage
Experience in Formal verification (using Jasper Gold) is good to have
Good communication, presentation skills and teamwork.

Preferred Qualifications:
Demonstrated strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Effective communication skills to interact with all stakeholders.
Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions.
Strong time management skills that enable on-time project delivery.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment.
Ability to take the initiative and drive for results.
Ability to build strong, influential relationships with cross-functional teams.
Added Advantage :
Experience in silicon debug along with design and silicon validation team.
Experience in audio signal processing and understanding of audio systems/applications.
Hands-on exp on I2C, SPI, ASI protocols.
Hand on experience on Cadence tools
Preferred Skills/ Experience
3-5 years of relevant experience

Description:
Customer Support Agent Inbound
Company: Groww
Locations: Bangalore / Jaipur / Mumbai
Experience: 0-5 Years
Salary: 2-3 LPA
Employment Type: Full-time
Working Days: 6 Days a Week
About Groww
Groww is a financial services platform focused on making financial services accessible to every Indian. It offers a multi-product investment platform that helps customers take control of their financial journey.
The company focuses on customer-centricity, transparency, simplicity, ownership, and making informed financial decisions easier for millions of Indians.
About the Role
We are looking for dynamic and customer-oriented individuals to join Groww's Customer Support Team as Customer Support Agents – Inbound.
The selected candidates will handle inbound customer calls, assist customers with queries related to the Groww platform and its financial products, provide accurate information, and ensure a smooth customer support experience.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, conversational Hindi, basic English proficiency, and a customer-first attitude.
Key Responsibilities
Handle a high volume of inbound customer calls and queries.
Assist customers with questions related to the Groww platform and its financial products.
Provide accurate information and resolve customer concerns effectively.
Offer technical support and guidance to customers using the platform.
Explain product features and functionalities in simple and understandable language.
Educate customers about available product features and possible upgrades.
Understand customer concerns, demonstrate empathy, and provide appropriate solutions.
Maintain excellent service standards and ensure customer satisfaction.
Collect customer feedback and identify recurring issues.
Coordinate with internal teams to help address customer concerns and improve the customer experience.
Required Skills
Strong conversational Hindi communication skills (mandatory).
Basic English communication skills.
Good verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
Customer support and customer-handling abilities.
Active listening and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage inbound voice calls.
Customer query resolution and relationship management.
Positive attitude and willingness to learn basic financial concepts.
Educational Qualifications
Bachelor's degree is mandatory.
B.Com and BCA graduates preferred.
BBA, BBM, BA, B.Sc and other undergraduate/postgraduate qualifications are also considered as per eligibility.
Minimum 50% marks in 10th, 12th and Graduation.
No academic backlogs.
No education gaps during studies.
Preferred Knowledge
Basic knowledge of the following financial products and concepts will be an added advantage:
Mutual Funds
Systematic Investment Plans (SIP)
Stocks and Equities
NSDL and CDSL
Prior knowledge of financial products is not mandatory. Freshers are welcome to apply.
Mandatory Eligibility Criteria
Must have completed a Bachelor's degree.
Conversational Hindi is mandatory.
Basic English proficiency is required.
No uncleared academic backlogs.
Must meet the minimum 50% academic criteria.
Must be willing to work six days a week.
Ideal Candidate
A customer-focused individual with good communication skills, a positive attitude, and the ability to understand customer concerns and provide effective solutions. Candidates should be eager to learn about financial products and deliver a seamless customer support experience.
Freshers are eligible to apply.

It offers a range of financial products and services, including mutual funds, stocks, and other investment solutions. The company focuses on customer-centricity, simplicity, transparency, and technology to help individuals make informed financial decisions.

About the role
We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven professional to lead the development of a world-class franchise model. The ideal candidate will be responsible for generating leads, managing the sales funnel, onboarding new franchisees, and ensuring both the growth and retention of franchise stores. In this role, you will play a critical part in expanding our franchise network by onboarding 50 new stores per month and driving sustainable revenue growth across the franchise portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

Franchise Acquisition & Expansion

• Strategic Acquisition Planning: Design and execute a comprehensive franchise acquisition strategy aligned with organizational growth targets.
• Pipeline Leadership: Oversee and optimize the full acquisition funnel, ensuring consistent inflow of high-quality prospects and timely conversions.
• Market Penetration: Identify high-potential markets and expansion zones, developing region-specific growth plans.
• Channel Diversification: Leverage digital, on-ground, partnerships, and referral ecosystems to expand franchise reach and strengthen lead quality.

Franchise Onboarding & Set-Up
• End-to-End Launch Ownership: Lead the onboarding and operational go-live of new franchise stores, ensuring all SOPs, processes, and compliance standards are met.
• Scale Management: Ensure successful onboarding of 50+ franchise stores per month, maintaining quality and standardization at scale.
• Capability Building: Establish robust training, enablement, and support frameworks to set new franchise partners up for long-term success.

Franchise Performance, Retention & Revenue Growth
• Portfolio Management: Oversee performance of the entire franchise portfolio, using data-driven insights to enhance store productivity and profitability.
• Retention & Engagement: Develop franchise retention programs, strengthen partner relationships, and proactively resolve operational challenges.
• Business Growth Initiatives: Drive revenue optimization initiatives, implement performance-improvement plans, and roll out business interventions to support consistent growth.
• Operational Excellence: Ensure adherence to brand standards, operational guidelines, and customer experience expectations across all franchise stores.

Qualifications
• Experience: Minimum 5+ years in Business Development, Franchise Management, or Multi-Unit Operations within FMCG, retail, food, logistics, or telecom
• Skills: Strong leadership, stakeholder management, strategic planning, communication, negotiation, and analytical capabilities.

Role & responsibilities
Operation & Maintenance:
1. Responsible for the operation and maintenance of control and instrumentation systems in a thermal power plant.
2. Perform preventive, corrective, and breakdown maintenance of Siemens PLC systems and related automation equipment.
3. Monitor and ensure proper functioning of DCS, PLC, and other C&I systems during shift operations.
Shift Operations:
1. Manage and oversee shift operations, ensuring smooth functioning of C&I systems and coordinating with other departments (electrical, mechanical, and operations teams).
2. Act as a point of contact during shifts for any technical issues related to instrumentation and control systems.
PLC & Automation:
1. Experience with Siemens PLC programming, modification, and system integration.
2. Analyze and optimize control loops, implementing changes and improvements to enhance plant performance and efficiency.
Commissioning:
1. Plan, execute, and document commissioning activities for new C&I equipment and systems, ensuring proper functionality in line with project specifications.
2. Collaborate with contractors and vendors during the installation and commissioning phases.
Field Instruments & Actuators:
1. Expertise in the installation, calibration, testing, and commissioning of field instruments including temperature, pressure, flow, and level transmitters.
2. Lead the commissioning and troubleshooting of electrical and pneumatic actuators used in valve operations and other control systems.
3. Diagnose and rectify faults in field instrumentation, ensuring minimum downtime.
Documentation & Reporting:
1. Maintain accurate logs of shift activities, maintenance work, and equipment performance.
2. Prepare reports on system health, incidents, and corrective actions taken.

Preferred candidate profile
Should have minimum 10 years of experience in thermal power plant (C&I department).

Description:
Job Title: Intern
Department: Operations
About Business line/Function: The Operations team includes different business units such as Securities Services, Wealth Management, Global Banking Operations, Markets Operations (back office & middle office) and Client engagement & Financial Securities.
These business units provides services to global clients across Asia, Europe & US region offering a wide range of services, which include custody operations, fund accounting, middle-office operations, static data management, trade clearing and settlement operations, securities lending, corporate action, Tax Operations, AML / KYC and other transversal services.
Position Purpose: The purpose of the roles is to provide service to Clients and their Portfolios related activities pertaining to different markets across the globe. 
The incumbent will be managing the daily operations/workflow within the business group and helps the Leads in achieving the process deliverables. 
Responsibilities
Processing of transactions within the agreed timelines
Ensure all the transactions are completed and approved in the system within the TAT /SLA
Ensure all the transactions are processed with at most care without errors/mistakes.
Prioritize the work and conduct investigation with due diligence on all the discrepancies.
Taking corrective measures/action in consultation with the Leads
Escalate unresolved open items to the Leads
Maintain Communication Channels with internal peer groups.
Participate in Cross Training and ensure the Knowledge transfer between the team and processes is happening on periodic basis.
Participate in Brainstorming Sessions and share the best practices and ideas with the peer groups and team members.
Consistently evaluate and update documented procedures to ensure they are complete, accurate and current
The position interfaces with other Process Associates, Mid Office Staff, Relationship Managers and Clients
The position interfaces with International Team Members of BNP Group and its Clients or Vendors or Sub-Custodians
Compliance and Risk Management: Ensure adherence to compliance and risk management policies and procedures. Identify and report any potential risks or compliance issues.
Quality Assurance: Conduct regular self-checks to ensure that all processes and transactions meet the required standards and guidelines.
Technical & Behavioral Competencies
The candidate should be able to read, write and speak in French language
Strong analytical skills, detail orientation, service commitment, solid organizational and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work in shifts as required.
Specific Qualifications:
Graduation in any discipline
DELF B1 and above certification in French language
Location: Mumbai/ Chennai/ Bangalore
About BNP Paribas Group:
BNP Paribas is the European Unions leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Groups commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
About BNP Paribas India Solutions:
Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.

Description:
Oracle Payroll Technical Analyst
Location- Bangalore/ Hyderabad/Chennai/Pune
Exp- 8+ Yrs
Mandatory Skills- Oracle Payroll, E-Business Suite (EBS), SQL and PL/SQL, Oracle Fast Formualas
Role Summary
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Payroll Technical Analyst to support, maintain and enhance Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) Payroll within a complex, multi-country payroll environment.
Working as part of a specialist team of analysts and developers, this role combines deep Oracle Payroll functional knowledge with strong technical expertise to deliver payroll system enhancements, support legislative compliance, maintain platform stability and ensure the successful delivery of business-critical change.
The successful candidate will possess advanced technical skills in SQL, PL/SQL, Oracle Fast Formula, Oracle E-Business Suite architecture, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), integrations and application lifecycle management. They will also have practical and demonstrable experience supporting payroll operations across multiple jurisdictions, translating country-specific legislative and regulatory requirements into compliant system configurations, calculations, controls and technical solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Oracle Payroll Support & Administration
Support, maintain and enhance Oracle EBS Payroll and associated HRMS modules.
Investigate and resolve complex payroll, application and integration issues.
Ensure system reliability, availability, performance and security.
Support payroll operations across multiple countries, ensuring compliance with local payroll legislation, statutory requirements, regulatory controls and reporting obligations.
Provide technical and functional expertise in payroll processing, balancing, reconciliation and issue resolution.
Monitor system health and proactively identify opportunities for improvement and risk reduction.
Technical Development
Develop, maintain and support:
SQL and PL/SQL solutions
Oracle Fast Formulas
Payroll configurations
Custom developments
Interfaces and integrations
Reports and data extracts
Analyse business requirements and translate them into scalable, supportable technical solutions.
Ensure developments comply with established development standards, security requirements and best practices.
Perform root cause analysis and implement sustainable solutions to recurring issues.
Support data migration and transformation activities where required.
Solution Delivery & Change Management
Manage the end-to-end delivery lifecycle for payroll enhancements and projects.
Support requirements gathering, solution design, development, testing and deployment activities.
Ensure technical solutions are documented, supportable and aligned with business and architectural standards.
Collaborate with Payroll, HR, Finance and project teams to deliver business-critical change.
Support release management, deployment planning and environment management activities.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and system optimisation opportunities.
Architecture & Technical Support
Maintain a strong understanding of Oracle EBS architecture and supporting technologies.
Support Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) environments.
Work with infrastructure teams and third-party support providers to resolve technical issues and implement system changes.
Support resilience, performance optimisation and capacity planning activities.
Contribute to technical roadmaps and platform improvement initiatives.
Maintain awareness of Oracle product strategy, security recommendations and industry best practices.
Upgrades, Patching & Release Management
Support the planning and execution of:
Oracle application upgrades
Security patching
Legislative updates
Environment refreshes
Release deployments
Participate in testing, validation and deployment activities.
Conduct impact assessments, support regression testing activities and deployment planning.
Ensure upgrades and patches are implemented in accordance with governance and operational requirements.
Assess Oracle legislative updates and country-specific regulatory changes and determine their impact on payroll configurations, calculations, interfaces and reporting.
Coordinate testing and implementation activities with Payroll and relevant subject matter experts.
Stakeholder Engagement
Communicate complex technical concepts and solution options clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Partner with Payroll, HR, Finance, Tax, Legal and Compliance teams to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.
Work with in-country Payroll specialists to ensure local legislative requirements are accurately reflected within Oracle Payroll.
Support business stakeholders in understanding system capabilities, risks, limitations and solution options.
Build effective relationships across all levels of the organisation.
Provide clear and practical technical recommendations to support informed business decisions.
Vendor & Partner Management
Work closely with third-party infrastructure and application support providers.
Manage supplier performance against agreed service levels and operational standards.
Collaborate with vendors to resolve incidents, implement enhancements and deliver technical improvements.
Support supplier governance processes and periodic service reviews.
Escalate risks and service concerns appropriately to ensure timely resolution.
Audit, Controls & Compliance
Support and maintain a robust controls framework across the Oracle Payroll landscape.
Ensure payroll system processes, configurations and integrations operate in accordance with internal controls, audit standards and regulatory requirements.
Partner with Internal Audit, External Audit, Security and Compliance teams to support periodic reviews and audits.
Provide system expertise and evidence for audit requests, including documentation of system controls, processes, workflows and technical configurations.
Identify and mitigate operational, security and compliance risks relating to payroll systems and processes.
Support the design and ongoing monitoring of application controls, segregation of duties and access management processes.
Ensure development, change management and release management activities comply with governance standards.
Lead or support remediation activities arising from audit findings, control assessments and compliance reviews.
Maintain accurate technical and functional documentation to support compliance, operational effectiveness and knowledge management.
Contribute to disaster recovery, business continuity and resilience testing activities.
Essential Skills & Experience
Functional Expertise
Demonstrable experience supporting Oracle E-Business Suite Payroll within multi-country environments.
Strong understanding of end-to-end payroll processes and controls.
Experience assessing, configuring, testing and implementing country-specific legislative and regulatory payroll changes.
Ability to interpret payroll legislation and statutory requirements and translate them into effective Oracle Payroll solutions.
Experience managing legislative and compliance-driven payroll requirements across multiple jurisdictions.
Strong understanding of payroll balancing, reconciliation and validation processes.
Experience supporting complex payroll operations within large corporate environments.
Technical Expertise
Advanced SQL skills.
Strong PL/SQL development experience.
Extensive Oracle Fast Formula experience.
Strong understanding of Oracle EBS architecture and underlying technologies.
Experience supporting Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
Experience with:
Integrations and interfaces
Data migration activities
Troubleshooting and root cause analysis
Batch processing and concurrent programmes
Payroll calculations and reconciliation
Security and access controls
Enterprise Command Centre (ECC)
Oracle workflow technologies
Oracle development standards and best practices
Experience managing application upgrades, patching and environment management activities.
Governance, Risk & Compliance
Understanding of IT General Controls (ITGCs), application controls and audit requirements.
Experience supporting internal and external audits.
Knowledge of segregation of duties, access governance and security controls.
Experience working within regulated and compliance-driven environments.
Ability to assess technical and operational risks and implement appropriate mitigation actions.
Understanding of change management, release governance and compliance frameworks.
Essential Skills & Experience
Functional Expertise
Demonstrable experience supporting Oracle E-Business Suite Payroll across multiple countries or jurisdictions, including the assessment, configuration, testing and implementation of country-specific legislative and regulatory changes.
Strong understanding of end-to-end payroll processes and controls.
Experience supporting large-scale, multi-country payroll environments.
Strong understanding of payroll governance, audit and compliance requirements within regulated environments.
Ability to interpret payroll legislation and statutory requirements, working with in-country payroll or specialist advisers where necessary, and translate those requirements into functional and technical Oracle Payroll solutions.
Experience managing legislative and compliance-driven payroll requirements and implementation deadlines across multiple jurisdictions.
Strong understanding of end-to-end payroll delivery processes and controls, including payroll calculations, balancing, reconciliation, validation, General Ledger, statutory reporting, audit requirements and legislative compliance across multiple jurisdictions.
Personal Skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and effectively.
Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
High attention to detail and commitment to quality.
Collaborative team player with a proactive approach.
Strong sense of ownership, accountability and customer focus.
Excellent documentation and knowledge-sharing skills.
Continuous improvement mindset focused on operational excellence and resilience.
Qualifications (Desirable)
Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Systems or a related discipline.
Oracle certifications relating to Oracle Payroll, HRMS or Oracle E-Business Suite.
Payroll qualification or equivalent payroll operations experience.
ITIL Foundation or equivalent service management certification.
Experience working within large, international or highly regulated organisations.

Description:
Company Profile
Hitachi Energy is a pioneering technology leader that is helping to increase access to affordable, reliable, sustainable, and modern energy for all. We help to power your home, keep the factories running, and our hospitals and schools open. Come as you are and prepare to get better as you learn from others. Bring your passion, bring your energy, and plug into a team that appreciates a simple truth: Diversity + Collaboration = Great Innovation.
Visit us -
Business Information:
Hitachi Energy India Development Centre (IDC) is a research and development facility with around 500 RD engineers, specialists, and experts, who focus on creating and sustaining digital solutions, new products and technology. This includes product integration, testing, cybersecurity, and certification. The India Development Centre is situated in Chennai and Bangalore.

IDC collaborates with the RD and Research centres of Hitachi Energy, which are spread across more than 15 locations throughout 12 countries.
In the past 20 years, IDC has secured more than 200 international papers and 150+ patents.
Mission Statement:
We are looking for a skilled and motivated engineer to join our team of RD Engineers.
A person interested in the field of power electronic converters and contribute towards global RD projects.
How you'll make impact:
You bring broad knowledge in the field of controls design, power electronics as an experienced control engineer for power electronics.
Development of control/Protection software in MACH control platform and MATLAB Simulink.
Documentations for control software like concept documents, test reports and other supporting documents part of development.
Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.
Your background:
Phd or Master's degree in electrical engineering with an emphasis on Power Electronics control and control system.
Industry experience with power converters, control systems design and real-time control software.
Control software design experience in MACH control platform, MATLAB/Simulink, or other control platforms.
Proficiency in the use of simulation tools such as MATLAB/Simulink, PSCAD would be an advantage.
Python programming would be an advantage.
Team spirit with the capacity to work independently, complemented by a quick intellect and well-developed analytical skills.
Experience working in an Agile development team would be an advantage.
Eagerness for learning and innovation, the readiness of mind for the use of various new tools for developments tasks but also for collaborating with the team efficiently.
You like to work in multicultural/international environment.
Proficiency in both spoken written English language is required.

Description:
The Opportunity:
The role translates applicable regulations, standards, customer requirements, and internal policies into practical controls, repeatable methods, engineering guidance, and auditable evidence. It supports product teams through out the lifecycle-from applicability and risk assessment through secure development, conformity assessment, release, vulnerability handling, and post-market compliance. Coordinating pilot runs on new products or processes. The role provides end-to-end cybersecurity architecture ownership across controllers, embedded devices, industrial networks, HMI/SCADA, engineering workstations, and remote service interfaces, extending to edge platforms, cloud services, applications, and data flows connected to these systems. The architect translates operational risks, customer needs, and applicable security requirements into practical architectures and reusable controls, balancing protection with safety, availability, deterministic performance, maintainability, and long industrial lifecycles. This is an engineering architecture role working closely with product development, system engineering, service, and cybersecurity governance teams.

How you'll make an impact:
Act as the technical authority for cybersecurity architecture of industrial control systems and their connected digital solutions, owning architecture direction and driving implementation alignment.
Partner with control, embedded, software, network, digital platform, service, product security, and enterprise IT teams to align security responsibilities, roadmaps, and engineering execution.
Mentor engineering teams, establish reusable security practices, engage customers and suppliers on architectural topics, and communicate security trade-offs and investment priorities to technical and business stakeholders.

Your Background:
Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Electrical Engineering, Control Systems, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
Strong grounding in industrial automation, systems and network architecture, cybersecurity engineering, and secure product development. Relevant industrial cybersecurity or security architecture certifications are an advantage.
15+ years of relevant experience across industrial control systems, protection and automation, embedded products, or critical infrastructure, including substantial responsibility for cybersecurity engineering and architecture.
Proven experience defining and delivering security architectures for industrial products or OT system solutions, from risk assessment and requirements through verified implementation and deployment.
Practical experience securing industrial networks, remote access, and interfaces between OT and connected digital, edge, or cloud systems, including brownfield and lifecycle constraints.
Experience leading cross-functional architecture decisions, working with product and system engineering teams, and engaging customers, suppliers, and cybersecurity stakeholders in global organizations.
Threat modeling, industrial cyber risk assessment, attack-surface analysis, security requirements engineering, and risk-based selection of architectural controls.
Practical application of the IEC 62443 series to secure development, component and system requirements, and system security design; familiarity with other relevant industrial security frameworks
Secure development lifecycles, software supply-chain assurance, SBOMs, vulnerability management, security verification, signed releases, and industrial patch and update strategies.
OT asset visibility, security logging and monitoring, incident response interfaces, backup and recovery, and operational resilience for long-lived industrial installations.
Security architecture for OT-connected edge platforms, APIs, messaging, containers, hybrid and cloud services, and industrial data platforms, with clear isolation of control-system trust boundaries.
Ability to produce clear architecture models, data-flow and trust-boundary diagrams, security specifications, and assurance evidence. Experience in power systems or energy-sector automation is an advantage.
More about us:
Hitachi Energy is a pioneering technology leader that is helping to increase access to affordable, reliable, sustainable, and modern energy for all. We help to power your home, keep the factories running, and our hospitals and schools open. Come as you are and prepare to get better as you learn from others. Bring your passion, bring your energy, and plug into a team that appreciates a simple truth: Diversity + Collaboration = Great Innovation.
Hitachi Energy India Development Centre (IDC) is a research and development facility with around 500 RD engineers, specialists, and experts, who focus on creating and sustaining digital solutions, new products and technology. This includes product integration, testing, cybersecurity, and certification. The India Development Centre is situated in Chennai and Bangalore.

IDC collaborates with the RD and Research centres of Hitachi Energy, which are spread across more than 15 locations throughout 12 countries.
In the past 20 years, IDC has secured more than 200 international papers and 150+ patents.

1. About Jaro Education
Jaro Education is India's most trusted online higher education company and a pioneer in the executive
and online education industry. Founded in 2009 by Dr. Sanjay Salunkhe, the company has been self-
funded and protable since inception. Jaro Education has been honored with the EdTech Leadership
Award and recognized as a National Best Employer by the World HRD Congress.

professionals. The organization nurtures entrepreneurs and working executives across entry-level to C-

Company Mission: To make high-quality, outcome-oriented executive education accessible to every
student and professional at all stages of their career.
2. Role Overview & Snapshot
The Career Development Ocer (CDO) / Inside Sales Specialist plays a critical role in driving
business growth by engaging with working executives, assessing their career goals, and counseling them
on higher education options. This is an end-to-end sales and counseling role that combines lead
generation, relationship building, and consultative program matching.
Designation
Career Development Ocer (CDO) / Inside Sales Specialist
Admissions & Executive Education Sales
Department
Target Audience
Working Days
Working Professionals, Corporate Executives & Freshers
Monday to Saturday (Sunday Weekly-O)

requirements)

Mon Fri: Business Formals | Saturday: Smart Casuals
Primary CRM Tool
LeadSquared
3. Key Responsibilities & Performance Expectations
High-Volume Lead Outreach & Prospecting
¢ Connect daily with a minimum of 80 working professionals sourced from the LeadSquared CRM
database to build a healthy sales pipeline.
¢ Initiate conversations using cold-calling and warm lead nurture strategies, establishing rapid rapport
with high-potential prospects.
Consultative Counseling & Needs Analysis
¢ Analyze candidate professional backgrounds, current skills, domain expertise, and future career
aspirations.
¢ Identify skill gaps and recommend optimal executive programs, degree courses, diplomas, or
certications from Jaros university partners.
¢ Conduct structured telephonic, virtual, or in-person counseling sessions detailing curriculum
highlights, faculty credentials, learning methodologies, and career outcomes.

End-to-End Sales Execution & Enrolment
¢ Guide prospects through the complete sales funnelfrom cold calling to lead nurturing, objection
handling, fee negotiation, and nal enrolment closures.
¢ Maintain consistent, personalized follow-up schedules with high-intent leads to maximize conversion
rates.
¢ Meet or exceed assigned daily activity deliverables, weekly conversion targets, and monthly revenue
metrics.
Operations & Data Management
¢ Maintain accurate, real-time records of lead statuses, meeting notes, follow-up dates, and payment
stages in LeadSquared.
¢ Coordinate closely with internal Admissions, Student Support, and Operations teams to ensure a
seamless onboarding experience for enrolled learners.
¢ Stay up-to-date with evolving EdTech trends, institutional accreditation updates, and competitor
oerings.
4. Candidate Prole & Prerequisites
¢ Education & Experience: Bachelors degree in any discipline. Freshers with exceptional
communication skills or candidates with prior sales/EdTech outreach experience are preferred.
¢ Communication Skills: Fluency in English with strong verbal, written, and persuasive articulation
capabilities.
¢ Sales Mindset: High competitive drive, negotiation skills, objection-handling capability, and comfort
working in target-driven environments.
¢ Interpersonal Skills: Empathy, active listening, and the ability to build immediate rapport with mid-to-
senior working professionals.
¢ Technical Savvy: Basic familiarity with Microsoft Oce (Excel, Word) and CRM applications like
LeadSquared.
5. Career Growth Pathway
¢ Structured Career Path: Opportunities to transition from CDO to Senior CDO, Team Leader,
Assistant Manager, and Business Manager based on performance and target achievements.
Page 3 of 5



Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide
Interview Preparation Kit
Please review the following instructions and preparation guidelines before attending your interview with
Jaro Education.
A. General Interview Hygiene & Rules
1. Professional Appearance: Dress in business formals (MonFri style) to demonstrate
professionalism.
2. Technical Setup: Ensure a stable high-speed internet connection, functional camera/microphone,
and a silent, distraction-free environment for virtual meetings.
3. Communication Delivery: Keep answers crisp, structured, and focused. Avoid lengthy anecdotes
or o-topic details.
4. Energy & Condence: Demonstrate high energy, enthusiasm, and articulate speech throughout
the conversation.
5. Past Employer Etiquette: Maintain a strictly positive, objective, and factual approach when
discussing previous employers. Do not speak negatively about former companies or colleagues.
B. Fundamental Concepts to Master
1. What is EdTech?
Denition: EdTech (Educational Technology) refers to the integration of technology, software, and
hardware tools into educational processes to enhance learning accessibility, engagement, and
eectiveness.
Industry Context: Explain why online higher executive education is essential todayallowing
working professionals to upskill without pausing their full-time careers.
2. What is Consultative Selling?
Denition: A sales approach focused on prioritizing the buyer's needs, challenges, and goals rather
than aggressively pushing a product.
Application at Jaro Education: As a CDO, you do not simply "sell a course." You rst identify a
professionals career bottlenecks, understand their skill gaps, and then recommend the specic
executive program that aligns with their career growth.
Page 4 of 5



Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide
C. Sample Interview Questions & Preparation Strategies
Important Note: Interview questions may change from person to person depending on individual
candidate proles and interviewer evaluation. The questions below are representative FAQ example
types to aid your preparation.
¢ "Walk me through your resume and key achievements."
Tip: Focus on your outreach metrics, target achievements, past sales/counseling experience, and
everyday responsibilities.
¢ "Why do you want to build a career in the EdTech industry?"
Tip: Highlight the rapid growth of the online education sector, your passion for career counseling, and
the impact of upskilling working professionals.
¢ "How do you handle a candidate who says the program fee is too high?"
Tip: Demonstrate consultative sellingreframe the fee as a long-term career investment, highlight the
prestige of partner institutes (e.g., IIMs, IITs, Wharton Interactive, Harvard Business Impact), and
discuss nancial exibility (EMIs, loan support).
¢ "What is your reason for leaving your current/previous role?"
Tip: Provide an honest, professional, and growth-oriented answer (e.g., seeking better exposure,
career progression, or entry into the EdTech industry).
¢ "How do you explain gaps in your career (if applicable)?"
Tip: Be transparent, condent, and concise. Explain how you utilized the gap period productively
(certications, skill-building, personal responsibilities).
D. Quick Checklist Before Joining the Interview
Researched Jaro Educations company background, leadership (Dr. Sanjay Salunkhe), vision, and
mission.

Memorized key partner institutions across categories (e.g., IIMs, IITs, IISc, XLRI, Wharton Interactive,
Harvard Business Impact).

Prepared to explain past key performance indicators (KPIs), call targets, and sales achievements.

Reviewed the core denition of Consultative Selling and EdTech.

Dressed in crisp business formal attire.

All the best for your interview!

Description:
This person will lead the design of AI-led and AI-enabled enterprise solutions from sales qualification through contract award. Partnering with Sales and clients, the role will translate business requirements into scalable solution architectures and compelling RFP/proposal responses. The position is revenue-facing, with success measured by solution quality and conversion of opportunities into signed business. The architect will guide delivery teams post-award to ensure alignment between the proposed and delivered solution. Strong enterprise application/platform expertise is essential, with the ability to identify where AI creates genuine business value and where conventional solutions are more appropriate.
Key Responsibilities:
Advisory and Thought Partnership
Serve as a principal technical consultant throughout the sales lifecycle, collaborating with stakeholders to refine business problems prior to architectural mapping.
Evaluate client infrastructure, data maturity, and operational workflows to architect pragmatic and sustainable AI implementation roadmaps.
Provide expert guidance on the functional utility and constraints of AI, distinguishing between high-value AI use cases and areas where traditional methods excel.
Enhance the organization's market presence by contributing to executive briefings, industry workshops, and thought leadership collateral regarding AI in education.
Prioritize organizational change readiness and stakeholder alignment as critical success factors, ensuring technical architectures are sequenced for successful adoption.
Pre-Sales Support and Lead Response
Act as the lead technical authority for the sales organization on all high-potential enterprise opportunities.
Provide technical qualification, comprehensive effort modeling, and conceptual solutioning for incoming qualified leads.
Lead discovery sessions and deep-dive requirement gathering with prospective enterprise clients.
Advise leadership on technical feasibility, risk profiles, and strategic differentiation to improve competitive win rates.
Proposal and RFP Development
Develop high-quality technical content for RFPs, RFI responses, and detailed Statements of Work (SOWs).
Deconstruct complex bid requirements to align organizational capabilities with client needs, identifying strategic build or partner opportunities.
Produce sophisticated AI architecture visualizations, technical narratives, and operational assumptions for client-facing submissions.
Define robust positions on data privacy, model governance, and ethical AI mitigation to satisfy rigorous procurement and security reviews.
Collaborate across legal, finance, and delivery teams to ensure technical solutions remain consistent with commercial objectives and timelines.
Optimize bid turnaround by maintaining a centralized repository of validated architectural patterns and solution templates.
Solution Design and Architecture
Contextualize requirements within specific industry domains, including EdTech, publishing, Life Sciences, BFSI, and manufacturing.
Architect modular, AI-centric enterprise solutions designed to solve business challenges within complex technical constraints.
Deploy optimized AI methodologies, ranging from RAG and LLM applications to agentic workflows and traditional ML as required.
Integrate rigorous evaluation frameworks, human-in-the-loop protocols, and safety guardrails as foundational elements of the system design.
Establish comprehensive integration frameworks, data lineage, and infrastructure requirements for end-to-end delivery.
Analyze buy-vs-build scenarios to recommend the most efficient and scalable deployment strategy.
Quantify and articulate the trade-offs between accuracy, latency, and operational costs for AI-driven approaches.
Engineer holistic enterprise ecosystems including non-functional requirements (SLAs, scalability, observability) and secure integrations with legacy systems (CRM, ERP, LMS) via robust API patterns.
Harmonize traditional and AI technologies within a unified architecture to ensure optimal system performance and reliability.
Generate standardized EA artifacts, including reference architectures and decision records, aligned with client data and cloud governance.
Formulate Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) models, encompassing licensing, capacity planning, and scaling economics for AI solutions.
Prototyping and Demonstrations
Develop high-impact proofs of concept (PoCs) and functional prototypes to demonstrate the tangible value of AI solutions.
Deliver customized technical demonstrations that speak directly to the client's unique operational context and pain points.
Iterate on architectural designs based on stakeholder feedback from prototype reviews to ensure final submission alignment.
Client Presentation and Stakeholder Engagement
Present complex architectures to C-suite leadership, procurement committees, and specialized academic governing bodies.
Champion technical strategies during bid reviews and provide evidence-based responses to technical clarifications.
Address concerns regarding AI ethics, IP protection, and data security with technical depth and industry-specific insight.
Calibrate technical communication to suit varied audiences, from business stakeholders to deep-technical and procurement specialists.
Qualifications & Experience
Experience in Solution Architecture, Technical Pre-Sales, or Solution Engineering, with strong client-facing and revenue-linked exposure.
Proven expertise architecting large-scale, mission-critical enterprise platforms, across both AI and non-AI solutions, with strong integration, API, cloud, data, security, IAM, and DevOps capabilities.
Hands-on experience delivering production-grade AI solutions, including LLMs, RAG, agentic/multi-agent workflows, prompt/context engineering, evaluation, guardrails, and human oversight.
Strong understanding of Responsible AI, privacy, IP, bias, transparency, and compliance, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, DPDP, HIPAA/GxP, security, and data residency.
Proven ability to lead technical proposals/RFPs, client-facing POCs/prototypes, multi-vendor bids, and advise senior stakeholders on AI strategy, adoption, and organizational readiness.
Experience with enterprise learning technology including LMS/LXP, SCORM, xAPI, LTI, WCAG 2.2, and Section 508; exposure to academic/institutional governance is preferred.
Excellent technical writing, presentations, stakeholder advisory, Agile/Scrum, and modern front-end/rapid AI prototyping skills, with public contributions to AI/learning technology preferred.
Bachelors degree in CS/Engineering or equivalent; cloud certification (AWS/Azure/GCP), Scrum certification, and TOGAF/Enterprise Architecture certification or equivalent experience preferred.

About the Company:
NoBroker is the world's largest no-brokerage property platform, offering end-to-end services in real estate. As India's first Prop-Tech unicorn with a billion-dollar valuation, we provide a seamless experience to future homeowners. We operate in six major cities: Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, NCR, and Chennai. About the Role: As an Area Sales Manager (ASM), you will play a crucial role in bridging demand and supply in the real estate market. You will guide, consult, and support potential homebuyers throughout their purchase journey, helping them find the right property while maximizing sales for NoBroker.

Key Responsibilities:
Engage potential customers via phone, virtual meetings, and on-site visits to explain available properties and convert them into buyers.
Attend qualified leads through virtual or in-person meetings, present tailored property options, and encourage on-site visits.
Negotiate deals between clients, ensuring a win-win agreement.
Build and maintain client relationships, ensuring satisfaction and generating referral business.
Cross-sell additional NoBroker services to offer a complete home-buying experience.
Nurture leads to build a strong sales pipeline and meet daily, weekly, and monthly targets.
Stay updated on market trends, property prices, inventory, and buyer demand.

Requirements:
Bachelors degree or equivalent qualification.
Proven track record in sales, preferably in real estate or a similar domain.
Strong communication, negotiation, and persuasion skills.
Ability to handle objections and close deals effectively.
Good local market knowledge.
Target-driven mindset with a customer-first approach.
Own a vehicle (two-wheeler/four-wheeler preferred).
Fluency in English, Hindi, and a local language.
Availability to work 6 days a week (including weekends).

Key Competencies:
Real Estate Knowledge
Communication, Questioning, and Listening Skills
Networking & Relationship Building
Problem-Solving & Negotiation
Rapport Building
Persuasion & Convincing Skills
Customer-Centric Approach

Position: LA/AC
Experience: 10+ years

Position Description: Guidewire Developers with 5+ years of working experience in Guidewire Billing Center configuration, having hands on experience on all the Billing Center functionalities. The work involves constant interaction with business to clarify the requirements, necessary configuration as per those requirements, coding, gunits, fixing defects reported. • Hands-on expertise in BillingCenter functionalities
• Experience in GUnit testing and defect resolution
• Good understanding of Guidewire architecture and data model
• Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
• Strong communication and stakeholder interaction skills
Good to have:
• Experience in Guidewire Cloud migration and implementation
• Exposure to integration and enhancement projects
• Knowledge of Insurance domain (preferred)

Job Description: Quality Engineering (QE) Lead Insurance & AI Platforms
Practice / Domain: P&C Insurance Digital Transformation & Quality Engineering
Experience Level: 10–14 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Location: Bangalore / Chennai
Role Overview
We are seeking a forward-thinking Quality Engineering (QE) Lead to architect and drive end-to-end quality assurance across large-scale Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance transformation programs and emerging generative AI initiatives.
In this high-impact delivery role, you will lead global testing teams across complex Guidewire InsuranceSuite (PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, ClaimCenter) implementations while spearheading modern test automation using Playwright and establishing robust evaluation frameworks for AI Agents and LLM-powered workflows. You will act as the technical and operational bridge between client stakeholders, onshore/offshore engineering pods, and release management teams.
Key Responsibilities
1. Core Insurance & Guidewire Quality Delivery
Lead End-to-End Guidewire Testing: Own the test strategy, planning, and execution for Guidewire InsuranceSuite (Cloud / On-Prem) across PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, and ClaimCenter, including complex rating engines, underwriting rules, forms validation, and downstream integrations.
Integration: Drive rigorous testing of REST/SOAP APIs, messaging queues, batch jobs, and third-party rating/pricing or document management integrations.
Defect Management: Manage defect triage, root-cause analysis (RCA), and critical production/UAT defect recovery to protect sprint velocity and release timelines.
2. Modern Test Automation Architecture
Scale Playwright Frameworks: Design, build, and maintain scalable, modular UI and API test automation frameworks using Playwright.
Shift-Left Integration: Embed automated regression, smoke, and contract test suites directly into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab, or Jenkins) for continuous quality feedback.
Enterprise Tooling: Leverage Guidewire-native testing frameworks or enterprise tools (e.g., Tricentis Tosca) alongside Playwright where appropriate to optimize regression coverage and execution speed.
3. AI Agent Quality Engineering
Validate Autonomous AI Agents: Define and execute testing strategies for LLM-based applications, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines, and multi-step AI Agents (e.g., claims triage agents, underwriting co-pilots, customer service bots).
AI Evaluation: Implement automated AI evaluation frameworks to measure agent tool-calling accuracy, groundedness, hallucination rates, latency, and multi-turn conversation reliability.
Red-Teaming: Conduct adversarial testing for prompt injection, PII data leakage, bias, and compliance guardrails within regulated insurance workflows.
4. Delivery Leadership & Governance
Distributed Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and scale onshore/offshore QE pods (6–12+ engineers), driving high sprint velocity, structured QA compliance, and clear accountability.
Executive Reporting: Establish actionable QE KPIs such as automation coverage, defect leakage, mean time to detect (MTTD), and AI eval pass rates and present to client and practice leadership.
Qualifications & Experience
Required Qualifications
10+ years of hands-on experience in Software Quality Assurance and Test Automation, with at least 2+ years in a QE Lead or Test Architect capacity within consulting or enterprise delivery environments.
Deep Guidewire Expertise: 4+ years of hands-on functional and automation testing experience across Guidewire PolicyCenter, ClaimCenter, or BillingCenter (Guidewire Cloud experience strongly preferred) within the P&C insurance domain.
Playwright Mastery: Proven track record of architecting and scaling end-to-end UI and API automation frameworks from scratch using Playwright with TypeScript/JavaScript or Python.
AI Agent Testing Experience: Practical experience testing generative AI applications or autonomous AI agents, including prompt evaluation, RAG retrieval validation, tool-use verification, and LLM-as-a-Judge methodologies.
API Testing: Strong proficiency in RESTful API testing (Postman, RestAssured, or Playwright API request contexts), SQL/database validation, and mocking/service virtualization.
Delivery: Demonstrated ability to manage complex multi-vendor or onshore-offshore delivery models, test estimations, and risk mitigation in Agile/SAFe environments (Jira, Xray, Zephyr, or ADO).
Preferred Qualifications
Certifications: Guidewire Certified Specialist/Ace (QA track), ISTQB Advanced Level, or Cloud certifications (AWS/Azure/GCP).
Adjacent Insurance Platforms: Experience testing modern insurance rating and pricing engines (e.g., Earnix) or enterprise low-code automation platforms (e.g., Tricentis Tosca).
Performance & Non-Functional Testing: Exposure to k6, JMeter, or Gatling for API/system load testing and LLM token-throughput benchmarking.

Job Title: Guidewire Billing Centre Configuration
Position: LA/AC
Experience: 10+ years
Category: Software Development/ Engineering
Main location: Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad
Position ID: J0926-1224
Employment Type: Full Time
Education Qualification: Bachelors degree in computer science or related field or higher with minimum 3 years of relevant experience.
Position Description: Guidewire Developers with 5+ years of working experience in Guidewire Billing Center configuration, having hands on experience on all the Billing Center functionalities. The work involves constant interaction with business to clarify the requirements, necessary configuration as per those requirements, coding, gunits, fixing defects reported. The work should be delivered in Agile methodology and involves demonstrating the work done to client every 2 weeks. Also in scope will be close coordination and collaboration with other teams that are part of this program. Experience in Cloud Migration and implementation would be added advantage.
Bachelor’s /master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field

• Guidewire development: strong Gosu, Guidewire Studio, data model/entity extensions, typelists, PCF/UI configuration, business rules, workflows, and validation.

• Technical foundation: Java/J2EE concepts, SQL and relational databases, Git/version control, debugging, gunits and CI/CD.
• Guidewire Cloud: increasingly important—Guidewire Cloud Platform, Cloud API, Insurance Suite releases, deployment/configuration practices, and cloud compatible development patterns.
• Insurance knowledge: P&C insurance fundamentals, especially policy billing, direct/agency billing, payments, refunds, write offs, delinquency, commissions, and financial reconciliation.
• Delivery experience: Agile/Scrum, requirements analysis, technical design, code reviews, defect resolution, production support, and collaboration with BAs, QA, architects, and business teams.
• Experience level: 5+ years of Guidewire/insurance platform development in BillingCenter both integration and configuration. Nice to have Cloud, IG App Integration
• Guidewire BillingCenter experience: configuration, integration, and customization of BillingCenter; understanding of billing plans, payment plans, invoices, payments, commissions, delinquency, and account/billing workflows.
Required qualifications to be successful in this role
Must Have Skills:
• Strong experience in Guidewire BillingCenter Configuration
• Hands-on expertise in BillingCenter functionalities
• Experience in GUnit testing and defect resolution
• Good understanding of Guidewire architecture and data model
• Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
• Strong communication and stakeholder interaction skills
Good to have:
• Experience in Guidewire Cloud migration and implementation
• Exposure to integration and enhancement projects
• Knowledge of Insurance domain (preferred)

Regulatory, Risk & Forensic
Our Regulatory, Risk & Forensic team supports client leaders translate multifaceted risk and an evolving regulatory environment into defensible actions that strengthen, protect, and transform organizations. Leverage advanced data, AI, and emerging technologies with deep domain and industry insights to help bring clarity from complexity and accelerate the path to value creation.
Position Summary
Level: Consultant or equivalent
As an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.
Work youll do:
Our Regulatory, Risk & Forensic Operate professionals help organizations effectively navigate business risks and opportunities—from strategic, reputation, and financial risks to operational and regulatory risks—to gain competitive advantage. We apply our experience in ongoing business operations and corporate lifecycle events to help clients become stronger and more resilient. Our market-leading teams help clients embrace complexity to accelerate performance, disrupt through innovation, and lead in their industries. 
We support clients by delivering Operate services spanning the Regulatory, Risk & Forensic portfolio. We embed continuous advantage through domain, industry, technology / Gen AI, and transformation skills to perform client business functions that manage risk and deliver value - added outcomes.
The Consultant will be responsible for completing timely and high-quality validation activities, as well as, for identifying issues, validation concerns, and observations, recommending corrective actions, presenting results of validation reviews, interfacing with business partners, and writing reports. Additionally, in this role, you will:
Plan and complete testing within required timeframes and in accordance with established processes and procedures
Applying risk analysis principles, determine the scope, including focus, objectives, and rationale
Develop testing strategies, including procedures and selection of samples, sample size, and rationale 
Prepare working papers, ensure that documentation appropriately supports the testing conclusions, and document process flows and describe major processes within the area being reviewed
Analyze the results of testing and review activities. Analyze exceptions and make recommendations to enhance internal controls
Ensure that testing is accurate, complete, and in accordance with standards and protocols. Communicate test/review results and issues/concerns to leadership, validating and recommending resolutions to issues
Effectively communicate the testing or validation process, status, and results to business and risk partners
Write and/or review reports or presentations that clearly articulate the results/conclusions of testing or validation activities
Effectively communicate with leadership and escalate validation concerns or issues as appropriate
Identifying and implementing efficiencies and process improvements
Complete assigned activities in accordance with established processes and procedures under limited supervision
Actively participate in learning & development opportunities to ensure the use of best-in-class processes and procedures
Proven client-facing experience with strong relationship-building skills
Experience in coaching and mentoring junior team members
Developing clear and concise reporting to be shared with leadership
Assist in managing change to ensure an effective risk management program
The team: 
We are experts in :
Providing FinCrime Operate solutions to optimize cost, quality, and effectiveness of FinCrime operations, including transaction monitoring, fraud investigations, Know Your Customer, screening, and controls testing, leveraging GenAI, technology platforms, and data analytics.
Comprehensive Discovery and data analysis support, preservation, collection, processing, hosting, and production using advanced technologies and GenAI.
Industrialized testing and transformation of regulatory, risk, and compliance processes, driving efficiency with automation, GenAI, and technology.
Dynamic, cost-effective risk monitoring using expert resources and technology to quickly identify elevated risks and potential noncompliance.
Qualifications
Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications: 
4 - 7 years of hands-on experience in in risk management (includes control testing, issue identification and validation, compliance, financial crimes, operational risk, internal audit, business process management)
Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications: 
Financial services knowledge: compliance, risk management, audit operations
Experience in testing procedures; evaluating policies, processes, controls; identifying compliance issues
Public accounting experience in audit or SOX advisory/consulting
Intermediate Microsoft Office skills
High responsibility, initiative, accountability
Excellent communication skills
Strong analytical skills, attention to detail
Ability to interact across organizational levels
Education: 
B. Com / BBA or similar 3 year graduate course
M.Com / MBA or similar post grad course (Tier 2/3 colleges)

Hyderabad , Bangalore, Chennai
The professionals are expected to work from Office all 5 days in a week.

Description:
Role: Consultant - Functional Production Planning and Quality Management
Skill Set: SAP PP/QM
Location: Bangalore/Kolkata
EXP: 6 To 8 Years,
Type: Contract to hire(C2H).
Skills: SAP PPQM, Functional, S4Hana, End to End Implementation, Brownfield, Greenfield Implementation.

Job Description:
About the Role
We are looking for an SAP Production Planning (PP) and Quality Management (QM) consultant with hands-on implementation experience. You will design, configure and deliver manufacturing and quality solutions for discrete and process industry clients. You will work directly with business stakeholders across the project lifecycle, from requirement gathering to go-live and hypercare, on S/4HANA transformation programs.
Key Responsibilities
Production Planning (PP)
Lead requirement workshops with production, planning and supply chain teams, and translate business needs into PP solution designs.
Configure PP master data: material master (MRP views), BOMs, work centres / resources, routings and master recipes, production versions.
Configure and deliver planning processes:
Demand management, planned independent requirements and planning strategies (MTS, MTO, ATO)
MRP Live (MD01N), MRP areas, lot sizing, safety stock and scheduling
Capacity planning and levelling
Configure execution processes: discrete manufacturing (production orders), process manufacturing (process orders, PI sheets) and/or repetitive manufacturing.
Set up order types, scheduling, availability checks, goods issue/receipt, backflush, confirmations and order settlement.
Handle batch management, batch determination and batch classification.
Support subcontracting, co-products/by-products, rework and scrap processes.
Quality Management (QM)
Lead workshops with quality and compliance teams and translate requirements into QM solution designs.
Configure QM master data: master inspection characteristics, inspection methods, catalogs, code groups, selected sets, sampling procedures and dynamic modification rules.
Configure inspection types and inspection plans for goods receipt, in-process, final, stock transfer, recurring and customer returns inspections.
Configure quality notifications (customer complaints, vendor complaints, internal problems) and follow-up actions.
Set up the full inspection lot process: results recording, defects recording, usage decision and stock postings.
Configure quality info records, vendor certificates, certificates of analysis (CoA) and quality certificates.
Support calibration inspections integrated with PM, and stability studies where applicable.
Across Both Modules
Prepare fit-gap analysis, solution design documents, functional specifications and configuration documents.
Handle integration with MM, SD, PM, FI/CO and EWM/WM.
Support data migration: define templates, cleanse and validate master data, and load via S/4HANA Migration Cockpit.
Work with technical teams on RICEFW objects: write functional specs and test enhancements, reports, interfaces, forms and workflows.
Drive SIT and UAT: write test scripts, coordinate defect resolution, and obtain business sign-off.
Prepare training material, conduct key-user and end-user training, and support cutover, go-live and hypercare.
Configure and demonstrate relevant SAP Fiori apps for planners, production supervisors and quality inspectors.

Builds and supports ArcGIS Pro–based tools, editing workflows and geoprocessing automation for electric utility network data, working closely with data, migration and business teams to make network editing efficient and reliable.

ArcGIS Pro
ArcPy

Develop add-ins, configurations and custom tools using the ArcGIS Pro SDK for .NET (C#) and to support utility network editing and QA workflows.
Configure and maintain ArcGIS Pro project templates, map views, attribute rules, contingent values, editing templates and tasks for field and office editors.
Automate repetitive data maintenance and validation through Python toolboxes, ModelBuilder and scheduled scripts.
Support Utility Network operations in ArcGIS Pro including validate topology, update subnetworks, tracing and association management, and help editors resolve dirty areas and errors.

Hands-on experience with ArcGIS Pro and the ArcGIS Pro SDK for .NET (C#, WPF/MVVM).
Strong Python and ArcPy scripting skills.
Working knowledge of geodatabase concepts: versioning (branch and traditional), domains, relationship classes, attribute rules.
Understanding of ArcGIS Utility Network or Geometric Network concepts.
Good analytical, troubleshooting and communication skills.
Preferred / Nice to Have
Experience with electric, gas or water utility data models.
Exposure to legacy GIS platforms such as GE Smallworld, Intergraph/Hexagon or ArcMap/ArcObjects.
Esri technical certification (e.g., ArcGIS Pro Associate/Professional).
Education
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Geoinformatics, Geography, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
