Description:
We are seeking an experienced Zuora Senior Manager Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) Solution Architect to lead the end-to-end solution architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise Zuora Billing, Zuora CPQ, and Zuora Revenue implementations across the complete Quote-to-Cash lifecycle. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Zuora Billing and Revenue solutions, with extensive experience in subscription management, pricing, usage-based billing, invoicing, taxation, payments, collections, revenue recognition, financial integrations, and enterprise application architecture.
As a trusted advisor to clients, the Senior Manager will lead business transformation initiatives by translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and high-performing Zuora solutions aligned with industry best practices. The role requires a strong blend of functional, technical, and consulting expertise, with the ability to engage executive stakeholders, lead cross-functional teams, and deliver large-scale digital transformation programs across diverse industries.
The successful candidate will be responsible for end-to-end solution ownership, including solutioning, enterprise architecture, business process design, fit-gap analysis, functional and technical design, Zuora configuration, customizations, integrations, data migration, development oversight, proof of concepts (POCs), testing strategy, deployment planning, user enablement, and post-go-live support. The role also requires strong leadership in project management, delivery governance, team management, quality assurance, risk management, stakeholder communication, and driving successful project milestones while ensuring delivery excellence.
Additionally, the Senior Manager will play a strategic role in practice growth by leading pre-sales engagements, solution demonstrations, estimations, client workshops, AI-enabled delivery initiatives, capability development, mentoring, reusable solution accelerators, and thought leadership. The individual will collaborate closely with client executives, business stakeholders, product teams, enterprise architects, functional consultants, and technical teams to deliver end-to-end Zuora Q2C solutions that optimize revenue operations, accelerate digital transformation, and support long-term business growth.
Years of Experience: 12 - 18 Years
Position Requirements:
Own the end-to-end solution architecture and design for enterprise Zuora Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) transformation programs across Zuora Billing, Zuora CPQ, and Zuora Revenue, including subscription management, pricing, usage-based billing, invoicing, taxation, payments, collections, revenue recognition, and financial integrations.
Lead large-scale Zuora implementation programs by overseeing project planning, solution architecture, fit-gap analysis, functional and technical design, configuration, customizations, integrations, data migration, testing, deployment, hypercare, and post-production support while ensuring successful delivery within scope, budget, and timeline.
Partner with client executives, business stakeholders, product owners, and cross-functional teams to understand business objectives, facilitate discovery workshops, define solution roadmaps, recommend industry best practices, and provide strategic guidance for enterprise Q2C transformation initiatives.
Define enterprise architecture, solution blueprints, integration strategy, and implementation roadmaps while ensuring scalable, secure, and high-performing Zuora solutions aligned with enterprise architecture standards and business objectives.
Lead the design and implementation of Zuora Billing, CPQ, and Revenue capabilities, including product catalog, subscription lifecycle management, pricing models, billing schedules, invoice generation, taxation, payment processing, collections, revenue recognition, and accounting integrations.
Design and oversee integrations between Zuora and enterprise applications such as Salesforce, SAP, Oracle ERP, NetSuite, Workday, payment gateways, tax engines (Avalara, Vertex), CRM platforms, middleware, and data warehouse solutions, leveraging Zuora APIs, Workflow, Events, and integration frameworks.
Provide technical leadership and solution governance by reviewing architecture, configurations, customizations, integrations, code quality, and delivery artifacts while ensuring adherence to best practices, security standards, and scalable design principles.
Lead business discussions with clients to discover requirements, define problem statements, facilitate solution workshops, evaluate solution alternatives, and drive executive-level architecture decisions throughout the project lifecycle.
Establish delivery governance by managing project risks, dependencies, quality assurance, issue resolution, stakeholder communication, and milestone tracking while ensuring teams follow defined delivery methodologies, documentation standards, and implementation best practices.
Mentor and lead multidisciplinary teams of solution architects, functional consultants, technical consultants, and developers by providing technical guidance, conducting design and code reviews, supporting capability development, and fostering delivery excellence.
Drive innovation and practice growth by contributing to pre-sales, solution demonstrations, estimations, proposals, AI-enabled delivery accelerators, reusable solution assets, capability building, thought leadership, and go-to-market initiatives that enhance delivery efficiency and business growth.

Job Title- Azure DevOps Engineer / SRE DevOps
Total Exp - 8 - 16 Years
Location- Pune or Kolkata
Work Mode- Hybrid

Job Description: We are looking for an experienced DevOps Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in CI/CD pipeline automation, cloud infrastructure and container orchestration.

Key Responsibilities:
Design, build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins or equivalent tools.
Manage containerization using Docker and orchestration using Kubernetes.
Automate infrastructure provisioning using Terraform (IaC).
Manage cloud infrastructure across AWS, Azure or GCP.
Work on Git-based version control and branching strategies.
Perform Linux administration and automation using Shell/Bash/Python scripting.
Implement monitoring, logging, security and troubleshooting practices.
Support production deployments, incident management and infrastructure reliability.

Mandatory Skills:
Jenkins / CI/CD
Git / GitHub / GitLab
Docker and Kubernetes
Terraform / Infrastructure as Code
Linux / Unix Administration
AWS / Azure / GCP (any one)
Shell / Bash / Python / PowerShell
Networking fundamentals (DNS, Load Balancing, SSL/TLS, Firewalls)
Monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Splunk or Datadog)

Good to Have:
Helm, Ansible, Argo CD, Flux, SonarQube
Nexus / JFrog Artifactory
AWS EKS / Azure AKS / GKE
DevSecOps, GitOps, SRE and Disaster Recovery experience

The Opportunity
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As an Tech Lead (Backend Developer) - Manager, you will play a pivotal role in transforming raw data into actionable insights, enabling informed decision-making and driving business growth. Within our Advisory practice, you will leverage advanced analytics and statistical techniques to extract insights from large datasets, helping solve complex business problems and inform strategic decisions. As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for confirming project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will take ownership of projects, confirming their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion.
Responsibilities
- Leading data science initiatives to transform raw data into actionable insights for informed decision-making
- Guiding teams in the application of advanced analytics and statistical techniques to solve complex business problems
- Developing and implementing machine learning models to enhance data-driven decision-making processes
- Collaborating with client support teams to design and develop robust data solutions that drive business growth
- Utilizing data science algorithms and troubleshooting techniques to optimize data analysis and visualization
- Mentoring team members to leverage their unique strengths and improve performance on client engagements
- Analyzing system components to identify linkages and interactions for comprehensive data solutions
- Taking ownership of projects, including planning, budgeting, execution, and completion, to meet client expectations
- Encouraging innovation and the use of technology to enhance delivery and inspire team development
- Addressing conflicts and engaging in challenging conversations with clients and stakeholders to maintain project alignment
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree from Tier 1
- At least 7 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Artificial Intelligence, Business Analytics, Computer and Data Engineering, Computer Science, Human Computer Interaction, Industrial Engineering, Information Systems/Technology, Machine Learning, Management Information Systems, Software Engineering
- Strong proficiency in Python for production-grade application or service development.
- Experience designing, implementing, and integrating REST APIs.
- Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and containerised service deployment.
Strong working knowledge of PostgreSQL, including schema design, querying, and performance tuning.
- Proficiency with Git-based collaborative development workflows.
- Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including clean code, automated testing, design patterns, and maintainability.
- Working knowledge of Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
- Experience setting technical direction, reviewing code, resolving complex issues, and mentoring engineers.

Minimum of 5 years’ working experience with Esri ArcGIS Software (Enterprise, Desktop, Server, ArcGIS Pro, Online)
Understanding of ArcGIS Enterprise Architecture- ArcGIS Server, Portal, data Store etc.

Description:
Role: GIS Performance Tester
Experience: 5-6 years
Staff Level: Senior Associate
Education: BE/BTECH or equivalent
Key responsibilities:
Define GIS performance testing strategy covering web, desktop, and servicelevel workloads (ArcGIS Server, Utility Network, Feature Services).
Identify performancecritical GIS workflows (pan/zoom, tracing, edits, large spatial queries, batch jobs).
Create realistic GIS workload models based on editor, viewer, integration, and batch processing usage patterns.
Design test scenarios for: 
Map rendering and symbology scaling
Feature service queries (attribute + spatial)
Utility Network traces and validations
Web GIS Load Test scenarios
Concurrent editing and versioned data access 
Load and Stress Simulation:Execute load, endurance, and stress tests to determine how GIS (likeArcGIS Server) perform under high user traffic, specifically testing 2D/3D map rendering and data querying.
Bottleneck Analysis: Monitor system KPIssuch as CPU utilization, memory, response times, and throughput—to identify bottlenecks related to spatial analysis or database queries.
Result Reporting: Create detailed performance analysis reports that highlight the system's performance, identifying areas for improvement or potential downtime.
Collaborate with Functional Analysts to map business flows into performance test cases.
Prior experience in GIS Testing assignments will be an advantage.
Collaboration & Optimization:Work with GIS developers and architects to suggest infrastructure changes, database tuning, or code optimizations to resolve issues.
Perform RCA on performance issues and recommend improvement opportunities.
Essential Qualifications:
Minimum of 5 years’ working experience with Esri ArcGIS Software (Enterprise, Desktop, Server, ArcGIS Pro, Online)
Understanding of ArcGIS Enterprise Architecture- ArcGIS Server, Portal, data Store etc.
Understanding of ArcGIS Pro concepts: Maps, Projects, Layout templates, Editing Templates, Tasks etc.
Understanding of Esri geoprocessing tools: model Builder
Understanding of Geodatabases: Versioning and Spatial data Types

Description:
PwC US CONSULTING SOLUTIONS - MANAGEMENT CONSULTING Our Management Consulting team works with our global clients to design and implement growth, operational and customer focused strategies for sustainable competitive advantage. Our thought leadership and unparalleled experience help clients turn formidable challenges into market advantage across the value chain and around the globe. Additionally, our extensive expertise in various industries allows us to serve clients with consulting services with a focus on the most profitable elements of the value chain to create scalable businesses that will deliver increased sustainable profits.  Our Management Consultants work with the client and project teams to support global engagements from India through activities that are driven toward delivering results - conduct analyses and develop insights, prepare excel models, analyze large sets of data, capture as-is processes, prepare work plans, design to-be processes. In addition, consultants also support project lead, work directly with client teams, and facilitate meetings to enable decision making, organize and prepare recommendations on client issues, and participate actively in new business development, thought leadership and firm building activities. PRACTICE OVERVIEW: WORKFORCE SOLUTIONS
At PwC, this team of consultants works with their US counterparts to develop both short and long-term Workforce Solutions for our clients. Our practitioners facilitate transformation by conducting strategic change initiatives, assisting transformative leadership initiatives, designing HR processes, developing, and implementing learning interventions that align with the clients business strategy. Some of our key capabilities include: 
HR Strategy & Operations 
NextGen Change  
Organization & Talent  
Rewards & Benefits 
Workforce Technology – Enabling Apps 
POSITION REQUIREMENTS: Key Responsibilities: As a Learning Design & Development practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients navigate their transformation challenges by designing and building the learning solutions that carry those transformations, owning the work from curriculum architecture through to release-ready assets. You will provide tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities, optimize HR functions, and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growthAs such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to): Engagement Delivery
Delivering learning solutions for technology driven or culture-based client transformation journey, by including (but not limiting to) the below skill sets:
Learning Strategies: 
Instructional Design (ID) or Learning Experience Design (LXD) with a strong command of adult learning principles and instructional strategies, and working fluency in recognized frameworks - ADDIE and/or SAM, Bloom’s taxonomy for objective setting, and Kirkpatrick for evaluation.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of business operations and ERP and HCM solutions like Workday, Oracle, SAP, etc.
Learning Activities:
Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to deliver Training Needs Analysis, Curriculum design, role-based learning plans and blended training solutions.
Ability to use a variety of collaboration tools available to the client to run workshops and presentations.
Ability to develop engaging scenarios, activities, and assessments for blended learning solutions.
Hands-on proficiency with industry-standard authoring and multimedia tools - Articulate Storyline and Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond, or equivalent - to build visually engaging learning assets.
Publish and troubleshoot content on an LMS or LXP, including SCORM/xAPI packaging and versioning, and build to accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 / Section 508).
Work directly with clients to support engagement delivery – spanning across phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation of training. 
Learning Effectiveness:
Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs against Kirkpatrick Levels 1–3 using a range of methods - reaction surveys, knowledge checks, and on-the-job performance measures.
Continuously improve learning programs based on feedback, industry best practices, and emerging trends.
General Requirements: 
Excellent storyboarding skills, and able to produce release-ready facilitator guides, participant materials and ILT/vILT decks to a publishable standard.
Communicate complex information effectively through engaging written and verbal formats tailored to the client's needs and audiences.
Ensure regular communication and alignment on project updates with the engagement team
Ability to work through ambiguity, flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
Ability to work flexibly across time zones as per project requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and efficient project execution.
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in learning and development.
Contribute learning scope, effort estimates and instructional methodology input to pursuits and proposals as a subject-matter expert.
Provide guidance and support to team members to reinforce learning from engagements.
Believe in the value created by diverse teams and adapt to different working styles.
Continue to develop internal relationships and your PwC brand.
What skill does it take? Must-have
An interest in upskilling for a digital world and technology trends, an openness to learning new tools and adapting how you work. 
Will to work in a fast-paced environment with sometimes unpredictable circumstances or changes, comfortable working in ambiguity. 
Self-motivated with a passion for client work and teamwork. 
Strong project management skills. 
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with stakeholders at all levels. 
Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs. 
Ability to develop and present new, innovative ideas and conceptualize new approaches and solutions. 
Will to learn, adopt and lead new ways of doing things (e.g., personas, journey mapping, gamification, etc.). 
Proficiency in leveraging GenAI tools to enhance productivity, analysis, and delivery quality. 
Ability to work with data to transform information into actionable insights. 
Foster an efficient, innovative, and team-oriented work environment.  
Strong work ethics, proactive, and professional behavior. 
Good-to-have
Effective storytelling and communication skills to various audiences (written and verbal). 
Strategic, creative thinker and problem solver. 
Analytical mindset, with the ability to use data and metrics to assess training effectiveness. 
Supports engagement managers in delivering engagements by identifying and addressing client needs. 
Exhibits strong ability to work independently as well as in a highly collaborative team environment. 
Demonstrated experience supporting client-facing consulting engagements and mentoring junior team members. 
Hands-on experience utilizing AI tools and capabilities such as prompt engineering, AI-assisted analysis, and creating workforce-specific solutions.

About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.
What You’ll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What We’re Looking For
1–5 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role. Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools

Key Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain Alteryx workflows for data preparation, transformation, and integration.
Develop and support ETL/data workflows to ingest, cleanse, validate, and enrich data from multiple sources.
Translate business requirements into technical workflow designs and reusable components/macros.
Implement data quality checks, reconciliation logic, and exception handling to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Optimize workflow performance by improving logic, reducing run time, and managing resource usage effectively.
Document workflow logic, data mappings, and operational steps to support maintainability and handovers.
Collaborate with analysts, data engineers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues and deliver enhancements.
Support production runs, monitor scheduled workflows, and resolve failures within defined timelines.

Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelors degree (or equivalent) in Engineering/Technology/Computer Applications/Science (e.g., BTech, BE, BSc, MCA, MTech, MSc).
2-5years of experience working with Alteryx to build and maintain data preparation or automation workflows.
Strong hands-on experience in ETL and data workflow development, including transformation and validation steps.
Solid understanding of data concepts such as joins, aggregations, filtering, data types, and schema handling.
Ability to analyze requirements, debug workflow issues, and deliver reliable outputs with attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.
Understanding of analytics lifecycle practices such as versioning, documentation standards, and reusable workflow design.
Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders, present findings, and recommend improvements to data processes.
Good to have skills:
SQL, Data Warehousing, Data Quality Frameworks, Power BI, Python

Description:
Field HR Associate JD
Role Summary:
The Field HR Associate will support and execute human resources activities at the ground
level across logistics sites such as warehouses, fulfillment centers, and delivery hubs. The role
involves blue-collar hiring, attendance and payroll support, engagement activities, labor
compliance tracking, and issue resolution for site-based workforce.
Key Responsibilities:
Recruitment & Onboarding
Coordinate daily/weekly hiring of warehouse associates, loaders, delivery staff, etc.
through vendors and local channels.
Manage candidate screening, document collection, and induction processes.
Maintain trackers for manpower deployment and contractor rotation.
Attendance, Payroll & HR Ops
Monitor daily attendance through biometric/manual systems.
Collate and validate attendance data for payroll input in coordination with central HR
ops.
Assist in issuing ID cards, onboarding kits, and HR documentation at the site.
Compliance & Labor Law Support
Support contract labor compliance (e.g., ESI/PF records, CLRA documentation).
Coordinate with compliance teams and vendors to ensure audit readiness at the site.
Maintain updated personnel records as per labor law norms.
Employee Engagement & Grievance Handling



Conduct engagement activities (e.g., weekly briefings, rewards, celebrations).
Act as the first point of contact for associate grievances related to wages, safety, shift
timings, etc.
Escalate unresolved issues to regional HR.
HR Reporting & Coordination
Maintain HR MIS, hiring status, attrition reports, and daily dashboards.
Coordinate between warehouse operations, vendors, and HR leadership.
Support audits, safety drills, and training rollouts.
Qualifications:
Graduate in any discipline; PG Diploma in HR preferred
13 years of experience in field HR roles (logistics, manufacturing, retail, or facility
management)
Freshers with relevant internship experience may be considered
Language: Local language fluency + basic English required
Comfortable with fieldwork and managing blue-collar workforce
Key Skills:
People-centric and proactive
Basic knowledge of labor laws and HR documentation
Strong coordination and reporting ability
Comfortable with MS Excel and attendance software



High integrity, discipline, and site ownership mindset

Key Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain Alteryx workflows for data preparation, transformation, and integration.
Develop and support ETL/data workflows to ingest, cleanse, validate, and enrich data from multiple sources.
Translate business requirements into technical workflow designs and reusable components/macros.
Implement data quality checks, reconciliation logic, and exception handling to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Optimize workflow performance by improving logic, reducing run time, and managing resource usage effectively.
Document workflow logic, data mappings, and operational steps to support maintainability and handovers.
Collaborate with analysts, data engineers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues and deliver enhancements.
Support production runs, monitor scheduled workflows, and resolve failures within defined timelines.

Bachelors degree (or equivalent) in Engineering/Technology/Computer Applications/Science (e.g., BTech, BE, BSc, MCA, MTech, MSc).

Strong hands-on experience in ETL and data workflow development, including transformation and validation steps.
Solid understanding of data concepts such as joins, aggregations, filtering, data types, and schema handling.
Ability to analyze requirements, debug workflow issues, and deliver reliable outputs with attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.
Understanding of analytics lifecycle practices such as versioning, documentation standards, and reusable workflow design.
Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders, present findings, and recommend improvements to data processes.
Good to have skills:
SQL, Data Warehousing, Data Quality Frameworks, Power BI, Python

Description:
About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.
What You’ll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What We’re Looking For
0–3 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role.
Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools
Prior experience in logistics, e-commerce, D2C, or B2B sales will be an added advantage.
Who Will Do Well in This Role?
Someone who is sharp, articulate, proactive, and comfortable speaking to customers every day—someone who enjoys sales and account management, takes ownership, learns quickly, and can turn customer conversations into meaningful business opportunities.
If you are looking to build a career in Inside Sales, Account Management & Customer Success with one of India’s leading logistics companies, we’d love to hear from you.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's leading supply chain services company.
The company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border, B2B & B2C warehousing and technology services.
Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities

Description:
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced AI/ML Engineer with 5 to 8 years of industry experience in developing, deploying, and optimizing Machine Learning and Generative AI solutions. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in machine learning algorithms, deep learning, NLP, LLMs, model deployment, and MLOps practices.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy Machine Learning and Deep Learning models for business use cases.
Build and optimize AI/ML pipelines for data processing, training, evaluation, and deployment.
Develop Generative AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs).
Fine-tune foundation models using frameworks such as Hugging Face and Lang Chain.
Implement NLP solutions including text classification, sentiment analysis, summarization, and conversational AI.
Collaborate with data engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into AI solutions.
Monitor model performance, accuracy, and drift in production environments.
Create scalable AI solutions on cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Implement MLOps best practices for model lifecycle management.
Stay current with advancements in AI, Generative AI, and Machine Learning technologies.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Python and AI/ML libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn.
Hands-on experience with TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, or similar frameworks.
Experience in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, and Generative AI.
Strong understanding of LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, Vector Databases, and AI Agents.
Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, or similar frameworks.
Knowledge of MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, or Azure ML.
Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases.
Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software engineering best practices.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, Gemini, Claude, or similar AI platforms.
Hands-on experience in AI Agent development and orchestration frameworks.
Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with Vector Databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, or FAISS.
Exposure to Computer Vision and multimodal AI solutions.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Technology, or related fields.
Nice to Have
Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102)
AWS Machine Learning Specialty
Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer
Experience working in enterprise-scale AI transformation programs.

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. The opportunity: Executive-GOV-SaT-SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory - Chandigarh
Our Global Government Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.
Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.
To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.
We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.
SaT:
The Government and public sector transactions services is part of EY's Government Public Sector (GPS) Services which is a network of highly skilled professionals from assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, devoted to serving the government and public sector organizations and institutions.
The practice combines private sector leading practice with an understanding of the public sectors diverse needs, focused on delivering improved public services. Government and public sector transactions services, sits under EY's Transaction Advisory Services practice, a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team, working with leading businesses across a range of industries. This practice is in a unique position to deliver implementable strategies given the firms sector depth, transaction perspectives, and operational insights.
The practice provides experience working with various sectors such as, Transport, Social Health care, Education, Urban Infrastructure, Economic Development Advisory , Water waste Sanitation, Power Utilities and Public Finance Management.
SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory :
Strategy and Transactions enables clients to reimagine ecosystems, reshape portfolios and reinvent for a better future. Using our Capital Agenda framework, we work with clients to find answers to todays toughest strategic, financial, operational and commercial questions. We help corporates, private equity, governments, sovereign wealth funds, private and family businesses, and educational institutions with their key financial issues. From portfolio review and capital allocation processes to financial planning analytics and decision support, we have the people, analytics and tools to better allocate capital. Our team helps clients manage their risk/return trade-offs to support them with better decision-making around financing and capital efficiency.
Whether clients are preserving, optimizing, raising or investing, our Connected Capital Solutions (CCS) are our five go-to-market offerings that help drive competitive advantage and increased returns through improved decision-making. The CCS include Strategy, Corporate Finance, Buy and Integrate, Sell and Separate and Reshaping Results, and are underpinned by our Connected Capital Technologies.
Our key focus areas are - Investment Banking Advisory, Valuations, Modeling and Economics, Transaction Diligence, Restructuring and Turnaround Services, Project Finance and infrastructure, EY Parthenon - Strategy and EY Parthenon - Execution.


Your key responsibilities
Support consulting and advisory projects through research, data collection, analysis, and documentation.
Assist in preparing reports, presentations, concept notes, proposals, and other client deliverables.
Conduct secondary research, market assessments, policy reviews, and stakeholder mapping to support project objectives.
Analyze data and synthesize findings into clear and actionable insights.
Participate in client meetings, workshops, surveys, and stakeholder consultations.
Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders to support project execution.
Assist in monitoring project timelines, deliverables, and reporting requirements.
Contribute to business development activities, including proposal preparation and knowledge management initiatives.
Stay updated on industry trends, government policies, and sector developments relevant to assigned projects.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to conduct research and interpret information from multiple sources.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
Ability to work effectively in a team environment and manage multiple tasks.
Strong learning mindset, professional attitude, and willingness to take ownership of assignments.


Qualifications
"Bachelors or Masters degree in Management, Economics, Public Policy, Engineering, Commerce, Finance, Social Sciences, or a related discipline."


Experience
0-2 years Entry Level


What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Role & responsibilities
The Circle Business Head is responsible for the overall Business operations of the Circle according to Brands operational standards and run profitable business as an SBU. Majority of time is invested leading/guiding and coaching the team to meet Guest expectations, achieving both bottom and topline objectives, in line with the principles of Brands Vision and Mission.

Key Accountabilities
Leads Operational Excellence and the Guest Experience:
Role models expected behavior and coach teams on hospitality standards
Ensures all the restaurant meets safety, sanitation and cleanliness standards as per expectations
Sets the standards to ensure team handles all Guest concerns in a timely and sustainable manner
Empowers the team to satisfy Guest needs and resolve concerns 5. Removes barriers to delivering Hospitality behaviours during shift.
Drives Sales Growth:
Takes accountability for understanding all in store marketing promotions of the circle and provides inputs for national marketing on circle digital/print and other medium of marketing elements
Executes new product rollouts
Responsible for system growth as well new store sales
Responsible and drive Bottom Line:

Constant monitoring and reviewing the same with all direct reports and prepare the GAP analysis, guide them to maintain the lines
Ensure that all restaurants in the circle maintain these lines and facilitate them to earn bottom line incentive
Builds Team Talent:
Treats all team members fairly and with respect.

Job Summary
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. The opportunity : Project Consultant-GOV-SaT-SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory - Chandigarh


GOV
Our Global Government Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.
Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.
To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.
We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.


SaT
The Government and public sector transactions services is part of EY's Government Public Sector (GPS) Services which is a network of highly skilled professionals from assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, devoted to serving the government and public sector organizations and institutions.
The practice combines private sector leading practice with an understanding of the public sectors diverse needs, focused on delivering improved public services. Government and public sector transactions services, sits under EY's Transaction Advisory Services practice, a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team, working with leading businesses across a range of industries. This practice is in a unique position to deliver implementable strategies given the firms sector depth, transaction perspectives, and operational insights.
The practice provides experience working with various sectors such as, Transport, Social Health care, Education, Urban Infrastructure, Economic Development Advisory , Water waste Sanitation, Power Utilities and Public Finance Management.


SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory
Strategy and Transactions enables clients to reimagine ecosystems, reshape portfolios and reinvent for a better future. Using our Capital Agenda framework, we work with clients to find answers to todays toughest strategic, financial, operational and commercial questions. We help corporates, private equity, governments, sovereign wealth funds, private and family businesses, and educational institutions with their key financial issues. From portfolio review and capital allocation processes to financial planning analytics and decision support, we have the people, analytics and tools to better allocate capital. Our team helps clients manage their risk/return trade-offs to support them with better decision-making around financing and capital efficiency.
Whether clients are preserving, optimizing, raising or investing, our Connected Capital Solutions (CCS) are our five go-to-market offerings that help drive competitive advantage and increased returns through improved decision-making. The CCS include Strategy, Corporate Finance, Buy and Integrate, Sell and Separate and Reshaping Results, and are underpinned by our Connected Capital Technologies.
Our key focus areas are - Investment Banking Advisory, Valuations, Modeling and Economics, Transaction Diligence, Restructuring and Turnaround Services, Project Finance and infrastructure, EY Parthenon - Strategy and EY Parthenon - Execution.


Your key responsibilities
Support consulting and advisory projects through research, data collection, analysis, and documentation.
Assist in preparing reports, presentations, concept notes, proposals, and other client deliverables.
Conduct secondary research, market assessments, policy reviews, and stakeholder mapping to support project objectives.
Analyze data and synthesize findings into clear and actionable insights.
Participate in client meetings, workshops, surveys, and stakeholder consultations.
Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders to support project execution.
Assist in monitoring project timelines, deliverables, and reporting requirements.
Contribute to business development activities, including proposal preparation and knowledge management initiatives.
Stay updated on industry trends, government policies, and sector developments relevant to assigned projects.


Skills and attributes

To qualify for the role you must have
Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science
Bachelors or Masters degree in Management, Economics, Public Policy, Engineering, Commerce, Finance, Social Sciences, or a related discipline.


Experience
0-2 years Entry Level


What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Title: FIREMAN
Role: To ensure immediate and effective response to fire and emergency situations at the client premises, assist in the prevention of fire hazards, and support the client’s overall safety and security operations through regular inspections, drills, and fire safety compliance.   Key Responsibilities: 1. Fire Prevention and Risk Mitigation Conduct routine fire safety inspections across the premises, especially high-risk areas.  Identify and report fire hazards, unsafe practices, and recommend corrective actions.  Ensure proper storage and usage of flammable materials as per safety guidelines.  Check availability, functionality, and accessibility of fire extinguishers, hydrants, hoses, sprinklers, alarms, smoke detectors, and emergency lights.  2. Fire Response and Emergency Handling Respond promptly to fire alarms and emergency calls.  Operate firefighting equipment such as fire extinguishers, hose reels, hydrants, foam, and breathing apparatus.  Evacuate personnel from affected areas and guide them to safe assembly zones.  Administer first-aid and support paramedical teams during emergencies.  Assist the firefighting team, civil authorities, and local fire brigade in containment and post-incident recovery.  3. Compliance and Documentation Maintain detailed incident logs and fire safety inspection records.  Assist in ensuring compliance with local Fire Safety Norms, NBC (National Building Code), and client-specific fire regulations.  Support internal audits and third-party fire inspections.  4. Training & Drills Conduct or participate in fire drills, evacuation exercises, and mock emergency simulations.  Educate on-site personnel on fire safety protocols and emergency procedures.  Provide demonstrations on the usage of fire safety equipment.  5. Maintenance & Housekeeping Inspect fire equipment daily and maintain logs for servicing schedules.  Ensure that escape routes, fire exits, and emergency doors are not blocked.  Liaise with facility teams for maintenance of fire panels, sprinklers, pumps, and water tanks.    Qualifications & Experience: Education: Minimum 10th Pass. Diploma or Certificate in Fire Safety or Industrial Firefighting from a recognized institute is mandatory.  Preferred Certifications:  Fireman Training from State Fire Services Civil Defence Government-recognized institutes  Basic First Aid and CPR Certification  Experience: 2–5 years in industrial, commercial, or institutional firefighting roles. Freshers with formal fireman training can also be considered.    Skills & Competencies Required: Thorough knowledge of fire detection and suppression systems.  Ability to work calmly under pressure and respond quickly in emergencies.  Physically fit, alert, and able to carry firefighting equipment.  Clear communication skills and basic understanding of HindiEnglishregional language.  Team player with a disciplined and responsible attitude.    Work Environment & Physical Requirements: Rotational shifts (daynight) including weekends and holidays.  High-risk environment requiring PPE usage.  Need to remain alert and mobile throughout the shift.  May require climbing, lifting, and operating in confined or high areas during fire events.    Employment Terms: Employer: G4S Secure Solutions India Pvt. Ltd.  Deployment: At client’s site (industrial, corporate, hospital, mall, warehouse, etc.)  Uniform & Equipment: Provided by G4S  Remuneration: As per industry standards and location norms  Contract Type: Full-Time Contractual based on client agreement    Growth Path: Fireman Senior Fireman Fire & Safety Supervisor Fire & Safety Officer Fire Safety Manager    Additional Notes: Background verification and medical fitness check are mandatory prior to deployment.  Strict adherence to G4S Code of Conduct and client site rules is expected at all times.

Description: Job Title: Fireman Department: Fire & Safety Security OperationsLocation: Client Premises (Pan-India deployment)Reporting To: Fire & Safety Officer Site In-charge Security Manager   Objective of the Role: To ensure immediate and effective response to fire and emergency situations at the client premises, assist in the prevention of fire hazards, and support the client’s overall safety and security operations through regular inspections, drills, and fire safety compliance.   Key Responsibilities: 1. Fire Prevention and Risk Mitigation Conduct routine fire safety inspections across the premises, especially high-risk areas.  Identify and report fire hazards, unsafe practices, and recommend corrective actions.  Ensure proper storage and usage of flammable materials as per safety guidelines.  Check availability, functionality, and accessibility of fire extinguishers, hydrants, hoses, sprinklers, alarms, smoke detectors, and emergency lights.  2. Fire Response and Emergency Handling Respond promptly to fire alarms and emergency calls.  Operate firefighting equipment such as fire extinguishers, hose reels, hydrants, foam, and breathing apparatus.  Evacuate personnel from affected areas and guide them to safe assembly zones.  Administer first-aid and support paramedical teams during emergencies.  Assist the firefighting team, civil authorities, and local fire brigade in containment and post-incident recovery.  3. Compliance and Documentation Maintain detailed incident logs and fire safety inspection records.  Assist in ensuring compliance with local Fire Safety Norms, NBC (National Building Code), and client-specific fire regulations.  Support internal audits and third-party fire inspections.  4. Training & Drills Conduct or participate in fire drills, evacuation exercises, and mock emergency simulations.  Educate on-site personnel on fire safety protocols and emergency procedures.  Provide demonstrations on the usage of fire safety equipment.  5. Maintenance & Housekeeping Inspect fire equipment daily and maintain logs for servicing schedules.  Ensure that escape routes, fire exits, and emergency doors are not blocked.  Liaise with facility teams for maintenance of fire panels, sprinklers, pumps, and water tanks.    Qualifications & Experience: Education: Minimum 10th Pass. Diploma or Certificate in Fire Safety or Industrial Firefighting from a recognized institute is mandatory.  Preferred Certifications:  Fireman Training from State Fire Services Civil Defence Government-recognized institutes  Basic First Aid and CPR Certification  Experience: 2–5 years in industrial, commercial, or institutional firefighting roles. Freshers with formal fireman training can also be considered.    Skills & Competencies Required: Thorough knowledge of fire detection and suppression systems.  Ability to work calmly under pressure and respond quickly in emergencies.  Physically fit, alert, and able to carry firefighting equipment.  Clear communication skills and basic understanding of HindiEnglishregional language.  Team player with a disciplined and responsible attitude.    Work Environment & Physical Requirements: Rotational shifts (daynight) including weekends and holidays.  High-risk environment requiring PPE usage.  Need to remain alert and mobile throughout the shift.  May require climbing, lifting, and operating in confined or high areas during fire events.    Employment Terms: Employer: G4S Secure Solutions India Pvt. Ltd.  Deployment: At client’s site (industrial, corporate, hospital, mall, warehouse, etc.)  Uniform & Equipment: Provided by G4S  Remuneration: As per industry standards and location norms  Contract Type: Full-Time Contractual based on client agreement    Growth Path: Fireman Senior Fireman Fire & Safety Supervisor Fire & Safety Officer Fire Safety Manager    Additional Notes: Background verification and medical fitness check are mandatory prior to deployment.  Strict adherence to G4S Code of Conduct and client site rules is expected at all times.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Job Description Associate, Network
Operations Center (NOC L1)
Department: IT Network Operations
Designation: Associate NOC L1
Experience: 02 Years
Qualification: BE/B.Tech preferred
Certification: CCNA preferred
Key Roles & Responsibilities
1. Monitor network infrastructure, including switches, routers, firewalls, wireless access
points, and ISP links, to ensure network availability.
2. Perform basic network troubleshooting using tools such as Ping, Traceroute, and
network monitoring dashboards.
3. Understand basic networking concepts, including TCP/IP, OSI Model, VLANs, DHCP,
DNS, LAN, WAN, and packet flow.
4. Identify and perform initial troubleshooting of network connectivity issues, link failures,
port errors, and basic Layer 2 problems.
5. Have a basic understanding of VLAN configuration, switch port settings, trunking, and
Spanning Tree Protocol (STP).
6. Monitor network alerts, bandwidth utilization, device availability, and performance
through network monitoring tools.
7. Create, update, and track network incidents in the ticketing system, ensuring timely
escalation and resolution within defined SLAs.
8. Coordinate with ISPs and internal IT teams for connectivity issues, outages, and service
restoration.
9. Perform initial troubleshooting of wireless connectivity issues and escalate complex
problems to the NOC L2 team.
10. Assist senior engineers in network maintenance activities, switch replacements, firmware
upgrades, and configuration changes.
11. Follow established SOPs, incident management processes, escalation matrices, and
shift handover procedures.
12. Maintain accurate incident records, troubleshooting logs, and daily network health
reports.
Required Technical Skills
Networking Fundamentals: Basic understanding of TCP/IP, OSI Model, IP addressing,
subnetting, VLANs, LAN/WAN, DNS, DHCP, and routing concepts.

VLANs, STP, and port status.
Network Monitoring: Familiarity with monitoring tools such as PRTG, SolarWinds, or
similar NMS platforms.
Incident Management: Understanding of ticket handling, incident prioritization, SLA
tracking, and escalation procedures.

handover reports.

troubleshooting preferred.
Familiarity with Cisco switches and enterprise networking environments.
Good communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
Willingness to work in 247 rotational shifts as per NOC operational requirements.

troubleshooting, incident logging, ISP coordination, and timely escalation of complex network
issues to L2/L3 teams. The role focuses on maintaining network availability, following
operational SOPs, and supporting day-to-day network operations under senior engineers'
guidance.

Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Entry level management position that focuses on successfully accomplishing the daily objectives in the kitchen. Assists in leading staff while personally assisting in all areas of the kitchen, including food production; purchasing and kitchen sanitation. Position contributes to ensuring guest and employee satisfaction while maintaining the operating budget.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Culinary Arts, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Ensuring Culinary Standards and Responsibilities are Met
- Maintains food handling and sanitation standards.
- Performs all duties of Culinary and related kitchen area employees in high demand times.
- Oversees production and preparation of culinary items.
- Ensures employees keep their work areas clean and sanitary.
- Works with Restaurant and Banquet departments to coordinate service and timing of events and meals.
- Complies with loss prevention policies and procedures.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Communicates areas in need of attention to staff and follows up to ensure follow through.
- Leads shifts while personally preparing food items and executing requests based on required specifications.
- Prepares and cooks foods of all types, either on a regular basis or for special guests or functions.
- Supervises and coordinates activities of cooks and workers engaged in food preparation.
- Checks the quality of raw and cooked food products to ensure that standards are met.
- Assists in determining how food should be presented and creates decorative food displays.
Supporting Culinary Team Activities
- Supervises daily shift operations.
- Ensures all employees have proper supplies, equipment and uniforms.
- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and financial objectives are met.
- Ensures completion of assigned duties.
- Participates in the employee performance appraisal process, giving feedback as needed.
- Handles employee questions and concerns.
- Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.
- Participates in an on-going employee recognition program.
- Conducts training when appropriate.
- Monitors employees progress towards meeting performance expectations.
Maintaining Culinary Goals
- Participates in department meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the departmental goals to produce desired results.
- Supports and assists with new menus, concepts and promotions for the Restaurant outlets and Banquets.
Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Handles guest problems and complaints seeking assistance from supervisor as necessary.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service within guidelines.
Additional Responsibilities
- Reports malfunctions in department equipment.
- Purchases appropriate supplies and manages food and supply inventories according to budget.
- Attends and participates in all pertinent meetings.

We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

The upcoming Crowne Plaza & Holiday Inn Zirakpur marks an exciting new chapter in hospitality for the region. Strategically located along the Chandigarh-Ambala Highway, the cluster hotel will bring together 335 well-appointed rooms across two renowned brands - 149 rooms at Crowne Plaza and 186 rooms at Holiday Inn, Zirakpur.
The cluster will offer a diverse range of F&B experiences, along with a swimming pool, fitness centre, spa, and extensive banqueting facilities, including approximately 1,00,000 sq. ft. of meeting and event space. With excellent connectivity to Chandigarh and key destinations across North India, it will be well-positioned to cater to business and leisure travelers, while offering versatile spaces for conferences, weddings, and social celebrations.
A little taste of your day-to-day:
Every day is different at IHG, but you ll mostly :
Oversee the Implementation of standards as detailed in the departmental standards and procedures manual
Develop and implement Promotions Calendar for F&B products in restaurant, manage customer database and utilize effectively
Ensure the departmental performance of staff is productive, d emonstrate compliance to Food Safety Management safety policies and procedures and ensure all procedures are conducted safely and within FSMS guidelines and ensure your direct reports do the same
What We need from you:
Bachelor s degree / higher education qualification in Hotel Management, culinary arts, or related field preferred.
Proven experience as a Restaurant Manager or in a similar leadership position.
Strong knowledge of restaurant operations, food and beverage service, and hospitality standards.
Excellent communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills.
Strong business acumen with an understanding of sales, revenue, and cost control
What you can expect from us:
We give our people everything they need to succeed. From a competitive salary that rewards all your hard work to a wide range of benefits designed to help you live your best work life - including a full uniform, impressive room discounts and some of the best training in the business.

Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams where we celebrate difference and encourage colleagues to bring their whole selves to work. IHG Hotels & Resorts provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability. We promote a culture of trust, support, and acceptance. Always welcoming different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

IHG gives every member of the team the room they need to belong, grow and make a difference in a collaborative environment. We know that to work well, we need to feel well - both inside and outside of work - and through our myWellbeing framework, we are committed to supporting wellbeing in your health, lifestyle, and workplace.

So, join us and you ll become part of our ever-growing global family.

About the Role:
The role will spearhead strategic revenue growth by driving enterprise customer acquisition and expansion across key verticals and geographies. The role demands deep industry insight, strong solutioning capability, and the ability to build executive relationships within large organizations. As a senior leader, you will own the go-to-market strategy, shape high-value logistics solutions for clients, and build a scalable and high-performing BD team.
Key Responsibilities:
Drive Revenue Growth: Lead and deliver aggressive revenue targets on a monthly and quarterly basis through new customer acquisition and strategic account expansion in the logistics and supply chain domain.
Enterprise Sales Ownership: Identify, engage, and convert large B2B clients particularly those with complex freight, warehousing, and distribution needs across industries such as retail, FMCG, manufacturing, and e-commerce.
Market Development: Launch and scale presence in new geographies; perform competitive intelligence, demand mapping, and localization of offerings to suit regional market dynamics.
Team Leadership: Build, mentor, and lead a high-impact BD team; establish scalable processes for lead generation, funnel management, and account growth.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Operations, Product, Pricing, and Finance to develop compelling proposals, pilot programs, and commercial models.
Performance Tracking: Own pipeline forecasting, sales performance metrics, and revenue attribution; regularly report to executive leadership on growth performance and strategic initiatives.
Client Success & Retention: Ensure seamless client onboarding, continuous engagement, and upselling of adjacent logistics services such as reverse logistics, express delivery, or value-added services.

5+ years of experience in B2B sales or business development, with a strong focus on logistics, LTL/PTL, FTL, freight forwarding, 3PL/4PL, or supply chain tech platforms.
Strong track record of closing complex enterprise deals, especially in contract logistics, transportation management, and integrated logistics solutions.
Deep understanding of supply chain processes including LTL, FTL, warehousing, distribution networks, and logistics tech platforms.
Data-driven, solution-oriented mindset with strong commercial acumen.
Ability to work in a high-growth, agile environment with rapidly evolving priorities.
Local market knowledge or regional exposure is a strong advantage.

Job Description

Are you passionate about building next-generation AI solutions? Join our team to design, develop, and deploy cutting-edge Generative AI applications that drive real business impact.

We are looking for experienced GenAI professionals with strong expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, Agent Frameworks, RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation), and MCP (Model Context Protocol).

If you are an immediate joiner and excited about shaping the future of AI, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities
Design and develop enterprise-grade Generative AI applications.
Build Agentic AI solutions using modern agent frameworks.
Develop and optimize RAG-based architectures for intelligent knowledge retrieval.
Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems using MCP and related protocols.
Work closely with business and technology teams to translate requirements into scalable AI solutions.
Evaluate, fine-tune, and deploy AI models for production environments.
Ensure AI solutions are secure, scalable, and performance-optimized.

Required Skills
Strong hands-on experience in Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
Expertise in RAG, vector databases, embeddings, and prompt engineering.
Experience with Agent Frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, LangChain, etc.).
Knowledge of Agentic AI concepts and implementations.
Experience with MCP, API integrations, and AI orchestration.
Proficiency in Python and AI/ML development ecosystem.
Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP) is an advantage.
Qualification: BE / BTech / MTech / MCA / BCA

Description:
Key Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain Alteryx workflows for data preparation, transformation, and integration.
Develop and support ETL/data workflows to ingest, cleanse, validate, and enrich data from multiple sources.
Translate business requirements into technical workflow designs and reusable components/macros.
Implement data quality checks, reconciliation logic, and exception handling to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Optimize workflow performance by improving logic, reducing run time, and managing resource usage effectively.
Document workflow logic, data mappings, and operational steps to support maintainability and handovers.
Collaborate with analysts, data engineers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues and deliver enhancements.
Support production runs, monitor scheduled workflows, and resolve failures within defined timelines.

Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelors degree (or equivalent) in Engineering/Technology/Computer Applications/Science (e.g., BTech, BE, BSc, MCA, MTech, MSc).
2-5years of experience working with Alteryx to build and maintain data preparation or automation workflows.
Strong hands-on experience in ETL and data workflow development, including transformation and validation steps.
Solid understanding of data concepts such as joins, aggregations, filtering, data types, and schema handling.
Ability to analyze requirements, debug workflow issues, and deliver reliable outputs with attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.
Understanding of analytics lifecycle practices such as versioning, documentation standards, and reusable workflow design.
Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders, present findings, and recommend improvements to data processes.
Good to have skills:
SQL, Data Warehousing, Data Quality Frameworks, Power BI, Python

About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.
What You’ll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.

0–3 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role.
Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools
Prior experience in logistics, e-commerce, D2C, or B2B sales will be an added advantage.

Description:
Position - Business Development Manager

Location - Chandigarh

Experience - 2 - 8 Years


Job Summary:
The Business Development Manager will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, building and maintaining client relationships, and driving company growth through new customer acquisition. This role requires a strong ERP sales background and the ability to develop and execute business development strategies.

Roles and Responsibilities:
Develop and implement strategic business development plans
Identify new market opportunities and potential clients
End to End Sales Cycle from Lead Generation, Prospecting, Software Demo, Discovery, Solution, Negotiate and close business deals
Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and key stakeholders
Collaborate with internal teams to drive company growth
Analyze market trends and competitor activities
Qualifications:
2-7 years of experience in ERP sales or business development.
Bachelor's / master s degree in business administration or related field
Proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales targets
Excellent communication and negotiation skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.


Benefits:

We like to think that talent grows at Ginesys and stays at Ginesys. To ensure this, we provide our employees with the best working environment, the latest technology and continuous support. We go out of our way to retain the small business feeling with which we started and stimulate innovation and collaboration through teamwork and our non-hierarchical approach. We offer competitive salary, and other fantastic perks and benefits, such as:

Ginesys Academy for holistic training and development
Comprehensive health insurance coverage
Excellent rewards and recognition policy
Transparent compensation policy with no unnecessary deduction in CTC
Annual company off-site and a variety of events, celebrations throughout the year
Travelling opportunities between our offices across the country.
Annual Ginesys walkathon & related sporting events
Quarterly Coffee with CEO
and more!

Here s our story; now tell us yours:

Ginesys is India s best omniretail suite, the first integrated Retail specific ERP software for online and offline retail and distribution. It is the largest Indian company in the retail tech industry catering to both online and offline needs. 1200 + brands including (Manyavar, V-Mart, Skechers) are accelerating their businesses with Ginesys. With a team of 300+ employees, Ginesys One plans to revolutionise retail by being a single-stop cloud-based retail suite.

We have a pan India presence with offices in major cities including Gurgaon, Kolkata, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Mumbai & Goa and are expanding rapidly. We love the challenges of retail and are busy solving them to create a great retail tech suite.

Ginesys core mission is to continue to build world-class internal service capabilities, in a bid to deliver outstanding external service value to customers. We are an ISO-certified and SOC compliant company having won myriad awards for our innovation and support. For further information, please visit our website http://ginesys.in
AboutCompany:
Ginesys develops retail technology software for retailers, brands and e-commerce businesses. Its products include ERP, POS, omnichannel and inventory management solutions. The company enables digital transformation across retail operations.
